chapters.title: Chapter 101: Do You Dare To Touch Them?!
paragraphs: After a while, the celebration began.
As for the other programs, Chen Yun simply watched them. After all, he had come to watch Mengmeng and Xiao Xue’s program.
At this moment, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were preparing backstage. Beside them was the anxious student union president.
“What did you say? You haven’t been able to contact Wang Yiting?!”
“It’s about to begin. What is she trying to do?!”
“If she still doesn’t come, I’ll definitely tell the Dean about this! What is she doing?! She’s still acting like a big shot at a time like this!”
The student union president’s roar shocked Chen Mengmeng and the others.
However, Wang Yiting came a while later!

She was not the only one. There were also assistants, managers, and bodyguards beside her. The crowd was majestic. Those who knew her would know that she was a B-list celebrity, but those who didn’t would think that she was some leader!

Han Xue wanted to pull Chen Mengmeng to greet Wang Yiting, but Chen Mengmeng grabbed her hand. “Let’s just do our job. Anyway, the protagonist of this drama is not us. There’s no need to care about her.”
Chen Mengmeng did not believe that a person who had not been to many rehearsals could put on an outstanding performance.
As she spoke, Wang Yiting walked past them without looking at them.
Han Xue also understood and rehearsed with Chen Mengmeng.
They wanted to ensure that nothing went wrong!
Half an hour later, it was their turn to perform. Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were wearing ancient gauze clothes with sequins. Coupled with elegant music, they appeared gracefully.
Their dance steps and gentle posture shocked everyone present.
“Meng Xue, Meng Xue, Meng Xue!”
“We love you. Come on!”
For a moment, the commotion shocked Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue. They did not expect themselves to be so popular. However, although they were shocked, their dancing was not affected at all.

Behind them, not only were the boys cheering, but even the female seniors looked at the two juniors on the stage and cheered them on. After all, their dance skills were far inferior to the skills of these two girls.
“They’re so beautiful!”
“I heard that they’re the two students with the highest results among the new students in this art exam! From the looks of it, they’re outstanding. They’re really talented to have such results.”
“Originally, I thought that letting the freshmen come up was nonsense. Now, it seems that the Dean was really too bold and insightful!”
Many people were discussing this lineup.
The commotion became louder and louder!
It even surpassed the previous programs.
One had to know that there were celebrities in the previous programs, but none of them had such an effect!
Backstage, Wang Yiting looked at the two of them and smiled. The Jiang City University of the Arts was just so-so. If two freshmen could have such a commotion, what would happen if she went up?
At that moment, she puffed out her chest proudly and walked up with the microphone.
However, she did not cause much of a stir. Instead, it suppressed the commotion just now.
For a moment, Wang Yiting’s expression turned ugly. She thought that there would be more cheers after she went on stage, but there was nothing!
There were no flowers! There were no posters! There were even fewer praises!
In fact, the influence of her appearance was not as impressive as before she appeared!
For a moment, she glanced at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, her eyes filled with hatred!

With such a mentality, coupled with the fact that she had only rehearsed twice before, Wang Yiting was not in a good state when she sang. She was not good to begin with, but now, the entire show’s effect had been ruined by her!
“What’s going on! This singing is simply ruining the dance!”
“Ahhh! I’ve been listening to Sister Menghan’s new songs recently, but hearing such songs now is like pouring shit into my ears.”
“What the hell! I can sing better than her even if I go. There’s no need to brag at all!”
As these people spoke, many people nodded in agreement.
The entire audience was discussing animatedly. There was even booing.
The booing started to spread. Then, everyone in the venue began to boo.
The fans of “Meng Xue” started cursing.
“Get lost! What are you singing? You’re simply ruining Mengmeng and Han Xue’s dance!”
“That’s right. They’re already worlds apart. She can send Tang Sanzang to the afterlife!”
The entire audience was filled with resentment!
Even Du Haochen frowned. He felt nauseous listening to Wang Yiting’s singing.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun ignored them. His gaze was on Mengmeng and Xiao Xue.
The atmosphere below the stage was immediately transmitted to the stage. When Wang Yiting heard the boos and curses, her already gloomy turned even darker.
She looked at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue behind her, the hatred in her eyes intensifying!
However, the two of them did not seem to be affected. They continued to maintain a high-level dance. With the rhythm of the music, every move was perfect, revealing the results of their hard work.
The more this was the case, the greater the contrast was!
Wang Yiting was so angry that she couldn’t even sing a few lyrics.
For a moment, there were curses everywhere!

When Wang Yiting saw this scene, she adjusted her expression and took a few steps forward. As she walked, she sang. Like a celebrity’s concert, she strolled around the entire stage, blocking Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue’s dance path from time to time.
The two of them had no choice but to adjust their routes at the last minute.
Seeing that her scheme had failed, Wang Yiting took a step back and quickly appeared in front of Chen Mengmeng.
Due to inertia, Chen Mengmeng lost her balance and bumped into Wang Yiting before running into Han Xue.
“Ah!”
Cries of surprise suddenly sounded. The two girls fell to the ground, and the entire performance came to an abrupt end!
Wang Yiting’s expression changed. She looked at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue as she sneered. “What are you doing?!”
“When you rehearsed, how did you practice your positions and routes?!”
“I’m so disappointed in you!”
“I didn’t expect the students of the Jiang City University of the Arts to be so unprofessional. I won’t come again even if you invite me! What a joke!”
With that, she slammed the microphone on the stage and left.

No one expected such a scene. Du Haochen immediately waved at the student union president, who quickly got someone to go on stage and helped the stunned Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue backstage. Then, he arranged for the host and the next program to go on stage.
Chen Yun had seen everything just now. He immediately slammed the table and stood up. He snorted and walked backstage.
This slap on the table made the leaders of the entire judging panel nervous. Cold sweat broke out on their foreheads. They knew that Chen Yun was already angry!
Backstage, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue stood there in a daze. This was their first time on stage, but this had happened.

They had practiced this dance for a long time. There were a few times when they practiced it in their dreams. It was impossible for them to make a mistake. The trajectory was also correct. Why did they collide with Wang Yiting?
On the other side, Wang Yiting was also chattering non-stop after coming down from the stage. When she saw the two of them standing there in a daze, she sneered and walked over.

“Look at you. If you can’t do it, don’t go on stage. You were so embarrassing on stage! You’ve embarrassed me completely!” Wang Yiting looked at the two of them and scolded coldly, “Do you know how much my annual salary is?! If this affects me, can you bear the responsibility?!”
“Tell me, how are you going to compensate me?”
“Students from the Jiang City University of the Arts? What the heck!”
The two of them were stunned. After being frightened by Wang Yiting, they were completely overshadowed.
“I’m... I’m sorry,” Chen Mengmeng said with red eyes. After all, it was her mistake.
“I’m sorry? What’s the use of being sorry!” Wang Yiting glared. “Just you wait. I’ll definitely ask your Dean to punish you severely and get you out of the Acting Department!”
“You students are really getting worse and worse! You’re really trash!”
The more Wang Yiting spoke, the more agitated she became. In the end, she raised her hand and prepared to slap Chen Mengmeng’s face!
Thud!
The next moment, a muffled sound came from the door!
Chen Yun simply kicked the door open and looked at Wang Yiting, who was waving her hand. His eyes were extremely cold.
“What are you trying to do?!”
“If you touch them today, I’ll skin you alive!”

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Banned!
paragraphs: “What are you trying to do?!”
“If you touch them today, I’ll skin you alive!”
He was furious!
Coupled with the kick at the door previously, everyone backstage was shocked by Chen Yun.
Pairs of eyes looked at Chen Yun, not knowing what had happened!
At this moment, Chen Yun’s face was gloomy, and his eyes were like those of a wild wolf, emitting a cold light. It was as if a single glance could freeze someone to death!

Chen Mengmeng had been the apple of his eye since she was young. He held her in his hands as he was afraid that she would fall. After so many years, he had not even scolded her, let alone hit her. Now, someone actually wanted to touch her?!
Wang Yiting was asking for death!
At this moment, Wang Yiting was stunned by Chen Yun’s roar. She stood there in a daze, her hand hanging in the air, not knowing what to do.

“Who are you? How dare you shout at me!” Wang Yiting lowered her hand and looked at Chen Yun. She frowned and her face was filled with displeasure. When she said this, her sharp voice simply stimulated everyone’s ears.

Wang Yiting had been acting like a big shot for a long time. Looking at Chen Yun’s young appearance, she simply did not take him seriously. She immediately sneered and wanted to see what he could do for her.
Seeing Chen Yun walk over, she waved her hand. The two bodyguards immediately walked up and pressed Chen Yun’s shoulder. “Kid, what do you want?”
“I’ll give you one chance. Get lost.”
Chen Yun spoke coldly. This sentence made the two burly men sneer. What was this kid talking about? Although he was lean, he should have taken a look at who he was facing.
The two of them were bodyguards. They were both muscular and more than 1.9 meters tall. This kid actually dared to talk nonsense in front of them. It was simply ridiculous!
“Hehe, kid, you...”
Crack!
Before one of the men could finish speaking, Chen Yun grabbed his forearm and simply twisted it!
The other man was also kicked out by Chen Yun. Blood flowed from the corner of his mouth as he clutched his chest and screamed.
This!
In an instant, even Wang Yiting did not expect Chen Yun to have such ability. In two moves, he crippled the two bodyguards she had spent a lot of money to hire!
Then, Chen Yun walked up to Wang Yiting.
Wang Yiting also swallowed and looked at the aggressive Chen Yun.
However, in the next moment, she also thought it through. So what if Chen Yun could fight? They were only two bodyguards, and she was a B-list celebrity!
Did he dare to touch her?!
Everyone was watching. If Chen Yun dared to touch her, she would dare to hire a lawyer and send Chen Yun to jail!
“What do you want!” Wang Yiting put her hands on her hips and looked arrogant. “If you dare to touch me today, I’ll send you to prison! I’ll make you lose! Your! Reputation!”
Every word made everyone’s hearts tremble.
Seeing that the situation was not good, the president of the student union was about to come up and mediate the situation when he saw Chen Yun raise his hand.
Pa!
A crisp sound rang out!
It was extremely clear!
Five finger marks were imprinted on Wang Yiting’s face!
Wang Yiting fell to the ground and covered her face with a shocked expression.
At the side, when everyone saw this scene, they were also shocked. Their eyes widened, and they could not believe what they were seeing!
Someone actually slapped Wang Yiting?!
This...
When the student union president saw this scene, he cried out in his heart. It was a small matter if they quarreled. However, if Chen Yun attacked now, it would be a big deal!
“Good! Good, good, good! How dare you hit me? How dare you hit me?!” Wang Yiting sat on the ground and pointed at Chen Yun. “Just you wait. How dare you hit me? Do you know who I am?!”
“Do you know who you are?!”
“You’re going to jail!”

Her words made the students beside them worry. They looked at Chen Yun. Although Chen Yun was able to vent his anger with this slap, based on Wang Yiting’s temper and personality, she might really throw him into prison.
If he really went to prison, it would leave an extremely disgraceful scene in his records. The rest of his life might also be greatly affected.
This...
The student union president leaned closer to Chen Yun. “Student, you’re too impulsive. You should quickly apologize to her. Don’t be stubborn anymore.”

“That’s right. Don’t mess around with her. We can’t win against her,” said a few female students softly. After all, Wang Yiting was now a quasi-B-list celebrity. In the eyes of the students, this was already quite a high position.

“Can’t win against her?” Chen Yun’s lips curled into a cold smile. He looked at Wang Yiting, who was sitting on the ground and making a scene, and snorted. “You don’t have to stay in the entertainment industry anymore. Get lost.”
“You don’t have to stay in the entertainment industry anymore. Get lost!”
His words stunned everyone present, including Wang Yiting.
Then, Chen Yun took out his phone and called Ma Ke.
Seeing Chen Yun’s actions, Wang Yiting, who was on the ground, laughed loudly.
What a joke!
Was he trying to ban her?!
Who the hell was he?!
A stinky student actually dared to show off in front of her!

“Kid, are you trying to scare me? Let me tell you, ban me? Dream on. Do you know who’s behind me? I’m not afraid to tell you the truth. My boyfriend is the manager of Central South Entertainment’s Operations Department, Huang Shi’an!”
Huang Shian!
He was the manager of Central South Entertainment’s Operations Department!
The students’ eyes widened. Although they knew that Wang Yiting’s acting skills were so bad and she was supported by someone, they did not expect her to have such a strong source of support.
Central South Entertainment was a medium-sized entertainment company in the south. Last month, they made a huge profit from a literary film.
“Central South Entertainment’s Huang Shi’an, right? Alright.” Chen Yun nodded and sent another message.
Just as he sent the message, a group of people rushed in. It was none other than Du Haochen. When Du Haochen saw the situation in front of him, his eyes almost popped out!
Wang Yiting looked at Du Haochen. “Dean Du, this must be a student from your school. The students of the Jiang City University of the Arts are really impressive. They even dare to hit me!”
“Let me tell you, he’s not the only one who will suffer today’s incident. The reputation of the Jiang City University of the Arts will also be ruined!”
“This matter is not over!”

When Du Haochen heard Wang Yiting’s words, he quickly walked up and looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, it’s all my fault today. It’s all because I didn’t choose the guests properly that this happened.”
Du Haochen’s attitude was extremely humble, shocking everyone.
Including Wang Yiting!

The next moment, her phone rang. It was from her agency. She picked it up. “Hello, Sister Wang. I’m at the Jiang City University of the Arts. I was beaten up by a student. You have to help me. Throw him into...”

Before she could finish speaking, a voice roared from the other end. “What are you doing? Let me tell you, you’re finished! The higher-ups have already issued a notice! They’re going to ban you completely!”
These words made Wang Yiting sit there, paralyzed. She was stunned.

Last month, they made a huge profit from a literary film.
“Central South Entertainment’s Huang Shi’an, right?
Alright.” Chen Yun nodded and sent another message.
Just as he sent the message, a group of people rushed in.
It was none other than Du Haochen.
When Du Haochen saw the situation in front of him, his eyes almost popped out!
Wang Yiting looked at Du Haochen.
“Dean Du, this must be a student from your school.
The students of the Jiang City University of the Arts are really impressive.
They even dare to hit me!”
“Let me tell you, he’s not the only one who will suffer today’s incident.
The reputation of the Jiang City University of the Arts will also be ruined!”
“This matter is not over!”
When Du Haochen heard Wang Yiting’s words, he quickly walked up and looked at Chen Yun.
“Director Chen, it’s all my fault today.
It’s all because I didn’t choose the guests properly that this happened.”
Du Haochen’s attitude was extremely humble, shocking everyone.
Including Wang Yiting!
The next moment, her phone rang.
It was from her agency.
She picked it up.
“Hello, Sister Wang.
I’m at the Jiang City University of the Arts.
I was beaten up by a student.
You have to help me.
Throw him into...”
Before she could finish speaking, a voice roared from the other end.
“What are you doing?
Let me tell you, you’re finished!
The higher-ups have already issued a notice!
They’re going to ban you completely!”
These words made Wang Yiting sit there, paralyzed.
She was stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Eight Billion!
paragraphs: Wang Yiting held the phone, her mind blank. How could she have expected things to turn out like this? She had originally wanted her management company to help her send Chen Yun to prison, but in the end, what was going on?

“But... Why did they ban me? My boyfriend is Huang Shi’an! With him around, who would dare to ban me?!” The reason why Wang Yiting was arrogant and acted like a big shot every day and took on so many roles was because Huang Shi’an supported her from behind!
The manager of Central South Entertainment’s Operations Department was someone many people wanted to curry favor with!
“Huang Shi’an? Hehe.”
The person on the other end of the phone sneered. “Don’t even think about it. Just now, Huang Shi’an was directly kicked out of Central South Entertainment.”
“Now, Huang Shi’an is nothing!”
“Go back to the company later and terminate your contract. Compensate the company for its losses!”
Wang Yiting held the phone and collapsed. She looked at Chen Yun. “Who... are you?”
Du Haochen sneered. “Director Chen is the Chairman and the largest shareholder of Sacred Heaven Entertainment. He is definitely the controlling shareholder!”
The absolute controller of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!

These words made Wang Yiting’s eyes widen and her spirit collapsed. She sat on the ground with lifeless eyes. She finally understood why Chen Yun was so capable. He banned her with a phone call and sent a message to Central South Entertainment to kick Huang Shi’an out!
This was because!
In front of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Central South Entertainment was nothing!
The entire entertainment industry had to respect Sacred Heaven Entertainment. If Sacred Heaven Entertainment wanted to ban an actor, who would dare to disrespect them?!
Who would dare to offend such a colossus for her...
Chen Yun looked at Wang Yiting and Du Haochen. “Dean Du, your department celebration is quite interesting.”

These words made Du Haochen’s forehead break out in cold sweat. A chill rose from his feet and rushed straight to his heart. Meanwhile, the leaders of the department beside him froze and did not dare to say a word.
“Director Chen, I’m not good at hiring people and have made you unhappy.”

“If it happens again, I don’t mind looking for the Principal of the Jiang City University of the Arts and asking him to consider choosing another candidate for the Dean of the Acting Department. I think he will respect my request.”
His words were extremely threatening.
Du Haochen immediately bowed.
What Chen Yun meant could not be clearer. If Du Haochen let Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue suffer in the future, his position as the Dean would be lost!
Then, Chen Yun brought Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue out, leaving only the stunned crowd.
After walking out of the auditorium, Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, who asked him, “Are you still angry?”

“Brother, we’ve embarrassed ourselves in front of you.” Chen Mengmeng’s eyes were still red. She had prepared meticulously for so many days just to show Chen Yun that she was not just a pretty vase. She was constantly improving herself with her own efforts.
But now, she still messed up.
“Alright, it’s fine.” Chen Yun smiled. “It’s not your fault. That woman suddenly jumped into your path. I saw it all.”
“Besides, you and Xiao Xue were already dancing very well. I’ve seen your efforts. Good.”
At this moment, no one’s words were as useful as Chen Yun’s. Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue’s mood immediately improved.
In the next moment, many people came out of the auditorium and saw Chen Yun and the others.
“Over there!”
Someone shouted. He was still holding the posters of Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue. The men and women beside him were all holding light sticks or boards with the words “Meng Xue”.

“Junior Chen Mengmeng, Junior Han Xue, we went backstage to look for you just now, but they said that you had already left.” A girl walked over and handed them the flowers in her hand. “We’re your fan club.”
“Ah? We... have a fan club?” Chen Mengmeng was stunned. She looked at everyone in disbelief, her eyes filled with gratitude.

A boy at the side nodded. “That’s not all. The two of you are already two belles in the Acting Department. Now, the two of you are already first and second on the department belle selection platform.”

“Just now, the student council president also sent a message. We all know the truth. It was Wang Yiting who acted like a big shot and didn’t come to rehearsals. It was also her who suddenly blocked your dance path.”
“Don’t be sad. We’re all behind you.”
“Meng Xue! Meng Xue! Meng Xue!”
Even Chen Yun was pushed out by these fans.
Chen Yun was confused.
[Host, please check in.]
Coincidentally, it was time to check in.
[Check-in successful.]
[The host has completed the additional mission.]
[Activating bonus reward.]
[Reward issued.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining one billion yuan!]
Then, the dice of the Random Double skill began to spin.
Eight times!
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining eight billion yuan!]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a supreme-grade card!]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a reward of eight Dimensional Spaces!]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a supreme-grade Dragon Spring Tang Sword! It has been sent to your Dimensional Space!]
Did he receive so many rewards?
Was it because he had completed the additional mission?
He had received eight billion yuan! Coupled with the previous four to five billion yuan, Chen Yun already had an extremely terrifying capital flow!
He had a capital flow of more than 10 billion!
With this, he had the capital to deal with the entire Su family and uproot them!
Moreover, he had obtained a supreme-grade card! Currently, Chen Yun already had two supreme-grade cards!
Among them, he was most interested in the supreme-grade Dragon Spring Tang Sword. However, he was too embarrassed to take it out in public. After all, it was a restricted sword.
The next moment, a few girls from the fan club turned around and came over.
“Handsome, let’s add each other on WeChat, okay?”
“We’ve been watching you for a long time.”
“Are you also a student of the Jiang City University of the Arts?”
A few people surrounded him and asked Chen Yun questions, making him feel a little desperate. Sometimes, it was not good to have too much charm.

After a while, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue completely recovered their spirits and were brought out of the Jiang City University of the Arts by Chen Yun. At noon, they went to the First-Grade Restaurant and ate heartily. It could be considered a celebratory feast.
During this time, Zhou Jingyi walked in.
“Director Chen, these are the accounts for the past few days and the situation at the First-Grade Situation.”
Chen Yun glanced at it. Although the income of the First-Grade Residence was much more terrifying than that of East Sea City, it was not enough to catch Chen Yun’s eye.
After dinner, the two little girls said that they wanted to go shopping. After all, they had been preparing for the exam for so long. Now that the exam was over, they should relax.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun called Ma Ke, Jiang Zhengyu, and Zheng Yuan to gather at the East Mountain Villa.
When they arrived, Sun Wenkai had already brewed tea. Chen Yun sat at the head of the table and looked at the three people who had rushed over. He waved his hand.
After the three of them sat down, Chen Yun’s fingers gently tapped the table, his eyes filled with coldness.
“I called you here today to say one thing.”
“It’s time to attack the Su family.”

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Surging Like a Gathering Storm!
paragraphs: “It’s time to attack the Su family.”
Chen Yun’s words made the three people who had just taken a sip of tea almost spit out the tea in their mouths.
What?
What was Director Chen talking about?!
Were they going to attack the Su family so soon?!

Although they had laid the groundwork for a long time, the Su family’s foundation was still there. Many companies were entangled with them and could not be cut off. Under such circumstances, even if they destroyed the Su family in the end, they would have to pay an extremely high price!

It could be said that they had a 70-30 chance of winning against the Su family. However, if the Su family had any backup plans, it might not be the case. Therefore, they did not recommend attacking the Su family now. Otherwise, it would be a huge blow to them.
It was equivalent to killing 1,000 enemies and sacrificing 800 of their soldiers!
Jiang Zhengyu immediately voiced his thoughts.
Jiang Zhengyu was from the military. Although he had been in the business world for so many years and was less straightforward, he was still a frank person who was unwilling to beat around the bush.
After hearing this, Chen Yun sneered. “With 100 million yuan, we can’t touch the Su family.”
“One billion yuan is not enough to destroy the Su family.”
“Then, is ten billion yuan enough to make the Su family fall?”
Ten billion!
The three of them were stunned. They looked at Chen Yun with widened eyes. They could not believe what they had heard. Ten billion yuan!
It was money! Not real estate!
Currently, Chen Yun’s real estate had long exceeded a worth of 10 billion.
However, unexpectedly, Director Chen actually still had 10 billion yuan in funds!
Ten billion yuan could be used to wage a price war with the Su family, cut off the connections between the Su family and other companies, and snipe the shares of the Su family’s businesses!

Chen Yun looked at the three of them. “Now, I’ll pay ten billion. I want you to use the lowest price to destroy the Su family. In the future, there will only be one big tree in Jiang City, and that will be us!”
These words made the three of them feel their blood boil.
Chen Yun looked at them. He wanted to command this battle personally. He wanted to destroy the Su family personally!
“Ma Ke, come up with a countermeasure. I’ll give you a day.”
“Yes, Director Chen!”
Ma Ke suddenly stood up. He naturally knew the importance of this battle to the Sacred Heaven and Chen Yun!
Now, Chen Yun had actually handed such a heavy burden to him. How could he not be touched? How could he not use his full strength?
At this moment, in the Su family.
Sitting on the main seat was an old man with white hair and beard. He wore a long coat and sat on an armchair. Beside him was a dragon-headed walking stick, looking dignified.
Su Yuncheng sat below.
The next moment, the two of them looked outside and stood up at the same time. They walked forward. A man in a wheelchair was pushed in through the door.
It was none other than Kawakaze Kei, whose legs had been shot through by Chen Yun!

“Mr. Kawakaze, you’ve been discharged.” The old man leaned on his dragon-headed walking stick and looked at Kawakaze Kei with a flattering smile. Beside him, Su Yuncheng also forced a smile at Kawakaze Kei.
“Mr. Su, you must be anxious,” said Kawakaze Kei in awkward Chinese. “I heard in the hospital that the Su family hasn’t been doing well recently.”
As soon as he said this, even the Su family’s family head, Su Qingtian, laughed bitterly. Currently, the Su Family was not just in a bad state.
Since some time ago, Sacred Heaven Entertainment began to attack Huaying. Ma Ke released the Heavenly Spirit Water and removed many of the Su family’s wings.
Meanwhile, Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Yuan took the opportunity to lead many companies to suppress the Su family’s business.

The Su family’s extensive network of connections had been cut off in a short period of time, and their profits had plummeted. If this continued, the Su family would fall into an extremely difficult situation in less than half a year.
At that time, the Su family would not be able to retaliate at all!
They would be at the mercy of Chen Yun and Sacred Heaven!
At that time, the outcome of the Su family could be imagined!
Thinking of this, Su Yuncheng looked indignant. The matter of him being thrown out of the East Mountain Villa by Chen Yun appeared in his mind again, making him clench his fists tightly!
“Mr. Kawakaze Kei must have some good ideas for coming here at this time, right?” Su Qingtian looked at Kawakaze Kei as if he was looking at a life-saving straw.
Kawakaze Kei sneered. “Of course.”
“The Three Spirits Financial Group invested three billion yuan into the Su family.”
Three billion!

Su Qingtian was instantly excited. With this three billion, the Su family could be revitalized and made more profitable. Moreover, this could be considered as establishing connections with the Three Spirits Financial Group. This way, the Su family would have a chance to soar in the future!
Kawakaze Kei looked at Su Qingtian’s expression. “It’s not just this three billion. My family also asked me to bring a group of 20 assassins that have been nurtured for a long time.”

“Each of them was once a mercenary and has undergone unbearable training. These assassins of the Three Spirits Financial Group were nurtured by us and have an important strategic position in our family. They are usually used to deal with business disputes and carry out beheading operations.”
This!

When Su Qingtian heard this, his heart skipped a beat. The Su family had also nurtured a batch of such people, but they were formed by young hooligans. Although they had undergone training and knew how to use firearms, their combat strength was inferior to Jiang Zhengyu’s bodyguards, let alone the assassins nurtured by the Three Spirits Financial Group.
Their assassins were specially used to kill big shots!

With such power, if they could get rid of Chen Yun without anyone knowing, the Sacred Heaven alliance would be leaderless and the battlefront would collapse. At that time, Sacred Heaven, Cauldron Dragon Security, and the Zheng Corporation would be easy targets.

“Good! That’s great!” Su Qingtian and Su Yuncheng were both smiling. “I didn’t expect the Three Spirits Financial Group to help us like this. Our Su family will definitely be endlessly grateful to the Three Spirits Financial Group!”
Kawakaze Kei nodded. “However, the Three Spirits Financial Group will not help you for nothing.”
“Of course. As long as you ask, the Su family will definitely do our best.”
“Alright!” Kawakaze Kei smirked. “I want the jade seal!”
“Moreover, after taking down Jiang City, the Su family will become the springboard for the Three Spirits Financial Group to open up in China.”

Although the Three Spirits Financial Group enjoyed a good reputation in their country, it did not have many markets in Jiangbei. Although he was the person in charge of Jiangbei, he knew that the Chamber of Commerce formed by the five big families in Jiangbei was not their place to interfere.
That was why they wanted to use the Su family as a springboard to open the door to Jiangbei from Jiang City!
Meanwhile, Su Qingtian and Su Yuncheng agreed without any hesitation.

To them, this was simply a good thing. This way, the Su family could rely on the Three Spirits Financial Group and rely on the power of the Three Spirits Financial Group to reach the top of Jiang City!
Needless to say, after arriving in Jiang City, the Su Family could still develop outside of Jiang City. Their future was promising!

Although the Three Spirits Financial Group enjoyed a good reputation in their country, it did not have many markets in Jiangbei.
Although he was the person in charge of Jiangbei, he knew that the Chamber of Commerce formed by the five big families in Jiangbei was not their place to interfere.
That was why they wanted to use the Su family as a springboard to open the door to Jiangbei from Jiang City!
Meanwhile, Su Qingtian and Su Yuncheng agreed without any hesitation.
To them, this was simply a good thing.
This way, the Su family could rely on the Three Spirits Financial Group and rely on the power of the Three Spirits Financial Group to reach the top of Jiang City!
Needless to say, after arriving in Jiang City, the Su Family could still develop outside of Jiang City.
Their future was promising!

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Unintentional
paragraphs: After discussing this matter for a while, Kawakaze Kei left in satisfaction.
Then, Su Qingtian looked at Su Yuncheng. “Yuncheng, the Su family has been passed down for decades. We’ve built such a huge family business. Now, we’re at a critical juncture.”

“I’m old, and you can’t always be under my wing. If I die one day, the Su family will definitely be in chaos. Your uncles, including your father, are all disappointing. I watched you grow up in the entire Su family, and I know your temper the best. You can lead the Su family to the light.”

“Therefore, you must seize this opportunity. As long as we succeed this time, we will be able to climb up with the Three Spirits Financial Group. At that time, not to mention Sacred Heavens, even Jiang City will be under our feet. In the future, we might be able to compete for the position of the sixth major family in Jiangbei!”
“Furthermore, this is also a good opportunity for you to establish your might and convince the masses.”

“Let go and do it. The Su family also has a team that I’ve nurtured. I’ll mobilize 30 people for you to command. No matter what, you can only succeed and not fail. No matter what method you use, as long as you achieve victory in the end, you’ll be the winner!”

These few words shocked Su Yuncheng. The corners of his mouth curled into a smile. Grandpa’s words meant that he wanted to hand the Su family to him. As long as he defeated Sacred Heaven and Chen Yun this time, the Su family would be his.
In the future, Jiang City would also be his!
Thinking of this, Su Yuncheng’s eyes flashed with extreme madness when he thought of Chen Yun.
The next moment, his phone rang. Su Yuncheng picked it up.
“What’s wrong?”
“Young Master, Wang Menghan has a dispute with us because of the copyright. What should we do now?” The person on the other end said in a panic.
After all, Wang Menghan was no longer an ordinary singer. Her four songs had made her popular on the Internet. She had tens of millions of fans and was extremely influential.

“What should we do? Do you need me to teach you such a small matter? Her contract is still in our hands. We have the final say. We’ll do it the same way as before. If she still wants to cause trouble, we’ll ban her. Bitch!”
She issued these songs under Huaying, yet still wanted the copyright. Dream on!
If the copyright was released, Huaying would suffer a huge loss!

Su Yuncheng sneered. Thinking of Wang Menghan, who had once rejected him, he gritted his teeth. “Stupid b*tch, I’ll let you be with that bastard Chen Yun. After I deal with Sacred Heaven and kill Chen Yun, see how I deal with you.”

After receiving Su Yuncheng’s instructions, Manager Su was very unyielding. He looked at Wang Menghan in front of him and sneered. “You’d better know your position. Do you think no one can control you after writing four songs?”

“Let me tell you, if you want the copyright back, there’s no way. If you want to do it, do it. If you don’t, get lost. However, don’t forget, if you breach the contract, the fee for breaching the contract is not something you can afford.” Manager Su was unperturbed. “Why don’t you take a piss and take a look at yourself? What kind of morals do you have!”
You!
Wang Menghan and Zhang Xiaozi looked at Manager Su in front of them, their beautiful eyes filled with anger.
Those songs were Chen Yun’s songs. However, she was unable to keep the copyright now.
How could she face Chen Yun?!

After walking out of Huaying Building, Zhang Xiaozi looked at Wang Menghan beside her, only to see a hint of determination in her eyes. “Xiaozi, no matter what, I can’t let it go like this. Even if I’m banned, even if my reputation is ruined, even if I have to pay a high fee to breach the contract, I have to get the copyright back.”
“You!”
Zhang Xiaozi sighed. “This is also my dereliction of duty. I didn’t expect Huaying to be so crazy as to come up with such an idea to cheat us of our copyrights. I’m going all out!”
Three hours later, a 4,000-word article was posted on Wang Menghan’s Weibo.
The post was about Wang Menghan being squeezed dry by Huaying for so many years and about Huaying’s robbery of the copyright!
Every word was deeply rooted in their hearts!
Just by looking at it once, it made people feel indignant and criticize Huaying!
With Wang Menghan’s number of fans and her current popularity on the Internet, this Weibo post was reposted by everyone online in a short period of time. The speed was simply shocking.
“Did you see Wang Menghan’s revelation? Huaying is really too despicable!”
“How dare you cheat her of the copyright!”
“What an evil heart! Do you like benefiting from the misfortune of others?”
On Weibo, this matter quickly fermented. The official Huaying Weibo account was being severely criticized.
Xiao Xin also reposted Wang Menghan’s Weibo immediately. It could be said that this matter was completely pushed to the center of attention.

One had to know that the most popular people on the Internet were Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin. One of them relied on four songs to quickly become famous, while the other relied on her fame as the God of Luck to have a large number of fans!
For a moment, the entire internet began to target Huaying Entertainment.

On the Huoyin short video platform, all the videos that interpreted this matter had at least hundreds of thousands of views. The videos with the highest number of views had already reached hundreds of millions of views!
On Bilibili, this incident had once again set off another wave of frenzy. The MAD video1 zone was even more explosive than before!
For a moment, all the major forums were discussing this matter intensely. The matter quickly fermented and dealt a huge blow to Huaying Entertainment and the Su family!
Nearing the close of the market, the stock price of Huaying fell to the limit!

Moreover, the trend was obvious. After all, they had already become the target of the entire Internet attack, just like the Flying Fish live-stream platform previously. The consequences could be imagined.
In the Sacred Heaven Building.
Even Chen Yun and Ma Ke did not expect such a situation to happen.

“This...” Ma Ke smiled bitterly. “This really helped a lot. The foundation of the Su family is Huaying. Now that Huaying is in dire straits, the entire Su family and the Su family’s alliance will go bankrupt in a few days!”
Chen Yun did not expect that Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin, who he had unintentionally planted, would become his two sharp swords that pierced through the Su family’s heart!
“Ma Ke, you can’t let your guard down. Get rid of the Su family as quickly as possible.”
Chen Yun looked out at the falling night and took out his phone to call Chen Mengmeng. He was about to ask if they were done shopping, but no one picked up.
“This is really strange. They seem to have said that they wanted to go to Lexiang Valley,” muttered Chen Yun.

Lexiang Valley was equivalent to an amusement park and shopping city. It was an entertainment and shopping place in Jiangtan District that was specially opened by Jiang City. A large amount of money was invested to boost the economy of Jiangtan District, which was far away from the city.
“I’ll go.” Chen Yun looked at the three of them. “I’ll go out for a while.”
“Director Chen, we’re here. Don’t worry.” Ma Ke swore that his desire for the upcoming victory was greater than anyone else’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Attack!
paragraphs: Chen Yun stood in front of the glass wall and looked at the bustling scene outside.
He was about to stand at the peak of Jiang City!
After walking out, Chen Yun drove the Mercedes-Benz G-Class towards Lexiang Valley.

There were not many cars on the road. After all, Lexiang Valley was far from the city center and it was almost closing time. Chen Yun drove and looked at the two black cars in the rearview mirror. He frowned slightly.
The two cars behind him seemed to be following him.
At that moment, Chen Yun tentatively turned right. The two cars behind him also turned right.
He stepped on the accelerator!
The Mercedes-Benz G-Class suddenly roared and rushed forward.
The two cars also accelerated.
In the black car.

“No, we can’t catch up to him. His car is too good!” A member of the Su family spoke. Then, the masked man in the passenger seat opened the skylight and stuck his head out to take out a light sniper rifle.
Bang!
One shot blew up Chen Yun’s tire!
“Well done!”
The driver instantly smiled happily. This was extremely comfortable.
Chen Yun also did not expect the people chasing him to have a gun.
It was the Su family!
The Su family was actually so crazy!
They actually got someone to kill him!

The tire of Chen Yun’s Mercedes-Benz G-Class was blown up. He could only park by the roadside after driving for a short distance. Two black cars surrounded him. Eight burly men got out of the car and surrounded Chen Yun. They also suddenly took out their pistols and aimed them at Chen Yun, who was in the driver’s seat.
“Young Master, we’ve already forced him to stop,” said a member of the Su family into the phone. His tone was relaxed. Even he did not expect him to be so relaxed.
“Don’t worry, we’ve pierced through his tires. He can’t run anymore. Now, he’s already a turtle in a jar. He’s like fish on the chopping board. He can only be slaughtered by us.”
“Alright, I’ll definitely kill him and bring his corpse back.” As the man spoke, he fired a shot at the driver’s seat in front of him.
Bang!
One shot!
It didn’t even penetrate the glass!
This car was bulletproof!
The man was also shocked!
Damn it, this kid was really f*cking rich. His usual cars were bulletproof. Did he think he was a high-level leader?!
“Get down!”
The man’s words did not cause any movement at all.
However, there was no panic on his face. This place was far from the city center. It was too late to call for help!
“Set fire and burn him to death!”
Since Chen Yun was not coming down, he would light some gasoline and burn him to death!
As soon as he said this, there was a slight click. The car door opened slightly, and the eight people’s faces were filled with joy.
This kid was quite tactful. In that case, it would save them the trouble.
He grabbed the handle and pulled the door open. The gun in his other hand jerked up, ready to shoot at the driver’s seat.
However, in the next moment.
Whoosh!
A saber was drawn!
The knife cut through the air!
A round object was cut off!
The cold light and blood shone on the faces of the remaining people for a moment, shocking them. Cold air suddenly rose.
Chen Yun was like a ferocious tiger that had been released from its cage. The Dragon Spring Tang Saber in his hand killed people without any blood. With three slashes, three people lay on the ground!
“Die!”
An assassin was the first to react. He raised the gun in his hand, but in the next moment, his arm flew out!
It was a dark and windy night!
When the blood mist rose!
“Hey, hey, hey!”
“What happened?!”
“Say something! Is Mr. Chen dead?!” Su Yuncheng’s voice came from the phone.
The next moment, the phone was picked up.
“Stop shouting. They will never be able to speak again.”
An extremely cold voice sounded, startling Su Yuncheng. “You’re actually not dead!”
“If I’m not dead, it means that the Su family is going to die!” At this moment, Chen Yun’s eyes were extremely cold, as if he could not feel any emotions.
Haha.
A chuckle immediately sounded.
“Mr. Chen, guess who’s in my hands now?”
“Your precious sister is in my hands now. I’ll give you an address now. Come alone. Otherwise, I guarantee that the two of them won’t be able to see the sun tomorrow.”
Su Yuncheng looked at Chen Mengmeng in front of him and grabbed her hair. “Come, come and tell your brother a few things.”
Chen Mengmeng looked at Su Yuncheng with hatred in her eyes. Without saying a word, he kicked her. “F*ck you, stinky b*tch. Speak!”
Chen Mengmeng fell to the ground and grunted. Han Xue, who was beside her, quickly came over to hug her and protect her.
When Chen Yun heard the muffled groan, the coldness in his eyes intensified.
“Listen carefully. If they lose even a strand of hair, I want your entire Su family to die!”
Chen Yun’s words were cold enough and filled with killing intent!

However, in the ears of the current Su Yuncheng, it was as if it was a huge joke. “Mr. Chen, you don’t have to scare me. I was raised in fear! You forced me to do this. Ten minutes. I’ll only give you ten minutes! After ten minutes, I’ll chop off one of her fingers every minute! Don’t test my patience!”
After hanging up, Han Xue looked at Su Yuncheng in front of her. Her eyes were bloodshot. “I’ve already given you the jade seal. Why are you still hitting Mengmeng?!”
“You’re a piece of shit!”

At this moment, Han Xue’s eyes were red. Previously, when she was threatened to save Mengmeng, she was asked to steal the jade seal. In the end, when the jade seal was brought over, they actually went back on their word!

When Su Yuncheng heard Han Xue’s words, he laughed out loud. “I think your brain might be playing tricks. The two of you are such good bargaining chips. Unless I’m stupid, why would I let you go? If I let you go, how could Chen Yun obediently come and be killed by me?!”
“Let me tell you, Chen Yun forced me to do all of this! He offended the Su family and the Three Spirits Financial Group. This is his outcome. This is his retribution!”
“Not only him, but the two of you will also die with him today!”
You!
When Chen Mengmeng heard this, she stood up and ran into Su Yuncheng, wanting to bump into him. However, before she could bump into him, she was grabbed by the man beside her.
“Tie them up. In a while, I want them to see how Chen Yun dies!”
Then, he looked at Kawakaze Kei on the other side, who was playing with the jade seal and touching the patterns at the bottom of the jade seal.
It said, “Having received the Mandate from Heaven, may the Emperor lead a long and prosperous life.”
He naturally knew that there was another supreme treasure inside. Now, these two supreme treasures belonged to the Kawakaze Clan!
“Mr. Kawakaze, congratulations on obtaining the supreme treasure!” Su Yuncheng said respectfully to Kawakaze Kei.

Kawakaze Kei also laughed out loud. “Don’t worry, Su Jun. The Three Spirits Financial Group made a promise with the Su family and won’t go back on our word. As long as we destroy Chen Yun, the Three Spirits Financial Group will inject a large amount of capital again and help the Su family tide over the difficulties. Then, the Su family will become the leader of Jiang City!”
Kawakaze Kei held the jade seal in his hand and was overjoyed. This time, he wanted to bring the jade seal back to the family and never let it out for generations!
“Thank you very much.”
Afraid that something unexpected would happen, Su Yuncheng called his grandfather, Su Qingtian, to report the situation.
The next moment, gunshots came from outside!
He was here!
He was actually so fast!

Then, he looked at Kawakaze Kei on the other side, who was playing with the jade seal and touching the patterns at the bottom of the jade seal.
It said, “Having received the Mandate from Heaven, may the Emperor lead a long and prosperous life.”
He naturally knew that there was another supreme treasure inside.
Now, these two supreme treasures belonged to the Kawakaze Clan!
“Mr.
Kawakaze, congratulations on obtaining the supreme treasure!” Su Yuncheng said respectfully to Kawakaze Kei.
Kawakaze Kei also laughed out loud.
“Don’t worry, Su Jun.
The Three Spirits Financial Group made a promise with the Su family and won’t go back on our word.
As long as we destroy Chen Yun, the Three Spirits Financial Group will inject a large amount of capital again and help the Su family tide over the difficulties.
Then, the Su family will become the leader of Jiang City!”
Kawakaze Kei held the jade seal in his hand and was overjoyed.
This time, he wanted to bring the jade seal back to the family and never let it out for generations!
“Thank you very much.”
Afraid that something unexpected would happen, Su Yuncheng called his grandfather, Su Qingtian, to report the situation.
The next moment, gunshots came from outside!
He was here!
He was actually so fast!

chapters.title: Chapter 107: I Don’t Want to Say It a Third Time!
paragraphs: For a moment, gunshots sounded from outside!
“Young Master Su, that kid drove in!”
A figure hurriedly walked in and reported.
Su Yuncheng could not help but lower his body and stay away from the window. Then, he looked at the surrounding people. “What are you waiting for? Go out and take a look! Help me kill Chen Yun!”
“Yes!”
Outside, a car simply crashed in from the main entrance. Chen Yun opened the car door, rolled out of the car, and pulled the trigger.
For a moment, a bloody mist rose!
With the double enhancement of the Gun King Skill Pack and the Eye of Truth, Chen Yun’s shots were 100% accurate!
There were no missed shots!
With every gunshot, a person’s forehead was pierced!
However, Chen Yun did not expect there to be so many people here. The bullets in his two pistols had been emptied, and there were still almost half of them!
At that moment, he held the Dragon Spring Tang Saber, which was in the black scabbard, and pulled it out!
Under the moonlight, the saber that flickered with a cold light looked even colder!
Facing the black muzzle, Chen Yun simply rushed forward alone!
Hearing the gunshots outside, Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei’s faces were filled with madness. “Haha! I didn’t expect this kid to really dare to come alone!”
At the side, when Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue heard this voice, their faces were filled with anxiety. However, their mouths were sealed with tape, so they could only whimper.
After a while, the gunshots outside subsided.
A crazy smile appeared on Su Yuncheng’s face!
“Alright! Mr. Kawakaze, it seems like that kid has been killed. I’ll push you out!”
A smile also appeared on Kawakaze Kei’s face. Beside him, Chen Mengmeng’s tears flowed uncontrollably when she heard Su Yuncheng’s words.
Su Yuncheng looked at them. “Cry. Your brother has already been killed. It’s time to send you on your way.”
He took out his gun and aimed it at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue.
However, in the next moment, a muffled sound was heard. The door was suddenly knocked open and a burly man flew in. He fell to the ground and his entire chest caved in. He was no longer alive.
This!
Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei suddenly looked outside. Their eyes widened. They simply could not believe what they were seeing. There were already corpses everywhere outside!
Thirty to forty people died just like that!
In a short period of time, they were all dead!
How was this possible?!
Kawakaze Kei’s face was filled with disbelief!
One had to know that the assassins nurtured by the Kawakaze Clan were all assassins who had experienced life and death through hundreds of battles!
It was unknown how much blood the higher-ups of the company had in their hands!
However, they were all down now!
They had fallen under the hands of a 20-year-old youth!
This!
Tap, tap, tap...
Footsteps sounded. The two of them looked outside and saw a figure slowly walking over.
It wasn’t anyone else!
It was Chen Yun, whose suit was stained with blood!

At this moment, Chen Yun was holding the Dragon Spring Tang Saber in his hand. The tip of the saber tapped the ground, and his voice sounded in Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei’s ears like the sound of the God of Death’s chains!
It was shocking!
It was extremely shocking!
Looking at the current Chen Yun, Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei were simply like two frightened quails. All the hair on their bodies stood on end. They did not expect Chen Yun to be so ferocious!
“Don’t come over! If you come over again, I’ll kill them!”
Su Yuncheng was about to raise the gun in his hand when Chen Yun suddenly threw out his Dragon Spring Tang Saber!
The saber tore through the wind!
It directly cut off Su Yuncheng’s forearm!
“Ah!”
A scream suddenly sounded. Su Yuncheng covered his hand and cried in pain.
Chen Yun jumped in and grabbed his neck, lifting Su Yuncheng, who weighed 70 to 75 kilograms!
Su Yuncheng grabbed Chen Yun’s arm with his remaining arm and wanted to pry it open, but it was useless. Chen Yun’s hand was like an iron clamp that could not be moved at all!
“Wuwuwu!” Chen Mengmeng, who had been frightened after seeing the blood, looked at Chen Yun, her eyes lighting up. At this moment, she only had eyes for her brother.
Tears flowed uncontrollably.
Chen Yun looked at the two little girls. “Don’t cry. I’ll bring you out.”
The next moment.
Footsteps came from outside.
Two rows of burly men in black surrounded the entire room. Every burly man was holding a gun, and their black muzzles were aimed at Chen Yun.
The burly men parted, revealing an old man holding a dragon-headed walking stick.
It was none other than Su Qingtian, who had come to prepare to obtain the fruit of victory after hearing Su Yuncheng’s report.
However, he never expected such a scene to appear after coming here!

At this moment, Su Yuncheng looked at the scene outside with a ferocious expression. He shouted with all his might, “Chen Yun, if you dare to touch me, you’re dead! I won’t let you off! You won’t be able to walk out of this door today!”
Pa!
Chen Yun raised his hand and simply slapped Su Yuncheng’s face. In an instant, half of his teeth were slapped off!
“Shut up.”
Su Yuncheng gritted his teeth and swallowed them. He looked at Chen Yun resentfully.
Pa!
Another slap!
The two slaps made both sides of Su Yuncheng’s face swell up.
Su Yuncheng spat out a mouthful of blood. His teeth were shattered, and bloody foam kept coming out of his mouth.
He felt an intense pain. How could Su Yuncheng dare to be arrogant?
“Chen Yun, let go of the Young Master. Otherwise, we’ll blow your head off!”
As the leader of the black-clothed men spoke, he turned his gaze to the high ground not far away.
“Let Young Master go! Otherwise, even if you’re the emperor, you’ll die here today!”
Cold words were spat out at Chen Yun.
The burly man in black threatened Chen Yun. The safety lock of the gun in his hand was even unlocked, ready to attack Chen Yun at any time.
Chen Yun ignored these burly men and picked up Su Yuncheng’s gun from the ground. Then, he carried Su Yuncheng to the door and said as he walked, “Put down your guns.”

This sentence was spoken indifferently. It was not loud and did not carry any emotions. However, when it landed in everyone’s ears, it was as if it had a magical power, causing their hearts to tremble and their hands to tremble unconsciously.
The burly men did not move and looked at Chen Yun. They did not know whether to advance or retreat.
Su Qingtian stood up. “Chen Yun, I’ll give you a chance now. As long as you let Yuncheng go, I can let you go.”
“Do you know what you’re doing now?!”
“You’ve killed people from the Three Spirits Financial Group! Moreover, you’re threatening the safety of Mr. Kawakaze Kei, the person-in-charge of the Three Spirits Financial Group!”
“The power of the Three Spirits Financial Group is not something you can imagine!”
When Chen Yun heard Su Qingtian’s words, he said, “The Three Spirits Financial Group? Hahahaha!”
“So what!”
“If anyone dares to be impudent in China and dares to be impudent in front of me, I’ll teach him a lesson! A bloody lesson!”
The next moment, Chen Yun raised his hand.
Bang!
A gunshot rang out, and Kawakaze Kei’s temple was instantly pierced. Blood flowed out and landed on the jade seal.
This!
Su Qingtian’s eyes widened as he looked at the scene in front of him. He was shocked!
Chen Yun had actually killed Kawakaze Kei!
Chen Yun then pointed the gun at Su Yuncheng’s temple. “I don’t want to repeat myself a third time. Put down your guns!”

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Destruction of the Su Family!
paragraphs: “Put down your guns!”
After these words, Su Yuncheng was the first to be unable to accept it. He shouted loudly, “F*ck your mothers, put down your guns! Don’t you understand human language?!”
“I told you to put down your guns!”
Su Yuncheng roared angrily. At this moment, he was like a furious lion!
Su Qingtian waved his hand and asked the burly men beside him to put down his gun. Then, he looked at Chen Yun. “What do you want? We can talk about it as long as you let Yuncheng go.”
Chen Yun did not speak. He stood there. In the next moment, a team of people walked in.
“Jiang Zhengyu!”
When Su Qingtian saw Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Yuan bringing people over, he immediately frowned!

At this moment, Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Yuan were even more shocked. They looked at the scene in front of them. Just now, Director Chen had asked them to bring people over. They did not expect him to kill his way in just now. Now, he had actually dealt with so many people alone!
He even kidnapped Su Yuncheng!
He had forced Su Qingtian into a corner!
This!
What kind of ruthless person was he?!
“Take them down!” Jiang Zhengyu ordered. A group of bodyguards stepped forward and restrained the burly man in black.
When Su Qingtian saw this scene, it was as if he had aged ten years. “Alright, alright. So you were waiting for them. My Su family has lost. I admit it.”
Chen Yun looked at the defeated Su Qingtian and sneered. “Didn’t you ask me what I wanted just now? I wanted his life.”
Bang!
With a gunshot, Chen Yun pulled the trigger and simply killed Su Yuncheng!
You!
“How dare you!” Su Qian shouted loudly as he grabbed his walking stick!
However, in the next moment, a bloody hole appeared on his head!
There were two shots!
He killed Su Yuncheng and Su Qingtian!
The entire Su family no longer had a pillar that could hold up the sky!
“Director... Director Chen.” Jiang Zhengyu looked at Chen Yun, who was standing there covered in blood, and his voice could not help but tremble.
Chen Yun threw Su Yuncheng down and took off his clothes. He tore them apart and covered the two girls’ eyes. Then, he pulled out the Dragon Spring Tang Saber from the wall and brought them out.
“CEO Jiang.” Chen Yun’s voice was calm, but it had endless dignity.
“I don’t need to teach you how to do it, how to say it, what to say, and what to do, right?” Chen Yun walked out slowly. “The Su family will be expelled from Jiang City.”
“In three days, I want to hold a banquet at the upper echelons of Jiang City at the East Mountain Villa.”
Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Yuan looked at Chen Yun’s back and then at the scene in front of them. Their hearts were naturally as clear as a mirror.
The current Su family had already lost!
Chen Yun and Sacred Heaven were about to reach the peak of Jiang City!
The winner was the king, and the loser was the bandit!
They would also soar. The Jiang family and the Zheng family would obtain unimaginable benefits. Now, what they had to do was to protect Chen Yun and clean up this place!
At night, a huge fire rose from here and burned all traces of everyone.
The traces on the road were also completely dealt with by Jiang Zhengyu.
In the early morning, the news broke.

At that time, the Su family’s patriarch, Su Qingtian, and Young Master Su Yuncheng could not withstand the pressure from the fact that they were about to go bankrupt. Thus, they committed suicide at home.
The next day, when the market opened, Huaying’s shares fell to the limit. Under various pressures, they applied for bankruptcy.
Everything that belonged to the Su family was auctioned off.

If it was any other time, after Su Qingtian died, the various branches of the Su family would have long been unable to interact with each other. They would have beaten one another up until their heads bled. The biological siblings would ask for more of the inheritance in court.
Now, everyone from the Su family was staying in their villas sadly. They looked at the luxurious room decorations around them and felt sad.
Chen Yun did not kill them, but snatching their wealth and chasing them out of Jiang City was even harder than killing them.
“Hurry up and move out. Director Chen has already bought this villa. From now on, it belongs to Director Chen. It has nothing to do with you.”
A group of burly young men barged into the villa group and reprimanded Su Haoguang and the others.

Su Haoguang was Su Qingtian’s third son and the third son in the family. He was also the Vice-Chairman of the Su Corporation. His status was usually respected. When had he ever met someone who came to collect debts from him?
His son, Su An, was Su Yuncheng’s cousin. Now, he jumped up and spoke angrily.
“Who are you? What right do you have to barge into my Su family? Where are the security guards? Hurry up and chase them out.”

“Yo, do you still think you’re the Young Master of the Su family?” The burly man with a black tiger tattoo on his head sneered and said, “All your assets, as well as the entire Su family, belong to Director Chen. This is written on paper in black and white. Do you still want to deny it?”
“The Su family has already become rats on the streets and is hated by everyone. Do you still want to show off like before?”
“But, but.” Su An was instantly at a loss for words.

Su An originally thought that he could take his time in the competition for the family assets. It would not be a problem for him to file a lawsuit and drag it out for a few years so that the Su family could transfer the assets easily. However, he did not expect that debt collectors would directly come to chase them away.

This time, he really panicked. Usually, with the Su family’s power, he could do whatever he wanted in Jiang City. When he went out, he would be in front of everyone. If he wanted any celebrity, the other party would obediently climb into his bed for him to enjoy.
But now, everything was gone!
He had gone from a profligate young master to a pauper!
“Enough!”
Su Haoguang slammed the table and shouted angrily.

After all, he was the Vice-Chairman of the Su family consortium. He had been in a high position for a long time, so his aura was very dignified. The group of valiant young men didn’t dare to be impudent for a moment. At this moment, a group of people suddenly walked in from outside the door. When Su Haoguang saw the person in front, his expression suddenly changed. He stood up and asked.
“CEO Zheng?”

Su Hao recognized Zheng Yuan and saw him coming. He immediately said in a low voice, “Zheng Yuan, the Su family and the Zheng family usually mind our own business. You don’t have to be so ruthless, right? You don’t even give us a few days.”
Zheng Yuan sneered and said, “From today onwards, all the assets here will belong to Director Chen. Third Master Su, you should quickly leave with your son, lest you hurt our harmony.”
Su Haoguang’s expression changed drastically.
He never expected Zheng Yuan to come to his door to collect debts on behalf of Chen Yun.
Thinking of this, Su Hao’s face turned ashen. In the end, he could only tremble and leave with his children.
This scene did not only happen in Su Haoguang’s family. Instead, it also happened in the families of the Su family’s eldest son, second son, and many other families.

Of course, not everyone in the Su family was obedient. Some even tried to resist. Unfortunately, in front of Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Yuan, people like them were still at the mercy of others. Their legs were broken and they were thrown out. In the past, they were members of the Su family and descendants of nobles. Now, it was different. They were just a group of fallen phoenixes who were inferior to chickens.
Soon, the sovereignty of the entire Su family and the Su family’s business changed.

The unforeseen event that happened to the Su family finally spread throughout Jiang City. For a moment, public opinion in Jiang City boiled. The Su family was a wealthy family, but they were suddenly kicked out. This was simply like a legend.
“The old master of the Su family, Su Qingtian, and the young master committed suicide.”
“The Su Corporation’s businesses changed owners overnight. Sacred Heaven merged with Huaying and became a company that is comparable to an old entertainment company.”

Countless Jiang City newspapers were reporting this news. The people of Jiang City usually read about celebrity scandals and speculated about these wealthy families. This time, the Su family’s sudden downfall caused them to owe countless debts and their assets were taken away. It simply piqued the curiosity of the people of Jiang City.

A group of burly young men barged into the villa group and reprimanded Su Haoguang and the others.
Su Haoguang was Su Qingtian’s third son and the third son in the family.
He was also the Vice-Chairman of the Su Corporation.
His status was usually respected.
When had he ever met someone who came to collect debts from him?
His son, Su An, was Su Yuncheng’s cousin.
Now, he jumped up and spoke angrily.
“Who are you?
What right do you have to barge into my Su family?
Where are the security guards?
Hurry up and chase them out.”

“Yo, do you still think you’re the Young Master of the Su family?” The burly man with a black tiger tattoo on his head sneered and said, “All your assets, as well as the entire Su family, belong to Director Chen.
This is written on paper in black and white.
Do you still want to deny it?”
“The Su family has already become rats on the streets and is hated by everyone.
Do you still want to show off like before?”
“But, but.” Su An was instantly at a loss for words.
Su An originally thought that he could take his time in the competition for the family assets.
It would not be a problem for him to file a lawsuit and drag it out for a few years so that the Su family could transfer the assets easily.
However, he did not expect that debt collectors would directly come to chase them away.
This time, he really panicked.
Usually, with the Su family’s power, he could do whatever he wanted in Jiang City.
When he went out, he would be in front of everyone.
If he wanted any celebrity, the other party would obediently climb into his bed for him to enjoy.
But now, everything was gone!
He had gone from a profligate young master to a pauper!
“Enough!”
Su Haoguang slammed the table and shouted angrily.
After all, he was the Vice-Chairman of the Su family consortium.
He had been in a high position for a long time, so his aura was very dignified.
The group of valiant young men didn’t dare to be impudent for a moment.
At this moment, a group of people suddenly walked in from outside the door.
When Su Haoguang saw the person in front, his expression suddenly changed.
He stood up and asked.
“CEO Zheng?”
Su Hao recognized Zheng Yuan and saw him coming.
He immediately said in a low voice, “Zheng Yuan, the Su family and the Zheng family usually mind our own business.
You don’t have to be so ruthless, right?
You don’t even give us a few days.”
Zheng Yuan sneered and said, “From today onwards, all the assets here will belong to Director Chen.
Third Master Su, you should quickly leave with your son, lest you hurt our harmony.”
Su Haoguang’s expression changed drastically.
He never expected Zheng Yuan to come to his door to collect debts on behalf of Chen Yun.
Thinking of this, Su Hao’s face turned ashen.
In the end, he could only tremble and leave with his children.
This scene did not only happen in Su Haoguang’s family.
Instead, it also happened in the families of the Su family’s eldest son, second son, and many other families.
Of course, not everyone in the Su family was obedient.
Some even tried to resist.
Unfortunately, in front of Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Yuan, people like them were still at the mercy of others.
Their legs were broken and they were thrown out.
In the past, they were members of the Su family and descendants of nobles.
Now, it was different.
They were just a group of fallen phoenixes who were inferior to chickens.
Soon, the sovereignty of the entire Su family and the Su family’s business changed.
The unforeseen event that happened to the Su family finally spread throughout Jiang City.
For a moment, public opinion in Jiang City boiled.
The Su family was a wealthy family, but they were suddenly kicked out.
This was simply like a legend.
“The old master of the Su family, Su Qingtian, and the young master committed suicide.”
“The Su Corporation’s businesses changed owners overnight.
Sacred Heaven merged with Huaying and became a company that is comparable to an old entertainment company.”
Countless Jiang City newspapers were reporting this news.
The people of Jiang City usually read about celebrity scandals and speculated about these wealthy families.
This time, the Su family’s sudden downfall caused them to owe countless debts and their assets were taken away.
It simply piqued the curiosity of the people of Jiang City.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Divine-Grade Guard Dog!
paragraphs: At this moment, Chen Yun was also drinking tea and reading the newspaper in his hand in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
If the Su family had not taken that step, he would not have gone so far as to exterminate the Su family. However, they had still touched his trigger.
Since they had done something wrong, they had to pay the corresponding price. The Su family had paid a painful price of blood!
Now, no one in the entire Jiang City was beyond Chen Yun.
Jiang Zhengyu, Zheng Yuan, and Ma Ke had already begun to nibble away at the companies that cooperated with the Su family and suppressed them.
After all, if one stood on the wrong side, they would also receive the punishment they deserved.
This was a rule that had existed since ancient times.
[Check-in mission.]
[Host, please check in.]
Chen Yun pressed the check-in button.
[Check-in successful.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining an antioxidant chlorella. It will be distributed continuously. One packet will be distributed every day.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a divine-level guard dog!]

Although there were no supreme-grade cards this time, Chen Yun was already very happy. After all, the antioxidant chlorella would actually continue to be distributed. Moreover, there was a pack every day. In that case, the supply of Heavenly Spirit Water would be very large.
He would accumulate more and more antioxidant chlorella.
“This divine-grade guard dog is quite strange. What is it?”
[The divine-grade guard dog is a military technology from the future.]
[It looks like a dog on the outside, but it’s a robot with an artificial intelligence. There won’t be any flaws.]
[Most importantly, it has a built-in Laser Conversion System that can store light energy and transform it into a laser that can cut through all enemies who dare to invade.]
[Of course, the divine-grade guard dog has other means of attack. I won’t list them one by one.]
Was it equipped with laser weapons?
Damn it!
If he had been given this reward earlier, would he have relied on using Su Yuncheng to force Su Qingtian to submit yesterday?
[The guard dog has been sent to the host’s courtyard.]
“Woof, woof, woof!”
Shouts immediately came from outside, making the eyes of the two girls, who had been in a daze since last night, suddenly light up.
“Brother, there’s a dog barking!”
“It seems to be in the courtyard.”

“Yes, go out and take a look.” Chen Yun was relieved to see that the two little girls were energetic. After all, their mentality was definitely not to the extent of being able to act as if nothing had happened after seeing him kill people yesterday.
It was not bad to have such a dog to make them happy.
However, Chen Yun stopped in his tracks when he went out.
Chen Yun was speechless.
Why did the future divine-grade guard dog look like a corgi?!
“Good boy, good boy!”
Chen Mengmeng hugged the corgi with a happy expression. The corgi’s four short legs were super cute!
When the corgi saw Chen Yun, it quickly ran over and licked his feet.
What a bootlicker.

“Let’s go. Carry it. We’re going out to buy clothes. Your Dean called me just now. He’ll let you participate in a training camp the day after tomorrow. Now, we’ll buy a few sets of beautiful clothes. Keep them and change into them when the time comes. Let’s go.” Chen Yun saw that the two girls were in a better mood, so he pulled them out to buy some clothes.
In Jiang City’s Century City.
Chen Yun and the other two arrived at the clothing level. Chen Mengmeng was still carrying the corgi.
“Miss, I’m sorry. You can’t bring pets in here...”
The salesperson of the Hermès store looked at Chen Mengmeng and said with a smile. However, in the next moment, the manager glanced over and looked at Chen Yun. Her eyes lit up!
Damn it, the God of Fortune was here!
Everyone in the branded shops in Jiang City’s Century City knew Chen Yun!
This person had already spent nearly ten million yuan here!
He was simply a walking God of Fortune!

“Ah! Sir, Miss, please wait. Please wait. She’s new and doesn’t know any better. Our shop doesn’t have such rules. Please come in.” The manager quickly walked over in her high heels, making the salesperson stunned.

“Manager, this...” Then, she saw the manager winking at her. She rolled her eyes and stroked the corgi’s head. “Aiya, I remembered wrongly. This puppy is so cute. We even have biscuits here. We can feed it these biscuits. Everyone, come in first.”
Chen Yun was also amused.
After entering the shop, he said, “I think this is not bad. Let them wear it.”
“That bag is not bad. There’s no need to look at it. Just pack two of these bags.”

Just as Chen Yun and the others were choosing from the Hermès store, the entire fifth floor immediately erupted in a pet craze. Many specialty stores sent salespeople to quickly choose pet supplies downstairs to attract them.
When Chen Yun came out of Hermès, he was immediately welcomed by all the stores on the fifth floor.
“Sir, please come to our place to take a look. If you shop here, we’ll give you some dog food.”
“We give away dog clothes here.”
“God of Wealth... Ummm, Sir, come in and take a look.”
This scene once again stirred up the entire fifth floor.
Everyone looked at Chen Yun’s bags. How rich was this person?!
After buying things, Chen Yun brought the two little girls to the amusement park to play and relax.
Then, they walked to the First-Grade Restaurant!
After a series of procedures, the psychological trauma of the two little girls was washed away.
Chen Yun felt relieved when he saw this.
Then, a call came. It was none other than Sun Wenkai from the East Mountain Villa.
“Have you arranged it?”

“Yes, Director Chen, all the invitations have been sent out and the banquet has been arranged,” said Sun Wenkai respectfully. He had naturally heard some inside information and knew that Chen Yun had already destroyed the Su family!
Tomorrow was the day Chen Yun reached the top of Jiang City!
Not only was he waiting, but all the high-ranking officials and nobles in Jiang City were waiting for tomorrow.
They were waiting for the banquet in Jiang City!
