chapters.title: Chapter 110: Jiangbei Banquet!
paragraphs: The next day, the entire Jiang City was unprecedentedly lively.
In the few districts of Jiang City, many rich people woke up very early. Even the high-ranking officials and nobles knew what day it was today.
Today was the day of Director Chen’s banquet in Jiang City!
Sacred Heaven defeated Huaying and the Su family! They stood proudly at the top of Jiang City!
No!
Sacred Heaven did not just defeat them!
Instead, they removed the Su family from Jiang City.
His methods were unprecedentedly ruthless!
Even the high-ranking officials and nobles who had not gone to the First-Grade Restaurant when it first opened in the past woke up early this time.
What a joke. The Su family had been destroyed. If they still did not give Chen Yun respect now, he might have burned the Su family down this time, but they might be next!
Chen Yun also woke up early.
Knock, knock, knock.
When he opened the door, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were already standing at the door in their gowns.
“Brother, Xiao Xue and I will pick out clothes for you.”
Chen Mengmeng spoke cutely. Chen Yun looked at the mental states of the two little girls. They should have already escaped from the effects of the incident the day before yesterday.
“Alright, come in.” After Chen Yun made way, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue walked in. They looked at Chen Yun’s wardrobe. Compared to them, it was pitifully small.
There were seven to eight sets of slim-fit clothes...
For a moment, Chen Mengmeng hugged Chen Yun. “Brother, you’re so willing to spend money on us, but you...”
“When I earn money in the future, I’ll definitely buy you more clothes. Look at your wardrobe. There are only a few pieces.”
As she spoke, Chen Mengmeng’s eyes turned red. Chen Yun doted on her too much.
At the side, Han Xue also nodded. She was not someone who would not repay kindness. She would definitely repay Chen Yun in the future.
“It’s fine, it’s fine. This is what a brother should do.” Chen Yun took out a suit. “What do you think of this?”
Chen Yun looked at it in the mirror. “Forget it. It makes me look a little petty. It’s no wonder. This is the cheapest set of clothes. It’s only worth a million yuan.”
It made him look petty.
It was the cheapest.
It was only worth a million yuan...
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Han Xue was also speechless.
What was this suit made of? Was it made of gold?! How did it cost a million yuan?!
One set of his clothes was equivalent to their entire cabinet of clothes!
He even made them reveal their true feelings just now!
They wanted their feelings back!

“Mengmeng, help me bring that one over. It’s the white one. Yes, I’ve already lost two sets. This is the last set.” As Chen Yun spoke, he shook his head. His two white suits had all been lost after being stained with blood.
Chen Mengmeng held it with both hands carefully, as if she was holding a blue-and-white porcelain vase instead of clothes, afraid that she would accidentally break it.
Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng and was amused. “Why are you so careful? This suit only costs three million yuan.”
“Oh my God!”
Three million!
Shouldn’t she be more careful?!
“It’s worth so much money. How can I be careless?!” Chen Mengmeng immediately spoke angrily.
Haha.
“I’ve never seen you be careful with my 100 million yuan blue-and-white porcelain vase.” Chen Yun’s words made Chen Mengmeng quickly throw the clothes to Chen Yun and cover his mouth.
Stop talking! She knew she was wrong!
After changing into his clothes, Chen Mengmeng helped Chen Yun pin a limited edition Cartier brooch to his chest.
It was in the shape of a longsword!
It meant that wherever the sword pointed, he was invincible!
Then, Chen Yun drove the Maserati Quattroporte to the East Mountain Villa with the two little girls.
When they reached the entrance, they suddenly realized that the parking lot of the East Mountain Villa was filled with people!
Any one of them was a luxury car worth more than a million yuan!
There were Mercedes-Benz S-Class cars, BMW 7 Series cars, Porsches, Bentleys...

It was no wonder that Chen Yun was shocked. Not only were the rich and upper echelons of Jiang City present at this banquet, but many people had also used their connections to enter. There were also many rich and powerful people from Jiang City who came uninvited to see the legendary Director Chen with their own eyes.
Hence, there were many different license plates in the parking lot, and many of them were not from Jiang City.
There were countless auspicious license plates.
“Oh my god, what day is it today? Why are there so many luxury cars?” Many passers-by watched this scene and were simply shocked.

“Such a huge commotion is simply unimaginable. I’m afraid all the high-ranking officials and nobles in Jiang City are present. What kind of person has such appeal? He can summon hundreds of people at once!”
The passers-by looked at the luxury cars and could not help but praise them.

Beside them, a group of young men and women walked over. Upon hearing their words, one of the girls sneered and said, “You’re a group of country bumpkins. You can only lament outside. With your level, how would you know the appeal of Director Chen from Sacred Heaven?”
The person who spoke was none other than Ye Xinyu, who was hugging Wang Zhouning’s arm.
As she spoke, she was also shocked.

Initially, she thought that it was just a gathering of a few big shots from Jiang City. However, she did not expect so many high-ranking officials and nobles to come. She knew many license plates in the parking lot. They all belonged to famous tycoons!
“Yuanyuan, looks like we’ve underestimated Director Chen’s appeal,” said Ye Xinyu. Then, she took a photo. “I’ll send it to Shu Fan to make her envious.”
“Don’t. She went out for training with her teacher and won’t be back. It’s not good for you to do this.” Wang Yuanyuan was also shocked when she saw this scene.

“Zhouning, it’s all thanks to you and your father that we got a place this time. Otherwise, we could only watch from the outside.” Ye Xinyu sighed and leaned towards Wang Zhouning, as if she had found a backer.
“Thank you, Brother Wang.”
“Thank you, Brother Wang.”
The two or three young men behind also hurriedly thanked him. Even Wang Yuanyuan thanked Wang Zhouning softly.
“Hey, why are you all so polite? It’s nothing.” Wang Zhouning was instantly flattered by this gratitude.
After entering, Ye Xinyu looked at Wang Yuanyuan and asked, “Yuanyuan, aren’t your parents here too? Why didn’t you come with them?”

These words made Wang Yuanyuan sigh in her heart. Her father and mother had obtained entry tickets only after her father’s CEO had sent a gift. However, there were only two tickets. How could she have a share?
After entering, their eyes lit up.
Inside, there were big-bellied people everywhere. Successful people with secretaries or assistants around them were all extraordinary and spoke loudly.
The man was dressed in a suit and leather shoes, while the woman had exquisite makeup.
The young people felt a little out of place standing here.
Thus, they consciously walked towards the corner, trying to avoid attracting as much attention as possible.
However, there were still sounds coming from the side.
“CEO Li, I didn’t expect you to rush over from Haiming City.”
“I got in through my connections. Director Wang, you have to help me introduce him to Director Chen today.”

“Aren’t you making things difficult for me? What kind of person is Director Chen? He’s the number one person in Jiang City now. Those who have met him are the highest-ranking figures in Jiang City. A small character like me has never met him, let alone recommended him to you.”
The man sighed. “If I can get close to Director Chen, I’ll definitely rise to the top in the future.”
After all, the Jiang family and the Zheng family were examples of this.
When the group of young men and women heard this, they felt even more ashamed of their inferiority. Ye Xinyu sighed. “I feel that I don’t even have the right to speak here.”
“It’s worth it for us to meet Director Chen today. We won’t be able to touch such a person even if we work hard for a few lifetimes.” Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes darkened before she shook her head.

They all belonged to famous tycoons!
“Yuanyuan, looks like we’ve underestimated Director Chen’s appeal,” said Ye Xinyu.
Then, she took a photo.
“I’ll send it to Shu Fan to make her envious.”
“Don’t.
She went out for training with her teacher and won’t be back.
It’s not good for you to do this.” Wang Yuanyuan was also shocked when she saw this scene.
“Zhouning, it’s all thanks to you and your father that we got a place this time.
Otherwise, we could only watch from the outside.” Ye Xinyu sighed and leaned towards Wang Zhouning, as if she had found a backer.
“Thank you, Brother Wang.”
“Thank you, Brother Wang.”
The two or three young men behind also hurriedly thanked him.
Even Wang Yuanyuan thanked Wang Zhouning softly.
“Hey, why are you all so polite?
It’s nothing.” Wang Zhouning was instantly flattered by this gratitude.
After entering, Ye Xinyu looked at Wang Yuanyuan and asked, “Yuanyuan, aren’t your parents here too?
Why didn’t you come with them?”
These words made Wang Yuanyuan sigh in her heart.
Her father and mother had obtained entry tickets only after her father’s CEO had sent a gift.
However, there were only two tickets.
How could she have a share?
After entering, their eyes lit up.
Inside, there were big-bellied people everywhere.
Successful people with secretaries or assistants around them were all extraordinary and spoke loudly.
The man was dressed in a suit and leather shoes, while the woman had exquisite makeup.
The young people felt a little out of place standing here.
Thus, they consciously walked towards the corner, trying to avoid attracting as much attention as possible.
However, there were still sounds coming from the side.
“CEO Li, I didn’t expect you to rush over from Haiming City.”
“I got in through my connections.
Director Wang, you have to help me introduce him to Director Chen today.”
“Aren’t you making things difficult for me?
What kind of person is Director Chen?
He’s the number one person in Jiang City now.
Those who have met him are the highest-ranking figures in Jiang City.
A small character like me has never met him, let alone recommended him to you.”
The man sighed.
“If I can get close to Director Chen, I’ll definitely rise to the top in the future.”
After all, the Jiang family and the Zheng family were examples of this.
When the group of young men and women heard this, they felt even more ashamed of their inferiority.
Ye Xinyu sighed.
“I feel that I don’t even have the right to speak here.”
“It’s worth it for us to meet Director Chen today.
We won’t be able to touch such a person even if we work hard for a few lifetimes.” Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes darkened before she shook her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Turn Into a Dragon After a Storm!
paragraphs: Just as they were standing here.
“Yuanyuan, are you here too?” The people who spoke were none other than Wang Qing and Auntie Song.
“Dad, Mom, why are you in the periphery?”

“We just came to take a look. I didn’t expect to meet you.” As Wang Qing spoke, he smiled bitterly in his heart. He wasn’t just here to take a look. He didn’t fit in here but he wanted to talk to others.
However, what kind of identities did these people have? At the very least, they were managers of large companies. They were unwilling to talk to people like him.
After all, it was useless. In this society, benefits were everything.
If someone else had something they wanted, they could be friends.
However, if someone else didn’t have anything, then I’m sorry.
On the other side, Chen Yun walked in with Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue. Chen Yun looked at the scene in front of him and smiled.
“Brother, this place is so big.” Chen Mengmeng looked at the decorations inside. It was probably not even as big as the Classical Gardens of Suzhou.
“If you like, you can stay here in the future.”
Chen Mengmeng waved her hand. “Brother, don’t fool me. Why would the owner of this place let me stay here?”
Hm?
Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng. “Didn’t I tell you? The East Mountain Villa belongs to me now. It’s our family’s business.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
He had never said this. He had definitely never said this!
Then, Chen Mengmeng looked over and was simply shocked!
“Brother, how rich are you? Does such a big villa belong to you?”
“In any case, I’m very rich.” Chen Yun waved his hand. “Go walk around with Xiao Xue. Take a look and eat whatever you want.”
“Alright, we’ll go first.”
Chen Mengmeng pulled Han Xue to eat delicious food happily.
“Hey, Xiao Yun?”
Chen Yun turned around and looked at Auntie Song, Ye Xinyu, and a large group of people beside her. Every one of them was holding a plate.
Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun with a cold expression and turned her head away. She did not know what to say and did not want to say anything.

The current Chen Yun had already jumped from the county boy she looked down on back then to a higher-up in Jiang City. He had even obtained the favor of the Jiang family. His achievements in the future would definitely not be minor. In any case, she would not be able to catch up.
“Auntie Song.”
Chen Yun only greeted Auntie Song. “You’re here too.”

“Yes.” Auntie Song smiled bitterly. She said that she was here to accompany Wang Qing, but she also had some thoughts. She also wanted to see what Director Chen, who was famous in Jiang City, looked like.
After all, if they were to be able to take a look at such a big shot, they could be considered to have broadened their horizons.
Beside him, Wang Qing looked at Chen Yun and turned his head. At this moment, a middle-aged man walked over.
“Hey! Isn’t this Section Chief Wang? I didn’t expect you to come too.”

“Manager Zhang, Director Chen invited me to this gathering, so I came to join in the fun.” Wang Qing made up a cover story. Why would Chen Yun invite him, a section chief? However, men were all prideful. Auntie Song heard it and didn’t say anything.
Manager Zhang smiled bitterly. “I followed someone in.”
“I came in to take a look and realized Director Chen’s appeal. Indeed, the rumors I heard are true.”
“What rumors?” Wang Qing was instantly interested. Wang Yuanyuan and the others beside him were the same. They subconsciously leaned over and listened attentively.
They also wanted to know more about the legendary Director Chen.
Manager Zhang lowered his voice. “Do you know Director Chen’s background, strength, and deeds in Jiang City?”
“Isn’t Director Chen the Chairman of Sacred Heaven Entertainment?” Wang Qing asked curiously.
“Section Chief Wang, you’re ignorant.” Manager Zhang chuckled as if he was mocking Wang Qing’s ignorance. “Director Chen has 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares!”
What?!
He had 80% of the shares!
Sacred Heaven was a colossus!
It was an entertainment company with a market value of tens of billions!
Seeing their surprised expressions, Manager Zhang was smug. He continued, “Look at the East Mountain Villa below us. It also belongs to Director Chen.”
“That’s not all. Rumor has it that Director Chen has billions of yuan in liquid assets. It was all Director Chen’s idea to attack the Su family and Huaying.”
This!
Wang Qing and the group of young men and women were also shocked when they heard this!
They didn’t expect Director Chen to have such a powerful background and such a huge fortune!
Yes!
If not for this family background, he would not have dared to go head-on with the Su family and even eat them up in the end!
“Manager Zhang, I heard through the grapevine that those two people from the Su family didn’t commit suicide, right?” Wang Qing’s words made Manager Zhang spit out a mouthful of champagne.
He looked at Wang Qing and frowned. “You can eat whatever you want, but you can’t spout nonsense! Is someone like Director Chen someone you and I can discuss? Be careful not to be overheard!”

“However, Director Chen did bring down the Su family and annexed Huaying. No one from the Su family was spared and they were all chased out of Jiang City. Without Su Qingtian and Su Yuncheng, the remaining members of the Su family won’t be able to achieve much. Now that a disaster is about to happen, they’ll fly away separately. We won’t be able to see them in Jiang City in the future.”
“Director Chen’s methods are unprecedented. Moreover, there are rumors that Director Chen is young and the power behind him is unpredictable.”
Thinking of the news they had heard, Wang Yuanyuan and the others felt even more ashamed of their inferiority. That was the real big shot.
Just as everyone was thinking about this, there was a commotion at the door. Manager Zhang stood on his tiptoes. “Aiya, those are the CEOs and chairmans among the upper echelons of Jiang City.”
For a moment, Wang Yuanyuan and the others went over to take a look.
“That’s the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Zhengyu. Beside him is his eldest son, Jiang Shouheng.”
“That’s CEO Zheng Yuan and Young Master Zheng Jianghao from the Zheng Corporation.”
“Look, there’s CEO Ma...”
Manager Zhang looked around for a long time and frowned. “Which one of them is Director Chen? Isn’t Director Chen here yet? Those aren’t him.”
“Could it be that one?”
Beside Jiang Zhengyu was a fat young man with greasy hair and a pink face.

“What nonsense are you talking about? He’s from one of the five major families in Jiangbei, the Qian family’s Young Master Qian Duo! He’s not Director Chen!” A man turned around and snorted at Manager Zhang.
The Qian family, one of the five major families in Jiangbei!
As soon as this name was mentioned, the people beside him were shocked!

Meanwhile, Auntie Song pulled Chen Yun and looked at everyone. She did not go over. She sighed softly and touched Chen Yun’s hand. “Xiao Yun, I originally told your mother that I wanted to take care of you. I didn’t expect you to turn into a dragon after a storm in Jiang City. You must have suffered a lot, child.”
“It’s alright.” Chen Yun chuckled, although it was quite tough to check in from time to time.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Overlooking Jiang City!
paragraphs: Jiang Zhengyu was walking with everyone and talking and laughing. He glanced at someone. “Hey, Miss Chen!”
At this moment, Chen Mengmeng was pulling Han Xue to roast the meat. When she heard Jiang Zhengyu’s words, she immediately stopped.
“Young Master Qian, this is Director Chen’s sister, Miss Chen Mengmeng.” Jiang Zhengyu introduced them to each other. “Miss Chen, this is the Young Master of the Qian family in Jiangbei, Qian Duo.”

“Hello.” Qian Duo greeted Chen Mengmeng. Then, an awkward smile appeared on his face. “Look at me. I didn’t consider it carefully. I didn’t expect Director Chen to have a sister. Come, Sister, this is for you. Take it as my greeting gift.”
“This is the Qianlong Emperor’s jade ring. It’s a trinket.”
Jiang Zhengyu was speechless. Damn it, did he just call this thing a small thing?!
Was it called a trinket just because it was small in size?
It was worth hundreds of thousands of yuan!
With just one sentence, he gave it away?!
Chen Mengmeng was speechless. Were greeting gifts so expensive now?!
On the other side, Sun Wenkai saw that it was time, but he could not find Chen Yun. He immediately walked to Chen Mengmeng. “Miss Chen, where’s Director Chen?”
“My brother is here. I wonder where he went.”
“It’s time. What should we do?” Sun Wenkai was also in a dilemma.
Jiang Zhengyu smiled. “Brother Sun, go up and host the show first. Director Chen will appear when he hears it. Anyway, he’s at the scene.”
“Okay.”

“Hello, everyone...” Sun Wenkai walked onto the stage and said a few opening words. “Thank you for being able to come here and attend this banquet. Director Chen has a few words to say to everyone. Next, let’s invite Director Chen on stage!”
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone applauded.
“I can finally see Director Chen’s true face.”
“I’m really looking forward to it. I really want to see what a person who can topple the Su family looks like.”
“I heard that Director Chen is very young.”
As they spoke, everyone cleared the red carpet in the middle.
Outside, Ye Xinyu and Wang Yuanyuan stood on their tiptoes and watched excitedly. They were ready to see what Director Chen looked like.
When Chen Yun heard Sun Wenkai’s words, he walked towards the red carpet.
“Xiao Yun, where are you going?”
Auntie Song was stunned and looked at Chen Yun. This was not the time to move blindly. This was the time for Director Chen to go on stage.
“I’m going on stage, Auntie Song.” Chen Yun chuckled.
Going on stage?
Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun and sneered. She said in a low voice, “Do you think you’re Director Chen because your surname is Chen?”
Chen Yun could not help but sneer when he heard this. He shook his head and continued walking out of the crowd.
“Section Chief Wang, this is your junior, right? What is he doing?” Manager Zhang immediately asked anxiously.
“I don’t know what that kid is thinking.” Wang Qing looked at Chen Yun and frowned. Was this kid’s brain damaged? What was going on? This was a banquet organized by Director Chen!
It was such an important occasion!
The people who came were all high-ranking officials and nobles!
Not only was Chen Yun disrespectful to Director Chen, but he also offended these big shots!
Even Jiang Zhengyu couldn’t protect him!
At that moment, Wang Qing’s interest was piqued. He looked in Chen Yun’s direction and prepared to see what would happen.

“Chen Yun, come back!” Auntie Song was about to chase after him when Wang Qing grabbed her hand. “What are you doing?! Do you know what kind of occasion this is? Do you want to offend these big shots too?!”
“That kid is taking things too hard. It’s his own business!”
On the other side, Chen Yun had already walked onto the red carpet. The surrounding people looked at Chen Yun in shock.
This was a young man. Why was he on the red carpet?
What was he doing?!
This red carpet was reserved for Director Chen. How could a young man like him go on it?
However, in the next moment.
The directors and CEOs in the fifth row looked at Chen Yun and stood up. “Hello, Director Chen!”
“Congratulations, Director Chen!”
Everyone was stunned. What was going on?
“Director Chen!”
“Director Chen!”
“Director Chen!”
As more and more people stood up, Ye Xinyu and the others were completely stunned when they saw the situation.
Meanwhile, Wang Qing’s eyes widened. He could not believe what he was seeing or what he was hearing!
“Director Chen!”
Under everyone’s surprised and respectful gazes, Chen Yun walked forward proudly!
Auntie Song covered her mouth. “Is Xiao Yun actually Director Chen?!”
Wang Yuanyuan was stunned on the spot. Her eyes stared at Chen Yun’s figure as he walked further and further away towards the stage. It was as if he had ascended a stairway to heaven...
“Director... Director Chen.”
The next moment, she collapsed to the ground. This was the biggest joke of her life.
That was all!

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Bugatti Veyron!
paragraphs: Director Chen?
It was not only Wang Yuanyuan who was shocked. Those who did not know Chen Yun looked at him and their hearts skipped a beat.
“This is Director Chen. Why is he so young?!”
“What kind of background does he have? He looks to be only 20 years old. At 20 years old, he has already reached the peak of Jiang City!”
“He’s too terrifying. Look at his aura. It doesn’t match his age at all!”

Only a few of the higher-ups of Jiang City had seen Chen Yun before. The others had simply followed the trend. Therefore, when they saw that the legendary Director Chen was so young, they couldn’t help but feel their jaws drop.
Meanwhile, Wang Qing’s fingernails were deeply embedded in his palm.
He could not believe it.
A poor kid who came from a small county had actually turned into a figure who was at the peak of Jiang City!
He had become a person who stood at the top of Jiang City and looked down on all the high-ranking officials and nobles!
However, the truth was now right in front of him. He had to believe it even if he didn’t want to!

He thought about his disdain for Chen Yun and how he had stopped his daughter. He really wanted to slap himself. If their family sought favor with Chen Yun now, he would be Director Chen’s father-in-law!
He would be able to turn the situation around with a flip of his hand!
However, it was too late now!

Chen Yun walked onto the stage and looked at the people in front of him. “I like to get straight to the point. I want to establish a Chamber of Commerce in Jiang City. With Sacred Heaven, Cauldron Dragon Security, and the Zheng Corporation as the core, I hope that all the corporations in Jiang City will join in and prosper together.”
“In the Chamber of Commerce, interests are interconnected. Each member will fork out 5% of their profits as membership fees. I don’t think anyone will object.”
He wanted to establish a Chamber of Commerce!
The membership fees were worth 5% of their profits!
The faces of the high-ranking officials and nobles present tightened as they weighed their options in their hearts.
After weighing the pros and cons, a CEO was the first to step forward. “Director Chen, the Sky Energy Group agrees to join the Chamber of Commerce and develop better under your lead!”
“Director Chen, the Liu Industry will also join!”
“I’ll join too!”
“Me too...”
For a moment, hundreds of people responded!

All the CEOs and directors expressed their stance, especially the families and companies that were originally under the Su family. They raised their hands in agreement, afraid that Chen Yun would attack them.
Those with discerning eyes knew that Chen Yun was pulling them into his faction.
However, they were also willing. After all, they only paid 5% of their profits as the membership fee, but what they received was a good development opportunity!
They would also receive the magical Heavenly Spirit Water in Chen Yun’s hands!
In particular, the Heavenly Spirit Water was incomparably precious! It was abnormally magical!
Such a scene shocked even the officials and nobles who were not from Jiang City. They were shocked by Chen Yun’s influence.
With that, Chen Yun walked down the stage.
Jiang Zhengyu and the others stood up and looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, this is the young master of the Qian family in Jiangbei, Qian Duo.”
“Young Master Qian, this is Director Chen.”
Qian Duo looked at Chen Yun, who was about the same age as him. He shook his head and sighed. “Director Chen is really handsome and rich!”
He reached out and shook Chen Yun’s hand.
“I’m here on my father’s orders to congratulate Director Chen and Sacred Heaven on standing at the top of Jiang City.” Then, Qian Duo took a box from the side and opened it. Inside was a car key.
“Oh my god, a Bugatti Veyron!” Jiang Shouheng, who was beside them, looked at the sports car key in the box. His eyes could not help but widen. He could not believe what he was seeing!
This was!
A sports car worth 45 million yuan!
It was one of the most luxurious supercars in the world!
Was it sent as a gift?!
Beside Chen Yun, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue also covered their mouths.
Chen Yun took the key and nodded. “Help me thank Patriarch Qian.”
“Director Chen, the car is outside. Why don’t we try the car?” Qian Duo looked at Chen Yun and gestured outside.
“I’d like that.”
Then, the two of them walked out surrounded by a group of big shots.
Chen Yun was about to reach the door when he turned to look at Wang Yuanyuan and the others standing at the side.
At this moment, Wang Yuanyuan had a complicated expression. She stood there without saying a word and only looked at Chen Yun, countless emotions flashing across her eyes.
There was shock, confusion... In the end, a myriad of emotions mixed together and transformed into a wisp of dense regret.
Chen Yun, who had been expressionless the entire time, chuckled and shook his head. Then, he turned around and strode away.
Only the stunned crowd was left standing there in a daze with endless regret.

In the parking lot, a brand new black Bugatti Veyron was parked. Chen Yun and Qian Duo got into the car. Under everyone’s gazes, Chen Yun stepped on the accelerator. The Bugatti Veyron was simply like a ferocious beast that had been released from its cage. It roared and rushed forward.

“F*ck! Brother Chen, slow down!” This frightened Qian Duo so much that he immediately cursed. Then, he pulled his tie. “It’s so tight. I’m so annoyed that to come to such an occasion, I even have to wear a suit and tie.”
He looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen, who exactly are you?”
Chen Yun glanced at Qian Duo. It turned out that this fellow was a friendly person. He had even acted like a young master just now.
“Did you come because of my identity?” Chen Yun asked.

Qian Duo immediately snorted. “How is that possible? When I, Qian Duo, make friends, I never see if the other party has money. Regardless of whether the other party has money or not, they’re not as rich as me.”

“What a coincidence. I have this habit of making friends too. In that case, how much money do you have?” Chen Yun asked, making Qian Duo instantly embarrassed. Qian Duo said, “I was wrong just now. I’m not as rich as my father.”
These few words completely changed Chen Yun’s impression of this young master of the Qian family. Damn it, this fellow’s aura just now was all fake.
Qian Duo looked at him as if he understood what he meant.

“Hey, Brother Chen, don’t look at me like that. I’m the young master of the Qian family in Jiangbei after all. I have to put on airs. If others see me like this and my old master hears about this, won’t they break my legs?” Qian Duo leaned over and chuckled. “Brother Chen, stop by the roadside. I’ll try driving too.”
Chen Yun drifted and swung the car to a stop.
The two of them got out of the car. Chen Yun threw the keys in his hand to Qian Duo and let him have a good time.
At night, Qian Duo left in a Bentley.
“Old Master, this is really an interesting person.” Qian Duo leaned against the seat. “In any case, I didn’t ask about his background.”
“Hey, don’t always call me trash. If you have the ability, come and ask him.”
“Hello, hello, hello? Aiya, Old Master, the signal is bad. I can’t hear you clearly. I’m hanging up.”
Qian Duo hung up and threw his phone away. “My old man, why don’t you reprimand my father? My ears are getting calluses from your reprimands.”
“Let’s go to the First-Grade Restaurant and try their food. I’ve long heard that the First-Grade Restaurant is top-notch. This time, we’ve finally caught a chance.”
The Bentley turned around and headed towards the First-Grade Restaurant.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Are Laser Arms That Powerful?
paragraphs: On the other side, Chen Yun looked at Ma Ke. “Ma Ke, I’ll leave the rest to you. Organize the Chamber of Commerce.”
Chen Yun had already laid the groundwork. All that was needed to do next was to get on the right track.
The entire Jiang City would establish an extremely huge Chamber of Commerce that would integrate the power of the entire Jiang City.
This strength was unimaginable!

Beside him, Ma Ke’s face was also filled with shock. He imagined this industry with Sacred Heaven, Cauldron Dragon Security, and the Zheng Corporation as its core. Although it could not compete with the Chamber of Commerce formed by the five major families now, it would feel like they would be inferior in the future.

At the same time, Ma Ke also felt that the burden on his shoulders had become heavier. Originally, when Chen Yun overthrew the Su family, he had to integrate Huaying and Sacred Heaven. Now, there was another mission.
However, even so, Ma Ke was confident and capable of doing it well.
A scholar would die for his confidant.
The banquet in Jiang City gradually dispersed.
Before leaving, many big shots came over to greet Chen Yun.
“Thank you for the banquet, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, if there’s a chance, I’ll treat you. Please come.”
“Director Chen, we’ll be leaving first.”

The people who came to greet Chen Yun were all high-ranking officials and nobles from Jiang City and the upper echelons of Lin City. Any one of them had a terrifyingly high status. As for the ordinary managers or directors, they also left silently.
After all, they knew their identities. Even if they came to look for Chen Yun, Chen Yun would not remember them.
Wang Qing and the others were like this.
They left dejectedly. Before they left, everyone turned around and looked at Chen Yun, who was standing in the middle of the crowd. He had a proud figure and was in high spirits!
Now, it was too late.
The banquet in Jiang City dissipated, but the aftershock did not decrease.

Participating in the Jiang City banquet had become a topic of conversation for the upper echelons. At the same time, the Jiang City Chamber of Commerce was also rushing to prepare. In a few days, it had already taken shape.
At the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
“Brother, are you really going home? I want to go back too.” Chen Mengmeng hugged Chen Yun and looked reluctant. “Sigh, forget it. Xiao Xue and I have to go for special training too.”
“Then, Brother, when are you leaving?” Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun.

“In the afternoon. I’ll send you to school later.” Chen Yun pondered for a moment. “By the way, I signed you two up for driving school. If you have time, go learn how to drive. Otherwise, some cars in my underground garage will turn moldy.”
“Okay!”
Upon hearing this, Chen Mengmeng immediately perked up.

“If you want to learn, you have to study hard. Don’t become a road killer.” Chen Yun patted Chen Mengmeng’s head dotingly. It was already the revision month in school, but he had long mastered those courses. Even if he did not revise at all, he could still pass his classes.
In addition, Chen Mengmeng was not around. Thus, he could go home and see his parents and his childhood friends.
After sending the two girls away, Chen Yun carried the corgi in the courtyard over and patted its head. “Fire a laser for me to see.”
The next moment, the corgi opened its mouth and a laser beam shot out.
Thud!
With a sweep of the laser, the trees in the courtyard fell with a bang.
Chen Yun went over to take a look and could not help but click his tongue. The incision was too smooth.
This divine-grade guard dog was extremely terrifying.
If this laser hit a person, the outcome would be the same.
They would be cut at the waist!
He made a call to the property management, who pulled away the fallen trees within half an hour.
“Alright, I’m going back too. Stay here and watch the house.”
Chen Yun instructed and turned off the villa’s biometric identification, immediately locking the entire villa.
Carrying the box, Chen Yun drove the Bugatti Veyron straight to Yanwei.
Jiang City was not far from Yanwei, which was only four to five hours away.
On the highway.
“F*ck!”
“What’s that?!” A man looked at the car that passed him and could not help but gasp. “What the hell! Is that a Bugatti Veyron?”
“It’s a car worth 45 million yuan!”
“I didn’t expect to see such a car in my life!”
Along the way, Chen Yun’s black Bugatti Veyron simply attracted countless gazes.
It aroused a wave of hatred.
However, the benefit was that as soon as Chen Yun’s Bugatti Veyron drove on the road, the cars on the highway quickly avoided it.
What a joke!
It was a car worth 45 million yuan!
If one scratched it, their house would be gone!
However, Chen Yun was also a little helpless. This Bugatti Veyron was good at everything, but it was too expensive.
It was not that Chen Yun could not afford to spend money.
However, it was very annoying to have to refuel the car from time to time. After all, its fuel tank was only so big.
He set off in the afternoon. When night fell, Chen Yun returned to Yanwei.
After arriving, Chen Yun called his mother.
“Xiao Yun?” Mother Chen was stunned when she saw Chen Yun’s call.
“Mom, where are you? I’m back.”
Huh?
Was he back?
“How did you come back? Do you want Mom to pick you up at the airport? Or should I go to the high-speed rail station?”
“There’s no need. I drove back. Where are you now? Why is it so noisy beside you?” Chen Yun heard the commotion from the other side, making him a little frustrated.
Mother Chen looked around. “Your father and I are attending a banquet at Dahai Residence by Uncle Chu. It’s to celebrate the advancement in his child’s studies.”
“Alright, why don’t you go home first?”
“Then I’ll hang up first.”
Mother Chen hung up the phone. Chu Zhengfeng, who was sitting at the main table, looked at Mother Chen. “Is it Xiao Yun?”
“That’s right. This child suddenly said that he’s back.”
“He’s back?” A man beside her said, “I remember that Xiao Yun is only in his third year of university. Shouldn’t he still be in class? Why is he back?”
“I don’t know either. Maybe it’s revision month, so there’s nothing going on,” said Mother Chen.
“Sister-in-law, I have to say this. You can’t let him be so sloppy.” Chu Zhengfeng knocked on the table. “He’s a young man. How can he not work hard?”

As he spoke, the man beside him echoed, “That’s right. Isn’t the teaching material right here? Not only did Zhiwei get into a graduate school under the 985 Project this year, but he can also buy his own Audi.”
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone revealed envious expressions.
“Zhiwei, how much is your Audi?” An elder asked the young man opposite him.
“Aiya, it’s not much. Just 300,000 yuan.”
“It’s not much.”
“Just 300,000 yuan.”

“It can’t compare to those good cars at all. I’m just selling some trinkets and earning some money. In this society, we still have to rely on our academic qualifications. Many graduate students in our school can get an annual salary of six to seven hundred thousand yuan,” said Chu Zhiwei proudly.
“How long has it been since we last met? Zhiwei, you’re already so promising. You’re amazing.” The man beside him could not help but praise.
Chu Zhiwei smiled faintly and did not say anything. However, his face was filled with pride.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: You’re Joking Again
paragraphs: Chu Zhiwei looked at Father Chen and Mother Chen. “I remember that Xiao Yun is at Jiang City University of Technology. Although he’s in a university under the 211 Project, Xiao Yun’s major isn’t easy to find a job in, so it’s best to ask him to take the postgraduate exam. Otherwise, when he comes out in the future, he might only be able to earn four to five thousand yuan a month. He doesn’t have much of a future.”
When Mother Chen heard this, she felt upset. She smiled bitterly and said, “That’s right. Zhiwei is really promising now. Brother Chu, you have a good son.”

When Chu Zhengfeng heard this, he felt as if he had eaten honey. His face was filled with smugness, but he was smug in his heart. However, he still said humbly, “Zhiwei was just a little more lucky on the basis of hard work.”
“By the way, Zhiwei, is your team still short of people? If you’re still short of people, why don’t you...”
“Dad!” Chu Zhiwei directly interrupted Chu Zhengfeng. “In our team, everyone graduated from a university under the 985 Project. Not everyone can enter.”
When Father Chen heard this, his expression darkened a little. What did he mean by not just anyone could enter?
The meaning was very obvious.
“That’s true.” A woman nodded and looked at Mother Chen. “Sister Chen, it’s still right to ask Xiao Yun to strive to get into a graduate school under the 985 Project.”
“You can’t let him be sloppy anymore. Otherwise, he’ll only be able to survive at the bottom in the future.”
“Yeah, look at Zhiwei.”
That night, Chu Zhengfeng and Chu Zhiwei received countless praises. When they came out of the restaurant, they felt a little light-headed.
“Brother Chen, why don’t we get Zhiwei to send you home?” Chu Zhengfeng said proudly, “In any case, he has nothing to do.”
Mother Chen waved her hand. “No need, no need. We drove here.”
The next moment.
A sound wave came from afar. Everyone looked over and saw a black sports car driving over quickly. That figure was like a ghost sneaking in the night, deep and dark!
Buzz!
The commotion immediately attracted the attention of many people. They looked at the sports car and could not believe what they were seeing. When did such a good car exist in Yanwei?!
This car could only be seen in the two most prosperous centers in China!
When everyone saw the sports car drive over, they consciously made way. Even a fool could tell that this car must be expensive.
“Oh my god, when did such a tycoon come to Yanwei?” Chu Zhiwei looked at the sports car driving over in disbelief. His eyes were filled with envy and extreme desire.
After all, which man didn’t want a luxury car?
“Zhiwei, how much is this car?”
The older generation did not know much about cars and immediately asked.
“Uncle Sun, this is a Bugatti Veyron. The price is above 45 million yuan! Moreover, it can’t just be bought with money!”
These words stunned the elders present.
They could not help but swallow a few mouthfuls of saliva.
Did this car cost 45 million yuan?!
It was so exaggerated!
What kind of big shot was this? How much money did he have to drive such a car?
Under everyone’s gaze, the Bugatti Veyron slowly stopped in front of them. The car door opened and a familiar figure in a suit alighted, appearing in front of everyone.
“Dad, Mom, are you done eating?” Chen Yun was the first to speak.
Father Chen and Mother Chen were simply stunned.
Xiao Yun?
Mother Chen looked at Chen Yun’s face. Her son had lost a lot of weight. At the same time, he was much more handsome!
“Chen Yun?”
“Xiao Yun?”
“This!”
At that moment, everyone was stunned.
What was going on?!
There must be something wrong with their eyes!
The person who drove the Bugatti Veyron worth 45 million was actually Chen Yun?!
“Uncle Chu, so you were eating together.” Chen Yun walked around the car and walked over.
Everyone looked at Chen Yun and immediately felt ashamed of their inferiority. It was not only because of Chen Yun’s looks, but also because of his aura, the aura of a superior!
Just standing in front of Chen Yun, they felt that they could not raise their heads.
“Ah, right. Xiao Yun, I had a meal with your parents. It was to celebrate the fact that Brother Zhiwei got into graduate school.”
At this moment, Chu Zhengfeng’s face felt a little hot, and his smugness from before was gone.
Damn it, they were just saying that Chen Yun was sloppy and did not do his job.
They even mocked him for being just a student from the 211 Project and thought that he could only get a salary of four to five thousand yuan in the future.
But now!
He simply came back in a luxury car!
A luxury car worth 45 million yuan!
With how promising Chen Yun was, why would he need his son to pull Chen Yun into the team?
He probably didn’t even like them!
“Xiao Yun, is this your car?” Chu Zhiwei looked at the black Bugatti Veyron and swallowed his saliva.
“A friend gave it to me. It’s just a means of transportation.”
Chu Zhiwei was speechless.
What the hell?!
It was just a means of transportation?!
Just?!
This sentence shocked everyone even more. A friend gave it to him. What kind of friend could give such a car?!
Moreover, that friend must have other motives for giving such a precious thing. That meant that Chen Yun was now a figure like the other party or even higher.
“Xiao Yun, what are you doing now? How much can you earn in a year?” A female elder asked gossipily. Then, she was pulled by her husband beside her.
“Why are you pulling me? I’m just asking Xiao Yun.”
When Chen Yun heard this, he said, “I’m not doing much. I just invested in some businesses. As for the money, I can’t calculate it clearly.”
Mother Chen was instantly speechless. This brat! Someone else was asking him a question, but he suddenly showed off.
How could he not calculate it? Was there any money that could not be counted?

If Chen Yun knew what his mother was thinking, he would definitely be on the brink of tears. He really did not know how much money he had now. He had Sacred Heaven, the East Mountain Villa, villas, various antiques, jade seals...
At the very least, these would cost more than 20 billion yuan.
When Chen Yun’s words fell into everyone’s ears, they had no choice but to believe him. After all, the Bugatti Veyron worth 45 million was right here.
This car!
Even if he gave it to them for free, they would not be able to drive it. They would not even be able to afford refueling it.

Chu Zhengfeng smiled awkwardly. “Xiao Yun, you’re really promising. Brother Chen, you’re really lucky. By the way, Xiao Yun, are your businesses still short of people? Do you want your Brother Zhiwei to help you? He just got into a graduate school under the 985 Project...”
When Chen Yun heard Chu Zhengfeng’s words, he laughed. “Uncle Chu, you’re joking again. It’s getting late. Dad, Mom, let’s go back.”
What a joke. In Sacred Heaven, any white-collar worker was a graduate student from a university under the 985 Project. Furthermore, they had to have the experience of studying abroad.
A quasi-graduate student in a university under the 985 Project was nothing.
Father Chen and Mother Chen looked at Chen Yun, then at his car with helpless expressions.
Chen Yun immediately understood. “Dad, get in the car. I’ll teach you how to drive this car. Drive back with Mom. I’ll drive our Volkswagen back.”

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Give Me a Compensatory Hug!
paragraphs: Chen Yun’s father, Chen Hongliang, originally did not want to drive, but Chen Yun helped him put on his seatbelt.
“Child.”
“Alright, Dad. Try driving it. If you think it’s good, I’ll give you this car. I still have a car in Jiang City,” said Chen Yun with a smile.

Chen Hongliang rolled his eyes at him. “It’s not appropriate for me to drive this car out. Moreover, it’s obvious that this car consumes a lot of fuel. How much money does your mother give me every month? That bit of pocket money is not even enough for me to fill a tank of fuel.”
“Don’t say that. Look at Mom’s gaze.” Chen Yun was instantly amused. These two people were really...
“Mom, what are you waiting for? Come on in.” Chen Yun opened the car door and let his mother get in.
Mother Chen touched the luxury car carefully. “I’m old, but I’m actually sitting in such a good car.”
“Brother Chu, Brother Zhang, we’ll leave first.”
Father Chen waved at them, then stepped on the accelerator and drove away with a roar.
Then, Chen Yun looked at the few people standing and exchanged a few pleasantries with them. Then, he drove away in the old Volkswagen Passat.
“I knew it. Even if these two old folks have money, they don’t know how to buy a good car or a good house.” Chen Yun touched the steering wheel of the Passat and smiled bitterly.
The remaining people looked at the taillights of the Passat. They had yet to recover from the shock.
Chu Zhengfeng had nothing to show off anymore. Thinking back to what he had just said, he was simply a laughing stock.
Chu Zhiwei also looked at his Audi. The car that he was originally proud of was like a pile of scrap metal in comparison. One cost more than 300,000 yuan, and the other cost 45 million yuan!
Damn it, Chen Yun’s car was enough to buy 150 of his car!
There was no comparison between the two!
Needless to say, the rest of the people felt as if their hearts had been hammered by a hammer. They were still in shock.
Then, they dispersed wordlessly.
When he returned home, his parents were already sitting on the sofa. Chen Yun took off his coat and looked at the familiar home. Although it was small, it was very warm.
“Mom, don’t you have ten million yuan in your hands now? Why don’t you think of changing the house or car?”
Mother Chen did not say anything. She patted the sofa and let Chen Yun sit down. “Xiao Yun, tell me what you’re doing now. Are the things in the photos Mengmeng took for us really yours?”
“So you wanted to ask these questions. Then why didn’t you just ask me during the video call previously?” Chen Yun held his mother’s hand and touched it gently.
When Mother Chen heard Chen Yun’s words, she stammered, “Mengmeng told us not to worry. She said that you’re a CEO now and that you’re usually very busy, so we didn’t dare to waste your time.”

Chen Yun looked at his mother, who was like an angry child who didn’t want to speak up. He shook his head. “Do you know Sacred Heaven Entertainment? It’s the one who aired the Desert Island Survival variety show not long ago.”
“I know. Your father and I watch that variety show sometimes. Why?”
“I’m now the Chairman of Sacred Heaven Entertainment and the President of the Jiang City Chamber of Commerce.” Chen Yun did not hide anything and said it directly.
This!
For a moment, Father Chen and Mother Chen’s eyes widened at the same time. They simply could not believe what they had heard.
Was Chen Yun already so capable?

“Now that you know, you can rest assured.” Chen Yun did not wait for them to continue asking and continued, “Therefore, the two of you don’t have to do anything else. When you want to, go on a trip. There’s 30 million yuan on this card. You have to spend it all in half a year.”

Chen Yun knew the old couple’s personalities. If they had money, they would definitely save it. That was why he gave this order. Moreover, if he gave them too much, they would feel even more uncomfortable.
“Alright, I’m going to take a shower.”
After saying this, Chen Yun stood up and left, leaving behind his shocked parents.
They could not accept this reality for a while.

However, they were very gratified in their hearts. Their son had grown up and was promising. Initially, they had wanted to save money to buy a house for their son. Now, they suddenly lost their goal and felt lost.
After washing up, Chen Yun chatted with his parents for a while before returning to his room.
He took out his phone and sent a message in the group chat.
It immediately made a few people jump up from their blankets.
[Fang Mengjun: Chen Yun, you’re back? Why are you back so late?]
[Dong Honghe: You’re so mean. When did you come back? Let me know and I’ll pick you up.]
[Wang Liang: ??? Brother Yun, didn’t we agree to go back together?]
[Lin Yuhan: Brother, are you coming out for a gathering tomorrow?]
[Zhang Huaiyao: Junjun and I will also rush home tomorrow. Let’s come out for a gathering.]
[Dong Honghe: Yo, we naturally welcome the two school belle-level beauties.]

Chen Yun chatted with them until late at night. Although they did not contact each other often, they still had the tacit understanding from when they were young. They were extremely familiar with each other with just a few words.
The next day.
Chen Yun walked out of the district and made a call. “Yuhan, where are you? Why don’t I see you?”
Then, two men and two women got out of a Ford not far from him.
“Brother, we didn’t see you either.” A voice came from the phone, making Chen Yun feel helpless. He immediately waved at the four of them.
“Here!”
Everyone looked at Chen Yun and were stunned on the spot.
This!
This, this, this!
Dong Honghe was the first to run over. He looked at Chen Yun in front of him and immediately hugged him with a bear hug. Then, he let go and hammered his chest.
“You’re good. It’s only been a short while since we last met, but you’re already like a different person. Will one really become handsome after losing weight? I’ll go back and lose weight too.”
As soon as he finished speaking, a female voice sounded not far away.

“Chen Yun, how long has it been? You didn’t even call me. How dare you come back? Haven’t you already forgotten the way home? Let’s see how I deal with you.” The girl who spoke was tall and about 1.7 meters tall. She was wearing shorts, revealing her long, snow-white legs. She looked extraordinary.
There was also a girl standing beside her. She had a gentle temperament, was beautiful and moving, and her appearance was not inferior to others.
These two were simply like sisters. Their figures and looks were not inferior to Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin.
They were Fang Mengjun and Zhang Huaiyao.
They were Chen Yun’s two beautiful childhood friends.
As the two of them spoke, they walked towards Chen Yun. Fang Mengjun opened her hands and was about to hug Chen Yun. “Give me a compensatory hug first.”
“Hey!”
Dong Honghe pulled Chen Yun behind him. “Don’t even think about taking advantage of my brother. You can’t let my brother suffer like this. I’ll do it!”
“F*ck you!” Chen Yun almost kicked Dong Honghe away.
This made everyone laugh.
Chen Yun then looked at Lin Yuhan, who was walking over.
“Brother, you’re back,” said Lin Yuhan.
“Yes, I’m back.”
These two simple sentences contained a lot of emotions.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Breaking Through the Heavens!
paragraphs: Looking at the two of them, Dong Honghe sighed. Among their childhood friends, Chen Yun and Lin Yuhan had the best relationship. They had to step back.
“Alright, stop being emotional. Let’s go eat.” Fang Mengjun pulled Chen Yun’s arm when no one was paying attention.
Chen Yun was speechless.
Oh? Was she taking advantage of him?
However, Chen Yun only smiled and allowed Fang Mengjun to pull him along. They had grown up in the same courtyard since they were young. They were not family, but were like family.
After getting into the Ford, Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan sat in front while Chen Yun sat at the back with the two girls.
At this moment, Zhang Huaiyao leaned closer to Chen Yun’s face and blinked her big eyes.
Dong Honghe looked at this scene through the rearview mirror and immediately smiled. “Beauty Huaiyao, why? Is there a flower on my brother’s face? That’s my opinion.”

“Why didn’t I notice it in the past? In my impression, Chen Yun has always been short, dark, and inconspicuous. Why do I instantly feel like I don’t know him? He’s so handsome that I’m a little infatuated.”
Chen Yun pursed his lips and felt helpless. He had indeed been short and dark since he was young, but he had been doing well since junior high.
First impressions really killed people.
Fang Mengjun also took out her phone and took a selfie with Chen Yun and the other two.

“It’s been a long time since we took a photo together. We’ll definitely take a good photo when we get out of the car later.” Fang Mengjun looked over and thought for a moment. “However, Wang Liang didn’t come back this time. It seems like he won’t be able to freeload on this gathering.”

“Come on, Wang Liang hasn’t been worried about food recently.” Zhang Huaiyao covered her mouth. “He even posted on his Moments a few days ago. I don’t know why he suddenly became so lucky. I heard that he won a meal worth up to 20,000 yuan at the First-Grade Restaurant, a high-end restaurant in Jiang City. Then, he won another prize while eating and obtained a membership card with 300,000 yuan on it.”

“An amount of 300,000 yuan is enough for him to eat for many years. A few days ago, I saw the photos he posted. He’s gained a lot of weight.” Zhang Huaiyao said with a jealous expression. Why wasn’t she pretty enough to have such benefits?
“Huh?”
Fang Mengjun was stunned. “Is there such a thing? In that case, the next time we go to Jiang City, let him treat us to a meal.”
“There’s no need. I’ll treat you guys the next time we come to Jiang City.” Chen Yun smiled and said, “When we reach Jiang City, I’ll do my best as a host.”
“Then let’s make a deal.” Fang Mengjun smiled. “When we reach Jiang City, you’ll be the host. I’ll be the host today. It’s not easy for us to get together.”
“Heh.”
Dong Honghe chuckled. “Beauty Fang, the three of us are here. How can we ask a girl like you to pay? What are you thinking? I have to pay for this meal.”
“Hey, I’m saving you money!”
“No need. I have money!” Dong Honghe joked with Fang Mengjun, but he did not see the loneliness in Lin Yuhan’s eyes.

This was also the place where they often came together in the past.
Although their ages had changed, their friendship had never changed.

Lin Yuhan patted Chen Yun’s shoulder. “Brother, let’s go out and smoke.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yun responded silently.
The two of them left the private room and went to the corridor.
Lin Yuhan leaned against the railing with a cigarette in his mouth. He looked at the crowd on the street below and felt lost.

“What’s wrong? What’s on your mind? By the way, I didn’t know that after you retired from the army, you actually went to Jiang City. Why didn’t you come and play with me?” Chen Yun stood side by side with Lin Yuhan and looked down.

“I was recommended by someone else and indeed blended into the circle of young masters. I even met Young Master Tan Zekun.” Lin Yuhan smoked a cigarette and sighed. “However, he knew that I was a retired soldier and asked me to enter the octagon cage. He broke my arm.”

“When he swung the rod at me, I wanted to dodge, but I didn’t dare.” Lin Yuhan’s eyes turned red. “I was afraid that if I dodged, not only would I be finished, but my father would also be implicated.”
“Brother, there are some things I can’t tell them. I can only tell you,” said Lin Yuhan in a low voice.
Chen Yun listened from the side and did not interrupt. He knew that Lin Yuhan just wanted to find an listening ear.

As expected, Lin Yuhan continued, “This incident has woken me up. After all, I’m not on the same level as those young masters. They’ve never treated me as a human. I want to be an honest person. If I continue to hang out like this, the gap between me and you will only increase.”
Seeing that Chen Yun seemed to be about to open his mouth, he quickly said, “Don’t refute me.”
“Both you and Wang Liang are good at studying and are very capable. In the future, you’re destined to surpass the previous generation and rise rapidly in the big city.”
“The strength of Honghe’s family is obvious. We all know their background.”
“It’s just me.”
“My father was cheated while doing business in Jiang City. Something happened to our family too. I don’t know what to do now.”
“I want to rely on myself to carve out a path. F*ck, one day, I’ll stand in front of that bastard Tan Zekun and break his limbs! I’ll tell him who he is!”
As he spoke, he flicked the cigarette butt to the ground and stomped on it, as if he wanted to vent all the depression in his heart.
At this moment, Chen Yun said slowly, “I’ve already crippled Tan Zekun. If you’re not satisfied...”
Lin Yuhan did not believe him. He lowered his head and smiled. “Brother, I feel much better after hearing your words.”

In his opinion, Chen Yun was just saying things in a fit of anger. What kind of status did Tan Zekun have? He was the young master of the Tan family in Jiang City. Usually, when he went out, he would have the status of someone who made others change from arrogance to deference.
If Chen Yun crippled him, how could he still be standing here? He probably could not even leave Jiang City.
“What happened at home? Do you need my help?” Although Chen Yun knew Lin Yuhan’s stubborn personality, he still asked.
As he had expected, Lin Yuhan shook his head. After chatting with Chen Yun for a while, they went in.
After a while, everyone finished eating. Chen Yun used the excuse of going to the toilet to secretly pay the bill. However, in the end, everyone rolled their eyes at him.
“Let’s go. I’ll send you home,” said Dong Honghe. However, Fang Mengjun and Zhang Huaiyao shook their heads. “We have something to talk to Chen Yun about. We have to take a walk.”
“What’s the matter? Why are you so mysterious?” Dong Honghe raised his eyebrows.
However, Fang Mengjun glared at him. Dong Honghe suddenly understood and pulled Lin Yuhan back. “Then, we’ll leave first.”
After the two of them left, Chen Yun looked at the two girls. “What’s wrong?”
The next moment, Fang Mengjun sighed and the smile on her face disappeared.
Then, she took out a bank card from his pocket.
She handed it to Chen Yun.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Call Someone!
paragraphs: Hm?
Chen Yun looked at the bank card handed to him and was stunned.
What was the meaning of this?
“What’s wrong?” Chen Yun looked at Fang Mengjun, not knowing her intentions.
“Let’s talk as we walk.” Zhang Huaiyao pulled Chen Yun and left with Fang Mengjun.
Fang Mengjun sighed. “Yuhan didn’t tell you about his situation, right?”
“I just asked, but he didn’t say.”
“Yuhan really treats us as outsiders.” Fang Mengjun shook her head, her beautiful face covered in frost. “He didn’t tell us either. It was Honghe who accidentally found out.”
These words made Chen Yun’s expression darken. “What happened?”

“Yuhan’s family’s situation isn’t too good now. His father failed in his business and was deceived, so he brought Yuhan back from Jiang City. However, when it rains, it pours. His sister even has leukemia.”
Leukemia!
Chen Yun’s eyes narrowed, but he did not reply and let Fang Mengjun continue.
“The last time Honghe went to their house to look for him, he realized that the owner had changed. If Honghe hadn’t told us, we wouldn’t have known now.”
Chen Yun did not expect his brother to fall into such a predicament. “He’s always been like this. He’s unwilling to drag us down.”
His words seemed to have pulled the two girls back to their childhood. At that time, when the two of them were bullied by children their age, it was the few of them who stood up for them.
Among them, Chen Yun and Lin Yuhan were the most ferocious.
As she thought about it, Fang Mengjun sighed. “There’s 300,000 yuan on the card. Give it to Yuhan. We know his personality. If we give it to him, he definitely won’t want it.”
“You’re not like us.”
“Three hundred thousand yuan?” Chen Yun looked at Fang Mengjun. “Where did you get so much money?”

“Honghe gave 150,000 yuan. Huaiyao and I gathered 150,000 yuan. Don’t worry, it’s not stolen from our family or online loans. It’s the living expenses we earned from tutoring others over the past few years.”
Fang Mengjun bit her lip and looked at the bank card. She was still a little reluctant. She had originally planned to buy a few sets of good clothes to prepare for society.
However, she could buy clothes in the future, but she could not save Liu Yuhan in the future.
Thus, she forked out the money and did not think of getting it back.
How could their relationship be bought with tens of thousands of yuan? If they lost the money, they could earn it back in the future. However, if they lost Liu Yuhan, they would lose everything.
“Take it quickly. It’s up to you.” Fang Mengjun pulled Chen Yun’s hand and was about to hand the card to him when Chen Yun closed his hand. “You don’t have to worry about this matter. I’ll do it.”
Huh?
Fang Mengjun was immediately a little angry. “Chen Yun, it’s not easy for Uncle and Auntie to earn money. We’re even in school. Don’t shoulder it yourself. Let’s do it together!”
“You don’t think of us as friends.”

“Don’t worry, I have money. It’s enough.” Chen Yun broke free from Fang Mengjun and ran towards the back. “I’ll go back and drive to the hospital. Do you know the address of his sister’s ward? If you do, send it to me.”
“How much money do you have?! Hey! Stop right there!” Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun, who had run away, and gritted her teeth. She was simply furious!
She wanted to chase after him, but how could she do so in high heels?!
She could only stomp his feet and grit his teeth. “I’m so angry! This Chen Yun!”
“Jun Jun, what should we do now?” Zhang Huaiyao had no idea.
Fang Mengjun looked at Zhang Huaiyao angrily. She had nowhere to vent her anger, so she could only rub her chubby face!
“What should I do? How would I know what to do? Call someone!”
“Huh? Who should we call?” Zhang Huaiyao was stunned by Fang Mengjun’s adult-like words. Was Fang Mengjun like a big sister in private? Zhang Huaiyao couldn’t tell!
Fang Mengjun looked at Zhang Huaiyao’s eyes. “Call Honghe. Why don’t we ask him and discuss it with him? If not, we’ll go to the hospital together.”
“Oh, oh, oh.”
“But you were so silly that I almost died.” Fang Mengjun blew at Liuhai. “It’s said that women with big breasts are brainless. However, yours is about the same size as mine. You’re just a C...”
The next moment, her mouth was covered by Zhang Huaiyao.
“Boohoo...”
This place was close to Chen Yun’s family house. He drove back and touched his pocket. Damn it, he had forgotten to change his keys. He immediately drove the Passat towards the city hospital.

Chen Yun also sighed. Just as Fang Mengjun had said, Yuhan had always been unwilling to tell them about his difficulties. In the past, when they were bullied, Yuhan was the first to go up. Later on, he was also the most oppressed by the young people of society. Every time, he was covered in wounds and had to endure it alone.
However, what time was it now? Why didn’t he tell them?!
He simply did not treat them as brothers!
If not for Honghe, Mengjun, and the others, he would not have known until now!
The next moment, Chen Yun’s phone rang.
“Ma Ke, what’s wrong?”

“Director Chen, I need your signature on the forms to transfer the Su family’s assets. I’ve sent a secretarial team, who should reach Yanwei in the evening. They’ll contact you when they arrive.” A voice came from the phone.
Then, Ma Ke reported the organization of the Chamber of Commerce and the merging status after Sacred Heaven annexed Huaying.
The integration and clean-up were nearing completion.
This also made Chen Yun feel much more at ease.
“Yes, I understand.” With that, Chen Yun hung up.
At this moment, in the city hospital.
Lin Yuhan looked at his sister in the intensive care unit with mixed feelings.
Initially, he thought that his sister’s condition had stabilized, but he did not expect it to worsen after a meal.
He rushed to the hospital. The doctor said that she had to undergo surgery, and the surgery fee was an astronomical price of 500,000 yuan!
Five hundred thousand yuan was too far away for him now.
They sold the house, the car, and all of their valuables. He had borrowed money from all the relatives they could borrow from.
Who else would lend them money?
“Dad, Mom, is Xiao Fan going to...” As Lin Yuhan spoke, the middle-aged man and woman beside him sighed. They stammered for a long time but could not say anything.

This was the first time Lin Yuhan felt so powerless. In the afternoon, he had even sworn to Chen Yun that he would make a name for himself and climb up the ranks. One day, he would stand in front of Tan Zekun and slap him.
However, now, he could not even save his sister. Without the surgery fees, he could only watch his sister die!
The next moment, the man’s phone rang.
“Really? Alright, alright, alright. Thank you so much. Thank you so much...” Tears streamed down Father Lin’s face as his body hunched.
“Dad, what’s wrong?”
“Someone will distribute the money we raised online later. Xiao Fan is saved.”

As soon as these words were spoken, Lin Yuhan became excited. Not long ago, someone had come to look for them and said that they wanted to help them raise money. Yesterday, he had even seen the data online.
They were about to raise 400,000 yuan.
It was 400,000 yuan!
With this 400,000 yuan and some money in their hands, it would be enough to cover Xiao Fan’s surgery fees!
Not long after, a few men walked towards the family.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Five Thousand?
paragraphs: Father Lin looked at the three of them and quickly went up to them. He nodded and bowed. “Mr. Qu, you really saved us from trouble. I really don’t know what debt I owed in my previous life. Why did the heavens treat my Xiao Fan like this...”
Lin Yuhan quickly came over to greet the three of them.

Qu Jingsen looked at Father Lin, who was crying in front of him, with disdain in his eyes. He was not in a hurry to hand over the money. He had seen many poor people like this. Every one of them was like this.

Beside him, a young man also sneered and pretended to look at the intensive care unit. He let out a long sigh. “Sigh, your family is really too much. I don’t know what sins you committed to give birth to such a sickly thing. Your entire family is implicated by her. Sigh...”
Lin Yuhan was stunned when he heard this. Then, he burned with anger. What did he mean by sickly?!
What did he mean by saying that she implicated them?!
He suddenly raised his head, but in the next moment, Father Lin grabbed him. Father Lin looked at him and said in a low voice, “Yuhan! Think about Xiao Fan. Don’t be rash!”
At the thought of this, Lin Yuhan glared at the young man and stopped talking.

At this moment, Qu Jingsen looked at Lin Yuhan’s performance and smiled playfully. He said to Lin Yuhan with concern, “However, don’t be afraid. The Little Angel Fundraising Platform was established to help families like yours solve their problems.”

“Now that everyone’s living standards are better, there are many people donating love. Moreover, when one party is in trouble, everyone will provide support. Everyone knows about your sister’s matter and has also contributed their love. Our Little Angel Fundraising Platform has also contributed some money. It’s not much money. It can be considered a token of appreciation.”
“After all, we’ve been helped before. How could we not help you at this time? Otherwise, it would really be unreasonable.”
When Lin Yuhan and the others heard his words, they were overjoyed. They did not expect the other party to have a sharp tongue but a soft heart. The platform could even donate to them.
With 400,000 yuan, the donation from the platform, and the remaining money in their hands, should be enough!
This time, they didn’t even need to borrow money from others!
He would go out and do odd jobs to gather the rest of the money. Although it was a little tough and tiring, he could still make ends meet.
Father Lin also said excitedly, “I’m really sorry. I thought you were liars before. I apologize. Thank you, platform. Thank you. If you hadn’t helped us, my Xiao Fan...”
Qu Jingsen waved his hand. “I’ve already said that this is what caring people like us should do.”
“Thank you, thank you. Even if I have to work like a cow or a horse in my life, I will repay you.”

“Sigh, what do you mean by working like a cow or a horse?” Qu Jingsen looked at the three people in front of him. “Let’s not chat anymore. How about this? Let’s take a photo together first. Later, you can sign an agreement and we can give you the money.”
“Alright, alright, alright.” Father Lin wiped his tears.
“That’s right, that’s right. Wipe your tears and be happy.” Then, Qu Jingsen looked at the young man. The young man quickly took out his silk banner and phone and took a photo of everyone.
Then, he took out the agreement. “Come on, quickly sign it. We still have a few families to give money to. Don’t delay.”
“Okay, I’ll sign it. I’ll sign it.” Father Lin took the contract and signed his name.
The three of them looked at this and smiled.

“Alright, you’re done signing. Thank you for trusting the Little Angel Fundraising Platform.” Qu Jingsen shook Father Lin’s hand. “Here’s 5,000 yuan. Among them, 3,000 yuan was donated by a kind person. Our platform has subsidized 2,000 yuan. Count it and see if the amount is right.”
His words stunned the three of them like a thunderbolt.
Five thousand yuan...
A kind person donated 3,000 yuan...
Why?
The platform clearly showed 400,000 yuan!
Why was there only 5,000 yuan in their hands?
Five thousand yuan could not even support the cost of being hospitalized for a day.
“Alright, we’re done. Let’s go to visit the next family.” As Qu Jingsen spoke, he looked at the young man beside him. “Don’t forget to post the photos and agreement photos online later.”
With that, he smiled. With this, they could gain the trust of those users.
As for these people, hehe.
They were already poor. How could they have the money to sue them or find trouble with them?
Even if they had the money, so what?

They already had the photos and agreements. If they really caused a ruckus, they could say that these people were insatiable. They had already given this family the money, but they were still not satisfied.
After all, the big smile and the silk banner were already in the photo.
This method was simply tried and tested.
“It’s all thanks to Young Master Wang’s idea. Just by relying on a website, we can easily earn more than a million yuan. Awesome!” Qu Jingsen chuckled and prepared to lead his men to the other side.
The next moment, a figure stood in front of them. “Wait.”
“What’s wrong?” Qu Jingsen looked at Lin Yuhan with a teasing smile.
“The platform clearly showed 400,000 yuan. Why is there only 3,000 yuan? Where’s the rest of the money?”

“What are you talking about? What 400,000 yuan? It’s clearly only 3,000 yuan. Why? Do you think 3,000 yuan isn’t enough? Listen to my advice and quickly give up on that burden. Otherwise, your family will collapse too.”
“The sooner such a burden dies, the sooner she’ll be reincarnated.”
“Get lost. Don’t block us.”
When Qu Jingsen heard about the 400,000 yuan, his eyes immediately turned cold.
The sooner she died, the sooner she would be reincarnated...
His words made Lin Yuhan’s eyes burn with anger. He was not a fool. A total of 400,000 yuan became 3,000 yuan. There was no need to mention the remaining money.
He even said that the platform donated 2,000 yuan!
Bullsh*t!
At that moment, Lin Yuhan grabbed Qu Jingsen’s collar. “This money is for saving lives. How dare you pocket it! Do you still have a conscience?!”
He roared. These people didn’t just pocket the money that was supposed to save lives!
They even treated his sister as a tool to earn money!
They treated a seriously ill and young child as a tool!
They were crazily extracting her value!
Qu Jingsen grabbed Lin Yuhan’s hand. “Kid, let me tell you, don’t cause trouble for me. If you dare to touch me today, I’ll throw you into a cell and lock you up for a few years.”
“Our background is not something you can imagine, nor is it something a poor person like you can afford to offend. Be sensible and get lost.”
“F*ck you!” Lin Yuhan simply punched him.

For a moment, the scene was chaotic. Lin Yuhan was outnumbered three to one. Although Mr. and Mrs. Lin stepped forward, they were kicked away. At their age, they were kicked and could only lie on the ground and watch as Lin Yuhan was beaten up.
After punching and kicking, Lin Yuhan was also beaten to the ground. His face was bruised.
“Pfft! Brat, just you wait!” Qu Jingsen simply stepped on Lin Yuhan’s broken arm.
“Ah!” A scream filled the entire corridor.
Seeing that there were more and more people around, Qu Jingsen pulled the two young men and said, “Let’s go.”
Just as they were about to leave, they saw a figure rush over.
He kicked the young man in the chest.
Crack!
A muffled sound immediately sounded.
A young man was instantly sent flying a few meters and fell to the ground. He only breathed out and did not breathe in. He was like a dead dog.
Qu Jingsen’s heart skipped a beat. Then, he looked at the young man in slim-fit clothes. In the next moment, his neck was grabbed and he was lifted up!
