chapters.title: Chapter 120: We Will Bear the Fees
paragraphs: At this moment, Chen Yun had thrown away the fruit basket he was holding, causing the fruits to scatter. At this moment, he was holding Qu Jingsen’s neck and smashing him against the hospital wall.
There was a thud.
It made one’s scalp tingle.
After a while, the snow-white walls of the hospital were even stained with blood!
Qu Jingsen felt the pain and looked at Chen Yun. He was about to say something when he met a pair of eyes.
The pair of eyes were like ferocious beasts. No! They were even more ferocious than ferocious beasts.
It was as if the eyes wanted to devour him!
They wanted to tear him apart!
If looks could kill, Qu Jingsen felt that he had already died several times!
“Let go! Stop!”
A hospital director looked at the scene in front of him and shouted at Chen Yun, “Do you know where this is?! Is this a place you can cause trouble in?!”
Then, he looked at the nurse beside him. “Call the security guards and get them to come up and deal with it.”
When Lin Yuhan, who was on the ground, saw this, he stood up and held Chen Yun’s hand. Then, he looked at Qu Jingsen, whose face had turned green and could not breathe for a long time.
It was a huge shock.
“Brother, don’t be rash. You don’t really want to kill him, do you?”
Lin Yuhan pulled Chen Yun. Chen Yun’s eyes turned cold as he threw Qu Jingsen out.
The force was so strong that Qu Jingsen fell to the ground.
“What’s going on?” Chen Yun looked at Lin Yuhan and asked the reason.
He did not need to know the reason at all just now. As long as anyone dared to touch his people, this would be the outcome.
The saying that one should help the reasonable and not one’s loved ones didn’t apply to Chen Yun!

“They used Xiao Fan to trick people into donating money online. They clearly raised 400,000 yuan but only gave us 5,000 yuan. They even said that Xiao Fan should die early and reincarnate early...” As Lin Yuhan spoke, his voice choked up, making Chen Yun’s eyes turn even colder.
“What 400,000 yuan? What 400,000 yuan?! You poor bastard, you’re just trying to cheat me of my money!” As Qu Jingsen spoke, he looked at the security captain who was walking over and sneered.
As soon as the security captain, Huang Lin, saw Qu Jingsen, he knew the reason for this.
After all, this was not the first time something like this had happened.
However, Qu Jingsen often ate with him and even gave him gifts, so he naturally did him a favor.
At this moment, Huang Lin shouted as he walked, “What’s wrong? What’s wrong? Who’s causing a medical dispute?”
Lin Yuhan looked at Huang Lin. “We didn’t cause a medical dispute. This person is swindling us. I want to call the police.”
“What are you calling the police for!” Huang Lin sneered. “The hospital has its rules. You’re the ones who caused trouble. Get out obediently now. Otherwise, we won’t be polite.”
He did not need to ask for the reason at all because he knew too well what the reason was.
“You won’t be polite? What do you want to do?” Chen Yun saw Huang Lin and Qu Jingsen look at each other a few times. He frowned and immediately understood.
“What are you doing?” Huang Lin took out a rubber stick from his waist. “Young man, don’t be so arrogant. Do you really want me to invite you out?”
They did not need to care about such a person at all.

Qu Jingsen was especially good at looking for people. The people he found were all people who had gone bankrupt to treat illnesses. Such people usually borrowed all the money they could borrow from the people around them, so they did not have any social connections.
It was fine if they hit or scolded such people.
If they were thrown onto the streets, what could they do? Even if they found the police, they did not have the money to file a lawsuit!
Therefore, he did not want to be polite at all. Immediately, a threatening voice sounded.
“What are you waiting for? Hurry up and throw them out!” Huang Lin shouted. The security guards glared at Chen Yun and the others.
The next moment, a few figures walked over from the other side of the corridor.

“Director Liu, I still have to consider being your hospital’s consultant. After all, I don’t know much about your hospital’s situation, but from the looks of it, it should be quite good,” said an old man as he stood beside a middle-aged man.
Director Liu looked at the person beside him with a respectful expression. He had no right to be disrespectful. After all, this was Divine Doctor Zhang Ming.
It was rumored that Divine Doctor Zhang was famous when he was young. Now, he was the top Chinese medicine doctor in Jiangbei. In China, he was also a rare figure.
If they could invite Zhang Ming to their hospital, their hospital would definitely be able to suppress the affiliated hospital of Taizhou Medical University and become the best hospital in Yanwei.
From today’s situation and Zhang Ming’s expression, they shouldn’t be far from achieving this.
Just as he was feeling smug, he looked at the situation in front of him and frowned.
“What are you doing? What’s wrong?! You’re all squeezing here.” Director Liu growled.

Huang Lin looked at the director and pointed at Chen Yun and the others. “Director, these people don’t have money to treat their illnesses and are still causing trouble in the hospital. Look, they even hit someone here.”

Beside him, Qu Jingsen sneered when he saw the director arrive. “The poor mountains and rivers really produce unruly people. Director, quickly get these people to scram. If they don’t have money, why are they treating illnesses?”
“The hospital isn’t a welfare home.”
These few words made the director immediately snort coldly. Then, he looked at Zhang Ming beside him. Seeing him frown, he shouted in his heart that something was wrong. Then, he looked at Huang Lin.
“What are you guys waiting for? Hurry up and...”
Before he could finish speaking, he saw Zhang Ming bow 90 degrees beside him with an extremely respectful expression.
“Little... Little Divine Doctor, I didn’t expect you to be here too.”
Little Divine Doctor!
You?!
This!

Director Liu was also stunned for a moment. He could not believe that he had heard it. He looked at Chen Yun in front of him. Was this the Little Divine Doctor who could determine what Divine Doctor Zhang Ming’s illness was at a glance, even though Divine Doctor Zhang Ming could not resolve it?
Moreover, Divine Doctor Zhang Ming admired him so much!
He actually bowed down!
For a moment, Huang Lin and the people beside him were stunned.
What was this big shot that the director had specially welcomed doing?!

In the next moment, Zhang Ming stood up and looked at Director Liu. “Director Liu, are the security guards of your hospital trying to use violence against the Little Divine Doctor? If you want to chase the Little Divine Doctor out, why don’t you expel me too?”
His voice was not loud, but it was like a hammer that hammered Director Liu’s heart, making his breathing quicken.
These words carried too much weight.
“This, this, this...” Director Liu panicked and did not know what to do. Then, he kicked Huang Lin. “You blind thing, take your salary and get lost later!”

Director Liu was also quite smart. When he heard Huang Lin’s words just now, he immediately scolded the directors accompanying him, “What are you doing? How can you let such a noble person stay in the ICU on this floor?!”
Then, he asked the previous director about Xiao Fan’s condition.

Then, he walked towards Chen Yun. “Little Divine Doctor, do you think this is okay? I’ll transfer the patient to a special care unit now and carry out the surgery immediately. As for the surgery fees, our hospital will bear them all. We’ll also hurry up with the bone marrow matching. Do you think this is okay?”
Director Liu asked with an extremely humble attitude!
Everyone looked at Chen Yun and was stunned!
Even Lin Yuhan’s eyes were filled with disbelief.

If you want to chase the Little Divine Doctor out, why don’t you expel me too?”
His voice was not loud, but it was like a hammer that hammered Director Liu’s heart, making his breathing quicken.
These words carried too much weight.
“This, this, this...” Director Liu panicked and did not know what to do.
Then, he kicked Huang Lin.
“You blind thing, take your salary and get lost later!”
Director Liu was also quite smart.
When he heard Huang Lin’s words just now, he immediately scolded the directors accompanying him, “What are you doing?
How can you let such a noble person stay in the ICU on this floor?!”
Then, he asked the previous director about Xiao Fan’s condition.
Then, he walked towards Chen Yun.
“Little Divine Doctor, do you think this is okay?
I’ll transfer the patient to a special care unit now and carry out the surgery immediately.
As for the surgery fees, our hospital will bear them all.
We’ll also hurry up with the bone marrow matching.
Do you think this is okay?”
Director Liu asked with an extremely humble attitude!
Everyone looked at Chen Yun and was stunned!
Even Lin Yuhan’s eyes were filled with disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: My Driving Is Steady!
paragraphs: This...
What was going on? How did his brother get the title of Little Divine Doctor? Moreover, the director in front of him was respectful to Chen Yun.
Even Father and Mother Lin looked at Chen Yun in surprise.

A few hours ago, the hospital’s attitude was very clear. If the patient didn’t pay, they would not treat the patient. Moreover, wards were extremely rare. They might not even be able to book them in advance.

However, Chen Yun’s appearance actually made a huge turnaround in the entire matter. The hospital did not ask for a single cent of fees. They even transferred her to a special care unit and hurried up with the surgery and matching.
This was too exaggerated!
When did the hospital become so efficient and charitable?
Father and Mother Lin were not stupid. They knew that the director was trying to express his goodwill to Chen Yun again.
Everything was because of Chen Yun.
When Director Liu asked about his condition just now, Chen Yun and Lin Yuhan had already gathered some information and sent it to Ma Ke.
It had only been a few minutes.

The Little Angel Fundraising Platform’s scheme was exposed. Moreover, many witnesses had personally pointed out their despicable actions. For a moment, the Little Angel Fundraising Platform became the target of everyone’s criticism.
A small website was criticized until the number of users reached the upper limit. Then, the server directly collapsed.
It could be seen how much the entire Internet hated such despicable actions!
Chen Yun even got Ma Ke to upload photos of Qu Jingsen and the others. Everyone was indignant and started to attack them.
The right to privacy did not exist at all. The right to privacy also depended on who it was. For such a person, living was a waste of air.
After a while, Qu Jingsen received many calls, and his face turned pale.

Then, he looked at the news and revelations on his phone browser and his legs trembled. In the next moment, he fell to the ground. His eyes were filled with shock as he looked at Chen Yun as if he was looking at a demon.
He knew that the rest of his life was ruined. This revelation isolated him from his friends and family. Moreover, he received a call from the police.
After a while, the police came to take Qu Jingsen away. Chen Yun looked at Lin Yuhan. “Yuhan, go and make a statement. I’ll look after Xiao Fan here. Don’t worry.”
“Brother, with you around, I can rest assured.” At this moment, Lin Yuhan was bandaged and had a long-lost smile on his face. It was as if he had been relieved of a burden and seen hope in life.
They entered the ward.
“Uncle, Auntie, let’s go and see Xiao Fan.” Chen Yun looked at Father and Mother Lin. Then, they walked into the new ward.
Looking at the little girl on the bed, Chen Yun took out the Heavenly Spirit Water.
Chen Yun fed Xiao Fan, and Father and Mother Lin did not stop him. They knew that Chen Yun would not harm Xiao Fan.
After feeding her, Chen Yun wrote a prescription that was mainly for Xiao Fan to recuperate.

Although he had the Unparalleled Medical Skill, he was not a god after all. For leukemia, it was better to have a bone marrow transplant. The medicine prescribed by Chen Yun was mainly to let Xiao Fan recover as soon as possible after undergoing chemotherapy and other damaging treatments.
With the Heavenly Spirit Water and the prescription, Xiao Fan did not have to suffer so much.
After chatting with Mr. and Mrs. Lin for a while, Chen Yun looked at the sky outside. It was already late.
Then, a call came in.
“Director Chen, we’ve arrived at Yanwei. Where are you?”
“I’ll send you an address later. It’s been a long journey.”
“Not at all, not at all. Alright, Director Chen. We’ll rush there immediately.” After the young man hung up the phone, his hands trembled with excitement. Who was Director Chen?!
The Chairman of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, a figure who stood at the top of Jiangbei, actually said that he had worked hard. It simply made him feel like he was in a dream.
At that moment, he felt like a scholar who would die for his confidant.
His entire body was filled with motivation.
Seeing that Chen Yun was about to leave, Father and Mother Lin stood up. “Xiao Yun, I’ll send you off.”

“No need, no need.” Chen Yun took out a bank card and handed it to Father Lin. “Uncle Lin, there’s some money on this card. The password is six zeros. Take it as an emergency fund first. If it’s not enough, ask me for more.”
You!

Father Lin looked at the card in his hand and quickly pushed it. “Xiao Yun, you’ve already saved Xiao Fan’s life. No matter what, we can’t take your money anymore. The Lin family already owes you too much. I won’t be able to repay you even if I work like a horse for the rest of my life.”
As he spoke, the man was sobbing.

“Uncle Lin.” Chen Yun sighed. “I earned some money in Jiang City. This bit of money is nothing to me. Use it as much as you want. When I was young, didn’t you get Yuhan to call me over to eat with you? You never treated me as an outsider.”
“Furthermore, Xiao Fan still has to recuperate after this. After she recovers, she still has to go to school. She has to have money.”
“Child...”
Father Lin choked a few times and looked at the card. “I’ll definitely return the money to you.”
Chen Yun still wanted to say something, but when he saw the determination in Father Lin’s eyes, he was silent for a moment. “It’s good that Xiao Fan is fine. Everything will be fine.”
“Uncle, Auntie, I’m leaving.” Chen Yun waved his hand and did not let them send him out. He entered the elevator alone.
“This...” Father Lin sighed. “I’m old and useless. I even let the younger generation help me.”
“Xiao Yun has become successful. Even the director is so respectful to him.” Aunt Lin smiled in relief.

“Mm, let’s not touch this money if we can. Now, I can go out and work. It won’t be a problem for me to maintain my livelihood.” Father Lin handed the card to Mother Lin. The latter nodded and put the card away. She had no intention of touching it.
However, what they did not know was that there were tens of millions of yuan in the card!
Then, Zhang Ming called Chen Yun and wanted to treat him to a meal, but Chen Yun rejected him. Then, he sent Zhang Ming a prescription.
Chen Yun stretched. After thinking for a moment, he called Zhou Jingyi and asked her to send a team of people to investigate.
It was not bad to open a few First-Grade Restaurant branches in Yanwei.
In that case, his parents could try the dishes that only the royal family could eat in the past.
“Mom, I’ll be back in a while. What are we eating tonight?” Chen Yun called back. “Oh, steamed buns. I’ll just eat half a bun.”

“Don’t worry, your son is already an experienced driver. I’m driving very steadily. It’s fine even if the steering wheel is thrown away.” Chen Yun teased. After resolving his brother’s predicament, even Chen Yun felt relieved.
This was especially when he saw Lin Yuhan’s smile.
Chen Yun walked towards the underground garage, got into the car, and inserted the car keys.

“Sigh, this sound isn’t domineering enough.” Chen Yun touched the steering wheel of the Passat and recalled his Bugatti Veyron. The sound waves and appearance were especially eye-catching when he drove it.
Just as Chen Yun got into the car, a few figures slowly appeared from behind the pillar.
“Look closely. Is it him?”
“Yes, it’s him. He ruined our plan today and even exposed our matter online. I won’t be mistaken.”
When a young man heard this, he blew the cigarette in his mouth to the side.
Good lord, after waiting for so long, this bastard finally came out!

chapters.title: Chapter 122: I’ll Slap You With My Belt!
paragraphs: In the end, Yanwei was not as prosperous as Jiang City. It was still early, but there were not many cars on the main road, let alone the small roads Chen Yun took.
After driving for a while, Chen Yun had no choice but to step on the brakes and stop the car. Then, he narrowed his eyes.
In front of him, an Mercedes-Benz E-Class and an Audi A6 blocked his path. Behind him, a Land Rover was also parked. Three cars blocked Chen Yun in the middle.

Looking at this situation, Chen Yun smiled. This was the first time he had been blocked in such a way. However, he was a little depressed. He had no grudges locally. Who would block him in such a manner?
Later on, five people got out of the three cars. After Chen Yun looked at one of them, he finally understood.
The young man Chen Yun was looking at was the one who stood beside Qu Jingsen today and survived..
The other party did not come with good intentions.
Wang Haoran got out of the Land Rover and held a cigarette in his mouth. Then, the young man beside him quickly lit it for him.
This person was the Young Master Wang that Qu Jingsen mentioned. He was also the one who suggested the website.

However, he had been careful back then. He had manipulated Qu Jingsen from behind and pushed him to the front. At first, Qu Jingsen was still timid. Later, after tasting the sweetness, he let go and did not care so much until this incident.
Wang Haoran looked at the Passat, his eyes filled with anger. If he had not been smart previously, he would have been the one whose reputation would have been ruined!
Damn it!
Severing someone’s income was like killing their parents. How could Wang Haoran let Chen Yun off so easily?
One had to know that just a few months ago, he could earn more than a million yuan a month by relying on the website!
Otherwise, how could he afford to drive the Land Rover?
Wang Haoran walked forward and knocked on Chen Yun’s car window.
Chen Yun lowered the car window and looked at him.

Wang Haoran was stunned. For a moment, he thought that the person sitting in the car was some celebrity. This kid had a good face. It made people want to punch him in the face and make his face look inhuman.

Chen Yun looked outside and sneered. “Everyone, it seems that you’re the ones behind the website. It turns out that the police arrested the wrong person today. The person who should be arrested is here.”
“I didn’t expect you guys to come knocking on my door.”
They had delivered themselves to him.
These words immediately made Wang Haoran sneer. This kid was still so ignorant even at this moment. Could he not tell that he was already surrounded?
“Young Master Wang, why are you still wasting your breath on him? Just kill him.”
Chen Yun clicked his tongue. “I advise you to call 120 now.”
Hahahaha...

Chen Yun’s words made them laugh out loud, as if they had heard a huge joke. “Kid, do you know what you’re talking about?! Let me tell you, you cut off my source of income. If you don’t give me an explanation today, do you think it might be easy?”
“What explanation do you want?”
“Cut off an arm and a leg.”
“What if I can’t?”

“What if you can’t?” Wang Haoran chuckled. “Brother, that’s not up to you. I’ve been blocking you in the parking lot since this afternoon, but I’ve waited for you for so long. If you don’t cooperate, we can only use violence.”
“Don’t worry, I’m also a reasonable person. I’ll pay for your medical fees and mental damage compensation. I definitely won’t let you die in the hospital without anyone caring about you.”
Wang Haoran’s eyes turned cold. It was because he wanted Chen Yun to suffer for the rest of his life for what he did today!
“That’s all I’m going to say. Think about it carefully. I’ll give you five seconds. If you don’t get out of the car after five seconds, don’t blame us for being rude.”
“One!”
Boom!
Wang Haoran had just shouted “one” when a roar suddenly sounded, scaring him. He hurriedly rolled to the side.
Thud!
With a muffled sound, Chen Yun simply reversed the car!
The car crashed towards Wang Haoran!
However, he dodged quickly. The Passat did not stop and crashed into the Land Rover behind him.
One hit!
The bumper of the Land Rover had fallen off. The headlights had exploded, and there was a lot of dents in the front of the car.
“F*ck your mother!” Wang Haoran couldn’t smile anymore. His eyes widened and his face was filled with disbelief.
He would never have thought that Chen Yun would want to kill them!
Moreover, Chen Yun had even knocked down his car!
This was his new Land Rover!

It was not only him. The young man beside him was also dumbfounded. Chen Yun’s madness was unexpected. He actually ignored them and collided with someone. He collided with the car before hitting anyone!
Would they dodge? If they dodged, the car would be gone. if they didn’t dodge, they would be gone.

After hitting the Land Rover, Chen Yun was not done yet. He directly put the car to S-mode and increased the rotations per minute to 8,000rpm! He activated the gasoline direct injection and charged at the young men in front of him.
The two of them dodged.
Thud!
There was another muffled sound, and the door of the Mercedes-Benz E-Class immediately caved in.
“Ah! My car, my new car!”
Knock, knock, knock!
The sound of collisions rang out, making the young men’s hearts bleed. These were all their new cars!
Just like that, their cars became like this!
This!
They couldn’t even fix it!
Damn it, how much was a Passata worth?!
Just like that, he destroyed their cars, which added up to more than a million yuan!
However, Chen Yun had already knocked open a path, but he did not leave. Instead, he continued to knock into the cars!
When Wang Haoran saw that his Land Rover was in tatters, his eyes immediately turned red and his body trembled with anger.
However, there was nothing he could do now. He could only suppress his anger and stare at the Passat.
“Young Master Wang, what should we do?” A young man looked at Wang Haoran helplessly.
First, Chen Yun had cut off their source of income, and now, he had damaged their new cars. How could they not be angry?!
“Just you wait! Let’s see how long he can crash for! I don’t want my new car anymore! I’m going to kill him today! I promise!” Wang Haoran took a deep breath, his eyes filled with anger.
“I can’t take it anymore. My new car has been smashed into that state. I can’t take it anymore. Give me the knife!”
“Don’t be rash. Come back first!”
At this moment, the young man’s eyes were red. How could he listen to Wang Haoran? He immediately took the knife and slashed at the Passat!
Buzz!
Chen Yun stepped on the accelerator and slammed into the young man with a bang.
Thud!
In an instant, he knocked the young man two to three meters away. Then, Chen Yun looked at the situation and pulled the hand brake. He slammed the car door and got out of the car.
“Alright!” Wang Haoran looked at Chen Yun. “Kid, you still dare to alight from your car. You’re bold and gutsy! If I don’t kill you today, my surname won’t be Wang! Attack!”
A few young men took out their sabers from their waists and rushed towards Chen Yun.
When Chen Yun saw this, the corners of his mouth curled into a teasing smile. Then, he pulled out his belt and pants.
Whoosh!
The belt was even more violent than a wet whip. It directly hit a young man two meters away. Half of his face was swollen and he spat a few mouthfuls of blood.

First, Chen Yun had cut off their source of income, and now, he had damaged their new cars.
How could they not be angry?!
“Just you wait!
Let’s see how long he can crash for!
I don’t want my new car anymore!
I’m going to kill him today!
I promise!” Wang Haoran took a deep breath, his eyes filled with anger.
“I can’t take it anymore.
My new car has been smashed into that state.
I can’t take it anymore.
Give me the knife!”
“Don’t be rash.
Come back first!”
At this moment, the young man’s eyes were red.
How could he listen to Wang Haoran?
He immediately took the knife and slashed at the Passat!
Buzz!
Chen Yun stepped on the accelerator and slammed into the young man with a bang.
Thud!
In an instant, he knocked the young man two to three meters away.
Then, Chen Yun looked at the situation and pulled the hand brake.
He slammed the car door and got out of the car.
“Alright!” Wang Haoran looked at Chen Yun.
“Kid, you still dare to alight from your car.
You’re bold and gutsy!
If I don’t kill you today, my surname won’t be Wang!
Attack!”
A few young men took out their sabers from their waists and rushed towards Chen Yun.
When Chen Yun saw this, the corners of his mouth curled into a teasing smile.
Then, he pulled out his belt and pants.
Whoosh!
The belt was even more violent than a wet whip.
It directly hit a young man two meters away.
Half of his face was swollen and he spat a few mouthfuls of blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Unlocking an Impressive Skill!
paragraphs: Putting aside the fact that Wang Haoran and the others did not know how to fight regularly, even experienced mercenaries were nothing in front of Chen Yun.

There was no need to activate the Eye of Truth to fight Wang Haoran and the others. Chen Yun sent them flying with a few attacks from his belt. These people did not even walk within half a meter of Chen Yun.
Looking at the group of wailing people, Chen Yun sneered at them. “Don’t you guys know your place? How ridiculous.”

Hearing Chen Yun’s words, Wang Haoran’s heart skipped a beat. He subconsciously rubbed against the ground and stepped half a meter back. He said weakly, “Don’t do anything rash. Let me tell you, if you dare to attack me again...”
“Why are you talking so much nonsense? Are you still threatening me at this time?”
Chen Yun whipped his belt.
With a slap, Chen Yun almost broke Wang Haoran’s blocked arm.
“What exactly do you want?!” Veins popped up on Wang Haoran’s forehead as he looked at Chen Yun.
“What do I want? You came to block me, and now you’re asking me what I want?”

Wang Haoran looked at the smile on Chen Yun’s face and was so frightened that his soul almost left his body. He had never seen anyone so good at fighting. He was holding a belt alone and beating them up as if he was playing with knives.
It was simply too terrifying.
He also knew that he had encountered a difficult figure. The other party was a tough nut to crack.

As Wang Haoran spoke, his voice trembled. “Brother, we didn’t have eyes today. We met a tough guy like you. You won, but don’t be happy too early. There are surveillance cameras here. You damaged our cars and hit our people. This isn’t something that can be resolved casually!”
“Don’t worry, I’ll compensate you for the cars. Not only will I compensate you, but I’ll also compensate you with double the amount!”
“These cars of yours are only worth 1.5 million yuan, right? I’ll give you three million yuan. Just wait.” Chen Yun made a call to the secretarial team that had just arrived.
In less than ten minutes, a few cars drove over. A few people got out, each of them carrying a leather suitcase.
They looked at the scene in front of them and their hearts trembled. This!
What was going on? It was too terrifying!
Was this the scene of a car accident?!
It didn’t seem like one!
Moreover, why were these people all lying on the ground?
The man in the lead quickly walked towards Chen Yun. “Director Chen, are you alright?”
“It’s fine.” Chen Yun looked at them. “Have you brought the things?”
“I was delayed on the way. Please forgive me.”
As he spoke, he opened the suitcase with the others.
There were six people!
There were six suitcases!
After opening the suitcases!
Six boxes of red notes shone in everyone’s eyes!
It was extremely eye-catching!
The five people on the ground looked at the red notes in the boxes and widened their eyes. They could not believe what they were seeing. These were stacks of yuan!
The six boxes of money contained three million yuan!
How could the five of them not be excited?!

At this moment, Chen Yun took out a stack of money and weighed it in his hand. “It’s hard to talk about anything else, but I’m especially trustworthy. Since I said that I’ll compensate you, I’ll compensate you.”

“Alright!” At this moment, Wang Haoran seemed to have forgotten the pain. “Brother, you’re indeed an open-minded person. We won’t look for you again in the future. Brother, if you have any difficulties, feel free to...”
The next moment, before he could finish speaking, the money in Chen Yun’s hand smashed towards his face.
Thud!
Splash...
After a muffled sound, the seal broke open, and a hundred red notes scattered with the wind.
As for Wang Haoran, his nose bridge was sunken as he fell to the ground. It was unknown if he was dead or alive.

“The ancients really didn’t lie to me. No wonder people always say that you can kill someone with money. It turns out that you can really kill someone with money.” Chen Yun took out another stack and threw it at Wang Haoran’s crotch.
With a muffled sound, everyone present, including the secretaries, felt their hearts tighten and cold sweat seeped out of their foreheads.
Damn it, what kind of strength was Director Chen using?
The stack of money just now made a sharp sound.
If this continued, he would probably be crippled for the rest of his life.
Everyone’s hearts were filled with sadness.
After the third stack, Wang Haoran’s left hand was twisted.
After the fourth stack, his right hand broke.
The fifth stack of red notes was thrown!
His penis was broken!

When the remaining four young men saw this, it was as if a basin of cold water had been poured over their heads on a hot day. Their entire bodies turned cold, and a cold aura rose from their feet and surged into their hearts.
“Brother, we were wrong. We won’t dare to earn money through evil means again.”
“We won’t do it again.”
“Let us go.”

The four of them cried. However, Chen Yun ignored them. “Let me tell you. I’m a person who doesn’t fight first. I’ll make things clear to you first. You don’t have to argue with me. If I say I’ll give you money, I won’t shortchange you.”
“However, how much you can accept will depend on your luck.”
The next moment, Chen Yun threw out another stack of red notes.
That night, many people on the streets were picking up money like crazy.

They did not believe that pies would fall from the sky and that they could pick up money on the way. However, looking at this scene, they were simply using both hands and feet, afraid that others would beat them to it.
When they found the source and saw this scene, they were all shocked.
The four cars were unrecognizable.
The four people present were also unrecognizable. Moreover, their limbs were twisted. They only breathed out and almost did not breathe in. They were about to die.
Who was this?!
He was actually so ruthless!
Everyone who saw this widened their eyes and hurriedly left with the money around them.
At this moment, in a black car, Chen Yun looked at the remaining five boxes of half-red notes and snorted. They could not accept the money.
“Don’t say that. It feels a little good to throw money at someone.” Chen Yun clenched his hands, scaring the men in the car. They looked at Chen Yun.
Director Chen seemed to have activated some unusual hobby...
“Director Chen, this is the agreement. Please sign it.” A secretary handed the agreement to Chen Yun, but his hands were trembling.
After all, they were also people who had witnessed the scene just now. It would be a lie to say that they were not afraid.
Chen Yun took it. After signing it, the remaining assets of the Su family were all received by Chen Yun.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Is the Car Model Written Under the Logo on Your Passat?
paragraphs: Now that he was done signing, Chen Yun could be considered to have resolved a matter on his mind. In this way, all the Su family’s assets would be under his name, and he had paid a small price.
Back home.
“Our son is back.” Mother Chen quickly stood up and brought out the hot rice in the pot for Chen Yun.
“Mom, don’t move. I’ll go.”
Chen Yun brought out the food. After sitting down, he scratched his head. “Let me tell you something. I damaged our Passat.”
These words shocked Father Chen and Mother Chen. They quickly stood up from the sofa and walked quickly towards Chen Yun.
“Were you in a car accident? Are you alright?”
“How could you be so careless!”
For a moment, Mother Chen observed Chen Yun. “Do you feel uncomfortable? Do you need to go to the hospital? Let’s go now.”
“No need, no need.” Chen Yun originally thought that his parents would lecture him. After all, there were many memories in the car.
“That car...” Chen Yun probed.
Father Chen waved his hand. “You don’t have to worry about the car. I’ll go to the car repair factory tomorrow to repair it. It won’t cost much to go to Uncle Wang’s place.”
When Father Chen saw that Chen Yun did not even have a scratch on his skin, he thought that something had just happened, so he did not take it to heart.
Chen Yun was speechless. This might not be a matter of money.
Chen Yun took a bite of a steamed bun. “This car, well, it’s just a little more damaged than you think.”
“It’s fine. At most, there’s just a dent in the car door, right?”
“It’s a bit worse than that.”
“Huh?” Mother Chen frowned. “It’s worse?”
“That’s right. It’s the kind where the car shell is almost scrapped.” Chen Yun smiled bitterly, stunning the two of them.
Oh my god.
What kind of explanation was this?!
The car shell was almost scrapped?!
No, how did he drive such that he incurred such damage?
That was heavy damage! Putting aside everything else, the car was very resistant to collisions.
If such a car could have its car shell scrapped, what exactly happened?!
“In any case, we can’t drive it anymore.” Chen Yun looked at his father’s pained expression. “I’ll go to the Volkswagen store tomorrow and buy another car.”
Chen Yun finished his meal in a few bites and returned to his room. It was almost time for Ma Ke’s daily report.
Meanwhile, Father Chen and Mother Chen sat on the sofa, puzzled.
“How do you think he drove the car such that the car shell is scrapped, yet Chen Yun is completely fine?” Father Chen looked at Mother Chen in confusion. Mother Chen also shook her head.
Actually, they did not know that one just had to drive the car like a bumper car!
The next day, Chen Yun woke up early. After running around the surroundings, he took a taxi to the Volkswagen car dealership.
Not long after, a new car was brought out.
At the door, a beautiful salesperson in a short skirt and black silk stockings looked at Chen Yun with stars in her eyes. She handed her business card to Chen Yun with both hands.

“Mr. Chen, this is my business card. If you need anything, contact me. I’ll definitely settle it for you immediately. As for the license plate, I’ll personally send it to your residence after it’s settled.” Chen Yun took the business card, nodded, and drove away.
Looking at the taillights in the distance, the beautiful salesperson simply jumped up excitedly!
She had never expected that she would receive such a huge order at the start of the day. This was almost equivalent to her monthly sales!
It was better to come early!
After the other salespeople walked out of the changing room, they were stunned when they heard the news.
What the f*ck!
Which tycoon bought a car in less than ten minutes?!
“Ahhh! Xiao Fang, I’m so envious of you.”
“It’s a car worth two million yuan. It’s one of the top cars here, but you actually sold it.”
“This time, how much commission will you receive?”
Xiao Fang stood rooted to the ground and accepted everyone’s envy and jealousy. She smiled so widely that she could not close her mouth.
Thinking of the handsome man just now, Xiao Fang could not close her legs.
On the other side, Chen Yun drove his new car and rushed home. Then, he picked up a call. “Beauty Fang, what’s wrong? Alright, wait for me.”
After arriving at the Carnival Hall, Chen Yun parked the car by the roadside.
After a while, a beautiful figure walked out of the district.
Fang Mengjun was wearing a white dress today. She was wearing a sweater and a small jacket. With some makeup, she was simply a beauty walking on the front line of the trend.
“Beauty, do you want to go out for a spin with me?” Chen Yun patted the new car and said, attracting the attention of the passers-by.
Damn it, could he be a hooligan just because he was handsome? He even had such a big audience.
However, in the next moment, Fang Mengjun smiled and held Chen Yun’s arm. “Alright, Brother. Where are we going?”
The passersby were speechless.
F*ck!
Damn it, a commoner could also woo beauties like this. The world had really changed. Could do whatever he wanted just because he was handsome?
The two of them looked at the others and simply got into the car without explaining.
After getting into the car, Fang Mengjun took out a fruit plate from her handbag and placed it in the middle. “Come, I took half an hour to make it. You don’t know how troublesome it was.”
As they ate, Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun. “I looked for Yuhan yesterday and wanted to give him the card. In the end, he told me everything.”
“Why was the director so respectful to you? Also, why do you still have the title of the Little Divine Doctor?” Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun like a curious baby. Her eyes flickered, eager to know.
“I’m just good at medicine, so I’m admired by others.” Chen Yun filled his mouth with a few blueberries. “Do you believe me?”

“Do you think I don’t believe you?” Fang Mengjun asked back. “Yuhan told me that the director came up to you like a bootlicker. In order to curry favor with you, he even converted Xiao Fan’s ward into a special care ward. I was stunned. You’re very impressive, little brother. You hid the key facts from me.”
“I didn’t expect a true dragon to appear among us.”
“Alright, alright, alright. Miss Fang, don’t say that. It doesn’t sound like a good thing to me.” Chen Yun rolled his eyes.
Fang Mengjun picked up a piece of cantaloupe with her fork and stuffed it into Chen Yun’s mouth. “I’ll stuff you to death! How am I not a good person?”
“By the way, by the way, are you especially rich now?”
“Yes, I’m not especially rich now. I’m super rich. Otherwise, how could I afford this car?” Chen Yun smiled. Fang Mengjun looked at the car and sniffed the fragrance of the new car.
The next moment, she muttered, “Do you think I don’t know about cars? This is a Passat. Didn’t Uncle Chen drive this in the past? He has one at home. Why did you buy another one?”
When Chen Yun heard her words, he almost vomited blood. “Hehe, Miss Fang, I’m impressed. You really know about cars. I admit defeat.”
A Passat?!
Was the car model written under the logo on her Passat?!
Had she seen a 12-cylinder Passat?!

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Preparation (1)
paragraphs: Seeing Fang Mengjun’s disbelief, Chen Yun did not explain. “Where’s Huaiyao?”

“Why? Can’t a beautiful woman like me accompany you today? Do you want another beauty? Your appetite isn’t small. Do you want to enjoy the bliss of having everyone at once?” Fang Mengjun stuffed another piece of cantaloupe into Chen Yun’s mouth.

Chen Yun ate the cantaloupe and felt the sweetness of it. He thought to himself that this fruit plate was interesting. She only cut off small pieces of cantaloupe near the center, so the taste was filled with sweetness.
Actually, he did not know that Fang Mengjun had specially cut it for him. She had eaten the remaining parts that were not sweet.
“I’m not that lucky,” said Chen Yun with a smile.
“Heh, you really thought about it!” Fang Mengjun leaned against the backrest. “Yao Yao went back to school. She came back because she wanted to see you and deal with Yuhan’s matter.”
“Now that the matter has been resolved and you’ve seen her, Yao Yao went back to school.”
“Alright, where are we going now?” Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun. “Let’s go. I’ll treat you to lunch.”
Now that Yuhan’s matter was resolved, her money had been returned to her. Now, she felt like a little rich woman. Chen Yun could not help but find it funny.

“What time is it now? Come with me first. Today, I’ll let you know what it feels like to be truly happy and bold.” As Chen Yun spoke, Fang Mengjun immediately pursed her lips. However, a hint of anticipation rose in her heart.
Coincidentally, Chen Yun was free and could make preparations for the First-Grade Restaurant branches.
He would go to take a look at the shop first.
That was what he thought, but there were many places that one could not buy just because one wanted to.
If the location was good, they would not sell it.
If the location was bad, one wouldn’t want to buy it either.

Coincidentally, Chen Yun knew about a commercial property from his parents. It was the Purple Heaven Pavilion District. The district had just been built. Other than houses, there was also a circle of shops outside.

That shop could be said to be a prime location in the future. Although the Purple Heaven Pavilion District was far from the city center and was located in the development area, there was news that a new business circle was going to be developed there. Moreover, it seemed like the infrastructure was being perfected.

Moreover, the Purple Cloud Pavilion District was developed by the best Jinkai Real Estate in Yanwei. There was no need to doubt the quality of the houses, and the property management services were top-notch.
Chen Yun brought Fang Mengjun to the Purple Cloud Pavilion.
“Chen Yun, why are we here? Do you want to buy a house?”
“Of course. If not, would I come here for coffee?”

After bringing Fang Mengjun in, the two of them stood together like a golden couple. Chen Yun was like an immortal who had descended to the mortal world. Fang Mengjun had a gentle temperament, and her looks and figure were indescribable!
This immediately attracted the attention of the salespeople and the other buyers in the hall. After all, people nowadays looked at appearances first.
“Hello, Sir and Miss. Are you here to look at houses?” A sales lady quickly walked over and looked at Chen Yun, her eyes filled with enthusiasm.
She had to receive so many buyers every day, but she had never seen anyone so handsome!
However, when she looked at Fang Mengjun beside him, she instantly deflated. Although she was good-looking, compared to Fang Mengjun, she still felt inferior!
After introducing themselves, Chen Yun asked about the shop.
As expected, because of its geographical location, not many shops had been sold. After all, there were still too few people in the development area.
However, many people had predicted the future policies. Thus, some people came here to buy houses or shops.
“Hey, Mengjun, Chen Yun? Are you here too?” At this moment, a voice sounded.
“Luan Qingqing?” Chen Yun could not help but turn around.
He saw a girl looking at him in surprise.
It was his high school classmate, Luan Qingqing.
“Why are you here? Are you here to pick a wedding room?” Luan Qingqing’s face was filled with joy. Then, she raised her eyebrows, her eyes filled with hidden meanings.

Chen Yun and Fang Mengjun immediately smiled bitterly. It was no wonder that Luan Qingqing looked at them like this. They had grown up together since they were young. Back then, they did not hide anything in school. Now that they were out alone, it was inevitable that they would be misunderstood.
“No, I’m here to take a look. What about you?” Chen Yun looked to the side. There was a middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman.
If he wasn’t wrong, they should be Luan Qingqing’s parents.
“Me? I’m accompanying my parents to look at houses.” Luan Qingqing’s parents had some spare money, so they wanted to invest in real estate.
They didn’t invest in development. Instead, they wanted to buy another house so that they could rent it out or sell it in the future.
“Oh, how was it?” Chen Yun nodded.
“This is the sixth house we’ve seen today. My father wants to continue looking.”

“There’s no harm in looking at a few more houses.” Chen Yun did not say much. After all, he was different from the other party. They wanted to buy a house and rent it out, while he wanted to buy a shop and open a First-Grade Restaurant branch.
“Okay, I understand. I’ll go over now.”
“Sure.”
The property consultant was very cultured. He stood at the side and quietly waited for them to finish chatting. He did not disturb them rashly.

“Sir, what do you think? Although we’re a distance away from the city, there are many people here. It’s a place that will focus on development in the future.” In the city, no matter how much it developed, it could only develop outwards.
This was indeed the case.
It would probably not be long before the construction here began.
Chen Yun nodded and looked at the site model.

“I know. I want all eight shops on this street. Tell me how much they cost.” Chen Yun looked at the buildings on the site model and pointed at a street. This place was not bad. Chen Yun was prepared to buy it.
In the future, when it was developed, these shops would face a pedestrian street and business would prosper.
Coupled with the culinary skills of the First-Grade Restaurant, the profits would definitely not be small.
The property consultant was stunned. “Do you want all eight shops?”
“Do you want all eight shops?”
Two surprised voices sounded, especially Fang Mengjun, who was beside Chen Yun. She simply exclaimed softly with a look of disbelief.
Chen Yun glanced at her. “Are you showing that human beings are essentially broken records? Why are you still learning from others?”
Fang Mengjun blushed. “I was just shocked.”

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Preparation (2)
paragraphs: She had yet to recover and felt confused. Then, Chen Yun looked at the property consultant.
“Yes, calculate the price for me.” Chen Yun took out his watch and looked at the time.
The property consultant was about to ask again when she looked at the watch on Chen Yun’s hand and immediately shut up!
This watch!
It was the Vacheron Constantin Traversing Four Seas series!
Just this model alone cost hundreds of thousands of yuan. It cost almost a million yuan!

It had been a rule since ancient times that the poor played with cars and the rich played with watches. This time, she looked at Chen Yun’s young face and thought to herself, “Could it be that the young master of some family has come out?”

“Mr. Chen, wait a moment. I’ll calculate it for you.” The property consultant was also a little anxious. She was afraid that he would let the esteemed guest go if she was negligent. She quickly took out a piece of paper, opened the calculator on her phone, and started working.
The cost per square meter for a shop cost more than a residence, and it could not be paid by loan.
However, Chen Yun had no intention of taking a loan.
Soon, the property consultant handed over a piece of paper.

“Mr. Chen, please take a look. This is the area of these shops and the unit price. If you buy them all, it will cost 54 million yuan. Do you think it’s appropriate?” The property consultant asked Chen Yun.
This!
The total cost was 54 million!
It was so expensive!
Fang Mengjun’s pink lips parted slightly as she glanced at Chen Yun. Then, she pulled him to the side. “Chen Yun, you’re asking in such detail. Don’t tell me you really want these shops?”
“I really want them.” Chen Yun chuckled. If he didn’t want them, would he need to waste his time?
You!
Fang Mengjun opened her hand. “Brother, it’s 54 million! 54 million! It’s not 54,000 yuan, or 540,000 yuan.”
Wasn’t it good to use this money to buy food or other things instead?!
Moreover, it was 54 million yuan. Did Chen Yun have so much money?!
“Sister, don’t worry about it.” Chen Yun took advantage of Fang Mengjun. “I know it’s 54 million yuan. Don’t repeat it.”
A price of 54 million yuan was not even enough to match the price when he bid for the jade seal. To Chen Yun, there was really nothing to make a fuss about.
Then, he turned around and took the form from the property consultant.
The largest shop had an area of more than 400 square meters. It was a two-story building.
One square meter cost 30,000 yuan. Thus, the entire shop was worth more than 10 million yuan.
There were two shops with an area of 200 square meters. They only had one floor each.
The remaining five had about the same area. They were all about 150 square meters large.
The eight shops added up to 54 million yuan.
“Alright, just prepare the contract.” Chen Yun waved his hand.
“Alright.” The property consultant was pleasantly surprised.
“Mr. Chen, wait a moment. Sister Li, bring them another cup of tea.”
Looking at the other party’s departing figure, Chen Yun smiled and shook his head.
“The quality of the sales consultants here is not good. I’ve been looking at them for a long time, but none of them are beautiful. No wonder there are so few people.”
The girls here were not bad, but Chen Yun had high standards.
Other than Xiao Xin, Wang Menghan, and Zhou Jingyi, even his childhood friends, Fang Mengjun and Zhang Huaiyao, were all beauties.
The people here could not compare to them at all.
Soon, the entire sales department was stirred.
They had sold eight shops in one go. It was really too showy.
The manager had personally come to serve him.
That fellow treated Chen Yun like an elder. He was really polite.
He served tea, snacks, and various drinks. He had never treated even his biological father this well.
He placed Chen Yun’s matter in the first place and prioritized handling his deal.
Soon, the contract was printed out.
Then, Chen Yun swiped his card, signed the contract, and pressed his thumbprint.
In the end, Chen Yun took eight sets of keys, a thick stack of contracts, and other things.
The entire process stunned Fang Mengjun. Her eyes were wide open. She could not believe what she was seeing!
The total cost was 54 million!
There were no loans!
He paid the full amount!
He even paid for everything at once!
This, this, this!
Fang Mengjun had never been as shocked as she was today in her life!
Was this the life of a rich person?!
Looking at Chen Yun’s expression again, it was as if he had bought a few kilograms of vegetables!
There was no pained expression at all!
“Ahhh, what kind of world is this?!” Fang Mengjun shouted in her heart. She suddenly felt that her values had collapsed.
He said that he would let her experience pleasure and tyranny, but he did not say that he would directly destroy her values!
This was too unbearable!
However, to be honest, the manager had personally come to pour tea for her and was even more respectful to her than to his biological mother. This feeling was not bad.
It was really not bad.

Moreover, when she saw that her childhood friend was actually so rich, she was actually very happy. For some reason, her appetite immediately improved. In addition, the food was really too delicious, making her disregard her image.

Chen Yun looked at Fang Mengjun, who was eating a lot, and poked her, telling her to pay attention to her image. When the manager saw this scene, he naturally understood. “Little Zhang, go and pack some snacks. Bring them over.”
Not long after, a bag of snacks was handed to Fang Mengjun, giving Chen Yun a headache.
After a while, the two of them walked out of the reception room. They did not find Luan Qingqing and left without thinking too much.
Meanwhile, Luan Qingqing’s family had already gone to the site to look at houses.
“What do you think?” After returning to the sales department, Luan Qingqing’s father asked Luan Qingqing and his wife.

“Brother, it’s definitely worth it for you to buy from us. Your daughter’s friend just bought eight shops from us in one go. You can be neighbors.” The property consultant lied. Chen Yun did not buy a house, so they could not be neighbors.
However, that was not important. What was important was to sell the house.
“Did he buy eight buildings? Furthermore, they were shops?” The family of three was stunned.
“Are you sure that it was my friend?” Luan Qingqing was a little confused.
“That’s right. When you came, I even saw you talking to him. He’s really amazing. The total was 54 million, but he simply swiped his card. If only my husband was so amazing.” The woman sighed.

She was extremely envious. Chen Yun was simply handsome and rich. No matter what kind of woman she was, she would want to rely on such a man. However, Chen Yun had a beautiful girl by his side. Compared to that beauty, she was far inferior. “You mean... Chen Yun?” Luan Qingqing did not understand and could not believe it. She immediately asked. After receiving an affirmative answer from the other party, she was also stunned.
Was Chen Yun’s family so impressive?
That was not right. Chen Yun’s family was not as good as her family.
“His surname seems to be Chen. I really don’t know his exact name, but he’s really rich. I’ve been here for so long, but I’ve never seen such a rich person.”
“Oh my god.” The words of the property consultant stirred up huge waves in Luan Qingqing’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: It’s Too Hard for Me...
paragraphs: Walking to the center of the sales building, Fang Mengjun was still in a daze. She recalled what had just happened. It was as if she had a dream.
“Chen Yun, pinch me.” Fang Mengjun pulled Chen Yun’s arm, and Chen Yun pinched her arm.
“Ah! It hurts!”
“You’re the one who asked me to pinch you. You’re the one who’s complaining about the pain now. Heh, woman.”
“You’re too rich now.” Fang Mengjun held back for a long time before saying this.
Chen Yun did not reply to her and brought her out. Then, he saw many people gathered beside his car.
At this moment, it was the peak hour after work. Many people drove here to look at the buildings, so there were more onlookers.
“Chen Yun, look, they’re pointing at your car.” Fang Mengjun pointed at those people and pulled him over. Then, she looked at everyone, whose faces were filled with envy and shock.
This...
Were these people so ignorant now?!
It was just a Passat. Did they have to look so envious?
“Wow, this car is so cool!”
“This is the first time I’ve seen this car in Yanwei. I’ve really opened my eyes today.”
“No, no, I have to take a photo as a memento. I don’t know who’s driving this car. It must be a low-key big shot.”
Everyone discussed animatedly. A few people took out their phones and took photos, causing Fang Mengjun’s eyes to almost pop out.
What were these people doing?
Was this car cool?
Was this the first time they had seen this car? Wasn’t the Passat everywhere on the road?
They even wanted to take a photo as a memento!
She was confused.
For a moment, she felt as if she had returned to the time when cars had first appeared in the country decades ago.
At that time, if anyone had a car, it would be amazing. They would be able to walk sideways.
However, things were different now. It was the 21st century. It could be said that it was rare for anyone not to have a car.
“Are people’s values so distorted nowadays? Isn’t it just a Passat? My family can afford it,” whispered Fang Mengjun as she looked at Chen Yun.
Chen Yun ignored her, but the person not far in front of Fang Mengjun turned around.

This...

Two million yuan!
One could buy a sports car for two million yuan!
In the end, Chen Yun bought this?!
She really did not understand the life of a rich person. It was really simple and boring!

They actually said that he didn’t understand just now.

“I just don’t understand. Isn’t it good to buy a sports car instead?”
“This is for my father. I damaged his car yesterday. I’m compensating him with this car today.”
Fang Mengjun was speechless.
Alright!
This was better than pretending!
She wanted to give him 200 points!
“Let’s go. I’ll bring you to spend money.” Chen Yun brought Fang Mengjun straight to Yanwei’s Century City.
The two of them strolled around Century City for a long time. Fang Mengjun carried shopping bags of various sizes in her hand. Her exquisite face was filled with many emotions.
There was shock, numbness, excitement, desire...
She was extremely conflicted.
At this moment, the customers and shop owners in Century City were stunned when they saw the two of them. What a handsome man and beautiful woman.
In addition, the bags in their hands were all branded bags. They attracted everyone’s attention and an explosive number of people turned back to look at them.
“Is there anything else you want to buy?”

“Brother, you’re my close brother. Why are you still buying me things? How much are these? There’s so much cosmetics, clothes, bags, this and that. They’re all branded. Those who don’t know might think that I’m your lover and you’re playing with me.” Fang Mengjun shook her head like a rattle drum. “I don’t want them. I don’t want them.”
Was he playing with her?
Chen Yun chuckled. He had grown up with Fang Mengjun and naturally knew her personality. No matter how much money it cost, it was impossible for her to sell her body and soul.

Chen Yun looked at his spending points. Previously, he could reach 100 million points if he spent another few hundred thousand yuan. However, now, the difference had only been reduced by more than 100,000 yuan.
He had given Fang Mengjun a chance, but she was useless!
How useless!
Chen Yun looked at Fang Mengjun. “You don’t even know how to spend money.”
“Ah! Big shot, your heart doesn’t ache when you spend money, but my liver is trembling.”
“Let’s go. I’ll buy you and Huaiyao another watch.” Chen Yun pointed at the Patek Philippe watch shop in front.
“I’m not going. I’m not going. I’m not going.” Fang Mengjun had dreamed of buying all kinds of luxury goods one day, but when the day really came, she felt like she was in a nightmare.
“Ah!” Fang Mengjun’s cry spread in all directions.
Chen Yun pulled Fang Mengjun towards the watch shop, but Fang Mengjun refused to enter.
In the shop, the two salespeople looked at the scene and the bags in their hands. They quickly ran over and helped push Fang Mengjun in.
Fang Mengjun was speechless.
She thought, “It’s too hard for me...”

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Come, Come, Come, Clamp It
paragraphs: “Miss, welcome to the Patek Philippe store.”
“Miss, please come in and take a look.”
“It’s fine if you don’t want to buy it. We like your noble temperament.”
Every sentence made Fang Mengjun pout.
Did she have a noble temperament?
She was just a country bumpkin!!!
She wouldn’t buy anything anymore. She wouldn’t dream about luxury goods anymore.
It was too scary!
After she entered, she was stunned. Looking at the strings of zeros in front of her, she began to feel confused.
Ten minutes later, they arrived on the street again. Fang Mengjun had a few bags in her hand.
There were two Patek Philippe watches and a bracelet.
Fang Mengjun did not just carry it as usual. Instead, she hugged the bag with both hands.
She was very careful, as if there was a peerless treasure inside.
What a joke. Just this little bag cost more than a million yuan. When she saw Chen Yun swipe his card, her heart twitched a few times.
In the Phaeton, Fang Mengjun placed the shopping bags neatly on the back seat. Chen Yun could not help but laugh when he saw them.
“Alright, Miss Fang. At this rate, are you going to personally escort them?”
Fang Mengjun rolled her eyes at Chen Yun. It was all because of him!
She placed the other things behind her and played with the two boxes in her hand.
She opened the box and took a look. A Cartier bracelet came into view, making Fang Mengjun’s eyes involuntarily flash with fondness.
She had seen a bracelet at the Cartier online store before, but she had only taken a look.
How much was that bracelet worth?
It was worth 45,000 yuan!
It contained a real diamond!
Looking at the price, Fang Mengjun endured the pain and gave up. She didn’t even want to think about it. Even if she had money, she wouldn’t spend it like that!
But now, the model Chen Yun had bought for her was simply incomparable. This model cost 250,000 yuan!
It was a limited edition model worldwide!
This diamond was simply incomparably dazzling!
If she wore it out and encountered someone who didn’t know about such things, they would think that it was fake!
After all, there were too many diamonds on it. The main diamond was too big!
Then, she opened the other box. There was a watch lying inside.
It cost 880,000!
The item was good, and this number...
It was super expensive!
She only took a second look at this thing. Then, Chen Yun simply asked the shop assistant to wrap it up without asking for her opinion.
At the side, Chen Yun looked at Fang Mengjun and asked telepathically, “Why? Do you not like it?”
“I like it.”
Fang Mengjun said it in a low voice without thinking. After saying this, she was stunned.
This...
Then, Chen Yun brought Fang Mengjun for lunch.
Initially, Fang Mengjun thought that buying a house and luxury goods in the morning was the end of her suffering. Little did she know that this was only the beginning!
In the afternoon, the two of them spent 270,000 yuan on a meal!
A bottle of red wine cost 200,000 yuan!
In the afternoon, Chen Yun brought her to the most upscale club in Yanwei for a spa. In Fang Mengjun’s opinion, throughout the entire afternoon, they simply spent money like dirt!
However, in Chen Yun’s opinion, this bit of money was simply not worth mentioning. What could money be used for?
Other than buying money to be happy, what else could money do?
At night, Chen Yun wanted to invite Fang Mengjun to another place for a meal, but she refused.
Ever since she was shocked by Chen Yun in the afternoon and they ate a meal that cost as much as her family car, she was traumatized from eating outside.

This was the first time in her life that she felt that the steamed buns and side dishes at home were more delicious than the fish and meat outside. At the very least, she could eat at ease. Otherwise, every time she ate, she would be like a calculator calculating how much money she had eaten.

“Alright, Beauty Fang. Take your things and don’t leave them behind.” Chen Yun got out of the car. Seeing that Fang Mengjun couldn’t take them, he immediately placed the remaining two gift bags under her arm.

“Come, come, come. Clamp it. Don’t drop it. These two costs tens of thousands of yuan. They might break if you drop them.” Chen Yun deliberately said something that made Fang Mengjun immediately clamp the two gift bags tightly.
When she walked, she was simply no different from a large penguin.
Along the way, Fang Mengjun attracted people to turn back and look at her. After all, this style was too shocking!
In the meantime, if not for the kind-hearted person who helped her swipe the card and open the door, she might not have been able to return home.
After knocking on the door, Mother Fang looked at her daughter. “What’s with your style? It’s so unique.”
Fang Mengjun rolled her eyes at her mother. When she saw her hand reach out to help her carry her things, she immediately shouted, “Don’t move! Don’t move, don’t move!”
Then, she simply walked into the house in her shoes. She gently placed all these gift bags and boxes on the bed.
Only then did she heave a sigh of relief.
Beads of sweat appeared on her forehead. She was tense the entire way back. It could be said that she walked back step by step.
“I’m so tired.” Fang Mengjun sat on the bed and took a deep breath. Her breathing was trembling.
After changing her shoes, she went to the living room. Mother Fang and Father Fang were both there. She quickly walked to their side and sat down. “I’m so tired. I won’t wear high heels anymore.”
Mother Fang smiled and said, “You haven’t gotten a boyfriend yet. You’re not married either. You can’t miss out on dressing up...”
Then, she leaned over and said, “Why did you suddenly think of going all out today? What did you buy? Did you buy a few pieces for me too?”
“Hurry up and tell me what good cosmetics you bought. Don’t hide them. Hurry up and bring them over for me to take a look.”
Fang Mengjun was already used to her mother. How could she snatch cosmetics from her daughter?
Seeing that her daughter had a box in her hand, Mother Fang stretched out her hand and Fang Mengjun handed the watch over.
Mother Fang opened the watch box and her eyes lit up. “You have good taste. This watch looks pretty good. These are all fake diamonds, right? They look real. Hey, why do I feel like...”

Seeing Mother Fang’s puzzled expression, Fang Mengjun snatched it away. “It’s not worth much. I bought it in a small shop. It’s only 88 yuan... Hey, hey, hey, don’t go through the gift bag. Don’t look. Don’t look. I’m afraid your heart won’t be able to take it.”
When Fang Mengjun snatched the watch away, Mother Fang felt that something was wrong. She took the gift bag and a receipt slid down.
“Look at what you’re saying. What hasn’t your mother seen? What do you mean by saying that my heart won’t be able to take it?” As Mother Fang spoke, she took a look at the receipt.
This???
“It costs... 880,000 yuan?!” Mother Fang almost screamed.

Then, she looked at Fang Mengjun. “You still said it cost 88 yuan?! It costs ten thousand times more! Fang Mengjun! What’s going on?! You even dare to fool your mother. Have your wings hardened and you become bold? Where did you go?!”
Did it cost 880,000?
Father Fang, who had no intention of paying attention to the mother and daughter, quickly came over and looked at the invoice. It really cost 880,000 yuan!
It was a Patek Philippe watch!
It was not that he had never heard of this brand of watch, but he had only heard of it and had never seen it before.
He would never have thought that he would see this brand of watch in his daughter’s hands in his life...

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Supreme-Grade Reward!
paragraphs: Then, Mother Fang simply stood up and walked towards her daughter’s room. She looked at the bed full of luxury goods and was stunned.
Seeing her mother like this, Fang Mengjun had no choice but to tell her everything.
She told her mother about how Chen Yun had spent 54 million to buy eight shops.
She also mentioned how he had spent two million yuan on a Phaeton.
She also talked about the fact that he had spent money like dirt today. She did not dare to leave anything behind and said everything.
After saying this, the stunned expression on Father Fang and Mother Fang’s faces became even more serious.
After a long time, Father Fang’s face relaxed. “Xiao Yun is really promising.”
“Xiao Yun has never revealed himself since he was young. I didn’t expect him to be so capable. Brother Chen really gave birth to a good son.” Mother Fang also sighed and looked at her daughter.
Fang Mengjun was speechless.
What did her mother mean by that resentful look just now?
Explain it clearly!

“Look at you. You don’t know anything. Xiao Yun gave you such an expensive gift. It shows how much he values you. You didn’t even let him come up for a glass of water. Next time, you must bring Xiao Yun back.” As Aunt Fang spoke, her expression made Fang Mengjun feel helpless.
What was going on?!
Was she treating Chen Yun as his son-in-law?!
Had she sold her daughter just like that?

However, she couldn’t do that. Didn’t she know what kind of person Chen Yun was? This fellow was a classic example of not harming one’s neighbors. Otherwise, she and Yao Yao would have long been in trouble.
Moreover, they were too familiar with each other. She couldn’t make a move on him!
They had been fighting since they were young. To put it bluntly, Chen Yun’s future wife would probably not be as familiar with Chen Yun as she was.
Ahem, she was talking about his personality.
At that moment, she waved her hand. “We’ll see. We’ll see.”
Then, she went back to tidy up her clothes.
“Hey, kid.”
Mother Fang looked at Father Fang. “Do you think she got the wrong idea?”
“Let’s not talk about her. Even I’m thinking too much.”
“I really didn’t mean that... Um... Maybe a little bit?”
Chen Yun, who had just returned home, placed the keys in his father’s hand. “I bought a new car today.”
“Huh?” Father Chen looked at the key in his hand. “If the car is spoiled, so be it. Why buy a new car?”
Chen Yun returned to his room and looked at the complaint sent by Fang Mengjun. He chuckled. His childhood friend couldn’t take it anymore.
It seemed that he had to let this girl experience the corruption of capitalism.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission.]
Oh? Chen Yun looked in front of him and pressed the check-in button.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining an enhancement of the Dimensional Space. You have obtained Space x4. You have also obtained an additional skill, Subjective Loading.]
[Subjective Loading: As long as an item belongs to the host, it can be stored in a Dimensional Space, regardless of the location of this item.]
Looking at the words on the light screen, wasn’t this thing equivalent to telekinesis? Could it directly bring over his things?
Chen Yun reached deep into the Dimensional Space and took the Desert Eagle from the drawer of his villa. He took the Dragon Spring Tang Sword, the imperial seal, and the thousand-year-old medicine...
He placed the items on the bed one by one. Then, he placed them back in the Dimensional Space.
This skill seemed to be of little value. In any case, Chen Yun could not think of any especially good use.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a supreme-grade card.]
[The host currently has three supreme-grade cards.]
[Do you want to exchange the cards for a supreme-grade reward?]
At this moment, Chen Yun jumped up from the bed. He did not expect that a supreme-grade card would drop from this check-in mission. This time, he had three supreme-grade cards.
At this moment, he had waited for a long time. How could he not hurry to exchange for it?
“Exchange.”
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining Vigor, a bodyguard robot from the future.]
[It’s already waiting for you downstairs.]
Chen Yun was speechless.
What was this?
At that moment, he quickly ran to the windowsill, opened the window, and looked down.
He saw a burly man standing below. At this moment, the burly man was looking up. He had tanned skin and short hair. His square face made people feel at ease.
That pair of sunglasses and suit attracted the attention of passers-by.
From the looks of it, wasn’t this a bodyguard or thug of some big shot in the movies?
At this moment, Vigor and Chen Yun looked at each other. Vigor raised his hand and saluted Chen Yun.
“Is this thing resistant to attacks? Can it fight?”
[Vigor is a bodyguard robot from the future. The host’s current physical fitness is 80. Vigor’s physical fitness is 100 times that of the host’s physical fitness.]
A hundred times! Did this mean that Vigor’s physical fitness was 8000?
What kind of terrifying value was this?!

[Furthermore, Vigor’s body is made of the strongest black ebony metal. He is wrapped in a layer of futuristic silicone that feels the same as a human body. Moreover, his core is installed with an artificial intelligence chip. He will only be loyal to his master and not have any rebellious thoughts.]
[He’s wearing a black suit and black sunglasses. This is his own design. It is also to better allow for the absorption of solar energy to charge him.]
Screens kept popping up, resolving the doubts in Chen Yun’s heart bit by bit.
“Dad, Mom, I’m going out for a while. My bodyguard is here,” said Chen Yun to his parents.
For a moment, Father Chen and Mother Chen were stunned. Bodyguard?
However, on second thought, it made sense. Chen Yun was already the boss of Sacred Heaven. He should have a bodyguard. This was safer.
At this moment, Chen Yun had already arrived downstairs and was looking at Vigor in front of him.
Good God!
From above, he did not feel anything. However, from the front, this guy was nearly two meters tall. His bulging muscles bulged through his clothes, showing what kind of figure he had below.
This design was too good. What bodyguard robot? This was like a Terminator.
“Hello, Master. These are my instructions. The relevant app has also been installed on your phone.”
Hearing Vigor’s words, Chen Yun turned on his phone. As expected, a bodyguard robot app had already been installed on it.
After opening it, he saw that he could set the number of meals per day, activate the chatty mode, silent mode, and so on...
After Chen Yun saw it, he set it up.
“Let’s go. Follow me up. Although I’ve set up a silent mode for you, you still have to guarantee the most basic conversation.” As Chen Yun spoke, he led Vigor into the elevator.
After entering, even Father Chen and Mother Chen were stunned. “Is this your bodyguard?”
This figure, this size, and this aura!
How much would it cost to hire such a bodyguard?
“Hello.” Vigor’s powerful voice sounded.
“Hello, hello.”
At night, he arranged a room for Vigor to sleep in.
[Check-in mission activated.]
[One day later, at Bohai Beach.]
[Reward unknown.]
Oh? Was there a new check-in mission?
Bohai Beach?
Chen Yun smiled. Wasn’t that the beach not far to the north of his house? When he was young, he often went there with his childhood friends to bathe and barbecue.
Coincidentally, they could gather again.

After all, the Sea Sky Pavilion was there. The Sea Sky Pavilion was one of the top restaurants in Yanwei. Although its status in Yanwei was not as high as the First-Grade Restaurant in Jiang City, it was comparable to East Sea City.
Usually, there were many high-ranking officials and nobles who went there.
Chen Yun sent a message in the group chat. After Lin Yuhan, Fang Mengjun, and the others saw the message, they naturally agreed.
[Dong Honghe: Sigh, Huaiyao has also gone back. Now that the three of us are bringing a girl along, it feels a little strange.]
[Lin Yuhan: What do you want? Why don’t you get Mengjun to call two more girls?]
[Fang Mengjun: Alright, I happen to have two best friends and roommates coming over to play. Wait for us.]
[Dong Honghe: How’s their appearance? I’m very picky.]
[Fang Mengjun: Hehe, there are no ugly women. There are only lazy women.]
[Dong Honghe: The key is that we have to go into the sea to take a bath first. As for makeup...]
[Fang Mengjun: ...]
In that case, makeup wouldn’t work.
However, Fang Mengjun was not worried.

What a joke. She was from Yanwei Art Academy. Although it was not as famous as Jiang City Art Academy and the other three art academies, it still had some reputation in the entire Yanwei and even the entire Shanhai Province. Those who entered might not be very beautiful, but they were definitely not ugly.
Moreover, how could her roommates not be attractive?
Chen Yun looked at the messages in the group and only smiled without saying anything.
The next day, Chen Yun asked Zhou Jingyi to send a secretary to check on the situation here.
After all, Zhou Jingyi was in charge of the First-Grade Restaurant now.

During this period of time, Chen Yun stood at the peak of Jiang City. There were also six First-Grade Restaurant branches. Including the main shop, there were a total of seven shops. It could be said that there were seven districts in Jiang City, and every district had a First-Grade Restaurant branch.
Moreover, his business was not affected at all. It was abnormally popular!
It had become a signboard of Jiang City. Many people who came to Jiang City to travel or visit would come because of its reputation.
Moreover, Xu Bin was also good at nurturing disciples. These disciples also displayed their skills in the branches and supported the business of the First-Grade Residence with Xu Bin.
Zhou Jingyi was just planning to further develop the First-Grade Restaurant when she heard Chen Yun’s instructions. She immediately sent someone to Yanwei.
A day later, Chen Yun walked out in a simple coat, swimming trunks, and slippers.
As for Vigor, he was in Chen Yun’s Dimensional Space.

Ever since Chen Yun realized that his parents were not used to Vigor’s arrival and were a little reserved, Vigor was thrown into a Dimensional Space by Chen Yun. He would take Vigor out when he returned to Jiang City.
“Dad, Mom, I won’t be eating lunch at home today. I’m going to the beach with Yuhan, Honghe, and the others to swim and eat.”
Mother Chen waved her hand, indicating that she understood.
Chen Yun walked out and saw Dong Honghe sticking his hand out of the car window and waving at Chen Yun.
“Little Divine Doctor!”
Chen Yun got into the car. Dong Honghe turned around and called out, making Chen Yun look helpless.

“Help me take a look at my illness, Little Divine Doctor.” Dong Honghe had looked for Lin Yuhan before and naturally knew that Chen Yun had resolved the matter. Even the director of the hospital was respectful to him. At that moment, he said this half-jokingly and half-seriously.
After all, he had been sweating recently.
“You? You haven’t changed your balls this month, right? You should go change them.”
Chen Yun’s words immediately made Fang Mengjun’s eyes widen. “Huh? Really? Do boys really change their balls once a month?”
“Do you have periods like us? Or do you have to change them manually?”
“Hahaha...”
The three boys in the car immediately laughed.

“Miss Fang, you’re really something. Everyone says that people with big breasts have no brains. This shouldn’t be the case for you.” Dong Honghe smiled the most enthusiastically and patted the steering wheel repeatedly.
Then, Chen Yun patted his shoulder. “Brother, to be honest, hurry up and find a girlfriend. Have you been sweating abnormally recently? Just don’t send too many messages.”
The smile on Dong Honghe’s face instantly froze.
F*ck!
They didn’t call him Little Divine Doctor for nothing!
Was he really that amazing?
