paragraphs: Don’t send too many messages...
These words kept echoing in Dong Honghe’s mind, making Fang Mengjun snort. “Heh, men are always like this.”
“What are you two looking at? I’m not talking about you.”

Fang Mengjun leaned against the back seat and looked at Dong Honghe. “Don’t worry. My two best friends are definitely beauties among beauties. As for whether you can get them, that will depend on your ability.”
When they arrived, everyone got out of the car. They were all locals. In addition, they knew that they would go to the sea to swim later, so they were all wearing slippers and loose clothes.
When Fang Mengjun arrived at the parking lot, she looked around. “Hey, they said they’ll take the bus over first. Where are they?”
“Look at those two. Aren’t they your friends?” Dong Honghe pointed at the two girls who were taking photos of the sea on the other side. Just looking at their figures made Dong Honghe stare.

The two of them were about 1.7 meters tall. Their pair of straight, slender, and long legs were like a gift from the heavens, especially dazzling under the sunlight. The two of them had ponytails that almost reached their waists. They raised their arms slightly and were taking pictures of the sea.

Fang Mengjun looked at Dong Honghe’s gaze and chuckled. “How is it? What’s our relationship? We’re childhood friends! I can cheat anyone but you, right? Look at these long legs. They’re long and fair. Are they enough for you to play with for three years?”
Dong Honghe rolled his eyes at her. “Who knows what it’ll be like when they turn around?”
“Then you should be happy.” Fang Mengjun placed her hands in front of her mouth. “Xiao Yu, Lei Lei!”
The two girls suddenly turned their heads and looked at Fang Mengjun. They immediately waved and ran over.
Many people at the side looked at the two pairs of long legs and could not help but swallow their saliva.
Dong Honghe looked at the two of them and exclaimed softly. Although their looks were not as shocking as Fang Mengjun’s, they were enough to enter the ranks of beauties.
Fang Mengjun didn’t lie to him!
Then, they introduced themselves. The two girls were called Zou Yu and Hu Xiaolei. They were Fang Mengjun’s roommates and best friends.
Chen Yun looked at the two of them. Although they were beautiful, they did not look stunning.
However, the two of them looked at Chen Yun differently.
Hu Xiaolei went to Fang Mengjun’s side. “Jun Jun, is this your childhood friend? He’s too handsome.”

“He wasn’t so handsome originally, but after he lost weight, he became so handsome. You haven’t seen him in a slim-fit suit before. He’s simply too handsome. Even the male models on the cover of those magazines are far inferior to him, let alone those young hunks in the entertainment industry.” Fang Mengjun couldn’t stop praising Chen Yun.
Now, in her eyes, other than being handsome, Chen Yun seemed to be surrounded by charm. He had a layer of golden charm that was known as the ability to make money.
It wasn’t just these two girls. There were also other girls surrounding Chen Yun.
“Handsome, can you teach me how to swim? I don’t know how to swim.”
“Handsome, can you add me on WeChat?”
“Can we have lunch together?”
Not long after, Chen Yun was surrounded by many girls. These girls looked at Chen Yun’s face with sparkling eyes.
He was too handsome.
It made their hearts itch and their bodies heat up. It was unknown if it was because of the weather or something else.

“Excuse me, excuse me.” Fang Mengjun finally squeezed in and held Chen Yun’s arm. Then, she looked at the girls around her apologetically. “I’m sorry, I’m sorry. This handsome man already has an appointment at noon. We’re leaving.”
After slipping out, Chen Yun had a helpless expression.
“Tell me, what’s the benefit of being so handsome?!” Fang Mengjun looked at the wolf-like girls at the side. She had to be on guard for Chen Yun at all times.
At this moment, Chen Yun pulled open his jacket.
He had a six-pack!
His chest muscles were firm!
The distinct edges and corners on his arms were not too much or too little, as if they were the most perfect piece of art.
“Ahhh!”
For a moment, many girls screamed, their eyes burning even more.
Fang Mengjun slapped her head. She thought, “My big brother, please stop showing off.”
He was too showy.
Even Hu Xiaolei and Zou Yu looked at Chen Yun’s figure with shining eyes. This figure was simply too good!
“F*ck! Yuhan, our limelight has been stolen.” Dong Honghe’s eyes almost popped out. When did Chen Yun have such muscles?!
What the hell were they playing here for!
They were not as handsome or as muscular as Chen Yun.
At that moment, Dong Honghe quickly pulled Fang Mengjun over. “Hold Chen Yun back and create an opportunity for the two of us.”
“Five meals.” Fang Mengjun placed her hands on her waist and raised the price.
“Oh my god, we’re childhood friends!” Dong Honghe looked at Fang Mengjun with an unyielding expression. “Alright, alright, alright. Five meals it is.”
Then, Chen Yun was pulled away by Fang Mengjun.

Throughout the entire swimming process, Fang Mengjun stayed by Chen Yun’s side. Seeing that Chen Yun was not interested in them, Zou Yu and Hu Xiaolei did not embarrass themselves. They also chatted with Lin Yuhan and Dong Honghe.
Chen Yun lay on the water and swam backstroke.
[Host, please complete the check-in on time.]
Chen Yun pressed the button.
[Congratulations to the host for successfully checking in and obtaining super silicon and the synthesis formula.]
[Super silicon is an evolutionary form of super solar panels. It has a power generation efficiency more than 50 times higher than the current solar panels.]
[It has been sent to the host’s Dimensional Space.]
This...
At this moment, Chen Yun jumped out of the water excitedly and stepped on the beach.
Pui, pui, pui.
This made Fang Mengjun, who was at the side, take a sip of seawater. She immediately felt extremely uncomfortable and looked at Chen Yun bitterly.
Chen Yun apologized, but the excitement on his face was obvious.
If he were to develop the super silicon, it would be enough to become a sharp blade in his hand. Wherever the blade pointed, it would be invincible.

It had to be known that in recent years, environmental protection was being advocated, and solar energy was clean energy. Most importantly, the efficiency of super silicon was more than 50 times that of normal silicon on ordinary solar panels.
Such efficiency was simply unimaginable.
With this, Sacred Heaven could also develop into a comprehensive enterprise. It would not just be an entertainment company.
“What are you doing!” Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun. “Did your leg cramp just now?”
“No, I thought of a good way to earn money.”
“Are you that amazing? Can you think of a good way even while swimming?” Fang Mengjun pouted. “How much can you earn?”

“I don’t know yet. Perhaps at least ten billion yuan,” said Chen Yun calmly. His net worth was already above 20 billion yuan, and he was still rising step by step, so it was easy for him to say that he could earn ten billion yuan, although this was only a conservative estimate.
However, this time, Fang Mengjun’s eyes widened. She could not believe what she had heard. Oh my god, it was worth tens of billions!
Could he think of an idea worth tens of billions just by swimming?
What kind of brain did he have?!
She could only swim and fill her stomach with water...
After taking a shower, Chen Yun and the others put on their slippers and walked towards the Sea Sky Pavilion.

Although there were many people by the sea, there were not many people in the hall of the Sea Sky Pavilion. After all, many people had brought their own barbecue grills here. Moreover, looking at the entrance of the Sea Sky Pavilion, it was obvious how expensive it was.

There were many luxury cars parked at the entrance, but which of those high-ranking officials and nobles would eat in the hall? They were all in private rooms, so Chen Yun and the others had some peace.
The Sea Sky Pavilion provided free showers for the guests to wash off the seawater on their bodies.
After everyone washed up, they sat in the hall.

Dong Honghe began to introduce the Sea Sky Pavilion. “I heard that the chef of the Sea Sky Pavilion studied under Master Sun Zhenwei. Many high-ranking officials and nobles like to eat here when they come to Yanwei.”
“The last time I came with Young Master Sun Peng, I went to the Sea Listening Hall upstairs to eat.”

“Sun Peng?” Fang Mengjun was stunned when she heard this. She knew this person. She had heard that he seemed to be the young master of some family. She didn’t expect Dong Honghe to hide the key facts and actually get close to a descendant of an aristocratic family.
“Oh my god, this menu is really expensive.” Just as Fang Mengjun was speechless, Dong Honghe nudged Chen Yun and said, “Brother Yun, look to your left.”
“What’s wrong?” Chen Yun turned around and saw a woman wearing sunglasses drinking soup with her head lowered.
Her sunglasses were very big and covered most of her face, only revealing her sharp chin and cherry lips. However, from her clothes and temperament, this woman was definitely not ordinary.
“Pervert, have you never seen a beauty before?” Fang Mengjun mocked him.
Even with a beautiful woman like Fang Mengjun here, did they still have to secretly look at others?!
Did they pretend that she didn’t exist?!
Chen Yun looked at this figure and felt that it was a little familiar, but he did not know where he had seen her before.
At this moment, a few people suddenly walked in from the door.
After these people looked around, they walked straight towards the girl’s table.

When they arrived at the girl’s table, the leader said something. The girl only shook her head. Then, there seemed to be an argument. One of them reached out to take her arm, and she immediately struggled violently.
“What are you doing?! Are you bullying us women?”
How could Fang Mengjun watch this scene? She immediately slammed the table and stood up, shouting.
For a moment, Dong Honghe’s face darkened. Big Sister!

Who was she? Didn’t she see the wretched faces of the people opposite her? One look and one could tell that they were hooligans. Did she think she was a hero from Liangshan who saw injustice and helped?
It was fine as long as it had nothing to do with him.
However, he was really crying from this silly girl’s stupidity.

However, Fang Mengjun had already stood up. At this moment, those people looked at Fang Mengjun with a cold glint in their eyes and walked towards her. They had just taken two steps when Chen Yun and the other two stood up. Dong Honghe even picked up the empty wine bottle in front of him with one hand. “What do you want!”
The four of them seemed to have a natural tacit understanding!
Although Fang Mengjun was stupid, they were the only ones who could bully her!
No one else could!

Originally, these people looked at Fang Mengjun and did not take her seriously at all. They were even prepared to teach her a lesson. But now, as soon as Chen Yun and the others stood up, it was different, especially the wine bottle in Dong Honghe’s hand. It was extremely shocking. As the saying went, the unreasonable were afraid of the stupid, and the stupid were afraid of those who did not care about their lives.
They weighed the pros and cons. The leader looked at the three people he brought and immediately fell silent.
He smiled apologetically at the girl and said, “Miss, our boss has already contacted your teacher. We want to have a meal with you and discuss sponsorship and your future development.”
“I said I’m not going,” said the girl coldly.
Lin Yuhan immediately coughed and took a step forward. He looked at the man threateningly.
The leader did not dare to say anything else and ran away dejectedly.
“Thank you.” The girl nodded at them.
Her voice was a little hoarse and carried a low tone, as if she was a lonely woman smoking at the bar counter.
“There’s no need to thank me.” Fang Mengjun said angrily, “In my opinion, to deal with such a pervert, we can just knee him.”
The girl was slightly stunned. She did not expect this girl to have such a fiery temper.
Dong Honghe, who was beside him, put down the wine bottle. “You’re really making me cry. Hurry up and sit down.”
“Don’t be too rash in calling me awesome.”
Everyone was speechless. Did he think that they were praising him?
Then, the girl looked to the side and was stunned. “Hey, Chen Yun? Why are you here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Who Are You?!
paragraphs: Chen Yun?
As soon as these words were spoken, Chen Yun also looked at the girl. He saw that the girl had taken off her hat and mask. Wasn’t this Shu Fan?
Previously, she had not appeared with Wang Yuanyuan and the others. He thought that Shu Fan had left their circle.
He didn’t expect her to come to Yanwei.
Shu Fan looked at Chen Yun and recalled what had happened to the fitness fighting club. If not for Chen Yun, they did not know what kind of suffering they would have suffered.
She did not like Wang Yuanyuan and Ye Xinyu’s arrogant behavior. However, they were still classmates and roommates. She wanted to leave the circle, but she could not go too far.
When Shu Fan took off her hat and mask, everyone was stunned.

She had a refreshing ponytail and wore a beige short-sleeved jacket. Underneath her jacket was a tight white shirt that outlined her bulging and slender waist. The lower half of her body was matched with a short skirt. She was only wearing a few accessories from head to toe, but her entire temperament was enhanced, as if she was an elegant and exquisite city girl.
Accompanied by the faint fragrance on her body, she was simply a peerless beauty.
For a moment, even Fang Mengjun, who had stood up for Shu Fan in the beginning, was stunned. A sense of danger rose in her heart.

Chen Yun looked at her expression and smiled. He did not say anything and waited for her to make a decision. After all, he was not very familiar with Shu Fan. He had only met her that day and chatted a few times on WeChat.

Fang Mengjun was also waiting for Chen Yun to speak. Then, she saw his indifferent expression and said to Shu Fan, “I didn’t expect you to be Chen Yun’s friend. Let’s eat together. You don’t look like a local. After dinner, we’ll send you back. There are still some hooligans in Yanwei.”
“It’s also very difficult to deal with them.”

When Shu Fan heard Fang Mengjun’s words, she nodded. Then, she looked at Fang Mengjun, who was sitting beside Chen Yun, and pursed her lips. She originally wanted to sit on the other side of Chen Yun, but after observing the distance between the two of them and the familiarity between Fang Mengjun and Chen Yun, she immediately felt ashamed and sat beside Hu Xiaolei.
As soon as she sat down, everyone was even more stunned by Shu Fan’s appearance. Moreover, she had the delicate beauty and gentleness unique to local women, making people feel very comfortable.

After they introduced themselves, the dishes were served. As they ate, they chatted happily. It could be said that they were slightly less reserved. Moreover, everyone was about the same age and were university students, so they naturally had many topics to talk about.
Dong Honghe looked at Chen Yun from time to time. He was really impressed by his childhood friend.
This fellow seemed to have been especially popular with women since he was young.

Needless to say, Fang Mengjun and Zhang Huaiyao were his childhood friends. It was normal for them to have a good relationship. However, this person actually moved to Jiang City from Yanwei and even had such a beautiful friend in Jiang City.
He was extremely envious of Chen Yun’s luck with women.
It made him a little jealous.
Meanwhile, as Shu Fan spoke, she sighed in her heart. She had followed her teacher out of Jiang City and came to Yanwei for special training and to find a scene to paint.

Her teacher was also a famous painter. She had brought a few of her favorite students to a few high-end cocktail parties, but she did not expect to be pestered by the young masters and bosses of Yanwei.

She was just a student and had yet to step into society. When she heard that the other party wanted her to drink with him, she had never seen such a scene before. She was afraid and naturally ran out, letting her teacher take the blame.
She did not expect the other party to chase after her and have such hooligans as his subordinates.
Fortunately, she had met Chen Yun and the others. Otherwise, Shu Fan would not know what to do.
She immediately decided that after dinner, she would buy a plane ticket and rush back to Jiang City. Who knew what would happen here?
After everyone finished eating, Fang Mengjun rushed to settle the bill, making Dong Honghe look helpless.
“Sister, what are you doing? Aren’t the three of us men embarrassed?”
The people of Yanwei were especially proud. While going Dutch was popular in the south, it was still more common to treat people here. When girls went out, they usually didn’t have to pay money.
However, a girl was now fighting to pay the bill. Erm...
“Alright, you’re making it look real.” Fang Mengjun went to Dong Honghe’s side and said, “Don’t forget that you still owe me five meals. If you really feel bad, you count this meal in too.”
Six meals.
In an instant, Dong Honghe really wanted to slap himself twice. Why did he need to slap himself so much?!
If he hadn’t said anything, Fang Mengjun might have forgotten about the five meals.

“Alright, alright, alright. Beauty Fang, it’s my treat. Isn’t it just six meals? Can’t I afford it?” As soon as Dong Honghe finished speaking, he saw Fang Mengjun’s half-smile and immediately added, “However, we agreed that a meal can’t exceed 300 yuan.”
“Aiya, how can I exceed 300 yuan alone?”
Dong Honghe was speechless. What about him? Was he supposed to wait for her to finish eating alone before paying the bill?
Just as they were about to go out, a group of people suddenly surged in from outside.
The leader was the thin man who had harassed Shu Fan previously. However, there was a middle-aged woman standing beside him now.
Seeing the middle-aged woman, Shu Fan’s expression changed slightly. The middle-aged woman could not help but say, “Xiao Fan, Boss Li is anxious from waiting. Please give him some respect.”

The middle-aged woman’s name was Zhang Huan. She was in her forties. Although her appearance was ordinary, her dressing was still very artistic. As soon as she entered, she started complaining and could not help but give Shu Fan a look.

She was also very helpless. Although she was a famous painter, she was nothing in front of him. Who was he? He was the big boss of Yanwei District. How could she take the blame there? Why would he give her any respect?
If it weren’t for the fact that the other party had taken a fancy to Shu Fan, she wouldn’t even have the right to speak to him.
At that moment, she had no choice but to look for Shu Fan and get her to accompany him for a drink.

“Miss Shu, your teacher is also here now. You can come with us now, right? Don’t worry, my boss only wants you to accompany him for a drink. As for the rest, it’s up to you,” said the thin man impatiently. Then, he looked at Shu Fan, and his eyes lit up. Such a person could simply be called a stunner.
He didn’t believe that money couldn’t make a girl open her legs.
After today’s meal and present, wouldn’t this woman obediently climb into a man’s bed?
“Teacher, I told you, I don’t want to go. I’ve already booked a plane ticket and will return to Jiangbei in the afternoon.”
Zhang Huan looked troubled. “Xiaofan, Boss Li’s banquet has already been set up. It’s not good for you not to meet him. Besides...”
“Besides what?” Shu Fan asked in a low voice.

“Besides, my boss has been waiting for you for such a long time. Do you really think it’s easy to not show up for a meeting with my boss?” The thin man said gloomily, “In Yanwei, not many people dare to stand my boss up. Who do you think you are? How dare you refuse here?”

Can’t I afford it?” As soon as Dong Honghe finished speaking, he saw Fang Mengjun’s half-smile and immediately added, “However, we agreed that a meal can’t exceed 300 yuan.”
“Aiya, how can I exceed 300 yuan alone?”
Dong Honghe was speechless.
What about him?
Was he supposed to wait for her to finish eating alone before paying the bill?
Just as they were about to go out, a group of people suddenly surged in from outside.
The leader was the thin man who had harassed Shu Fan previously.
However, there was a middle-aged woman standing beside him now.
Seeing the middle-aged woman, Shu Fan’s expression changed slightly.
The middle-aged woman could not help but say, “Xiao Fan, Boss Li is anxious from waiting.
Please give him some respect.”
The middle-aged woman’s name was Zhang Huan.
She was in her forties.
Although her appearance was ordinary, her dressing was still very artistic.
As soon as she entered, she started complaining and could not help but give Shu Fan a look.
She was also very helpless.
Although she was a famous painter, she was nothing in front of him.
Who was he?
He was the big boss of Yanwei District.
How could she take the blame there?
Why would he give her any respect?
If it weren’t for the fact that the other party had taken a fancy to Shu Fan, she wouldn’t even have the right to speak to him.
At that moment, she had no choice but to look for Shu Fan and get her to accompany him for a drink.
“Miss Shu, your teacher is also here now.
You can come with us now, right?
Don’t worry, my boss only wants you to accompany him for a drink.
As for the rest, it’s up to you,” said the thin man impatiently.
Then, he looked at Shu Fan, and his eyes lit up.
Such a person could simply be called a stunner.
He didn’t believe that money couldn’t make a girl open her legs.
After today’s meal and present, wouldn’t this woman obediently climb into a man’s bed?
“Teacher, I told you, I don’t want to go.
I’ve already booked a plane ticket and will return to Jiangbei in the afternoon.”
Zhang Huan looked troubled.
“Xiaofan, Boss Li’s banquet has already been set up.
It’s not good for you not to meet him.
Besides...”
“Besides what?” Shu Fan asked in a low voice.
“Besides, my boss has been waiting for you for such a long time.
Do you really think it’s easy to not show up for a meeting with my boss?” The thin man said gloomily, “In Yanwei, not many people dare to stand my boss up.
Who do you think you are?
How dare you refuse here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Why Should I Apologize?
paragraphs: At this moment, Fang Mengjun said in a low voice, “She’s unwilling to go. Can you still force her?”
As she spoke, she no longer had any confidence. After all, there were so many people standing there.

Hearing Fang Mengjun’s words, the man smiled coldly. “Force her? That’s right! W’ere forcing her. Not to mention a student like her, even if a celebrity came, they wouldn’t dare not to go to the trap set by my boss. Otherwise, they can forget about leaving Yanwei!”
“Weren’t you arrogant just now? You even raised a beer bottle. Let me see if you can be arrogant again.” The thin man raised his head and puffed out his chest. His back was stiff.
As soon as he finished speaking, a group of burly men surged out from behind him. Each of their arms was embroidered with tattoos and they had short hair. Their faces were filled with ferocity.
In an instant, everyone’s expressions changed.
They had never seen such a situation before. Hu Xiaolei and Zou Yu’s legs immediately began to tremble.
Dong Honghe could not help but say, “Brother, I know Young Master Sun. Why don’t we talk things out? Let’s sit down and talk.”
“Young Master Sun? Which Young Master Sun?” The thin man asked with slight fear.
“It’s Sun Peng, Young Master Sun!” Dong Honghe spoke.
“Pfft! Can Sun Peng also be called Young Master?” The thin man spat with a disdainful expression. “I thought you were talking of someone with a big background.”
Damn it, Sun Peng was the son of the general manager of a foreign trade company. Even Sun Peng’s father would not dare to fart in front of his cousin, let alone Sun Peng!
These words made Dong Honghe’s face turn ashen. Was the other party’s background was actually so powerful?
He had just called Sun Peng to prevent any accidents, but now it seemed...
Just as he was thinking this, a figure walked in from outside.
“F*ck, some people are really arrogant now. They’re starting to think that I don’t have a big background.”
A young man in a flowery short-sleeved shirt walked while lightly pushing the burly man in front of him. He did not take these hooligans seriously at all.
He looked across and immediately saw Dong Honghe standing there.
“Honghe, what’s going on?”
“Young Master Sun, my friend had a small conflict with someone. Please come and mediate the situation.” Dong Honghe smiled obsequiously.
“That doesn’t matter. As long as we’re in Yanwei, they should give me some respect.” Young Master Sun patted his chest and promised.
At this moment, the thin man beside him sneered. “Yo, Young Master Sun, when did you become so arrogant? Why don’t I know about this?”
“Second Brother Li?” Young Master Sun frowned slightly when he saw him.
Although this person was not very capable, he had a good cousin, which was the boss he mentioned, Li Xiao.

In the past few months, Li Xiao had gotten in touch with Jiang City and even participated in a few high-level gatherings in Jiang City. He had gotten to know many high-ranking officials and nobles in Jiang City and rose powerfully to become a new noble in Yanwei. Sun Peng definitely could not afford to offend him.

However, he might not be afraid of Second Brother Li, so he sneered and said, “Second Brother Li, are you smart? Which girl have you take a fancy to? Let me tell you, lascivious activities can lead to bitter consequences. These are all my friends. Before you move, you have to consider carefully.”

Young Master Sun’s words were not baseless. He was typically good at making friends and had a lot of connections. Coupled with his father’s power, he could be considered to have some power in Yanwei’s upper circle.
“Hehe, who do you think you are?” Second Brother Li smiled disdainfully.
“In that case, are you not going to give me respect?” Sun Peng’s expression darkened.

He was also a prominent figure in Yanwei. When others looked at his father, they would give him some respect. In his opinion, he and Second Brother Li should be evenly matched. Everyone had their own backers and should stay in one’s own lane.
“I’ll give you some bloody respect!” Second Brother Li suddenly picked up the wine glass on the table and threw it at him.

After dodging the attack, Sun Peng got up with a livid face and wanted to rush forward. However, Dong Honghe, who was beside him, stopped him and said in a low voice, “There are more than ten people on his side. Don’t be rash.”
Dong Honghe was also on the brink of tears. Damn it, he asked Sun Peng to be the peacemaker, but now, Sun Peng wanted to fight with the other party too.
“Hmph, no matter how many people there are, let’s see if they dare to attack.” Sun Peng was also afraid, but he still insisted.
“That guy doesn’t matter. The key is that he said he wanted to call his boss over. I was afraid that something would happen, so I called you over,” said Dong Honghe.
“What boss?” Sun Peng suddenly had a bad feeling.
It seemed like Li Xiao liked others to call him “boss” instead of “leader”.
“I don’t know.” Dong Honghe fell silent for a moment and said, “He seems to be called ‘Boss Li’. This person seemed to have said so just now.”
“Li Xiao, Boss Li?” Sun Peng’s expression instantly changed.
“That’s right. He’s my cousin, my big boss. Why? Are you, Sun Peng, going to hold this grudge?” Second Brother Li moved a stool and sat there with his legs crossed.
Sun Peng was instantly in a dilemma.
How could he have the ability to deal with Li Xiao? This was a new big shot in Yanwei. He had a billion yuan in assets and connections. Even his father was far inferior to him, let alone him.
“Brother, you didn’t ask me to offend Li Xiao when you called me here.”
Sun Peng looked at Dong Honghe and spoke with a fake smile.
“Young Master Sun, what are you doing?” Dong Honghe was stunned.

“Brother, my opinion is that you should apologize with gifts. Listen to him. Otherwise, it will be difficult to deal with when Boss Li really comes.” Sun Peng was silent for a moment. In the end, he persuaded them on account of their friendship.
“Why?” Chen Yun sat there and looked at the thin man not far away.
Sun Peng was silent, and a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes.

Why? It was because his fist was bigger than theirs! It was because he had more money than them! It was because he was the big shot of Yanwei, Li Xiao! How could these bumpkins from a small county compete with Li Xiao?
However, Chen Yun’s words excited Fang Mengjun.
“Do you know who Boss Li is?” Sun Peng couldn’t help but say, “Even the top young masters of Yanwei have to be respectful when they see Boss Li, let alone you guys!”

“Hehe, I advise you to listen to Young Master Sun. That’s the wisest choice. How about this? Come over and apologize obediently. Call me Second Brother and we’ll forget about this. How about that?” The thin man said proudly, “I’ve already called my cousin just now. If you don’t beg for mercy now, when my cousin comes, it won’t be resolved by an apology.”
“Do we really need to apologize?” Fang Mengjun’s eyes were filled with tears. When had she ever been bullied like this?
Lin Yuhan clenched his fists tightly. This scene reminded him of how he had been humiliated by Tan Zekun. Now, not only did he have to suffer, but even his best friend had to suffer such humiliation.
He was filled with grief and indignation. He hated himself for being so useless.
Dong Honghe also looked like he was about to cry.
At this moment, Chen Yun slowly stood up and sneered. “Apologize? Why should I apologize? Tell me, what did we do wrong?”
Was it wrong to see injustice? Or was it wrong to eat here?
“You’re not wrong, but your weakness is a huge mistake.” Sun Peng sighed. “Isn’t this society about fighting with fists, strength, background, money, and connections?”

“Boss Li has money, people, and backers. What do you have? Brother, although I haven’t interacted with you before, since you’re Honghe’s friend, I’ll give you a piece of advice. Don’t force yourself. You have to lower your head when it’s time.”

“Kid, you’re not afraid of death. Alright, when my cousin comes, let’s see if you can still be so stubborn.” The thin man looked at Chen Yun and his eyes darkened. “I’m not afraid to tell you the truth. In Yanwei, it’s my cousin’s territory. Even talents like you have to lie down!”

At the side, Shu Fan was pulled to the side by Zhang Huan. She looked at her teacher. “Teacher, who exactly is this Boss Li? He has so many hooligans as his subordinates. How did we meet such a person?”
Zhang Huan also sighed. If it weren’t for the fact that she wanted to get close to the upper echelons, these things wouldn’t have happened.

“Li Xiao is a playful local snake.” Zhang Huan smiled bitterly. “I heard that he has gone beyond Yanwei. He’s a big shot in two cities in Jiang City and has more than a billion yuan in assets. In Yanwei, he can basically be said to be extremely powerful. Otherwise, I wouldn’t be in such a difficult position.”
“To put it bluntly, this is their territory.”
These words made Shu Fan’s face turn pale. She did not expect the other party to be so difficult to deal with and have such a powerful background.

“Teacher, they got into trouble because they were protecting me. Tell Boss Li that I’ll drink with him. Let my friends go, okay?” Shu Fan had no choice. Looking at the scene in front of him, she was about to cry.
At that moment, she only wanted Chen Yun and the others to return safely.
However, Zhang Huan sighed. “At this point, if they don’t relent, no one can help them.”
At that moment.
At the other side.
Chen Yun turned around and looked at the thin young man indifferently.
“Are you so powerful in Yanwei? Why don’t you take a piss and look at yourselves? Who do you think you are? How dare you let us lie down?”
“Who do you think you are?”
“Why don’t you take a piss and look at yourselves?”
These words not only scolded the thin man, but were also targeted at Boss Li!
As soon as he said this, everyone’s expressions changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Come On! Another One! (1)
paragraphs: At this moment, in a luxurious club in the suburbs of Yanwei City.
The hall was brightly lit. A group of people was sitting at a huge round table, toasting each other.
Beside each of them stood a beautiful woman in a blue and white cheongsam. They were tall and had their hair tied into a bun.

These beauties were all above average in terms of looks. Outside, they were goddesses in the eyes of ordinary people, but here, they gently served these people wine and dishes, just like palace maids serving the emperor.

If there were people from Yanwei City, they would definitely be able to recognize at a glance that these people present were all rich young masters with a reputation in Yanwei City. None of them were worth less than 50 million yuan.
However, this group of tycoons did not pay attention to the beauties beside them at all. Instead, they focused their gazes on the two people at the head of the table.

There were two men sitting at the main seats. The one on the left was refined and delicate. He looked to be in his thirties. He wore gold-rimmed glasses and a custom-made suit made by an Italian tailor. Sitting there, he exuded a proud and noble aura. Clearly, his background was extraordinary.

On the right was a middle-aged man with a shiny hairstyle and a huge face. This middle-aged man was wearing an Armani suit and a Hermès belt at his waist. Occasionally, a Patek Philippe watch worth millions would be revealed on his hand. He looked like a local boss who had just become rich.
“How is it, Mr. Song? Are you satisfied with my hospitality?”
The middle-aged man asked with a smile.
“Thank you, Boss Li.” Mr. Song nodded, but a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes.

He came from the Song family, a big family in Jiangbei, and had seen all kinds of scenes. In his eyes, Boss Li’s club looked luxurious, but it was actually filled with the aura of a nouveau riche. The descendants of the real big families did not care about this at all.
“Haha, with Mr. Song’s words, I’m relieved.” Boss Li laughed proudly.

Mr. Song was a benefactor. He came from the Song family of Jiangbei, which was known as one of the five great families of Jiangbei. He was considered a leader in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry. Although Mr. Song was in his twenties, he was the Vice President of two or three listed companies. Moreover, the Song family of Jiangbei had a wide network of connections in the city. It was far from what Li Xiao could compare to.
However, Li Xiao was not afraid at all.
Now that he had stabilized his position as the boss of Yanwei, so what if he expanded his influence to Jiang City? They had to pay attention to a tyrannical local like him.
Thinking of this, he became even more smug, but he pretended to sigh.
“This time, if I hadn’t met a benefactor in Jiangbei and gotten in touch with CEO Ma Ke of Sacred Heaven, I probably wouldn’t even be qualified to entertain you now.”
When Mr. Song heard this, he frowned in his heart, but he had no choice but to join in.

“I heard that it’s not just Sacred Heaven. The Zheng Corporation and Cauldron Dragon Security also have many projects with you. You can be considered a member of the Jiangbei Chamber of Commerce now, right? This time, Boss Li’s net worth will probably increase by several times. You’re lucky.”

“Sigh, I was just a country bumpkin in Yanwei in the past. I was already satisfied to be able to drink soup with such a big shot. Who would have thought that today would be the day? I’m really ashamed.”
Although Boss Li said that he was ashamed, he did not show any signs of modesty.
When the surrounding rich bosses saw this, they immediately flattered Boss Li.
Mr. Song had a smile on his face, but he snorted inwardly.
However, he had a request this time, so he spoke respectfully.

“Boss Li is very popular now. Who doesn’t know that you have the right to sell the Heavenly Spirit Water in Yanwei District? Countless rich people and nobles want to ask you for the Heavenly Spirit Water.”
“Mr. Song, have you also heard of the Heavenly Spirit Water?” Li Xiao retracted his smug expression and asked seriously.

Mr. Song nodded and sneered in his heart. How could he not know about the Heavenly Spirit Water? Originally, his cousin, Song Jixing, the eldest young master of the Song family, had even gone to talk to Chen Yun, but Chen Yun did not give him respect at all and left unhappily.
However, the Song family’s pursuit of such a treasure would never end because of such a thing.
Moreover, Chen Yun had embarrassed them and made them hate him.

Although the Heavenly Spirit Water had only been circulated for a short period of time, its magical effect had already completely shocked the upper echelons of Jiang City. It even had a huge reputation in Jiangbei and Yanwei.

“Sigh, to be honest, Mr. Song, although Director Chen and CEO Ma handed the Heavenly Spirit Water to us to sell, I didn’t get much. I only received a few bottles a day. After I received it, this leader and that boss asked me for a bottle each. Look, there’s not much left.” Li Xiao shook his head helplessly.
Mr. Song sneered in his heart. He didn’t believe him at all, but he had no choice but to follow his words.
“I’ve indeed made things difficult for Boss Li.”
Then, he suddenly asked curiously, “I wonder if Boss Li knows the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water?”
“Well ...”

Li Xiao quickly shook his head. “Director Chen distributed this Heavenly Spirit Water. It’s very precious. How could I have the formula? I’m already very satisfied to be able to try it in my lifetime.”
Mr. Song chuckled. “Then Boss Li’s status in Yanwei should be about the same as Director Chen’s status in Jiang City.”
“How can I compare to Director Chen?” Li Xiao shook his head repeatedly. A trace of fear flashed across his eyes. “Director Chen is a god. I’m just a lackey under him.”

Back then, at the East Mountain Villa, he had watched helplessly as Chen Yun held a silver gun and broke the legs of Kawakaze Kei of the Three Spirits Financial Group. He had asked someone to throw the young master of Huaying, Dong Yuncheng, out the door. From then on, that scene was deeply imprinted in Li Xiao’s heart.

After that, Chen Yun even overthrew the Su family and established himself at the top of Jiang City. No one dared to surpass him. With such achievements at this age, what else could he be if not a god?
Meanwhile, Li Xiao wanted to sit firmly on the throne of Yanwei now. The most urgent thing was Chen Yun’s support and this Heavenly Spirit Water.
Therefore, Li Xiao respected Chen Yun like a god.
“Boss Li, you’re too modest.” Mr. Song smiled and shook his head, clearly not believing him. “You’re also a big shot. There will definitely be a day when you replace him in the future.”
Li Xiao remained silent, but he sneered in his heart.

He wore gold-rimmed glasses and a custom-made suit made by an Italian tailor.
Sitting there, he exuded a proud and noble aura.
Clearly, his background was extraordinary.
On the right was a middle-aged man with a shiny hairstyle and a huge face.
This middle-aged man was wearing an Armani suit and a Hermès belt at his waist.
Occasionally, a Patek Philippe watch worth millions would be revealed on his hand.
He looked like a local boss who had just become rich.
“How is it, Mr.
Song?
Are you satisfied with my hospitality?”
The middle-aged man asked with a smile.
“Thank you, Boss Li.” Mr.
Song nodded, but a trace of disdain flashed across his eyes.
He came from the Song family, a big family in Jiangbei, and had seen all kinds of scenes.
In his eyes, Boss Li’s club looked luxurious, but it was actually filled with the aura of a nouveau riche.
The descendants of the real big families did not care about this at all.
“Haha, with Mr.
Song’s words, I’m relieved.” Boss Li laughed proudly.
Mr.
Song was a benefactor.
He came from the Song family of Jiangbei, which was known as one of the five great families of Jiangbei.
He was considered a leader in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry.
Although Mr.
Song was in his twenties, he was the Vice President of two or three listed companies.
Moreover, the Song family of Jiangbei had a wide network of connections in the city.
It was far from what Li Xiao could compare to.
However, Li Xiao was not afraid at all.
Now that he had stabilized his position as the boss of Yanwei, so what if he expanded his influence to Jiang City?
They had to pay attention to a tyrannical local like him.
Thinking of this, he became even more smug, but he pretended to sigh.
“This time, if I hadn’t met a benefactor in Jiangbei and gotten in touch with CEO Ma Ke of Sacred Heaven, I probably wouldn’t even be qualified to entertain you now.”
When Mr.
Song heard this, he frowned in his heart, but he had no choice but to join in.
“I heard that it’s not just Sacred Heaven.
The Zheng Corporation and Cauldron Dragon Security also have many projects with you.
You can be considered a member of the Jiangbei Chamber of Commerce now, right?
This time, Boss Li’s net worth will probably increase by several times.
You’re lucky.”
“Sigh, I was just a country bumpkin in Yanwei in the past.
I was already satisfied to be able to drink soup with such a big shot.
Who would have thought that today would be the day?
I’m really ashamed.”
Although Boss Li said that he was ashamed, he did not show any signs of modesty.
When the surrounding rich bosses saw this, they immediately flattered Boss Li.
Mr.
Song had a smile on his face, but he snorted inwardly.
However, he had a request this time, so he spoke respectfully.
“Boss Li is very popular now.
Who doesn’t know that you have the right to sell the Heavenly Spirit Water in Yanwei District?
Countless rich people and nobles want to ask you for the Heavenly Spirit Water.”
“Mr.
Song, have you also heard of the Heavenly Spirit Water?” Li Xiao retracted his smug expression and asked seriously.
Mr.
Song nodded and sneered in his heart.
How could he not know about the Heavenly Spirit Water?
Originally, his cousin, Song Jixing, the eldest young master of the Song family, had even gone to talk to Chen Yun, but Chen Yun did not give him respect at all and left unhappily.
However, the Song family’s pursuit of such a treasure would never end because of such a thing.
Moreover, Chen Yun had embarrassed them and made them hate him.
Although the Heavenly Spirit Water had only been circulated for a short period of time, its magical effect had already completely shocked the upper echelons of Jiang City.
It even had a huge reputation in Jiangbei and Yanwei.
“Sigh, to be honest, Mr.
Song, although Director Chen and CEO Ma handed the Heavenly Spirit Water to us to sell, I didn’t get much.
I only received a few bottles a day.
After I received it, this leader and that boss asked me for a bottle each.
Look, there’s not much left.” Li Xiao shook his head helplessly.
Mr.
Song sneered in his heart.
He didn’t believe him at all, but he had no choice but to follow his words.
“I’ve indeed made things difficult for Boss Li.”
Then, he suddenly asked curiously, “I wonder if Boss Li knows the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water?”
“Well ...”
Li Xiao quickly shook his head.
“Director Chen distributed this Heavenly Spirit Water.
It’s very precious.
How could I have the formula?
I’m already very satisfied to be able to try it in my lifetime.”
Mr.
Song chuckled.
“Then Boss Li’s status in Yanwei should be about the same as Director Chen’s status in Jiang City.”
“How can I compare to Director Chen?” Li Xiao shook his head repeatedly.
A trace of fear flashed across his eyes.
“Director Chen is a god.
I’m just a lackey under him.”
Back then, at the East Mountain Villa, he had watched helplessly as Chen Yun held a silver gun and broke the legs of Kawakaze Kei of the Three Spirits Financial Group.
He had asked someone to throw the young master of Huaying, Dong Yuncheng, out the door.
From then on, that scene was deeply imprinted in Li Xiao’s heart.
After that, Chen Yun even overthrew the Su family and established himself at the top of Jiang City.
No one dared to surpass him.
With such achievements at this age, what else could he be if not a god?
Meanwhile, Li Xiao wanted to sit firmly on the throne of Yanwei now.
The most urgent thing was Chen Yun’s support and this Heavenly Spirit Water.
Therefore, Li Xiao respected Chen Yun like a god.
“Boss Li, you’re too modest.” Mr.
Song smiled and shook his head, clearly not believing him.
“You’re also a big shot.
There will definitely be a day when you replace him in the future.”
Li Xiao remained silent, but he sneered in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Come On! Another One! (2)
paragraphs: “Who do you think you are? Even if the head of the Song family came, he would only be on equal footing with Director Chen. You’re just a collateral relative of the Song family. How dare you talk big here? How dare you trample on Director Chen?” As he was thinking about this, Li Xiao suddenly received a call.
After hanging up, his expression instantly darkened.
“Boss Li, what’s wrong?” Mr. Song asked.

“The little guys are looking for trouble. The little girl you like and the little guys have caused some trouble.” Boss Li’s eyes flickered as he suddenly said, “Mr. Song, why don’t we go there now? We can personally deal with it and show our sincerity in wooing the beauty. If that girl knows Mr. Song’s identity, it will naturally succeed.”
“Sure.”
Mr. Song stood up happily.
Meanwhile, in the Sea Sky Pavilion.
When everyone heard Chen Yun’s words, their eyes widened. They could not believe what they had heard.
He actually dared to say that Boss Li was nothing!
The man and the others all drew their sabers and stood up. For a moment, the atmosphere was tense.
Sun Peng sucked in a breath of cold air as if he had never seen such a suicidal person.
Meanwhile, Dong Honghe and the others were frightened by Chen Yun. Fang Mengjun pulled his arm worriedly. Second Brother Li’s eyes were bloodshot, and his expression looked like he could eat people.
“F*ck you! What are you waiting for? Attack!”
“F*ck, who do you think you are? How dare you behave atrociously in Yanwei! Cripple them!” Second Brother Li ordered. The burly men behind him all rushed towards Chen Yun and the others!
In an instant, Fang Mengjun’s face turned pale. She had never seen such a situation before.
Not to mention Hu Xiaolei and Zou Yu.
They had also grown up in a greenhouse. Usually, when they saw others fighting, they would stay far away. At this moment, their legs were so weak that they could not stand.

“Stop quickly!” Shu Fan hurriedly shouted. Chen Yun and the others were also standing up for her. How could she let them be implicated now? However, those people did not listen to her, making her look at her teacher anxiously.
Zhang Huan also smiled bitterly.
Boss Li could be said to be extremely powerful in Yanwei. Who was she? How could she say anything?
She could not stop the scene in front of them.
At that moment, Chen Yun rushed forward and kicked a burly man away.
“F*ck you!” Dong Honghe picked up a beer bottle and rushed forward. Lin Yuhan roared and fought with a hooligan.

Sun Peng cursed in his heart when he saw this scene. He thought for a moment. If he didn’t go now, not only would he not be friends with Dong Honghe, but if this matter spread, no one would be able to befriend him.
“Second Brother Li, screw you!”
Sun Peng shouted and rushed towards Second Brother Li.
The chaotic battle was about to begin!
Chen Yun kicked the burly men out in three to four moves. For a moment, painful howls sounded.
“What are you afraid of? Attack!”
Second Brother Li urged again. The men looked at each other. “Attack! There’s only one kid. It’s difficult for two fists to fight four hands! Let’s attack together. Why should we be afraid of him?!”
However, in the next moment, this courage was immediately broken.

The two people who rushed over were smashed in the chest by Chen Yun’s fist. They were immediately sent flying like two sandbags. They spat out a few mouthfuls of blood in the air, and their sternums were dented.
It was obvious that many of their ribs had been broken.
“F*ck!”
This time, it was as if a basin of cold water had been poured on everyone’s heads. Many hooligans were dumbfounded.
Fang Mengjun’s eyes lit up. She was extremely excited. “He’s too fierce! It’s like fighting a kindergarten kid!”
Hu Xiaolei and Zou Yu looked at Chen Yun’s skills and their faces regained some color.
Lin Yuhan and Dong Honghe were even more encouraged. They punched the hooligans in front of them like hammers.
Sun Peng was also shocked. What kind of ruthless people were they?!

Second Brother Li immediately knew that he had landed himself in trouble. He was so angry that he was about to vomit blood. He roared, “A group of idiots. You can’t beat them with your bare hands. Don’t you know how to use your knives?! Are you saving your knives for show?!”

The hooligans looked at each other. Once they used their knives, there would be blood. That would be a big deal. However, in this situation, if they did not use their knives, they would definitely not be able to defeat the other party.
In the future, they would not have to work under Boss Li.
Thinking of Boss Li’s methods, everyone shivered.
“Brothers, grab your weapons!” The man in the lead, who had a dragon tattoo on his shoulder, immediately grinned.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh...
Cold light flashed, and the entire hall was instantly filled with killing intent.
All the customers and service staff ran out. The further they ran, the better. After all, they afraid that the blood would spill on their bodies.
Even the boss of the Sea Sky Pavilion hid when he heard that Second Brother Li was Boss Li’s subordinate. He did not dare to interfere at all.
Seeing them use their knives, Lin Yuhan and the others were also trembling in fear. Their blood had turned cold just now. This was not a joke.
They had to rely on their remaining courage to deal with the hooligans. If they were to be stabbed, they would have to stay in the hospital for a few days.
However, the other party did not care about them.

The man with a dragon tattoo on his shoulder was one of Boss Li’s capable thugs and the leader of the group. At this moment, he was holding a short knife and rushed forward first to slash at Dong Honghe.
“F*ck you! Die!”

This slash was extremely powerful, bringing with it the whistling sound of the wind. The snow-white saber beam was accompanied by a ferocious smile. It could be considered the proud work of the man with a dragon tattoo on his shoulder in his entire life. He could almost see the blood splatter when the short knife cut into the human body.
“Honghe, get out of the way.”
Fang Mengjun shouted and instinctively stepped forward.
However...
How could she catch up?!
It was over!
At this moment, Dong Honghe’s eyes were filled with despair. He was stunned.
“Go to hell!”
The man roared angrily and slashed down with his short knife.
The next moment.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
Three gunshots rang out!
“Ah!”

In the entire hall, everyone screamed. The young hooligans, who had ferocious expressions, were so frightened that the knives in their hands fell to the ground. They all squatted on the ground and covered their heads with their hands!
Fang Mengjun and the others also shouted and simply fell to the ground. Their eyes trembled as they looked at the young man standing in the middle of the field with a silver gun in his hand.
At this moment, Chen Yun pointed his gun at the young hooligans, his eyes flickering with a cold light. “Move! Another one! Come on!”

chapters.title: Chapter 135: I Advise You to Watch Your Words!
paragraphs: Move!
At this moment, every word Chen Yun said was enough to make everyone’s hearts tremble!!
This feeling was like being moved by a heavy hammer!
At this moment, Second Brother Li held his head in his hands and his entire body began to tremble. He could not believe what he was seeing.
This was the first time he had seen a gun in his life!
Not only was he shocked, but the people beside him were the same. This was the first time they had seen a gun in their lives.
In the face of the gunshots, they were no different from a group of sheep. The short knives in their hands fell to the ground. Everyone had a long face and their bodies began to tremble.
As long as Chen Yun wanted to, as long as he fired a shot, their lives would be his.
Now, it was as if they had fallen into an icy river. Their teeth could not help but tremble and emit cracking sounds.
Chen Yun looked at them and sneered. “I’ve said it before. Who do you think you are?”
He turned around, holstered his gun, and prepared to pull his childhood friends back.
However, in the next moment.

“Boss Li, looks like there are people in the Yanwei area who don’t respect you. Who do you think you are to talk to Boss Li’s subordinates? As the saying goes, you have to look at the owner before hitting a dog. I don’t need to say anything else, right?” A chuckle sounded.
Then, an uproar suddenly came from outside. A group of people walked in from the door. The leaders were a middle-aged man and a refined young man in his thirties.
It was Li Xiao, Mr. Song, and the others.
At this moment, when Li Xiao heard Song Kai’s words, his expression was extremely dark. He was just bragging about his status in Yanwei, but someone told his people that they were nothing.
Moreover, his subordinates were actually squatting on the ground and hugging their heads. Their posture was especially standard.
“F*ck, you bunch of trash!” Li Xiao was furious. “What are you doing?!”
When Second Brother Li saw Li Xiao, he was overjoyed. “Cousin, Cousin, you’re finally here.”
As he spoke, he turned to look at Chen Yun and the others and sneered. “My cousin is here. Let’s see how you die!”
In an instant, Sun Peng saw the person who came and shouted, “Oh no, Boss Li is actually here!”
There was no need to mention Fang Mengjun and the others. Although they did not know Li Xiao’s strength, they could tell from Sun Peng’s words that this person was definitely a ruthless person!
Unexpectedly, he actually came at this juncture!
Moreover, he heard Chen Yun’s words!
This was bad!
Second Brother Li looked smug.

However, he didn’t expect that before he could finish speaking, the moment Chen Yun turned around, Li Xiao’s eyes widened as if he had seen the most terrifying thing. His face immediately changed and turned extremely pale!
Beads of cold sweat the size of beans seeped out of his forehead.

When the leader of the Yanwei new nobles saw Chen Yun, his body trembled. Then, like a dog seeing its master, he quickly walked up to Chen Yun and quickly bent down. He spoke in the most respectful voice he had ever heard in his life.
“Director Chen!”
Chen Yun stood there and glanced at Li Xiao. After a long time, he replied.
“Yes.”
“Director Chen?”
Everyone present looked at this rising new noble of Yanwei in surprise. He bowed and stood in front of Chen Yun like a believer facing a god.
“Is he Director Chen from Jiang City?”
Sun Peng was already stunned on the spot in disbelief.
Almost everyone in the upper echelons of Yanwei knew that Li Xiao had gotten to his position because he had connections with Jiang City and gained Director Chen and CEO Ma’s trust.
Moreover, there was probably no other Director Chen in Jiang City who could make Li Xiao respect him so much!
At that moment, the way Sun Peng looked at Chen Yun changed.
The man with a dragon tattoo on his shoulder and the others were so frightened that their knives fell to the ground, making clanging sounds.
Mr. Song, who was standing at the door, also had a glint in his eyes. He did not expect to meet Chen Yun on this trip.
Meanwhile, Fang Mengjun and the others were confused.
Wasn’t Chen Yun their childhood friend? Why did he suddenly become ‘Director Chen’? Moreover, it seemed that Boss Li was very respectful to him.

Shu Fan had never attended a banquet in Jiang City, and Wang Yuanyuan and the others would not tell her what happened that day. Thus, she naturally did not know. Meanwhile, Fang Mengjun, Dong Honghe, and the others were too low-leveled. They had stayed in a small place and had never heard of Director Chen.
At this moment, Second Brother Li seemed to have yet to react and shouted.
“Cousin, what are you doing?! This kid was about to hit me just now and even scolded you. Hurry up and send someone to capture him and break his legs.”
Li Xiao still stood there respectfully and turned a deaf ear. Instead, he asked in a low voice.
“Director Chen, what do you think we should do?”
Chen Yun looked indifferently at Li Xiao in front of him. He took a glass of wine from the side, tilted his wrist, and poured the wine to the ground.
This meant that he had to bid farewell to and kill someone!
“Next time, I’ll pour this glass of wine for you.”
Li Xiao’s body trembled, then he stood up solemnly and said, “Yes!”
After saying that, he turned around and said coldly, “Little Seven, take this guy away.”

The one called Little Seven was the man with a dragon tattoo on his shoulder. After hearing the big boss’s order, he did not dare to hesitate at all. He immediately gathered together and picked up the thin man before taking him away.
Before Second Brother Li could figure out the reality, he shouted.
“What are you doing? Let go of me!”
“Cousin, Cousin, did you give the wrong order? The group of brats were scolding you, not me!”
Li Xiao turned a deaf ear to him, as if he did not know this person. However, his back was already drenched in cold sweat. He really wanted to take a needle and sew Second Brother Li’s mouth shut.

The eyes of the man with a dragon tattoo were clear. He punched Second Brother Li in the stomach and stopped him from saying anything else. He said fiercely, “Second Brother Li, don’t implicate the Boss if you’re courting death. Are you stupid? The person you offended is Director Chen from Jiang City!”
At this moment, Second Brother Li seemed to have thought of something and his face instantly turned pale.
The man with a dragon tattoo suddenly said, “F*ck your mother, you blind thing. You almost killed us. In your next life, watch your eyes when you reincarnate.”
When Second Brother Li heard this, his eyes were filled with despair. He said crazily and struggled with all his might, but it was too late.
After the thin man was brought out, the hall fell silent again.

Chen Yun did not speak, Li Xiao did not dare to speak, and Fang Mengjun and the others did not know what to say. Mr. Song’s eyes flickered as he observed Chen Yun. The many tycoons who came with Li Xiao were trembling.
“Alright, we should go too.”
Chen Yun stood up and waved at Dong Honghe and the others as a signal that they were leaving.
Although Dong Honghe and the others had a stomach full of doubts, it was not convenient to ask under such circumstances.

Meanwhile, Li Xiao bowed and did not dare to say a word. After Chen Yun and the others walked away, he slowly stood up. At this moment, everyone realized that although it was winter, his back was already wet, but his face did not show it at all.
“Boss, was that Director Chen?”
At the side, a high-ranking official from Yanwei asked.
“That’s right. That’s Director Chen from Jiang City,” said Li Xiao in an enfeeble voice.
“In that case, has the matter been resolved just like that?” Mr. Song asked curiously.

He knew Chen Yun’s methods. It was said that he had killed the head of the Su family and Young Master Su. Moreover, he was now standing at the top of Jiang City. With his status as a big shot in Jiang City, those who offended him would at least have their limbs broken. In serious cases, their families would be destroyed. Why did Chen Yun leave after dusting his hands?
Li Xiao remained silent, but he sighed in his heart.
How could it end so easily? Chen Yun’s last actions and words clearly meant that the wine was used to toast the dead.
Who was that toast to? Naturally, it was to Second Brother Li.
Therefore, Second Brother Li had to die!
Moreover, Chen Yun’s words were also a warning to him. If Li Xiao provoked him again, the next person to die would be Li Xiao!
However, he would not say this in public.
Moreover, this matter was not over. If he offended a big shot like Chen Yun, his status would be affected.
No, he definitely could not offend Chen Yun.
At that moment, he shook hands as if he had made up his mind.
Beside him, Song Kai looked at Chen Yun’s figure and sneered. “Good jon, Director Chen. How impressive.”

“Mr. Song, I advise you to be careful with your words!” Li Xiao looked at Song Kai with anger in his eyes. If he hadn’t taken a fancy to the female student, Li Xiao wouldn’t have asked someone to ‘invite’ her over and even provoked Director Chen.
It was Song Kai who almost caused him to lose his current status!
He almost cut off his path!
Moreover, even if he dealt with it like this now, his status in Chen Yun’s heart would probably plummet. It seemed that he still had to be prepared.
At the thought of this, he looked at Song Kai fiercely again. “Mr. Song, although you’re from the Song family in Jiangbei, if I hear you disrespect Director Chen again, I won’t be polite.”
These words made Song Kai narrow his eyes, and his eyes were filled with gloom.
This was a blatant threat!
Li Kai was simply protecting himself!
At that moment, he looked at Chen Yun in the distance and gritted his teeth.
