Their teeth could not help but tremble and emit cracking sounds.
Chen Yun looked at them and sneered.
“I’ve said it before.
Who do you think you are?”
He turned around, holstered his gun, and prepared to pull his childhood friends back.
However, in the next moment.
“Boss Li, looks like there are people in the Yanwei area who don’t respect you.
Who do you think you are to talk to Boss Li’s subordinates?
As the saying goes, you have to look at the owner before hitting a dog.
I don’t need to say anything else, right?” A chuckle sounded.
Then, an uproar suddenly came from outside.
A group of people walked in from the door.
The leaders were a middle-aged man and a refined young man in his thirties.
It was Li Xiao, Mr.
Song, and the others.
At this moment, when Li Xiao heard Song Kai’s words, his expression was extremely dark.
He was just bragging about his status in Yanwei, but someone told his people that they were nothing.
Moreover, his subordinates were actually squatting on the ground and hugging their heads.
Their posture was especially standard.
“F*ck, you bunch of trash!” Li Xiao was furious.
“What are you doing?!”
When Second Brother Li saw Li Xiao, he was overjoyed.
“Cousin, Cousin, you’re finally here.”
As he spoke, he turned to look at Chen Yun and the others and sneered.
“My cousin is here.
Let’s see how you die!”
In an instant, Sun Peng saw the person who came and shouted, “Oh no, Boss Li is actually here!”
There was no need to mention Fang Mengjun and the others.
Although they did not know Li Xiao’s strength, they could tell from Sun Peng’s words that this person was definitely a ruthless person!
Unexpectedly, he actually came at this juncture!
Moreover, he heard Chen Yun’s words!
This was bad!
Second Brother Li looked smug.
However, he didn’t expect that before he could finish speaking, the moment Chen Yun turned around, Li Xiao’s eyes widened as if he had seen the most terrifying thing.
His face immediately changed and turned extremely pale!
Beads of cold sweat the size of beans seeped out of his forehead.
When the leader of the Yanwei new nobles saw Chen Yun, his body trembled.
Then, like a dog seeing its master, he quickly walked up to Chen Yun and quickly bent down.
He spoke in the most respectful voice he had ever heard in his life.
“Director Chen!”
Chen Yun stood there and glanced at Li Xiao.
After a long time, he replied.
“Yes.”
“Director Chen?”
Everyone present looked at this rising new noble of Yanwei in surprise.
He bowed and stood in front of Chen Yun like a believer facing a god.
“Is he Director Chen from Jiang City?”
Sun Peng was already stunned on the spot in disbelief.
Almost everyone in the upper echelons of Yanwei knew that Li Xiao had gotten to his position because he had connections with Jiang City and gained Director Chen and CEO Ma’s trust.
Moreover, there was probably no other Director Chen in Jiang City who could make Li Xiao respect him so much!
At that moment, the way Sun Peng looked at Chen Yun changed.
The man with a dragon tattoo on his shoulder and the others were so frightened that their knives fell to the ground, making clanging sounds.
Mr.
Song, who was standing at the door, also had a glint in his eyes.
He did not expect to meet Chen Yun on this trip.
Meanwhile, Fang Mengjun and the others were confused.
Wasn’t Chen Yun their childhood friend?
Why did he suddenly become ‘Director Chen’?
Moreover, it seemed that Boss Li was very respectful to him.
Shu Fan had never attended a banquet in Jiang City, and Wang Yuanyuan and the others would not tell her what happened that day.
Thus, she naturally did not know.
Meanwhile, Fang Mengjun, Dong Honghe, and the others were too low-leveled.
They had stayed in a small place and had never heard of Director Chen.
At this moment, Second Brother Li seemed to have yet to react and shouted.
“Cousin, what are you doing?!
This kid was about to hit me just now and even scolded you.
Hurry up and send someone to capture him and break his legs.”
Li Xiao still stood there respectfully and turned a deaf ear.
Instead, he asked in a low voice.
“Director Chen, what do you think we should do?”
Chen Yun looked indifferently at Li Xiao in front of him.
He took a glass of wine from the side, tilted his wrist, and poured the wine to the ground.
This meant that he had to bid farewell to and kill someone!
“Next time, I’ll pour this glass of wine for you.”
Li Xiao’s body trembled, then he stood up solemnly and said, “Yes!”
After saying that, he turned around and said coldly, “Little Seven, take this guy away.”
The one called Little Seven was the man with a dragon tattoo on his shoulder.
After hearing the big boss’s order, he did not dare to hesitate at all.
He immediately gathered together and picked up the thin man before taking him away.
Before Second Brother Li could figure out the reality, he shouted.
“What are you doing?
Let go of me!”
“Cousin, Cousin, did you give the wrong order?
The group of brats were scolding you, not me!”
Li Xiao turned a deaf ear to him, as if he did not know this person.
However, his back was already drenched in cold sweat.
He really wanted to take a needle and sew Second Brother Li’s mouth shut.
The eyes of the man with a dragon tattoo were clear.
He punched Second Brother Li in the stomach and stopped him from saying anything else.
He said fiercely, “Second Brother Li, don’t implicate the Boss if you’re courting death.
Are you stupid?
The person you offended is Director Chen from Jiang City!”
At this moment, Second Brother Li seemed to have thought of something and his face instantly turned pale.
The man with a dragon tattoo suddenly said, “F*ck your mother, you blind thing.
You almost killed us.
In your next life, watch your eyes when you reincarnate.”
When Second Brother Li heard this, his eyes were filled with despair.
He said crazily and struggled with all his might, but it was too late.
After the thin man was brought out, the hall fell silent again.
Chen Yun did not speak, Li Xiao did not dare to speak, and Fang Mengjun and the others did not know what to say.
Mr.
Song’s eyes flickered as he observed Chen Yun.
The many tycoons who came with Li Xiao were trembling.
“Alright, we should go too.”
Chen Yun stood up and waved at Dong Honghe and the others as a signal that they were leaving.
Although Dong Honghe and the others had a stomach full of doubts, it was not convenient to ask under such circumstances.
Meanwhile, Li Xiao bowed and did not dare to say a word.
After Chen Yun and the others walked away, he slowly stood up.
At this moment, everyone realized that although it was winter, his back was already wet, but his face did not show it at all.
“Boss, was that Director Chen?”
At the side, a high-ranking official from Yanwei asked.
“That’s right.
That’s Director Chen from Jiang City,” said Li Xiao in an enfeeble voice.
“In that case, has the matter been resolved just like that?” Mr.
Song asked curiously.
He knew Chen Yun’s methods.
It was said that he had killed the head of the Su family and Young Master Su.
Moreover, he was now standing at the top of Jiang City.
With his status as a big shot in Jiang City, those who offended him would at least have their limbs broken.
In serious cases, their families would be destroyed.
Why did Chen Yun leave after dusting his hands?
Li Xiao remained silent, but he sighed in his heart.
How could it end so easily?
Chen Yun’s last actions and words clearly meant that the wine was used to toast the dead.
Who was that toast to?
Naturally, it was to Second Brother Li.
Therefore, Second Brother Li had to die!
Moreover, Chen Yun’s words were also a warning to him.
If Li Xiao provoked him again, the next person to die would be Li Xiao!
However, he would not say this in public.
Moreover, this matter was not over.
If he offended a big shot like Chen Yun, his status would be affected.
No, he definitely could not offend Chen Yun.
At that moment, he shook hands as if he had made up his mind.
Beside him, Song Kai looked at Chen Yun’s figure and sneered.
“Good jon, Director Chen.
How impressive.”
“Mr.
Song, I advise you to be careful with your words!” Li Xiao looked at Song Kai with anger in his eyes.
If he hadn’t taken a fancy to the female student, Li Xiao wouldn’t have asked someone to ‘invite’ her over and even provoked Director Chen.
It was Song Kai who almost caused him to lose his current status!
He almost cut off his path!
Moreover, even if he dealt with it like this now, his status in Chen Yun’s heart would probably plummet.
It seemed that he still had to be prepared.
At the thought of this, he looked at Song Kai fiercely again.
“Mr.
Song, although you’re from the Song family in Jiangbei, if I hear you disrespect Director Chen again, I won’t be polite.”
These words made Song Kai narrow his eyes, and his eyes were filled with gloom.
This was a blatant threat!
Li Kai was simply protecting himself!
At that moment, he looked at Chen Yun in the distance and gritted his teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Then He Doesn’t Have to Be a New Noble!
paragraphs: At this moment, in the car, Fang Mengjun was simply excited to the point of punching empty air. Her eyes were filled with excitement.
“This feels too good. Ahhh!”
“Director Chen, Director Chen!”
“You didn’t even see that when Boss Li first saw you, he looked like he had seen the emperor.”
“I swear that I’ve never felt so good in my life.”
“Hey, that’s not right. It felt good to buy things the day before yesterday. I’ve never felt so good in my life than in the past few days.”
Fang Mengjun’s straightforward voice filled the car. Chen Yun, who was at the side, also smiled bitterly. Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan’s eyes were filled with confusion.
Lin Yuhan was still fine. Previously, he had already seen the director’s respectful attitude towards Chen Yun in the hospital. Now that he saw this similar scene again, he was not as shocked.
However, Dong Honghe, who was driving, was different.
Lin Yuhan and Fang Mengjun did not know Li Xiao’s identity, but he knew it very well.

Li Xiao had started out as a hooligan. In the beginning, he relied on fighting and killing to get to where he was today. After he transitioned, he was unknown in Yanwei but could be considered to be in the upper echelons. However, recently, for some reason, Li Xiao’s status kept rising as if he had sat on a rocket and became a new noble in Yanwei.

He had heard some things from Sun Peng before. He said that Li Xiao had connections in Jiang City, but Sun Peng did not reveal anything more. He did not know if Sun Peng was deliberately hiding it from him or if Sun Peng really did not know.
However, he was certain that Chen Yun must have an identity in Jiang City that they could not believe. Moreover, he had an extremely powerful background!
It was so big that even Li Xiao had to look at Chen Yun’s expression. Once Chen Yun was angry, Li Xiao had to obediently endure Chen Yun’s anger!
He looked at Chen Yun’s face through the mirror, but the deep shock in his heart did not disappear.

However, he heaved a sigh of relief. After all, today’s matter was a close call. In addition, he knew that his brother’s current status was extraordinary and that he would definitely be rich in the future. He was really happy for Chen Yun.
Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun beside her. “Chen Yun, can you show me the gun? Just hold it and let me touch it.”
“Please satisfy me.”
Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan’s expressions changed when they heard her words. “Nonsense!”
Fang Mengjun was immediately shocked.

Lin Yuhan had been in the military for a few years, so he naturally knew about the gun in Chen Yun’s hand. However, he also knew that this thing definitely should not appear in the hands of ordinary people.
Chen Yun had taken it out in public today to help them out. They had to keep this matter to themselves and not tell anyone.
Otherwise, it would bring trouble to Chen Yun.
After reprimanding Fang Mengjun, she put away her playfulness and looked like a punching bag.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at his childhood friends from the side and could not help but feel a sense of sweetness.
However, Chen Yun did not treat guns as taboo. If ordinary people took a gun out, the outcome would definitely be different from Chen Yun’s case.
If he took a gun out, anyone who saw it would have to pretend not to see it. Today, even if he fired, no one would spread the news, let alone dare to pursue him!
This was because of his status. Otherwise, how would the Su family dare to form a guard team which was armed with guns?
“Honghe, send Yuhan and Mengjun back first,” said Chen Yun. Then, he looked at the pleading gazes of the two of them and smiled. “There’s still a long way to go. You’ll know in the future.”
After sending Fang Mengjun and Lin Yuhan off, Chen Yun sat in the front passenger seat. “Honghe, is there a teahouse here? Let’s go have tea.”

“It just so happens that I know one. It’s quite famous in Yanwei.” Dong Honghe looked at Chen Yun’s expression and knew what Chen Yun wanted to say to him. He was not in a hurry to ask. Instead, he brought Chen Yun to the Purple Bamboo Garden.

The Purple Bamboo Garden was one of the top tea gardens in Yanwei District. It was like a small villa. Purple bamboo was everywhere, and small bridges and flowing water ran through the tea garden. The stone carvings were well-arranged. During this period, birds chirped and springs sounded. It looked like a paradise.
There were many wooden houses here.
Each of them was equivalent to a private room.
Even though Dong Honghe had been here with his father a few times in the past, he was still shocked by the situation here.
“Uncle Wang, can you arrange a small courtyard for me?” After Dong Honghe entered, he looked at the boss in a long robe in front of him and asked eagerly, as if they were old friends.
“It’s Honghe. Alright, Xiao An, take him there.” The boss called a girl to bring the two of them to a small wooden house.
“Do you come here often?”
“I’ve only been here two or three times. Don’t you know me? I’m very friendly.”
Chen Yun nodded. Previously, although Honghe was in the same courtyard as them, he had shown a talent that was different from theirs since he was young. This fellow could make friends with anyone.
It was said that when he saw people, he would speak human language. When he saw ghosts, he could speak the language of the ghosts. There was no friend he could not make.
This kind of personality naturally benefited him a lot.
Otherwise, with the huge difference in status between him and Sun Peng, Sun Peng would not have personally come over for him and even helped them in the end.
After sitting down, Dong Honghe looked at the price of the tea leaves on the tea book and immediately swallowed his saliva.
What the f*ck!
After looking around, there was nothing he could afford.
The cheapest ones cost almost 1,000 yuan per gram.
Needless to say, the top ones were already worth more than 10,000 yuan per gram.
Seeing that Dong Honghe did not order for a long time, Chen Yun called the girl over. “I’ll take this. Give me three glasses.”
“Alright, Sir.” The little girl looked at the item Chen Yun was pointing at, her eyes filled with shock.
This customer was young and dressed casually, but he directly ordered the best tea leaves here.
It cost 30,000 yuan per gram!
It was a special Da Hong Pao.
Even though it could not compare to the tea leaves from the main trees on Wuyi Mountain, it was not much different.
After a while, the girl returned and served everyone dried fruits. Then, she gently closed the door.
Chen Yun looked at Dong Honghe. “Honghe, you must have a lot of questions for me now. Go ahead and ask. It’s fine.”
“Brother, what did you rely on to make Li Xiao bow down?”
As soon as he came up, Dong Honghe did not play games with Chen Yun.
“I relied on a lot of money, the assets in my hands, and my methods.”
Even with money, people like Li Xiao would only respect him.
With the Heavenly Spirit Water, Li Xiao would stand on the same side as him. After all, it could make him a new nouveau riche and a person who could call the shots at the peak of Yan Wei.
However, it was still not enough!
If Chen Yun had not overthrown the Su family and single-handedly expelled the Su family from Jiang City, everyone would only respect him, but not revere him!
The way to control people was to use both kindness and power!
“I’m now the Chairman of Sacred Heaven, the leader of the entire Sacred Heaven,” said Chen Yun calmly.
What?
Dong Honghe simply stood up with his eyes wide open. He could not believe what he had heard!
Chen Yun was actually the chairman of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He was the leader of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He had heard of Sacred Heaven even though he was in Yanwei!

In the short period of one to two months, Sacred Heaven had been making huge moves. They held the Desert Island Survival variety show, bought Flying Fish Live-Stream, and established their own live-stream platform, Tianyun Live-Stream, to annex Huaying...
One by one, these incidents appeared in Dong Honghe’s mind like a movie.
Moreover, the estimated market value of Sacred Heaven was close to 20 billion yuan!
It was no wonder Li Xiao was so respectful to Chen Yun. This alone was enough.
“Li Xiao isn’t respectful to me because of this. It’s because I have something in my hands that can control his status.” Chen Yun filled his mouth with a banana.

“However, this person is simply related to my interests. Everyone in the world comes for benefits. The chaos in the world is all because of benefits. He’s just a fence sitter.” Chen Yun shook his head. He could see Li Xiao’s nature clearly.
Then, he looked at Dong Honghe. “Honghe, I want to open up a channel between Jiang City and Yanwei to advance my interests.”
These words made Dong Honghe suddenly excited. He understood Chen Yun’s meaning very well.
However, in the next moment, his eyes darkened. “Why me? You and Yuhan...”

“Among the few of us, I do have the best relationship with Yuhan, but you and I grew up together. How’s our relationship compared to biological brothers? If I’m in trouble, will you help me? Will you risk your life for me?”
Chen Yun smiled and Dong Honghe nodded. “That’s for sure.”
After saying this, he smiled.

“Among us, Yuhan has the most straightforward personality. There’s no need to mention Mengjun and Huaiyao. They’re both rich and at ease. Only your personality is most suitable,” said Chen Yun calmly. “I plan to let you manage a few First-Grade Restaurant branches that I’m preparing to open first. After that, I’ll give you more things.”
For example, Chen Yun would give him the right to distribute the Heavenly Spirit Water in the future.
The First-Grade Restaurant!
Dong Honghe’s eyes widened again.
They had heard Wang Liang mention the situation at the First-Grade Restaurant. It could be said that everyone in Jiang City knew about it.
“Is the First-Grade Restaurant also yours? Then Wang Liang’s card...”
“What do you think? Who else would be stupid? How can there be a lucky draw for a card worth 300,000 yuan?”
However, Wang Liang had indeed relied on himself to get a free meal previously.
Dong Honghe patted his chest. “Brother, don’t worry. I’m here. I’ll definitely help you take care of it.”
If Dong Honghe took over, Chen Yun would be much more at ease. After all, Dong Honghe would definitely not be like Li Xiao, who was only here for benefits.
After a while, the girl came in and looked at Chen Yun and Dong Honghe. She placed the three cups of tea on the table and silently left.
Dong Honghe opened the lid of the teacup. For a moment, a fragrance wafted out. It was pleasant.
He swore that he had never smelled such a fragrance in his life.
Once it entered his mouth, this feeling was even more wonderful!
After taking a few sips, he looked at the cup of tea on the other side. “Chen Yun, who is this cup of tea for?”
“It’s for Li Xiao.”
Chen Yun spoke calmly.
“Li Xiao?” Dong Honghe was shocked. “Do you think he’ll come?”
“If he doesn’t come, or if he can’t find me, then he won’t be a new noble anymore.” Chen Yun put down his teacup.
Half a minute later.
Someone knocked on the door of the wooden house.

“What do you think?
Who else would be stupid?
How can there be a lucky draw for a card worth 300,000 yuan?”
However, Wang Liang had indeed relied on himself to get a free meal previously.
Dong Honghe patted his chest.
“Brother, don’t worry.
I’m here.
I’ll definitely help you take care of it.”
If Dong Honghe took over, Chen Yun would be much more at ease.
After all, Dong Honghe would definitely not be like Li Xiao, who was only here for benefits.
After a while, the girl came in and looked at Chen Yun and Dong Honghe.
She placed the three cups of tea on the table and silently left.
Dong Honghe opened the lid of the teacup.
For a moment, a fragrance wafted out.
It was pleasant.
He swore that he had never smelled such a fragrance in his life.
Once it entered his mouth, this feeling was even more wonderful!
After taking a few sips, he looked at the cup of tea on the other side.
“Chen Yun, who is this cup of tea for?”
“It’s for Li Xiao.”
Chen Yun spoke calmly.
“Li Xiao?” Dong Honghe was shocked.
“Do you think he’ll come?”
“If he doesn’t come, or if he can’t find me, then he won’t be a new noble anymore.” Chen Yun put down his teacup.
Half a minute later.
Someone knocked on the door of the wooden house.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: The Upper Ranks Are All Here! (1)
paragraphs: “Come in.” The door opened and Li Xiao stood outside. He looked at Chen Yun and quickly walked in.
Dong Honghe was stunned when he saw this scene.
Unexpectedly, what Chen Yun said was true. It had only been a short while, but Li Xiao had already come looking for him.

Dong Honghe looked at Li Xiao’s pale face and cold sweat on his forehead. Then, he looked at Li Xiao’s arm and saw that it was wrapped in thick gauze. However, it could not hide the blood that was seeping out.
“Boss Li, what are you doing?” Dong Honghe looked at Li Xiao and asked.
Li Xiao walked up to Chen Yun and bowed to him. “Director Chen, my subordinates were blind and offended you. This is my responsibility. Please forgive me.”
As for the injury on his arm, it was naturally Li Xiao’s explanation to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun glanced at Li Xiao. “Have a seat.”
Hearing Chen Yun’s words, Li Xiao was overjoyed. He quickly sat down and sighed. “Director Chen, actually, I’m not the one who wanted your friend to accompany me. It’s Song Kai.”
“Song Kai?” Chen Yun frowned. Then, he recalled the young man with gold-rimmed glasses beside Li Xiao.
“Don’t you know him?” Li Xiao was puzzled. Then, he realized that this was the case.

After all, although Song Kai had the Song family backing him and was even known as the Vice President of two listed corporations, in his opinion, these little achievements was nothing in Chen Yun’s eyes.

Moreover, Song Kai was only a collateral relative in the Song family. His strength was not even comparable to the grandson of the Su family and the Young Master of Huaying, Dong Yuncheng. How could he be worthy of Director Chen’s attention?

“Song Kai is a collateral relative of the Song family in Jiangbei. As you know, the Song family is quite famous in Jiangbei. Although I relied on your prestige to rise and become a new nouveau riche, I still have to be polite to him. However, I didn’t expect to provoke you. I deserve to die.” Li Xiao immediately slapped himself.
Chen Yun looked puzzled. “Why isn’t the Song family staying in Jiangbei? Why are they here?”
“That’s exactly what I wanted to tell you. He probably came this time to see that I have the Heavenly Spirit Water. Moreover, he even asked me if I had the formula,” said Li Xiao firmly.
Oh?

This was something Chen Yun did not expect. Chen Yun had met the eldest young master of the Song family, Song Jixing, previously. However, he treated Chen Yun as a fool and wanted a 40-60 or even a 30-70 split, but Chen Yun directly rejected him.
Unexpectedly, they did not give up and actually sent people to Yanwei.

However, Chen Yun also knew the value of the Heavenly Spirit Water. Now, the Heavenly Spirit Water in Chen Yun’s hand was famous. He only distributed 100 bottles a day. Each bottle was less than 100ml, but it was priced at 300,000 yuan.
However, even with such a high price of 300,000 yuan, it was still popular among the upper echelons of Jiang City!
Many high-ranking officials and nobles in other provinces and cities even pulled strings to buy it.
Among them, there was no lack of people selling the Heavenly Spirit Water. Chen Yun did not care much, but he heard that it had already reached a price above 500,000 yuan a bottle.
In a day, Chen Yun could earn 30 million yuan just by relying on the Heavenly Spirit Water!
Moreover, there was no cost of production!
How could this not make people jealous?
However, if the Song family wanted to get the formula from him, they were simply thinking too much.
Li Xiao looked at Chen Yun and pondered. He sat carefully at the side and did not even dare to touch the tea.
Then, he looked at Dong Honghe beside him and nodded. He bowed slightly to show his respect.
This shocked Dong Honghe. Just as he was about to say something, he was stunned.
Damn it, Director Chen was his brother.
It was only right for Li Xiao to be polite.
If he responded politely as well, wouldn’t he embarrass his brother?
At that moment, Dong Honghe only nodded at Li Xiao. The other party also enjoyed it and smiled.
However, with this fierce face, his smile didn’t look like a smile.
Chen Yun looked at Li Xiao. “I plan to open a few First-Grade Restaurant branches in Yanwei.”
This!

“This relationship is good!” Li Xiao almost jumped up, his eyes filled with excitement. He had been to Jiang City a few times, and every time he went, he ate at the First-Grade Restaurant. He ate there for all three meals and did not miss a single meal.
Naturally, he knew how good the First-Grade Restaurant was.
After eating at the First-Grade Restaurant, he felt that other delicacies were almost tasteless.

However, the only insufficient thing was that his base was in Yanwei. He could not stay in Jiang City. Now that Chen Yun said that he wanted to open several First-Grade Restaurant branches in Yanwei, he naturally agreed.

“Director Chen, how about this? I’ll hold a gathering tomorrow. Firstly, it’s to promote the opening of the First-Grade Restaurant. Secondly, many high-ranking officials and dignitaries want to get to know you. They begged me to introduce them to you a few times. I...” Li Xiao looked troubled.
After all, so many high-ranking officials and nobles had spoken to him about this. Moreover, if Chen Yun attended, his status in everyone’s eyes would rise to another level.
“Alright, make the arrangements. Drink the tea and go to the hospital to bandage your wounds.” Chen Yun waved his hand. Li Xiao quickly nodded, drank the tea, and left.
After Li Xiao left, Chen Yun looked at Dong Honghe. “Let’s go.”
“What’s wrong?”

“We’re going to buy formal clothes. Do you have formal clothes? The protagonist tomorrow is not me, but you.” After Chen Yun finished speaking, Dong Honghe immediately understood that Chen Yun was using Li Xiao’s reputation to pave the way for him.

After walking out, Dong Honghe found out that Li Xiao had already paid the bill when he left. Dong Honghe couldn’t help but smile. Boss Li was capable of doing this. At the very least, he was good at seeking favor with others.
In the afternoon, Dong Honghe learned what it meant to live the life of a rich person.
A watch cost about a million yuan!
Not to mention the remaining things!
The clothes cost tens of thousands of yuan. The shoes cost tens of thousands of yuan as well.
Even a belt cost more than ten thousand yuan!
Dong Honghe looked at the things in his hands. They were enough to buy a house in Yanwei!
Then, he looked at Chen Yun, who had a nonchalant expression.
Chen Yun also estimated Lin Yuhan’s figure and bought him a lot of formal clothes. He asked Dong Honghe to give them to him.
The next evening.

chapters.title: Chapter 138: The Upper Ranks Are All Here! (2)
paragraphs: Chen Yun changed his clothes and walked out of his room. He happened to see his parents on the phone with Mengmeng, so he walked over.
“Ah! Brother, you’re even more handsome now!” Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun and could not help but say.

“How have you been recently?” Chen Yun asked. “Have you encountered any difficulties? Do you have enough money? There’s no need to save money during the special training. Buy more things for yourself and Xiao Xue. Eat good food. If you don’t have enough money, I’ll give you more.”
“No need, no need.”
As soon as she heard about transferring money, Chen Mengmeng immediately shook her head like a rattle-drum. How could she spend it all? Just that card alone contained tens of millions!
It was tens of millions!
Even if she counted the money, she would have to count until her hands were cramped, let alone spend it!
Now, she probably only spent a few thousand yuan.

Moreover, besides the special training, she had also taken on some minor roles. She and Xiao Xue could earn money. Although they didn’t earn much, they still had enough for their daily expenses. She couldn’t always spend her brother’s money.
“Brother, where are you going in this outfit?” Chen Mengmeng asked when she saw Chen Yun in formal clothes.
“There’s a gathering in Yanwei. I’ll go take a look and go with Sister Mengjun and the others.”
Oh.
Chen Mengmeng immediately raised her eyebrows. “Brother, I have a bold idea.”
“Quickly put away your bold ideas.” Chen Yun smiled and looked at his parents. “Dad, Mom, do you want to come along?”
“Forget it, forget it. It’s a gathering of young people. It doesn’t matter if we go.” Mother Chen shook her head.
Chen Yun did not force them. However, tonight was not a gathering of young people, but a gathering of the upper echelons of Yanwei.
Chen Yun took the elevator downstairs, got into the Bugatti Veyron, and left.
At the Carnival Hall.

Fang Mengjun was waiting downstairs. She was wearing a light blue gown that Chen Yun had bought for her a few days ago. She was also wearing high heels, a Cartier bracelet worth more than 200,000 yuan, and a Patek Philippe watch worth 880,000 yuan.
She was like a noble princess.
Coupled with her extreme looks and figure, just by standing there, she formed a beautiful scenery. Many people were amazed, but no one dared to go forward.
What a joke. The current Fang Mengjun made people feel inferior just by standing there.
People who walked past her simply could not imagine what kind of person could talk to her.
However, Fang Mengjun looked left and right, her beautiful eyes looking at the roads on both sides.
“There’s no sign of a Passat... erm... Phaeton. Where is he?” Fang Mengjun guessed that Chen Yun was probably driving, so she did not disturb him.
Then, at the end of the road, a black car drove over.

The sound wave attracted the attention of many drivers. They originally thought that it was a modified car, but when they looked over, their eyes widened as if their hearts had been hit by a heavy mace.
What the f*ck!
How was it a modified car? It was a Bugatti Veyron!
It was a top luxury car!
On the other side, Fang Mengjun also noticed this luxury car and raised her eyebrows.
Could it be...
“Little silly girl, what are you waiting for?” Chen Yun turned and stopped the car in front of her. Then, he rolled down the window and spoke to Fang Mengjun.
“Ah!”
Fang Mengjun couldn’t help but cover her mouth and exclaim softly, “Is— is this also your car? A Bugatti Veyron?”
“Hey, you don’t know the Phaeton, but you know the Bugatti Veyron?”
“Don’t look down on people. That Phaeton was really unrecognizable, but this is different. It’s too conspicuous.” Fang Mengjun opened the car door and got in.
“I didn’t expect to be able to sit in such a luxury car in my lifetime.” Fang Mengjun looked at Chen Yun resentfully. “This time, you directly raised my standard for a partner.”

“It’s fine. If you can’t find a partner, I can make you a rich woman.” Chen Yun smiled. Fang Mengjun thought for a moment and said, “That won’t do. Even if I become a rich woman, I won’t be able to find someone with a handsome face like yours.”
“Forget it. It’s better to see you more before I find a partner. It’s more pleasing to the eye.”
“By the way, what party are we going to tonight?”
Chen Yun stepped on the accelerator. “It’s a gathering for you to become a rich woman.”
At this moment, in the Sky City Hotel in the city center of Yanwei, the waiters were all busy. It was as if everyone had wound their coil springs and didn’t dare to relax at all.
After all, they had never seen such a big scene. All of the famous big shots of Yanwei were all here. Their luxury cars almost filled the parking lot of the Sky City Hotel.
The entire hotel had been booked for a gathering tonight. At this moment, almost all the high-ranking officials and dignitaries had arrived and were chatting in the hall.
“President Zhang, long time no see. I heard that you’ve obtained another piece of land recently? Congratulations.”
“Director Liu, you’re here too.”

“Well, no matter how busy I am, I have to come. Who doesn’t know that Director Chen will be attending tonight? He’s such a big shot in Jiang City. For someone like me, I feel lucky to be able to toast him.”
“Have you seen what Director Chen looks like?” A CEO asked. The people around him shook their heads.
“I’ve never seen him before, but I heard that Director Chen seems to be very young.”
“Huh? Is that reliable? I heard that Director Chen’s net worth is already in the tens of billions. With such wealth, how can he be so young?”

“I wonder if I can chat with Director Chen. It would be even better if I can get a few bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water.” As a chairman spoke, he recalled the magical effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water and his face turned red.
The people beside him sneered. What the f*ck was he thinking?
There were only a few bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water in Yanwei a day. If he wanted to take a few bottles alone, what would they drink? Would they drink the wind?!
As they were talking, Li Xiao, Dong Honghe, and Lin Yuhan walked in side by side.
When everyone saw Li Xiao coming, they quickly went up to him.
“Boss Li, you’re here.”
“When will Director Chen arrive?”
“We really want to meet Director Chen. Boss Li, you must introduce me to him.”
When Li Xiao heard everyone’s words, he was disdainful. If he allowed them to get close to Director Chen, he would have nothing to gain. Then, he pressed his hand down, and everyone fell silent.
“Everyone, let me introduce them to you. These are Director Chen’s childhood friends, Mr. Dong Honghe and Mr. Lin Yuhan.”
This sentence caused an uproar among the crowd. The group of people looked at each other, their eyes shining. Just the words ” childhood friend” alone proved their status.
They were Director Chen’s childhood friends!
How strong was their relationship?!
“Hello, Mr. Dong. I’m the CEO of Zhong’an Pharmaceuticals.”
“Mr. Dong...”
“Mr. Lin...”
Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan looked at the enthusiastic attitudes of the high-ranking officials in front of them and felt extremely proud. They felt that they had reached the peak of their lives.

In particular, Dong Honghe looked at the people in front of him. He knew some of them. They were all CEOs or leaders of large companies. Some people might not even care if his father handed them cigarettes and toasted them, let alone his past self.
But now, they were standing in front of him and bowing to him.
This feeling was simply too satisfying!
Sun Peng also arrived at the banquet. However, with his status, he could only watch from the back. At this moment, he recalled what he had said to Chen Yun yesterday and had a bitter expression.
What weak strength? It was simply a joke.
Who was he? He was Director Chen from Jiang City!
Once this name was revealed, all the high-ranking officials and nobles in the city would flock over!
Li Xiao looked at the scene in front of him and socialized. Then, he looked at the time and waved at everyone. “It’s almost time. Let’s hurry downstairs to welcome Director Chen.”
The high-ranking officials and nobles present could not help but want to meet this legendary figure. They immediately followed Li Xiao out.
After everyone went down, they were all looking forward to it.
Moreover, no one complained.
After a while, the roar of an engine came from afar.
He was here!
Everyone’s hearts tightened as they looked at the approaching car.
After the car was parked, everyone present fell into a daze.
F*ck!
This car!

Just the words ” childhood friend” alone proved their status.
They were Director Chen’s childhood friends!
How strong was their relationship?!
“Hello, Mr.
Dong.
I’m the CEO of Zhong’an Pharmaceuticals.”
“Mr.
Dong...”
“Mr.
Lin...”
Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan looked at the enthusiastic attitudes of the high-ranking officials in front of them and felt extremely proud.
They felt that they had reached the peak of their lives.
In particular, Dong Honghe looked at the people in front of him.
He knew some of them.
They were all CEOs or leaders of large companies.
Some people might not even care if his father handed them cigarettes and toasted them, let alone his past self.
But now, they were standing in front of him and bowing to him.
This feeling was simply too satisfying!
Sun Peng also arrived at the banquet.
However, with his status, he could only watch from the back.
At this moment, he recalled what he had said to Chen Yun yesterday and had a bitter expression.
What weak strength?
It was simply a joke.
Who was he?
He was Director Chen from Jiang City!
Once this name was revealed, all the high-ranking officials and nobles in the city would flock over!
Li Xiao looked at the scene in front of him and socialized.
Then, he looked at the time and waved at everyone.
“It’s almost time.
Let’s hurry downstairs to welcome Director Chen.”
The high-ranking officials and nobles present could not help but want to meet this legendary figure.
They immediately followed Li Xiao out.
After everyone went down, they were all looking forward to it.
Moreover, no one complained.
After a while, the roar of an engine came from afar.
He was here!
Everyone’s hearts tightened as they looked at the approaching car.
After the car was parked, everyone present fell into a daze.
F*ck!
This car!

chapters.title: Chapter 139: I’ll Go With You!
paragraphs: Everyone looked at the supercar in front of them with their mouths wide open. They could not believe their eyes.
This!
Almost 99% of them had only seen this luxury car on television or the Internet!
It was the Bugatti Veyron!
It was one of the top luxury cars in the world!
It was the representative of luxury cars!
“This model costs 45 million yuan!” A tycoon couldn’t help but shout.
Forty-five million!
When this number fell into everyone’s ears, it was as if an atomic bomb had been dropped on the sea, causing huge waves!
It cost 45 million yuan! There were probably not many people who had liquid assets that exceeded this number, but a car was worth this price!
Was this the power of Director Chen, who stood at the peak of Jiang City?
How could they not be respectful?
Even Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan widened their eyes. They looked at the streamlined appearance of the Bugatti Veyron in front of them and were extremely envious.
Was this Chen Yun’s car?
Then, the car door opened and Chen Yun and Fang Mengjun got out. In an instant, the two of them were like two stars that shone brightly.
A handsome man and a beautiful woman appeared.
Chen Yun was dressed in a white suit and was extremely handsome. As for Fang Mengjun, she was wearing a light blue gown. She looked cultured and elegant, like a young lady from a rich family.
Was this... Director Chen?
Was he so young?!
Previously, when someone said that Chen Yun was young, they did not believe it at all. However, the truth was right here. Not only was Chen Yun young, but he was also too young!
At this age, ordinary people were still studying, but Chen Yun had already arrived at the peak of Jiang City. At the same time, he was famous!

This thought suddenly appeared in the minds of the high-ranking officials and the other dignitaries of Yanwei. Meanwhile, when Li Xiao saw Chen Yun, he quickly went up to him. “Director Chen, you’re here.”
In the next moment, the other high-ranking officials and nobles also went forward.
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, you’re here.”
Voices sounded one after another. Everyone surged towards Chen Yun like stars surrounding the moon. Their eyes were filled with respect!
Chen Yun looked at Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan. Then, he walked towards them.

“You’re early.” Chen Yun placed his hand on Dong Honghe’s shoulder. Dong Honghe leaned towards Chen Yun. “Damn it, Brother, your car is too ostentatious. Why didn’t you drive it for us to see previously?”
It was a Bugatti Veyron, a luxury car worth 45 million yuan!
If he could ride on it once, he would have no regrets in his life!
Just now, he felt that his heart was about to jump out. He simply could not stand such stimulation.
Chen Yun smiled and said in a low voice, “This car can’t carry many people. Moreover, why should I show off in front of you guys for no reason?”
“I drove it here today to show off and pretend.”
He spoke bluntly. With Dong Honghe and the others around, Chen Yun had nothing to hide. He immediately said his thoughts.

He had heard that people showed off in front of their classmates, but how could they show off in front of their childhood friends? Moreover, if not for today’s gathering, Chen Yun would not have driven this car here.
His goal in coming here was to shock the upper echelons of Yanwei and Li Xiao. He also wanted the First-Grade Restaurant to flourish in Yanwei and pave the way for Dong Honghe.
He paved a broad road!
At the side, when Dong Honghe heard Chen Yun’s words, he cursed in his heart. However, after thinking about it, he realized that this was not wrong.
Furthermore, the effect of showing off was 101 points. The extra point was to make him proud!

Everyone’s hearts seemed to twitch when they saw Chen Yun and Dong Honghe’s actions. Their gazes towards Dong Honghe also changed a lot. Many CEOs were even tempted to fawn over Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan later.
After all, from what Li Xiao said, they had seen how familiar Chen Yun was with them.
They were two completely different concepts!

At this moment, Li Xiao looked at Chen Yun with even more respect. He came to Chen Yun like a horse and lowered his body. “Director Chen, I’ve already booked the Sky City Hotel today. The banquet is about to begin. Shall we go in?”
“Alright.” Chen Yun walked in.
Dong Honghe and the others walked side by side with Chen Yun. Behind them were high-ranking officials and nobles.
At the banquet, high-ranking officials and nobles kept coming to toast Chen Yun. Chen Yun smiled but did not drink. The other party drank until their glasses were dry.

Dong Honghe also imitated Chen Yun. When someone toasted, he would raise his glass. However, if the other party was more famous, he would still take a sip. After all, his status was different from Chen Yun’s.
Not far away, Sun Peng looked at the people who toasted the top people of Jiang City and drank their fill. He sighed in his heart and followed his father over.
“Director Chen, let me toast you.” The middle-aged man following Sun Peng looked at Chen Yun and finished the wine in his hand in one gulp. Chen Yun only raised his glass.
Then, Chen Yun looked at Sun Peng and smiled at him. “You’re here too.”
“Director Chen, I offended you yesterday. I didn’t mean what I said. I didn’t know your identity either.” Sun Peng had a bitter expression. He didn’t expect Chen Yun to recognize him immediately.
Recalling how he had persuaded Chen Yun to lower his head and apologize yesterday, he found it funny.

When Chen Yun heard his words, he waved his hand. Although Sun Peng had said some things yesterday, it was unintentional. Moreover, he had attacked and dealt with those hooligans together. This made Chen Yun have a good impression of him.
At this moment, Chen Yun extended his wine glass and clinked it with the wine glass in Sun Peng’s hand. Then, he took a sip.
This action caused a huge commotion in everyone’s eyes!
This was the only half a mouthful of wine Chen Yun had drunk tonight!
Sun Peng was also stunned. Fortunately, his father reacted and quickly poked his waist. Sun Peng immediately finished the wine.
“Have fun at the banquet,” said Chen Yun before walking to the other side.
On the other side, Sun Peng was still in a daze, but the gazes of the high-ranking officials and nobles beside him were different.
“CEO Sun, I didn’t expect your young master to be on good terms with Director Chen.”
For a moment, Father Sun had a smile on his face as he socialized with the big shot beside him. After a while, he came back and hugged the still stunned Sun Peng’s shoulder.

“Good kid, your father didn’t raise a good son like you for nothing. When you go back tonight, tell me how you met Director Chen.” Just as Father Sun spoke a few words, he was pulled over by a few big shots to discuss business.
At this moment, Father Sun received a lot of orders. His mouth was almost crooked with joy.
After a while, Sun Peng suddenly came to a realization. He was also glad that he had made the decision yesterday.
At this moment, Fang Mengjun held Chen Yun’s arm and walked slowly. She looked at the side and saw that he was fine. Her eyes revealed a yearning light, but she did not dare to move.
The people beside her were all big shots, making her suddenly think of the stupid photo on the Internet.
It was a photo of a husky mixed with a wolf pack. Furthermore, the caption said, “They seem to treat me as one of their kind. What should I do?”
This was how she felt now. She was pretending to be a big shot, and the people beside her were all real big shots.
She still had to put on airs and not embarrass Chen Yun. Not only did she not eat anything, but she also did not drink water. Not only her, but Dong Honghe and Lin Yuhan were also the same.
In the end, after the banquet ended, Chen Yun asked Fang Mengjun to drive Dong Honghe’s car and bring them to a barbecue shop.
They ate heartily.

“Wuwuwu, there were so many delicious foods, but I didn’t manage to eat them. I might not be able to eat them in my life.” As Fang Mengjun ate the skewers, she thought of the feast tonight. Her heart was about to break.
Chen Yun looked at her resentful expression and chuckled. “Alright, alright, alright. Miss Fang, don’t use too much strength. You’re about to roast this barbecue stick.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Dong Honghe and the other two laughed.

“What are you laughing at?! You won’t be able to eat it in your lifetime.” Fang Mengjun glanced at the two of them, but Dong Honghe didn’t panic at all. “Hehe, just you wait. If Chen Yun opens the First-Grade Restaurant here, will the Sky City Hotel be able to maintain a monopoly?”
Recalling Li Xiao’s happy expression at that time, it was enough to show his strength.
“Really?”

“It’s true.” Chen Yun gave an affirmative answer. Compared to the dishes made by the First-Grade Restaurant, Chen Yun did not dare to say anything about the taste. After all, he had not eaten tonight either.
However, in terms of color and fragrance, the First-Grade Restaurant was definitely superior!
Moreover, the First-Grade Restaurant did not pay much attention to the color and fragrance. The taste was the best in the First-Grade Restaurant.
This meant that the First-Grade Restaurant was enough to suppress Sky City Hotel.
Fang Mengjun immediately rubbed her small hands excitedly. Listening to their descriptions, she immediately felt that the barbecue in her hand was no longer fragrant.
After eating, Chen Yun looked at Fang Mengjun and Dong Honghe. “Mengjun, send Honghe home. Yuhan and I happen to be on the same road. We can take a taxi back.”
Chen Yun had drunk alcohol, so it was impossible for him to drive. As for the Bugatti Veyron, he would drive it tomorrow.
“I’m preparing to return to Jiang City in the next few days.”
This made Fang Mengjun’s beautiful eyes widen.

“You’ve only been back for a few days, and you’re leaving again.” As she spoke, Dong Honghe coughed at the side. Fang Mengjun immediately pursed her lips and thought about how Chen Yun was surrounded by big shots. That’s right. If he didn’t go back to take the helm, how could his strength increase to the next level? This was the price of being sought after.
“Alright.” Fang Mengjun then looked up. “But you must pay attention to rest.”
“Alright, don’t look reluctant. Transportation is so developed now. It won’t take an hour to get here by plane,” said Chen Yun.
“That’s true. Then I’ll look for you when I have time. You can’t leave me a; one there,” said Fang Mengjun, but she had no intention of going to Jiang City. She only hid the sadness in her heart.
Chen Yun smiled and said, “Of course. Mengmeng is also in Jiang City. She’s still talking about you all day.”
However, that girl’s mind was filled with bold thoughts.
He did not know how bold she was.
He did not dare to ask either.
“Alright, let’s go.” Chen Yun and Lin Yuhan took a taxi. Instead of going home, they went straight to Binhai Park. Lin Yuhan followed Chen Yun to the seaview pavilion and was puzzled.
Chen Yun leaned against the railing. In the night, only the sound of waves could be heard.
“Brother, what do you want to do?”
“Do you want to stay here with Honghe or follow me to Jiang City?”
Chen Yun went straight to the point and gave Lin Yuhan two choices.
This stunned Lin Yuhan. He looked at Chen Yun and was silent for a long time.

“To be honest, I know what I’m capable of. I’m not suitable for business. I’m not shrewd and I’m too straightforward. Furthermore, I’m not like Honghe, who can get along with everyone. I’m suitable to be an assistant and carry out orders.”
This was a habit that he had developed in the military for a few years. He had a straightforward personality and was determined to carry out orders.
He looked up sharply. “I’ll go with you to Jiang City.”

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Let Me Show You A Big Treasure!
paragraphs: “Okay!”
Chen Yun looked at Lin Yuhan in front of him and smiled. “Go back and tell Uncle Lin that we’ll go to Jiang City the day after tomorrow.”
Lin Yuhan nodded.

The next day, the team sent by Zhou Jingyi had already finished their inspection. Other than the shops bought by Chen Yun in the development area, they had also chosen addresses in the other two districts. With them and Dong Honghe, Chen Yun did not have to worry about the First-Grade Restaurant.
At home.
“What? You’re leaving the day after tomorrow?” Mother Chen looked surprised. Then, her face fell. She looked at Chen Yun and sighed softly.
It was not easy for him to come back, but he had only been back for a few days. Furthermore, for the past few days, he had been going back and forth all day.
She couldn’t even catch him.
Chen Yun looked at his mother’s gaze and hugged her. “Why don’t you come to Jiang City with me?”
“No, I’m not going. If I go, I’ll disturb the work and the rest of you young people.” Mother Chen waved her hand and began to tidy up the fridge.
“Take these scallops, these shrimps, and some sea cucumbers. Your father and I won’t eat them either...”
At this rate, she was simply going to empty the fridge.

“Alright, alright, alright. I don’t lack anything. If Mengmeng and I want to eat these things, we just need to stretch out our hands.” As soon as Chen Yun finished speaking, Mother Chen’s eyes darkened again. Father Chen also suddenly coughed at the side.
Chen Yun quickly changed his words. “Mom, we still have your salted duck eggs at home. Please give me more of that. Mengmeng and I want to eat them.”

“Ah? Alright, alright, alright. I’ll go get it now.” Looking at Mother Chen’s figure, Father Chen walked over. “Go down and bring more things with you. It’s one thing not to lack them, but it’s another to bring them back. Otherwise, your mother will always be worried.”

“I understand.” Chen Yun also smiled. Then, he took out three packets of chlorella. “Dad, put this in pure water and drink the blue water produced. It’s very good for the body. You’ll know after drinking it once, but don’t eat the chlorella.”
Chen Yun was worried and even personally demonstrated it.
The next day, early in the morning, Chen Yun sat in the Bugatti Veyron and pulled Lin Yuhan along. He saw that Lin Yuhan was still holding cured meat in his hand.
“You...” Chen Yun looked at the cured meat in his hand and smiled bitterly.
All the mothers in the world were the same.
Chen Yun got out of the car.
The Bugatti Veyron didn’t have a trunk in any real sense. Its trunk was in the front, but there was very little space.
After opening the trunk.
“F*ck!”
“Where did you get so many salted duck eggs?” Lin Yuhan was stunned. He looked at the box of salted duck eggs that filled the small space. Not even a piece of meat could be stuffed in.

“Just place it at your feet. There’s nothing I can do about it.” Chen Yun smiled bitterly. “If not for the fact that my trunk is small, my mother would have packed all the salted duck eggs in the house for me.”
Then, the two of them set off.
Along the way, the roar of the car and the music in the car attracted the attention of many people on the highway. The number of heads turned was off the charts.
Each of them drove for half the journey. It was almost night before Chen Yun and Lin Yuhan arrived at Jiang City.
At this moment, everyone was already waiting at the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant.
“Director Chen is back.”
Ma Ke heard the sound waves from afar and saw the shadow of a car at a glance. He quickly went forward with Jiang Zhengyu and the others.
“Director Chen, you’re back.”
After Chen Yun got out of the car, he took out a few salted duck eggs from the trunk in the front and handed the keys to the waiter.
Chen Yun placed the salted duck eggs in Zhou Jingyi’s hand. “Get the kitchen to help me cook these two salted duck eggs. I’ll eat them later.”
“Okay.”
“Let’s go. Don’t stand there. There’s no need to be restrained between us.” Chen Yun introduced them to Lin Yuhan before bringing them up.
Lin Yuhan listened to their names and silently noted them down. Then, when he went to the toilet, he took a look.
He was so shocked that he almost dropped his phone.
The CEO of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Ma Ke!
The CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Zhengyu!
The Chairman of the Zheng Corporation, Zheng Yuan!
These few people were simply the leaders of Jiang City!
After calming down, he returned to the private room.
While chatting with them, Lin Yuhan tried his best to stabilize his emotions and suppress the trembling in his voice.
Before the dishes were served, Lin Yuhan stood up and raised his glass. “CEO Jiang, let me toast you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Efficient Battery Storage!
paragraphs: Brother!
Let me show you a big treasure!
Hearing this, Chen Yun was silent for a moment before looking at the thing in Chen Mengmeng’s hand.
After opening it, he saw a silver badge inside.
It was shaped like a dragon.
“Why did you think of buying something for me?” Chen Yun took it and pinned it on his clothes. “Yes, not bad. It’s quite good-looking. It must have cost a lot of money.”

“It didn’t cost much. It’s just a few thousand yuan. Xiao Xue and I saved up money to buy it during this period of time.” Chen Mengmeng then took out the card Chen Yun had previously given her. “Brother, this card is for you. The money we earn now is enough for our expenses. I didn’t touch the money on it.”
Chen Yun glanced at Chen Mengmeng. “Why? Have you grown up? Are you preparing to split from me?”
“Brother, no, I didn’t mean that.” Chen Mengmeng immediately panicked and didn’t know what to say. Han Xue was the same.
Chen Yun looked at the two little girls’ nervous expressions and smiled. “Take it. I don’t lack money. After your special training, I’ll arrange a few dramas for you. This way, you can grow faster.”

“It’s too late, Brother.” Chen Mengmeng held her head high. “I’ve already gotten the third female lead role in Spring and Autumn. Xiao Xue is also participating in another movie. She has a lot of scenes.”
These words made Chen Yun look at the two girls in a different light. Before he could make a move, the two girls had already started acting.
“Alright, act well. I won’t care about you. You can grow up wantonly.” After Chen Yun finished speaking, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue nodded.
“If you control us, we won’t be used to it.”
“Brother Yun, you’ve already helped us enough. The rest is up to us. Can we still stay under your wings?” Han Xue also said, “When I make a name for myself, I’ll definitely repay you, Brother Yun.”
Chen Yun nodded, but he did not take the card from Chen Mengmeng’s hand.
Back in the house.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission.]
After pressing the check-in button.
[Congratulations to the host for successfully checking in.]
[You have obtained a finished super silicon product and a high-efficiency storage battery.]
[It can store batteries efficiently and can store a huge amount of electricity.]
The two small cubes immediately landed in Chen Yun’s hands.

Chen Yun looked at the two little things and was a little surprised. These two little things were not even a third the size of his palm, but one of them was a finished super silicon product and had 50 times the efficiency of the current solar panels. The other was an efficient storage battery.
It was hard to imagine that such a small battery could be called capable of storing a huge amount of electricity.
This was good stuff.
With the finished super silicon product, the process of setting up the blueprint and formula for the finished product could be greatly shortened.
An hour later.
Chen Yun received a call from Zhou Jingyi saying that she had found a candidate.

The next day, Zhou Jingyi waited at the entrance of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion early in the morning. She watched as Chen Yun drove out in the Bugatti Veyron, got out of the car, and came to Chen Yun.

“She’s a senior of mine. She studied abroad since high school and graduated from Stanford University. She majored in photovoltaic industries and is also famous in school. She works in a laboratory in Jiang City now.”

As Zhou Jingyi spoke, she was also puzzled. After all, her senior could be said to be a figure who was like her idol. She was a genius. She originally thought that her senior would stay overseas, but she did not expect her to come back.
Perhaps it was also because she was close to her parents.

As for what she did, that was her choice. Zhou Jingyi could not influence her. However, her senior had also published many articles in international journals during her university years. She was indeed capable.

“Today is the opening day of their laboratory. I greeted her yesterday. We can also go to their photovoltaic laboratory to take a look.” After all, Zhou Jingyi knew how big a project Chen Yun had handed her, so she was very cautious. She was afraid that there would be any flaws, so she did not dare to make the decision. Therefore, they would go and take a look first.
Although her senior was famous, she still had to take a look.
The two of them arrived at the Guang City Photovoltaic Laboratory.
After parking the car, the two of them walked in.
At this moment, many people had already gathered in the photovoltaic laboratory, including some researchers in the photovoltaic industry and company executives from other provinces and cities.
Zhou Jingyi led Chen Yun forward and suddenly waved at a girl in front of her.
“Senior!”
The latter also walked over quickly. However, as soon as she came over, her eyes could not help but be attracted to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun was really too handsome.
Moreover, he exuded a charm from the inside out, making people unable to look away.
“Senior, senior?”
After Zhou Jingyi called out twice, the latter came back to her senses and extended her hand to Chen Yun. “Hello, I’m Li Xinyi.”
“Hello, I’m Chen Yun.”

Then, Chen Yun observed the girl in front of him. The girl in front of him also had a pretty face and a baby face. However, she was slightly shorter and was about 1.6 meters tall. However, even though she was wearing a loose laboratory suit, it could not hide the majesty of her chest.
She simply had a baby face...
“Senior, we’re here today to take a look and build a good foundation for our future cooperation.” As Zhou Jingyi spoke, she smiled at Li Xinyi.
“Yes, yes. I’ll go greet the professor. I’ll bring you to meet the professor in our laboratory later.”
“Okay.”
In the distance, a group of people was pointing at the center of the laboratory.
“Professor, do you have time now? A few of my friends want to talk to you about future cooperation.”
Li Xinyi quickly walked over.

“Nonsense, can’t you see that I’m talking to Boss Wang?!” A middle-aged man who was surrounded by everyone was listening to someone with a serious expression. When he saw Li Xinyi, he immediately scolded her angrily.
Hmph!
Professor Lu looked in the direction Li Xinyi was pointing at and saw a man and a woman. They were both very young. He immediately felt disdain in his heart and snorted. “Tell them to wait!”

As he spoke, he did not even look in Chen Yun’s direction. Instead, he nodded at the middle-aged man in front of him with a fawning expression. “Boss Wang, our laboratory is currently undergoing a new generation of photovoltaic renewal. After the renewal, it’s possible to double the efficiency of power generation. Clean energy is a trend for future development. What do you think...”
Boss Wang was surrounded by everyone as he stood in the center. Many professors were talking to him.
Seeing Professor Lu’s cold attitude, Li Xinyi looked anxious.

At this moment, an older man beside her pulled Li Xinyi and said, “Xinyi, Professor Lu is discussing a collaboration with someone else. This Boss Wang is from Huangning City in Jiangbei. He’s a big boss and is very interested in our project.”
“But Brother Zhang, my friend...” Li Xinyi sighed when she saw this man.

Brother Zhang also patted her shoulder. “Haven’t you seen such things many times after being here for so long? It’s fine. When the agreement period is over, you can go out and do it alone. Your ability is much greater than Professor Lu’s. We can’t do it. We can only stay in this laboratory and live under someone else’s roof.”
“Bring your friends over first. When the professor is in a good mood or after entertaining Boss Wang, he can welcome them.”
Looking at Li Xinyi’s figure, Brother Zhang sighed. A good seedling had wasted three years here.
Three years ago, Li Xinyi’s mother fell ill and had to pay a huge medical fee. Li Xinyi had no choice but to give up her good job overseas and work for Professor Lu for three years.
It was all for the one-time fee of 700,000 yuan.
He knew that someone would give the current Li Xinyi one or two million yuan a year, let alone 500,000 yuan.
In the past three years, 80% of the reason why the laboratory could develop so well and Professor Lu could earn so much money was because of Li Xinyi.
However, Professor Lu’s exploitation of Li Xinyi was increasing day by day. Now, he made her busy in the laboratory every night until nine or ten o’clock.
Brother Zhang looked at Professor Lu, who was smiling obsequiously, and sighed.
Just as he had said, Li Xinyi was capable. Thus, she could go out and fly alone. However, they could not and could only accept exploitation here.
Meanwhile, Li Xinyi explained the situation to Chen Yun and Zhou Jingyi before bringing the two of them over.
Zhou Jingyi looked at the scene in front of her and frowned slightly.
After all, with Chen Yun’s identity, the other party actually made them wait at the side. This made her a little dissatisfied.

After such a long time, she was also a little dignified when dealing with the matters of Sacred Heaven and the First-Grade Restaurant. However, when she saw that Chen Yun did not say anything, she did not say anything either.

Many people also noticed Chen Yun and Zhou Jingyi. However, looking at their ages, everyone automatically ignored them. The people who were sought after here were the various professors and potbellied businessmen. When these two young people stood here, they naturally were not respected by everyone.

At this moment, Professor Lu looked at Boss Wang, who was beside him, and his face was about to bloom with a smile. “Boss Wang, it’s definitely not wrong for you to invest in us. Right now, we’re able to double our efficiency. Moreover, we’re still working hard. In the near future, we’ll definitely develop a battery pack with three times the efficiency.”
“Your cooperation with us will definitely not go wrong.”

When Professor Lu said this, everyone around him was shocked. They did not expect their laboratory’s technology to be so advanced. However, while everyone was shocked, someone suddenly sneered and interrupted them.
He turned around and saw a delicate-looking girl standing there. Beside her, Li Xinyi was panicking.
“I thought you had some skills.”
Zhou Jingyi refused to give up and added another sentence. Chen Yun, who was beside her, also had a disdainful smile on his face. Everyone looked at the two of them and were immediately shocked.
