Moreover, he exuded a charm from the inside out, making people unable to look away.
“Senior, senior?”
After Zhou Jingyi called out twice, the latter came back to her senses and extended her hand to Chen Yun.
“Hello, I’m Li Xinyi.”
“Hello, I’m Chen Yun.”
Then, Chen Yun observed the girl in front of him.
The girl in front of him also had a pretty face and a baby face.
However, she was slightly shorter and was about 1.6 meters tall.
However, even though she was wearing a loose laboratory suit, it could not hide the majesty of her chest.
She simply had a baby face...
“Senior, we’re here today to take a look and build a good foundation for our future cooperation.” As Zhou Jingyi spoke, she smiled at Li Xinyi.
“Yes, yes.
I’ll go greet the professor.
I’ll bring you to meet the professor in our laboratory later.”
“Okay.”
In the distance, a group of people was pointing at the center of the laboratory.
“Professor, do you have time now?
A few of my friends want to talk to you about future cooperation.”
Li Xinyi quickly walked over.
“Nonsense, can’t you see that I’m talking to Boss Wang?!” A middle-aged man who was surrounded by everyone was listening to someone with a serious expression.
When he saw Li Xinyi, he immediately scolded her angrily.
Hmph!
Professor Lu looked in the direction Li Xinyi was pointing at and saw a man and a woman.
They were both very young.
He immediately felt disdain in his heart and snorted.
“Tell them to wait!”
As he spoke, he did not even look in Chen Yun’s direction.
Instead, he nodded at the middle-aged man in front of him with a fawning expression.
“Boss Wang, our laboratory is currently undergoing a new generation of photovoltaic renewal.
After the renewal, it’s possible to double the efficiency of power generation.
Clean energy is a trend for future development.
What do you think...”
Boss Wang was surrounded by everyone as he stood in the center.
Many professors were talking to him.
Seeing Professor Lu’s cold attitude, Li Xinyi looked anxious.
At this moment, an older man beside her pulled Li Xinyi and said, “Xinyi, Professor Lu is discussing a collaboration with someone else.
This Boss Wang is from Huangning City in Jiangbei.
He’s a big boss and is very interested in our project.”
“But Brother Zhang, my friend...” Li Xinyi sighed when she saw this man.
Brother Zhang also patted her shoulder.
“Haven’t you seen such things many times after being here for so long?
It’s fine.
When the agreement period is over, you can go out and do it alone.
Your ability is much greater than Professor Lu’s.
We can’t do it.
We can only stay in this laboratory and live under someone else’s roof.”
“Bring your friends over first.
When the professor is in a good mood or after entertaining Boss Wang, he can welcome them.”
Looking at Li Xinyi’s figure, Brother Zhang sighed.
A good seedling had wasted three years here.
Three years ago, Li Xinyi’s mother fell ill and had to pay a huge medical fee.
Li Xinyi had no choice but to give up her good job overseas and work for Professor Lu for three years.
It was all for the one-time fee of 700,000 yuan.
He knew that someone would give the current Li Xinyi one or two million yuan a year, let alone 500,000 yuan.
In the past three years, 80% of the reason why the laboratory could develop so well and Professor Lu could earn so much money was because of Li Xinyi.
However, Professor Lu’s exploitation of Li Xinyi was increasing day by day.
Now, he made her busy in the laboratory every night until nine or ten o’clock.
Brother Zhang looked at Professor Lu, who was smiling obsequiously, and sighed.
Just as he had said, Li Xinyi was capable.
Thus, she could go out and fly alone.
However, they could not and could only accept exploitation here.
Meanwhile, Li Xinyi explained the situation to Chen Yun and Zhou Jingyi before bringing the two of them over.
Zhou Jingyi looked at the scene in front of her and frowned slightly.
After all, with Chen Yun’s identity, the other party actually made them wait at the side.
This made her a little dissatisfied.
After such a long time, she was also a little dignified when dealing with the matters of Sacred Heaven and the First-Grade Restaurant.
However, when she saw that Chen Yun did not say anything, she did not say anything either.
Many people also noticed Chen Yun and Zhou Jingyi.
However, looking at their ages, everyone automatically ignored them.
The people who were sought after here were the various professors and potbellied businessmen.
When these two young people stood here, they naturally were not respected by everyone.
At this moment, Professor Lu looked at Boss Wang, who was beside him, and his face was about to bloom with a smile.
“Boss Wang, it’s definitely not wrong for you to invest in us.
Right now, we’re able to double our efficiency.
Moreover, we’re still working hard.
In the near future, we’ll definitely develop a battery pack with three times the efficiency.”
“Your cooperation with us will definitely not go wrong.”
When Professor Lu said this, everyone around him was shocked.
They did not expect their laboratory’s technology to be so advanced.
However, while everyone was shocked, someone suddenly sneered and interrupted them.
He turned around and saw a delicate-looking girl standing there.
Beside her, Li Xinyi was panicking.
“I thought you had some skills.”
Zhou Jingyi refused to give up and added another sentence.
Chen Yun, who was beside her, also had a disdainful smile on his face.
Everyone looked at the two of them and were immediately shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Fifty Times Effectiveness!
paragraphs: “I thought you had some skills.”

These words made everyone look at Zhou Jingyi. In the past, Zhou Jingyi would have been so frightened by such a scene that she did not even dare to raise her head. But now, it was completely different. When everyone looked at her, she raised her head and looked at them coldly. Her aura immediately spread out, and she was not afraid at all.
“How dare you ignore us with a battery pack that has just two to three times the effectiveness?”
She might be able to tolerate it if Professor Lu ignored her, but if he ignored Chen Yun, she would not be able to tolerate it anymore. She immediately sneered, shocking everyone.
Everyone’s eyes widened. They could not believe what Zhou Jingyi had said. This little girl was actually mocking the results of Professor Lu’s laboratory!
“Who are you? How dare you cause trouble here!” Everyone present looked at Chen Yun and the others and jumped out to criticize them.

At the side, Brother Zhang also looked at Chen Yun and Zhou Jingyi, who were beside Li Xinyi. He frowned slightly, and his eyes were filled with disdain. He thought to himself, “These are Xinyi’s two friends. Professor Lu asked you to wait at the side previously. Just follow quietly. When Professor Lu is in a good mood, he will naturally meet you.”
“Why do you guys really think of yourselves as big shots? Now that you’ve jumped out to cause trouble, do you know what kind of occasion this is?”
“The people present are all famous professors, the disciples of academicians, leaders, and bosses from neighboring provinces. How dare a 20-year-old girl like you speak so arrogantly?”
Beside her, a professor looked at Zhou Jingyi and said, “Little girl, what did you mean just now?”

Before Zhou Jingyi could speak, Chen Yun said, “Don’t you understand? She was just saying that with your battery pack that has two to three times effectiveness, you dared to ignore us when we came to discuss a collaboration with you. How ignorant.”
How ignorant!
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was in an uproar!

Earlier, it was fine if they spoke like this. Everyone would think that they were young and ignorant. However, the person talking to them now was a professor from the neighboring province. Many experts were also here, and Professor Lu was in front of them. How dare they speak like this? Wasn’t this slapping Professor Lu’s face in public?
As expected, the professor’s expression darkened. There were already people around who sneered and reprimanded, “Why are children interrupting when adults are talking?”
Chen Yun stood there and looked at the people in front of him. Although everyone was pointing at him, his expression was as usual and he was unmoved.
Just as the professor who previously spoke was about to end this farce, Professor Lu slowly restrained the coldness and disdain in his eyes and spoke calmly.
“It’s fine. If this young friend is from our industry, you can speak freely.”

“After all, there’s no order in learning. The accomplished are the masters. Although I’ve studied the photovoltaic industry for more than 40 years, I still feel that I know little and have learned very little.”
When Professor Lu said this, the surrounding people could not help but nod in approval.

The Chinese valued humility the most. Even if one was very capable, one could only say 50% of what they knew. Otherwise, others would think that they did not understand the principles of the world and were too revealing. For an old professor like Professor Lu to be so humble, everyone respected him even more.

The professor beside him smiled and said, “Professor Lu, you’re too humble. With your knowledge, you’re a big shot in the entire Jiangbei and even China’s photovoltaic industry. This little guy is just pretending to brag. There’s no need to pay attention to him.”
Professor Lu also chuckled and did not say anything. He stopped the professor’s flattery.

Meanwhile, Brother Zhang looked at this scene and felt indignant for Li Xinyi. Almost all of the achievements in their laboratory were led by Li Xinyi alone. Professor Lu was only good at business. In terms of scientific research, any one of them was better than him.
However, as he thought about it, he still gave Li Xinyi a look. “Xinyi, hurry up and leave with your friends. Do you still want to be a joke to the professors and experts?”
Li Xinyi was extremely anxious.
He did not know what to do now.

At this moment, Professor Lu glanced at Brother Zhang and knew that he was trying to smooth things over. He immediately smiled and said, “There’s no need to do this. Since this little kid came to my laboratory to take a look today, he should be a talent in the photovoltaic industry. Although I’ve been in this industry for so long, I know that my knowledge is far from enough. Little friend, you must have your own reasons for looking down on me.”
“Since you look down on my things, you’ll definitely be able to come up with something better. Don’t you think so?”
“That’s right.”
“Professor Lu is really humble.”
“This is a true master. He’s as broad-minded as the sea. Young people nowadays are simply too inferior.”
The surrounding bosses nodded and praised them. Even many experts looked at Chen Yun and the others impatiently.

Previously, they had been sighing at the achievements of Professor Lu’s laboratory. Some old professors who had worked with Professor Lu also felt inferior. Previously, when they worked together, Professor Lu’s knowledge was not as good as theirs. But now, he had actually developed such a good product. He had really lived and learned until he was old. Meanwhile, they were stuck in their ways.
Looking at the expressions of the others, Professor Lu raised his head and puffed out his chest, as if he had guided them to make these things.
This action made everyone admire him even more.
Many experts looked at Chen Yun impatiently.
“Hmph, he’s not even qualified to be a graduate student under me at this age. What results can he produce?” A professor from Jiang City University of Science and Technology said disdainfully.
“A graduate student? I don’t think he can even go to university.” Another expert from the Academy of Science shook his head.
“Teacher, do you think he’s really capable or is he deliberately mystifying things?” A delicate-looking woman with a ponytail turned her head and asked.

Before the white-haired old professor standing in front of her could answer, a 30-year-old man wearing black-framed glasses with thick lenses beside her smiled disdainfully and said, “How can he have true ability?”

“We’ve attended four years of university, two years of master’s courses, and three years of doctorate courses. We’ve also studied under our teacher for nearly ten years. We don’t know much about the photovoltaic industry. Even with our teachers and academicians, we find it difficult to solve the key problem of improving efficiency. What’s more, he’s a little boy who’s not even 20 years old. Could he be a prodigy?”
“Senior Brother is right.” The woman stuck out her tongue and shrank her little head.
The white-haired old professor standing in front of the two of them nodded.
This professor’s name was Mu Tian, and he was an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. He was the most respected person among everyone present. He was also the leader of the experts.
After arriving, even he was shocked by the results of Professor Lu’s laboratory.
The man behind him was called Hong Zhengtao. He had graduated from the Academy of Science and was his assistant.

Seeing that he was diligent and hardworking, Elder Mu took him in as a disciple. Hong Zhengtao did not disappoint him. Before the age of 30, he was evaluated as a deputy researcher, which was equivalent to an associate professor. Recently, he was trying to become a full-fledged researcher and was an elite among the younger generation of the Academy of Science.

Meanwhile, the girl’s name was Mu Qingqing, and she was his granddaughter. She had just graduated from Huaxia University of Science and Technology. Elder Mu had taken her by his side and would guide her from time to time. With the personal guidance of an academician grandfather, countless of Mu Qingqing’s classmates were envious.
Elder Mu looked at Professor Lu’s laboratory and sighed. “It seems like I’m not knowledgeable enough.”
“Teacher, don’t worry. Our laboratory is about to develop solar panels with twice the effectiveness.”
“This is different. The technology here has already matured, and we’re still figuring it out. Professor Lu is no longer the same as before. He’s a really capable person.”
After hearing Elder Mu’s words, Hong Zhengtao and Mu Qingqing looked at Professor Lu with respect. They naturally treated the little boy who challenged Professor Lu’s authority with disdain.
At this moment, Master Huang looked at Chen Yun in front of him and sneered. “Since you don’t like my achievements, I think you can produce better products than me, right?”
Facing everyone’s surprised, disdainful, or sneering expressions, Chen Yun said calmly, “That’s right. I have a super silicon with 50 times the effectiveness.”
Fifty times the effectiveness!
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was in an uproar. Everyone looked at Chen Yun in disbelief, as if they had heard wrongly.
Fifty times the effectiveness!
How was this possible?!
“Hahahaha...”
Many people laughed out loud, as if they had heard a huge joke.
They were all leaders of the photovoltaic industry, so they naturally knew how terrifying 50 times the effectiveness was!
It could simply overturn the entire photovoltaic industry!
It could even be said that it would change the entire era!

Even those foreign companies in the photovoltaic industry did not dare to say such a thing. However, this little guy in front of him actually dared to say that he had a super silicon with 50 times the effectiveness!
If this wasn’t a joke, what was?!
“That’s enough!” Professor Lu looked at Brother Zhang and said, “What are you waiting for? Hurry up and chase him out!”
Haha!

At this moment, Chen Yun shook his head unexpectedly. “When I came, I was thinking that if you have enough strength, I might as well give you an astronomical salary to participate in the project. It seems that your attitude and strength are not satisfactory.”
With that, he flipped his wrist and a black square appeared.
“Senior, this is a sample of the super silicon.”

As soon as Zhou Jingyi said this, Li Xinyi looked at her expression. She was about to tell them to stop fooling around, but she did not say it. She immediately brought the super silicon in Chen Yun’s hand over for testing.
Everyone looked at Chen Yun and snorted.
“He can actually take out a sample. That’s interesting.” Elder Mu was very cold.

Hong Zhengtao, who was beside him, said disdainfully, “Teacher, I think he’s just holding onto his act. A super silicon with 50 times the effectiveness? I’ve never heard of it. If such a thing existed, it would have long caused a sensation in this era.”
His words fell into everyone’s ears, making them nod continuously.
“Exactly.”
“If there was such a good thing, it wouldn’t have come from a kid.”
“I want to see how long he can hold on for. Just wait. I’ll definitely expose him online.”
Just as everyone was sneering at Chen Yun.
A sharp and ear-piercing sound suddenly sounded!
Everyone turned around and saw that the instrument used to measure effectiveness had already exceeded the threshold of five and was soaring crazily.
Ten!
Twenty!
Everyone looked at the numbers on it and their eyes widened in shock!
In the end, the numbers froze!
Fifty!
Fifty! It was originally a small number.
However, in terms of effectiveness!
Its terror was self-evident!
Everyone fell into a daze on the spot!

paragraphs: Fifty!
It was really 50 times more effective!

“This... this?” Everyone seemed to have been struck by lightning and stood rooted to the ground. Professor Lu pointed at Chen Yun with a trembling finger. He wanted to say something, but he could not.
“Fifty times! It’s really 50 times!” Elder Mu looked at the testing machine. He knew that the results of this machine would not be wrong!
This thing was really super silicon!
For a moment, everyone looked at that thing as if they had seen a peerless treasure!
It was really a peerless treasure!
Just think about it. In the entire China, how much electricity could the photovoltaic industry create in a year? Then, multiply the entire number by 50!
Look, what kind of number was this? With this, they should be able to achieve zero coal consumption!
Moreover, solar cars would be greatly popularized, and the use of fossil fuels would be minimized!
The entire world would enter a new era!
Furthermore, what would develop and start this new era was the super silicon in front of them!
Under everyone’s gazes, Chen Yun held the super silicon in his hand.

Professor Lu was the first to react. He looked at Chen Yun and said, “I didn’t expect Young Sir to have such a good thing at such a young age. Didn’t you come to discuss a collaboration with me today? Shall we have a good talk now?”

“I’ve been negligent before, but look at my achievements. I’ve developed a battery panel with twice the effectiveness. Putting aside the rest of the world, I can be considered to have a place in the entire China...”
Before he could finish speaking, Brother Zhang, who was beside him, suddenly chuckled.
“What are you laughing at!” When Professor Lu saw him smile, his heart tightened and he shouted.

“Professor Lu, don’t flatter yourself. Since when did you develop solar panels with twice the effectiveness? Eighty percent of the credit goes to Li Xinyi for being able to develop solar panels with twice the effectiveness. Twenty percent of the credit goes to us. You’re just an expert in business and cooperation. You don’t have any academic achievements. Now, you actually want to take credit for our research and development.”
Brother Zhang’s words enlightened everyone.
When Elder Mu heard the name Li Xinyi, he fell into deep thought. “Li Xinyi. I seem to have heard this name somewhere before, but I don’t remember. Where have I heard it?”
“Teacher, could she be Li Xinyi who published a few top-notch papers in the International Science and Technology Era publication a few years ago?”
With that said, everyone came to a realization.
So that was the case. It was no wonder Professor Lu could develop such a thing. It turned out that it was created by Li Xinyi. At that moment, many people looked at Professor Lu with disdain.
Then, Brother Zhang told everyone about how Professor Lu had been crazily exploiting Li Xinyi and his subordinates for so long. Everyone immediately sneered.
“Professor Lu, so this is how you use people. You really make the best use of people!” An old professor jumped out and criticized Professor Lu.
“This, this...”
Professor Lu was speechless. He knew that his reputation in the industry had been ruined.

Chen Yun looked at Li Xinyi beside him. “Li Xinyi, I’ll give you a salary of 10 million yuan a year. I’ll get you to form your own team and help me develop solar panels with 50 times the efficiency of current solar panels.”
Ten million yuan a year!
Everyone looked at Chen Yun and was shocked when they heard his words.
With that, Chen Yun walked out. Many bosses saw Chen Yun walk out and quickly followed him out.
“Sir, why don’t we talk about cooperation?”
“How much do you need? Name a price. I want to buy what you have.”
Not only did the bosses chase after them, but even the scholars chased after them, but they were stopped by Zhou Jingyi.
Zhou Jingyi took out a few gold business cards from her pocket and smiled. “I’m sorry, but we have enough funds to carry out this project.”
They had enough funds to carry out this project!
This stunned everyone. How confident were they?
However, in the next moment, they almost widened their eyes when they saw the words on the business card!
Damn it!
The Manager of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s Operations Department!
Zhou Jingyi!
Were they from Sacred Heaven Entertainment?!

How could they not know about Sacred Heaven Entertainment? They had a market value of more than 20 billion yuan. They had also annexed Flying Fish Live-Stream and Huaying Entertainment one after another!
For a moment, everyone was extremely dispirited.
Thinking back to their previous disdain, it was simply ridiculous. Not to mention the identity of the young man, just this girl’s name was not worthy of any of them!
Li Xinyi looked at the business card in a daze. Then, she could not help but chase after him.
A few minutes later, Chen Yun and Li Xinyi finished talking and drove away.
On a main road in Jiang City.
A Bentley Continental drove slowly.

“Brother, Jiang City is said to be one of the best in Jiangbei, but it’s not much compared to Jiangnan. Look, we’ve walked so far, but we haven’t seen a supercar or anything on the road. We haven’t even seen a car worth more than a million yuan.” A girl sat in the back seat of the Bentley and wrapped her arms around the neck of the young man beside her.

The girl’s facial features were exquisite and she even had baby fat. She looked younger than her actual age. She was clearly 20 years old, but she looked like she was 18 years old. She was dressed in branded clothes, and her slender legs were crossed. Her arms were snow-white. She looked like a gentle girl, but at this moment, she gave off a roguish feeling.
The young man beside her looked helpless. “Can you be a little more mature? Who am I? I’m your brother! What are you doing, sister? Do you treat me as your brother?”
“Aiya, what’s there to be afraid of? Aren’t we going out this time? We’re biological siblings. Why are you so particular?”
The girl chuckled and did not take it to heart at all. This made the young man look even more helpless. He cursed in his heart.
The girl looked out of the window. “Hmph, look, look. There’s not a single luxury car. Where are the rich people in Jiang City? They’re all...”
As soon as she finished speaking, a black car sped past the car window.
Lu Ying was speechless.
Who was she?
Where was she?
What had just passed by?
Not only was she shocked, even the young man beside her was stunned. “What was that just now? A supercar? Let me think. That look just now... Is it a Bugatti Veyron?”
As soon as he said this, the professional driver in front also said, “Young Master, that’s right. It’s a Bugatti Veyron. The price is about 45 million.”
Lu Ying was speechless. A price of 45 million...
The face slap came too quickly like a tornado.

The next moment, she leaned against the car window and looked behind her. However, the black Bugatti Veyron had long disappeared. She immediately hugged Lu Jun’s arm. “Brother, it’s a Bugatti Veyron! A Bugatti Veyron!”
“What are you trying to say?!”
Lu Ying blinked. “Brother, I want to buy one too. Why don’t you consider buying one for me?”
“Hehe.” Lu Jun chuckled. “Come, come, come. See how much your brother is worth. Just sell me and exchange the money for a car. How about that?”

“Look, you just can’t joke around. Why would I sell you? Who are you? You’re my biological brother!” Lu Ying glanced at him and said in a low voice, “Besides, even if I sell you, you won’t be worth much.”
Lu Jun was speechless.

“Alright, stop talking nonsense. This time, we’re going to complete the mission Dad gave us. I heard that De Ren Tang in Jiang City has a hundred-year-old medicine. Let’s quickly buy it and return to Jiangnan.”
“Understood!” Lu Ying immediately saluted like an obedient soldier, making Lu Jun look helpless. His sister was really a clown. He really shouldn’t have brought her out.
They arrived near De Ren Tang.
“Young Master, there’s no parking space here. Let’s park at the park over there.”
“Okay.” Lu Jun and Lu Ying got out of the car and went straight to Virtuous Heart Hall.

When they passed by the entrance of the park, a young beggar with fluffy hair and a sallow face looked at Lu Ying’s branded clothes. His eyes immediately lit up and he immediately shouted at her, “Good Samaritan! Please be kind. I haven’t eaten for two days. Please give me something to eat.”
When Lu Ying saw the little beggar, her expression changed. She wiped her eyes with her hand. “This is too tragic. It’s simply too tragic. Brother, let’s help him.”
“If I become so down and out one day, I’ll definitely hope that someone will help me.”
“Ah! I’m so miserable. I’m so hungry!” The little beggar was overjoyed when he heard Lu Ying’s words. He thought to himself that these rich people were so f*cking gullible.
He immediately shouted, “Is there anyone with good intentions who can help me?”
Lu Ying’s eyes darted around and she saw a grocery store. They bought ten steamed buns that had just been steamed. She returned and handed the steamed buns to the little beggar.
As he wiped the corners of his eyes, he said with a sympathetic expression, “You must be starving. These steamed buns have just been made. Eat them while they’re hot.”
The little beggar was confused.
What did this person mean? Was there something wrong with her? He didn’t want steamed buns. He wanted money!!!
Money!!!

At that moment, he was also a little confused. However, when he saw Lu Ying’s sympathetic expression, he felt a little helpless. At this time, there were many people at the entrance of the park. With so many people watching, if he didn’t eat these steamed buns, he would probably be labeled a liar and sent to the police station today.
Thus, the little beggar could only take the bag of steamed buns from Lu Ying with tears in his eyes. As he thanked the kind-hearted person, he started eating.

Lu Ying did not leave. She squatted beside him and watched him eat. As she watched, she wiped her tears. “It’s too tragic. I just can’t bear to see others poorer than me. When I see poor people, I feel upset. I can’t stop crying. It’s too difficult for me.”
The little beggar was speechless. Damn it!
She couldn’t bear to see others poorer than her, so why didn’t she give him money? What did she mean by giving him steamed buns?
“Eat slowly. Don’t be anxious. I’ll buy more for you later. It’s fine. I don’t lack money for a few steamed buns.”
F*ck!
There was something wrong with her!
The little beggar looked at Lu Ying resentfully. He picked up the bowl and was about to run when Lu Ying grabbed him and kicked him at the bend of his leg, sending him to the ground.

“Look, you really haven’t eaten for a few days. You don’t even have any strength. You’re too miserable. Are you going to bring these steamed buns back to your family? It’s fine. Just eat them. After eating these, I’ll buy you more. I’ll buy you as much as you want.”
“Come, come, come. Hurry up and eat.” Lu Ying’s fair little hand picked up a steamed bun and stuffed it into the little beggar’s mouth.
The little beggar was about to cry. He stood up again and prepared to run, but Lu Ying pressed him down.
This happened a few times in a row.
The little beggar immediately cried and wailed.
Lu Jun was speechless. She had been learning mixed martial arts for seven years, but was she using it in such a place??
In the end, the little beggar could only swallow his anger. After eating all the steamed buns, he cried and left the park.
Lu Ying looked at the little beggar’s back and turned to look at Lu Jun. “Brother, I’m really a kind person. Look at him. He’s so touched that he’s crying.”
Lu Jun was speechless.
Sorry, that was because he cried from being beaten by her.
He even suspected that this little beggar would not dare to come out and swindle others in the future. He was probably already traumatized.

At this moment, Lu Ying looked like she had won. She placed her hands on her hips and snorted. She thought to herself, “Do you really think I’m a young lady who hasn’t seen the world? I have something on today. Why don’t I let you eat all the food in the restaurant?”
Beside her, Lu Jun looked at his sister and felt a chill run down his spine. It seemed like no one could take in this little vixen.
He thought, “Heavens, quickly find someone to take her in. Don’t let her cause trouble for others again!”

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Thousand-Year Old Ginseng Black Chicken Soup!
paragraphs: “Alright, alright. Hurry up and retract your divine power.” Lu Jun grabbed Lu Ying and brought her to Den Ren Tang in the medicinal herb market.
There were still not many people in Den Ren Tang.
The two of them entered and immediately saw the man in a long robe standing by the counter. From his appearance, he was the shopkeeper here.
“Excuse me, are you the shopkeeper here?” Lu Jun asked politely.

“Yes.” The shopkeeper glanced at the two of them and his eyes lit up. They were simply a handsome man and a beautiful woman, especially the girl. She was dressed gorgeously and was incomparably exquisite. It was as if her facial features had reached the limits of perfection. If she was any fatter or thinner, there would be flaws.
He found it strange. Were all these children willing to come to his Chinese medicine shop now?
It was the same for the previous few people. A handsome man and a beautiful woman came over to wrap up all his century-old medicine.
“Shopkeeper, we’re here to buy a hundred-year-old medicine. Do you have it?”
These words instantly stunned the shopkeeper.
F*ck!
No way. Were they also here to buy a hundred-year-old medicine?
“Well...” The shopkeeper smiled embarrassedly. “We don’t have any here.”
“Stop it, shopkeeper.” Lu Jun chuckled. “We’ve all heard that you have a hundred-year-old medicine here. Why? Do you want to keep it as your trump card, or are you afraid that we can’t afford it?”
“Just name your price. Don’t be afraid. We can still afford it.” Lu Jun was filled with pride for a moment.
“It’s not like that.” The shopkeeper smiled awkwardly. “You’re a step too late. The hundred-year-old medicine here has already been taken away.”
“Taken away?”
Lu Jun was instantly shocked and felt bitter in his heart. Who was this? They actually bought all the century-old medicine from De Ren Tang.
What were they trying to do?

Beside the shopkeeper, Zhang Ming had also returned from Yanwei and happened to be visiting. When he heard that the two of them wanted to buy a hundred-year-old medicine, he opened his mouth and said, “Little friends, he’s not lying. The hundred-year-old medicine was taken away by the Little Divine Doctor.”

Ever since Zhang Ming saw Chen Yun in Yanwei, he had taken a few sets of medicine prescribed by Chen Yun. The illness in his hand immediately healed. He already admired Chen Yun to the extreme, so he privately called him Little Divine Doctor Chen Yun.
“The Little Divine Doctor? Why is there such a title?” Lu Jun was disdainful.
The shopkeeper looked at Zhang Ming. “Zhang Ming, it seems like some people don’t believe you.”
Zhang Ming?!
Hearing the shopkeeper’s words, Lu Jun immediately turned to look at Zhang Ming. “Are you Divine Doctor Zhang Ming from the Jiangbei Chinese Medical Hospital?”
“I can’t be called the Divine Doctor. I just have an undeserved reputation.”

As Zhang Ming spoke, Lu Jun was shocked in his heart. Although he was in Jiangnan and the Lu family was also a big family, no matter how rich he was, he could not withstand illnesses and disasters, so he knew some doctors.
Therefore, he had also heard of Zhang Ming’s reputation.

Then, Lu Jun revealed his identity. Zhang Ming instantly stood up. Although he had the title of the Divine Doctor, he knew how powerful the Lu family was in Jiangnan. He immediately became respectful.
After a simple conversation.
“Elder Zhang, did a young man really take away these herbs?”

“That’s right. Not only does the Little Divine Doctor have those hundred-year-old medicines, but he also has a thousand-year-old medicine.” When Zhang Ming mentioned Chen Yun’s thousand-year-old medicine, his voice began to tremble. “That thousand-year-old medicine is simply longer than an arm.”
A thousand-year-old medicine!
Moreover, it was confirmed by Divine Doctor Zhang that it was definitely not fake!
His grandfather happened to need this thing as a medicine catalyst.
“Divine Doctor Zhang, can you bring me to see that Little Divine Doctor? I want to talk to him. No matter how much it costs, I’ll accept it. How about that?”
“This...” Zhang Ming pondered for a moment. “I’ll call the Little Divine Doctor first.”
“Alright, then I’ll have to trouble Elder Zhang.”

After a while, Zhang Ming returned. “The Little Divine Doctor is currently in the First-Grade Restaurant. However, I didn’t mention the thousand-year-old medicine. It’s better to discuss such things in person.”
“That’s right.” Lu Jun nodded.
Beside him, Lu Ying tugged at her brother’s sleeve. “Is there really a thousand-year-old medicine? It’s fake, right?”
“Shh!” Lu Jun glanced at her. “Don’t talk nonsense.”
“If that’s true, how much would it cost?”
“Can we get it for 500 million?” Lu Jun did a rough calculation, but it was not accurate. After all, this thing was simply a rare treasure.
When Lu Ying heard this, she was interested. “Brother, how about this? I’ll be in charge of bargaining later. How about you buy me a car?”
“Alright, but I can’t give it all to you. Let’s split it evenly.”
Lu Ying was speechless.
Alright! Deal!
Then, everyone set off for the First-Grade Restaurant.
Half an hour later, in the First-Grade Restaurant.
Chen Yun and the others had already sat down and were waiting to eat. Li Xinyi was also invited over by Chen Yun. In the entire private room, other than Chen Yun, there was a circle of beauties.
Chen Mengmeng, Han Xue, Zhou Jingyi, and Li Xinyi were present.
Every one of them was above 90 points in terms of looks.
“Jingyi, tell Elder Xu to cook personally. Don’t waste those good things.”
“Alright.” Zhou Jingyi quickly stood up and walked towards the kitchen.
When she went downstairs, she passed by three figures. One was an old man, and the other was a man and a woman. The young man and woman were dressed gorgeously and had extraordinary auras.
Zhou Jingyi was puzzled. Who were these two people?
These two shouldn’t be among the high-ranking officials and nobles in Jiang City.
It seemed like they were from another province.
At this moment, Zhou Jingyi was looking at them, and they were also looking at Zhou Jingyi.
“She’s so beautiful.” The two of them sighed in unison.
“Wake up. Don’t look anymore. She’s gone.” Lu Ying pulled her brother beside her and said loudly.
“Do I look like I haven’t seen the world? Do I look like I’ll lost my soul when I see a beauty?” Lu Jun flicked her head.
Before arriving at the private room, Zhang Ming knocked on the door. “Is the Little Divine Doctor here? I’m Zhang Ming.”
“Come in.”
Then, Zhang Ming brought the two of them in.
As soon as she entered, Lu Ying felt as if she had entered a fairyland.
If it wasn’t an immortal realm, why would the people in the private room be like immortals and fairies?
In particular, she simply could not take her eyes off the young man on the main seat.
He was too handsome!
“You’re here.” Chen Yun looked at them.
“Little Divine Doctor.”
“Brother Little Divine Doctor.” Lu Ying’s words unconsciously made Lu Jun look sideways. Damn, she recognized him quite quickly.
These words made hostility suddenly rise in Chen Mengmeng’s eyes.
She met someone who stole her brother!
Chen Yun was also stunned. “What’s the matter?”
“Hello, I’m Lu Jun from the Lu family in Jiangnan.” Both parties introduced themselves. Then, Lu Jun said, “It’s like this...”
Then, Lu Jun briefly explained what had happened in De Ren Tang today.

“Therefore, I heard that you have a thousand-year-old ginseng in your hands, so we came over to ask you for the price. We’re interested in buying it. I hope you’ll give it up.” Lu Jun’s tone was respectful. Originally, he had not planned to speak like this before coming.
However, it was different when he saw Chen Yun.
The aura on Chen Yun’s body was simply terrifying. He could not help but be disrespectful.

What?
Five hundred million!
When Zhang Ming heard this, his eyes widened. He simply could not believe what he had heard!
He was actually so generous!
Such sincerity!

Before she could finish speaking, Chen Mengmeng coughed at the side. Then, she pulled Chen Yun over. “I’m sorry, my brother is not used to being so close to other girls.”

F*ck!
Six hundred million!
This brother was very rich!
Lu Ying immediately pouted.

“Boss, the thousand-year-old ginseng black chicken soup is here. Sorry to keep you waiting.”
The thousand-year-old ginseng black chicken soup!
These words made everyone present fall silent.
Lu Jun looked at the porcelain jar. It was as if all the strength in his body had been sucked out.
Zhang Ming’s eyes almost popped out.
Lu Ying’s eyes were dull, and her heart felt like it was being hit by a heavy mace.
Chen Mengmeng and the others were also petrified.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Leave That Jar Behind, It’s from the Ming Dynasty After All
paragraphs: Zhang Ming looked at the ginseng slices in the porcelain jar that were palm-sized. He was stunned.
F*ck!
Six hundred million!
Just like that, it was stewed into soup!
It was a thousand-year-old medicine!
His heart ached!
Meanwhile, Lu Ying was in a daze as tears streamed down her face.
This was too f*cking rich!
She could think of a hundred ways to use such a precious thing.
However, Chen Yun had used the 101st method, which was to eat it.
“Hey, why are you crying?”
Chen Yun looked at Lu Ying, who was beside him. Seeing that her tears could not be stopped, he was stunned.
Wasn’t he just cooking a thousand-year-old ginseng? She didn’t have to cry.
At that moment, Chen Yun waved his hand. “Alright, since you’re guests, let’s eat together.”
“Jingyi, go and ask them to bring a few chairs over.”
When Zhang Ming heard this, he became excited. What was this? This was thousand-year-old ginseng black chicken soup!

In the legends, one of the Eight Immortals, Zhang Guolao, ate a thousand-year-old knotweed root in front of the temple and directly brought the donkey to the heavens. Thus, Zhang Ming couldn’t help but fantasize about whether he would be able to ride the wind after eating this thousand-year-old ginseng.
However, this thought only lingered in his mind for a while. After all, he was studying Chinese medicine, not metaphysics.
After sitting down, Zhou Jingyi scooped a full bowl of soup for Chen Yun and handed it to him. Then, she distributed the soup clockwise.
When it was distributed to Zhang Ming and the others, they quickly took it, their eyes filled with gratitude.
“Come, come, come. Don’t let it get cold. Try it.”
Chen Yun picked up the bowl and took a sip. A warm current immediately filled his entire body.
Not bad!
The taste was also superb!
Meanwhile, Lu Ying looked at the thousand-year-old black ginseng chicken soup. Her eyes turned green. This was a soup made from ginseng that was worth 600 million yuan.
Her bowl was probably worth a Bugatti Veyron...
At the thought of this, she immediately burst into tears.
She turned into a crying person, scaring Chen Yun.
“Brother Lu, what’s wrong with your sister?”

“It’s a bad habit of hers.” Lu Jun glanced at Lu Ying. “It’s fine, it’s fine. Everyone, don’t worry about her. She just can’t bear to see others being richer than her. As long as she feels that she’s not as rich as others, she’ll feel ashamed.”
Lu Ying was speechless.
He... analyzed it quite well.
Lu Jun leaned over and whispered, “Look at you. You’re crying like this. How are you going to drink the soup? Why don’t I help you drink it?”
“Don’t even think about it!” Lu Ying bit her lip and wiped her tears. She looked at Lu Jun warily, then picked up the bowl and drank it in one gulp.
Her eyes immediately widened. Lu Ying felt as if a ball of fire had exploded in her body!
This feeling was simply too good...
After a while, everyone leaned against the chair, their faces glowing.
After the meal, Lu Jun looked at the waste of the thousand-year-old ginseng in the jar and then looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen, can you part with these things? I’ll buy them for 100 million.”
Although it was used to stew soup, even the waste of these thousand-year-old ginseng was much better than a hundred-year-old ginseng.
Chen Yun took a look. Chen Yun had no intention of using those waste materials anymore. He immediately waved his hand. “There’s no need. You can just take them away.”

“This... Thank you.” Lu Jun hugged the porcelain jar. Chen Yun coughed. “Brother Lu, leave the jar behind. This thing is from the Ming Dynasty. It’s a treasure of the shop. Although it’s only worth tens of millions, it’s still a cultural relic.”
It was from the Ming Dynasty...
It was only worth tens of millions...
F*ck!
Lu Jun was dumbfounded, let alone Lu Ying. She felt like she could not stop crying.
There was no need to be so generous!
A thousand-year-old ginseng was made into soup!
It was even a Ming dynasty jar that contained the soup!
In the next moment, a warm current rushed out of Lu Ying’s nose.
“Brother!” Lu Ying called out. When Lu Jun saw that blood was coming out of her nose, he was shocked.
Zhang Ming also quickly raised her neck and splashed cold water on her forehead.
Chen Yun smiled at the side. It was soup brewed with a thousand-year-old ginseng! How could ordinary people withstand it?!
If Mengmeng and Xiao Xue had not drunk the Heavenly Spirit Water before, he would not have dared to let them drink it.

After everyone made a fuss for a while, Lu Jun brought the waste materials and prepared to leave. Before he left, he turned to look at Chen Yun. “Brother Chen, the Lu family is in Jiangnan. I don’t dare to say that we’re the first or second, but we have some strength. If you reach Jiangnan, you must contact me and let me do my best as a host.”
“Me too. Brother Chen Yun, you must come when you have the time,” said Lu Ying to Chen Yun.

“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded. This pair of siblings was quite interesting. As for the Lu family, he did not know much about the situation in Jiangnan, so he had naturally not heard of them. However, it seemed that the Lu family’s reputation in Jiangnan was not minor.
After going downstairs, the two of them got into the Bentley Continental and left. Then, a Maybach drove over.
After getting out of the car, Chen Yun looked at the person. It was none other than Ma Ke.
“You’re here. What’s the matter?”

“Director Chen, it’s not a big deal.” Ma Ke smiled. “Recently, there was a biotechnology conference in Shi’en City, which is in Jiangbei. Now, all the high-ranking officials and dignitaries in Jiangbei know about the Heavenly Spirit Water in your hands. They unanimously want to invite you to the conference and leave you some time to give a short explanation.”

“The high-ranking officials and nobles at Shi’en City all want to get to know you. They called me a few times today and asked you to go over. However, I considered your situation and didn’t give them an accurate reply.”

“A biotechnology conference?” Zhang Ming, who was beside him, was also stunned when he heard the conversation. Then, he said, “I’m also invited to participate. Little Divine Doctor, you must go and take a look. The scale of this biotechnology conference is much larger than before. I heard that not only have they invited a few top groups from China, but they have also invited some international ruthless characters.”

“Every time there’s a conference, there will also be domestic or international tycoons participating. After all, some capital investments are also biased in this aspect.” As Zhang Ming spoke, his face was filled with excitement. If he could travel with the Little Divine Doctor this time, how glorious would it be?
However, in the next moment, Zhang Ming’s eyes darted around. He seemed to have missed out on some important information.
He recalled Ma Ke’s words again and his eyes suddenly widened. He looked at Chen Yun. “Little Divine Doctor! Did you make the Heavenly Spirit Water?!”

“That’s right.” Chen Yun did not hide anything, but Zhang Ming was petrified on the spot. He had heard of the reputation of the Heavenly Spirit Water more than once or twice, but he had never had the chance to taste it. He did not expect that this Heavenly Spirit Water was actually made by the Little Divine Doctor!
No wonder, no wonder there was such a magical effect!
Meanwhile, Chen Yun ignored Zhang Ming’s surprise.
Biotechnology.

Chen Yun thought for a moment. For example, hybrid rice, cloned animals, various synthetic hormones, and genetic modifications should all be considered biotechnology. In that case, this should be a big event.
“Who will China send to participate this time?” Chen Yun was interested, which was a rare occurrence.
“According to the information I received, it seems like the hybrid rice team, the artemisinin team, and a few biological science laboratories in our country will come over to exchange information.”

Chen Yun nodded. Now, there would be an additional packet of chlorella in his hands every day. In that case, it was only a matter of time before they were mass-produced. It was better to create a wave of momentum first.
For now, only Jiang City and Yanwei had priority in being supplied with batches of Heavenly Spirit Water. Later on, the market would also open.
“Alright, make the arrangements, Ma Ke.”
“Yes, Director Chen.”

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Nonsense!
paragraphs: A day later, the biotechnology conference was held in Shi’en City, Jiangbei.

Before the conference this time, Chen Yun saw the name list. Many scholars and experts who came to the biotechnology conference this time were internationally renowned in the field and had won various awards. In comparison, although Chen Yun was not famous, the organizers gave him the longest presentation time.

He scanned the name list. Chen Yun’s memory had also improved a lot after his physical fitness had been strengthened. He had a photographic memory. After scanning the list just once, Chen Yun roughly remembered the origins of these scholars and experts, which company they were currently in, and what awards they had won.

Moreover, Chen Yun remembered a lot of their companies and corporations. He was a little surprised. He did not expect such foreign financial groups to come to such a small biotechnology conference. It was a little strange.

Chen Yun was wearing a gold-lined black suit. Beside him, Zhang Ming was wearing a Chinese tunic suit. Meanwhile, a few high-ranking officials looked at Chen Yun with admiration. After all, what kind of figure was this?
He was a figure at the top of Jiang City!
In the entire Jiang City, he was the most powerful! He held Sacred Heaven and was the President of the entire Jiang City Chamber of Commerce!
Moreover, they did not expect Director Chen to be so young!
He was too young!
At this age, others should still be studying in university, but Director Chen had already become a dragon among men!
Along the way, there were endless people who came after hearing Chen Yun’s name.
“Director Chen, hello. I’m from Shi’en Education...”
“Director Chen, I’m the Chairman of Zhang Jiang Corporation...”
After seeing Chen Yun one by one, no matter how arrogant the high-ranking officials and nobles were usually, they still nodded and bowed to Chen Yun like lackeys.
They couldn’t help but be like this.
Chen Yun was already standing at the peak of Jiang City. Now, he even had a divine medicine like the Heavenly Spirit Water.
These high-ranking officials and nobles had drunk it less than five times, but they knew very well how good this thing was!

Although the others had never drunk it before, they also heard the legendary rumors. They all wanted to seek favor with Chen Yun and at least get a bottle of the Heavenly Spirit Water to try in their lives.
Under the pursuit, Chen Yun and Zhang Ming sat in their seats.

Chen Yun and the others had arrived early. Moreover, there were fewer media outlets at such a technological event. After all, reporters and media were all passionate about the gossip concerning some celebrities and did not pay much attention to such a technological event.
However, this was also decided by the market. After all, even if it was reported, how many people would open the content and browse it carefully?
After entering the venue, Zhang Ming pointed out a few people to Chen Yun with an excited expression.

“Little Divine Doctor, look. The person sitting on the other side is called Logan. He’s a big shot in the field of cell science. I heard that he’s studying how to eliminate or reduce the free radicals in the human body to further extend one’s lifespan. He relied on this research direction to win many international awards and even appeared in Time magazine.”
“It’s a little similar to your Heavenly Spirit Water.” Zhang Ming introduced.

Chen Yun nodded, but there were no waves in his heart. His Heavenly Spirit Water was the product of antioxidant chlorella. It was an extremely mature technology. The other party was only researching it, and there would not be any breakthrough or progress for a while. Such a person could not attract Chen Yun’s attention.

Moreover, the Heavenly Spirit Water not only had the effect of eliminating free radicals, but it also stimulated the vitality of cells and eliminated negative effects such as damage. How could he reach it?
Then, some teams came.
There was no lack of foreigners among them. Zhang Ming looked at the foreigners and sighed from time to time.
“I didn’t expect the Park Corporation from Korea to send people too.”
“Oh? There are also teams from the West.”
Zhang Ming looked at a team. The people from this team were also dressed in suits and leather shoes, but their eyes were filled with arrogance and disdain.
Chen Yun did not pay attention to anything else. He was now surrounded by a group of high-ranking officials and dignitaries, communicating from time to time.
Amidst the pleasantries, the biotechnology conference began. This time, China was the organizer and was giving an opening speech on stage.
In the Western team, a middle-aged man looked at the professor who was speaking on stage and chuckled. He said to the person beside him, “Hehe, I didn’t expect this conference to be held in China.”
“That’s right. China’s biotechnology is far behind the world. They’re far behind us. The various discoveries they rely on are just after-effects that we’re unwilling to explore.”

They spoke in English. Behind them, a scholar in a white suit listened to their words and an expression of agreement flashed across his eyes. Then, he looked at his assistant beside him. “I heard that this time, there will be a Chinese person who will rely on anti-aging and cell activation products to give a speech on stage, right?”
“Yes, Professor. At the very least, that’s what the information list says.”

The man beside him handed Logan an information form. “Their products have a magical effect. After consuming them, they can make people feel like they’ve been reborn in a short period of time. This time, the report they did was also about this. Moreover, they claimed that their products can resist free radicals and achieve anti-aging.”

Hearing his assistant’s words, Logan’s lips curled into a playful smile. “This is interesting. I’ve been researching for so long. Only then did I achieve some results and created some products. However, this Chinese has actually created something that can effectively resist the United States. What a joke. It’s a complete mistake to hold this conference in China.”

“An ignorant and backward race can actually let such a ridiculous person go on stage to give a report to the entire world. Are they serious? It’s just some small tricks used for commercialization. It’s definitely impossible for them to really explore the secret of immortality. Later, I’ll expose his lie in public and let the entire world know that China’s biotechnology is a joke.”
Then, he looked at the price of the Heaven Spirit Water, his eyes filled with envy and jealousy.
It was priced at 300,000 yuan a bottle!
Moreover, even at this price!
There were also many people who flocked to it!
Without a thorough investigation, this Chinese would be able to make tens of millions of yuan in a day with this product. Moreover, he didn’t need to create demand for it!
Some bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water had even been raised to 500,000 yuan a bottle!
How could he not be envious of such a huge market?
If he could snatch this market, he would have whatever he wanted for the rest of his life!

Not only did he feel this way, but even the young men in suits and leather shoes of the Park Group from Korea had enthusiastic eyes. Such a huge wealth was something that even the Park Group could not help but feel moved about.
After the opening speech, the first thing was for the Chinese scholars and experts to give their own reports. It could be considered a special treatment for the hosts.

However, when the foreign experts and scholars heard the report made by the Chinese scholars, they were either disinterested or snorted. The disdain on their faces was obvious. It was like when the Westerners invaded North America. When they saw the indigenous people, they looked down on the backward people.

Then, it was Chen Yun’s turn. As soon as Chen Yun stood up, all the high-ranking officials and nobles in Shi’en City immediately applauded. The enthusiastic applause made everyone’s gazes land on Chen Yun.
On the stage, Chen Yun looked at the group of scholars below with a calm expression. He had seen many such occasions and could not feel anything in his heart. Then, he began to explain.
However, a moment later, a middle-aged man with blond hair and blue eyes stood up. At this moment, he looked at Chen Yun on the stage and sneered.
“Mr. Chen, I don’t understand what you’re talking about.”
Everyone looked over and saw a man in his fifties.
Someone from the academic world recognized him and instantly exclaimed, “Isn’t this Professor Logan from the field of cytology research?”
Those who didn’t understand quickly asked. Only then did they know that Professor Logan’s reputation in the world was that of an expert in the field of cytology!
At this moment, he slowly opened his mouth.

“As everyone knows, life sciences is molecular genetics. We study the patterns, nature, and relationships between living beings. Our main goal is to treat genetic diseases and genetic defects, develop medicine, improve the ecological environment, and so on.”
Logan spoke frankly.

“Mr. Chen, the life sciences you’re talking about are to improve the essence of cells, increase the strength of cells, and make up for the cell deficiencies. Simply speaking, it’s to study the rejuvenation of humans. This is completely unorthodox and doesn’t belong to the ranks of formal biology. In layman’s terms, we biologists are studying how to treat congenital heart disease and how to cultivate hybrid rice. Mr. Chen, on the other hand, is studying how to evolve into Superman, Mutants, and Spiderman!”
As soon as he said this, everyone burst into laughter.
Many investors and experts who didn’t know biology understood after Logan explained.
“Ah? I felt like I was listening to a heavenly book. So this professor is talking nonsense.”
“Life science and future biomedicine sounds so classy. In other words, isn’t it to study supernatural phenomena?”
“Mr. Chen is not such a person.”
Everyone discussed animatedly, but there were also high-ranking officials who defended Chen Yun weakly.
“Do you think that’s impossible?” Chen Yun stood on the stage with a calm expression.

“Of course it’s impossible.I heard that there was Qigong fever in China in the 1980s. Furthermore, superpowers have been studied overseas, and there were all kinds of mutated heroes in American movies, such as Green Lantern Man, Spiderman, Hulk, and so on. However, you have to know that science is serious. It’s not a comic or a movie. Science needs evidence,” said Logan righteously. “The evolution of a creature has its own rules. External things can’t change its footsteps, let alone restore a dying cell and turn it into a new cell.”
Many of the participants nodded.
They were all researchers and social elites, so they naturally leaned towards rationality. They were not like ordinary people in the countryside who believed in ghosts, gods, and Buddha.
Many people were already looking at Chen Yun differently.
He was simply a liar. He was no different from those masters who claimed that water could turn into oil.

Zhang Ming sat below and could no longer maintain the smile on his face. Some high-ranking officials and nobles also muttered in their hearts. Clearly, they did not believe Chen Yun’s words that the Heavenly Spirit Water could revive the cells and eliminate the negative effects.
“Hehe, you don’t have any biology foundation at all. Do you dare to show off here with some rumors online? You’ve really embarrassed China. You’re simply a joke!” Another young professor snorted.
“What if I have evidence?” Chen Yun asked slowly.
