chapters.title: Chapter 147: Shocking Everyone!
paragraphs: “Evidence?” Logan almost laughed. “What evidence can you find? Is it that the lizard was exposed to radiation and turned into the big monster Godzilla? Or is it that a soldier was injected with super serum and turned into Captain America? Or is it that four young men and women were mutated by cosmic rays in the universe and turned into the Fantastic Four?”

“Mr. Chen, sometimes, I really wonder if you’ve received proper biology education,” said Logan with a sharp glint in his eyes. “May I ask which university you graduated from? Who’s your teacher? Have you studied abroad? What results have you produced? Have you published a few papers in international journals?”
Logan had already begun to show his true colors.
If Chen Yun could not convince Logan and the many scholars below the stage, he would definitely be chased off the podium and his reputation would be ruined.
Everyone looked at Chen Yun intently, waiting for his answer.
After a while, the sneer on Logan’s face became stronger and stronger. He looked at Chen Yun.
“Your statement doesn’t hold true. I suspect that the effect of your product might be caused by hormones!”

Logan paused for a moment before saying sternly, “I’ve studied the free radical for so many years, but I haven’t discovered the secret of rejuvenating and reviving the dead. How can China, with its weak technological ability, create it? You’re just sensationalizing it!”
“Since you can’t answer our questions, get lost. I’m the absolute authority in this field!”

Logan berated angrily. Then, he looked at his assistant beside him and asked him to complain to the International Biotechnology Association. It was already ridiculous enough to hold a biotechnology conference in China. Now, China actually let such an ignorant, incompetent, and ridiculous person go on stage. What did they treat this conference as?! Did they treat it as child’s play?!
This time, their arrival was a mistake!
Then, he looked at his assistant. “Where are our experimental materials?”
“Professor, over here.”
“Alright.” Logan nodded and took the cage. He looked at a few of the white mice and slowly walked onto the stage.

At this moment, Logan looked down. “Everyone, I’ve said it before. I’m the expert in studying free radicals and anti-aging. Please take a look. These white mice are all my experimental subjects. They’ve already lived for three years.”
What?
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone below the stage was shocked. Three years!
Ordinary mice could only survive for two years. Two years was the limit, and they had never heard of three years.
At that moment, many people’s eyes lit up. This was a huge discovery for humans. Perhaps it could allow humans to break through their current lifespan and reach a higher level.
“This is magical. It’s too magical. It seems that Logan is really an expert in the field of free radicals and human science.”
“If he can make a breakthrough and apply this technology to humans, it will cause a sensation throughout the world. It might even become a scene that transcends the century.”

Words of praise spread, making the joy on Logan’s face even greater. Just as these people had said, if he could take another step forward, he would be able to leave a glorious mark in the history of humanity.

Moreover, he had come prepared today. He wanted to destroy Chen Yun’s lie and wipe out the reputation that Chen Yun had relied on his product to build in Jiangbei. At the same time, he would publicize his products. He would obtain more sponsorships and opportunities to work with others.
Compared to everyone’s praise for Logan, Chen Yun endured even more abuse.

Below him, the faces of the people from the Park Group were a little solemn. They looked at the man in the black suit in the middle. “Professor Nathan, it seems that Logan has indeed made good progress in free radical research.”
“Should we report this to the directors?”
The man listened to them and stroked his stubble. He pondered for a moment. “Alright, report it now. If the director agrees, we’ll work with Logan.”
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at Logan and sneered.
“Are you saying that there’s no medicine that can rejuvenate one’s youth? Are you saying that I’m sensationalizing this?”
“Ignorant fool, how dare you spout nonsense here!”
“You said that I had no evidence, right? I’ll show you!”
As soon as he said this, everyone present did not dare to believe what they had heard. Even the foreign experts and scholars widened their eyes and looked at Chen Yun on stage.
What did he just say?
Initially, they thought that Chen Yun had already been exposed by Logan.
But now, he actually wanted to prove it on the spot!

However, their shock only lasted for a moment before they sneered. After all, Logan had been doing research in this field for decades and had yet to make a breakthrough. Now, a Chinese kid actually dared to say that he had developed a divine medicine that could rejuvenate one’s youth. Wouldn’t that make them laugh their heads off?

Even the people from the Park Group sneered at this moment. Nathan shook his head. “How interesting. This can’t help but remind me of the feudal dynasties in China in the past. They were called the Kingdom of Ten Thousand Nations and ruled the world. In fact, they were just frogs at the bottom of a well. They simply made an empty show of strength. Under the enhancement of ships and advanced technology, the Kingdom of Ten Thousand Nations was like a paper tiger that could be broken at a touch.”

“Now, such a kid actually dares to say such words. It seems that after so many years, they still haven’t taught the Chinese how to be humble. Not only did they not restrain themselves at all, but even such a young man is talking nonsense on such an occasion.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the people beside him either flattered him or agreed. They all nodded in agreement.
At this moment, Chen Yun had already walked in front of Logan and snorted. “Your achievements are only superficial. How dare you question me here?”
Oh?

When Logan heard Chen Yun’s words, he chuckled and said to Chen Yun in inaccurate Chinese, “I understand what you just said. You said that you wanted to prove that your medicine can rejuvenate one’s youth, right?”
“Not bad.”

After saying these two words, Logan immediately laughed out loud, as if he had heard the most ridiculous joke in the world. Then, he looked at Chen Yun and nodded. Then, he took out a white rat that was so old that it could not move.

“This white rat has already lived for three years, which is equivalent to nearly 150 years in human age. Since you have medicine that can rejuvenate the target, let me see if you can make this dying white rat rejuvenate. If you don’t, hmph, I can guarantee that the future biotechnology conference will definitely not be held in China. Your country will completely become a joke. You don’t have to doubt my methods.”
Chen Yun ignored him. He took the white rat and dripped the Heavenly Spirit Water into its mouth.
Seeing Chen Yun’s actions, the other experts and scholars exclaimed softly. This kid was really good, but the cold mockery on their faces did not reduce at all.

However, slowly, the mockery on everyone’s faces condensed bit by bit, and the shock in their eyes became more and more intense. They looked at the stage and saw the white rat that Logan had given Chen Yun, who was about to die of old age, actually stand up and crawl around the table. The death intent from before was no longer there. Instead, it was filled with vitality.
How was this possible?!
For a moment, even the scholars began to be shocked and in disbelief.
Beside Chen Yun, Logan also gasped, and his eyes began to tremble. However, in the next moment, he pointed at Chen Yun. “No! This is adrenaline! Only adrenaline can make it do such a thing!”

This sentence made many people react. Adrenaline was a hormone. For example, the so-called ‘last-minute lucidity’ was the effect of adrenaline. When one was about to die, a large amount of adrenaline would be secreted, allowing one to instantly recover their consciousness and vitality. However, when the effect of adrenaline disappeared, one’s life would come to an end.
It was the same for humans and white rats.
At that moment, many scholars began to argue.
Chen Yun sneered when he heard Logan’s words. “Ignorant.”

Then, he waited at the side. Although Logan was furious when he heard this, he waited quietly at the side. After all, the effect of adrenaline only lasted for ten minutes. After ten minutes, he would know if the mouse was really revived or if it was dying.
Everyone below also knew his intentions and waited quietly.
Gradually, more and more people exclaimed.
It had been more than ten minutes, but the white rat was still alive and kicking!
It did not look like its vitality had dissipated at all!
What did this mean?!
Naturally, it went without saying!
Even Logan trembled and looked at Chen Yun.
This Chinese!
He had really developed a divine medicine to rejuvenate one’s youth!

“How is this possible? How can such a thing come from the hands of a Chinese?!” Logan shouted hysterically. Then, he looked at Chen Yun, his eyes shining. Then, he pounced forward, preparing to snatch the Heavenly Spirit Water from Chen Yun’s hand.
“Give me a taste. I want to personally verify if this is divine water!”

However, his feet stopped the next moment. Chen Yun grabbed Logan’s neck and snorted before throwing him out. Logan rolled twice on the ground. His original arrogance was gone, replaced by an indescribable sense of dejection.

The entire venue was already fanatical. Everyone’s eyes lit up, as if they were misers who had seen a mountain of gold. As for Logan, who had fallen to the ground, no one paid attention to him. Their gazes were all on Chen Yun and the Heavenly Spirit Water in his hand.

For the remaining time of the biotechnology conference, no one was in the mood to participate. After all, they, who were in the biological sciences, naturally knew the value of the Heavenly Spirit Water in Chen Yun’s hand. It was a supreme treasure. Compared to Chen Yun’s Heavenly Spirit Water, the research that they focused on seemed insignificant. As a result, no one was interested at all.

Chen Yun only demonstrated the effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water but did not reveal any core content. This also made a group of experts and scholars come to Chen Yun, wanting to obtain some information about the Heavenly Spirit Water from him.

At this moment, Chen Yun was surrounded by a group of world-class experts and scholars. Beside him, those experts and scholars were like humble students. They were extremely respectful to Chen Yun, and their faces were no longer as arrogant as before.

Other people from the international biotechnology groups also began to report to their own groups. After all, such news was too shocking. As the saying went, one could not miss the first opportunity. Such a huge opportunity would create an unprecedented number of profits.

The high-ranking officials and nobles at the side also saw the effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water with their own eyes. They immediately admired Chen Yun even more. All of them looked at Chen Yun as if they were looking at a god.

The desire for Heavenly Spirit Water in their hearts swelled infinitely. They knew that after today, not only would the supply of the Heavenly Spirit Water not be able to meet the demand in Jiangbei, but the entire world would go crazy for such a product!
However, Chen Yun sat there, as unmoving as a mountain, as if he did not see the people beside him. “Let’s go.”
“Sir! Please wait!”
The next moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
Everyone looked in the direction of the voice and their eyes widened.
It was them!
What did they want to do by speaking at this moment?!

sentences.text: “Evidence?” Logan almost laughed.
“What evidence can you find?
Is it that the lizard was exposed to radiation and turned into the big monster Godzilla?
Or is it that a soldier was injected with super serum and turned into Captain America?
Or is it that four young men and women were mutated by cosmic rays in the universe and turned into the Fantastic Four?”
“Mr.
Chen, sometimes, I really wonder if you’ve received proper biology education,” said Logan with a sharp glint in his eyes.
“May I ask which university you graduated from?
Who’s your teacher?
Have you studied abroad?
What results have you produced?
Have you published a few papers in international journals?”
Logan had already begun to show his true colors.
If Chen Yun could not convince Logan and the many scholars below the stage, he would definitely be chased off the podium and his reputation would be ruined.
Everyone looked at Chen Yun intently, waiting for his answer.
After a while, the sneer on Logan’s face became stronger and stronger.
He looked at Chen Yun.
“Your statement doesn’t hold true.
I suspect that the effect of your product might be caused by hormones!”
Logan paused for a moment before saying sternly, “I’ve studied the free radical for so many years, but I haven’t discovered the secret of rejuvenating and reviving the dead.
How can China, with its weak technological ability, create it?
You’re just sensationalizing it!”
“Since you can’t answer our questions, get lost.
I’m the absolute authority in this field!”
Logan berated angrily.
Then, he looked at his assistant beside him and asked him to complain to the International Biotechnology Association.
It was already ridiculous enough to hold a biotechnology conference in China.
Now, China actually let such an ignorant, incompetent, and ridiculous person go on stage.
What did they treat this conference as?!
Did they treat it as child’s play?!
This time, their arrival was a mistake!
Then, he looked at his assistant.
“Where are our experimental materials?”
“Professor, over here.”
“Alright.” Logan nodded and took the cage.
He looked at a few of the white mice and slowly walked onto the stage.
At this moment, Logan looked down.
“Everyone, I’ve said it before.
I’m the expert in studying free radicals and anti-aging.
Please take a look.
These white mice are all my experimental subjects.
They’ve already lived for three years.”
What?
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone below the stage was shocked.
Three years!
Ordinary mice could only survive for two years.
Two years was the limit, and they had never heard of three years.
At that moment, many people’s eyes lit up.
This was a huge discovery for humans.
Perhaps it could allow humans to break through their current lifespan and reach a higher level.
“This is magical.
It’s too magical.
It seems that Logan is really an expert in the field of free radicals and human science.”
“If he can make a breakthrough and apply this technology to humans, it will cause a sensation throughout the world.
It might even become a scene that transcends the century.”
Words of praise spread, making the joy on Logan’s face even greater.
Just as these people had said, if he could take another step forward, he would be able to leave a glorious mark in the history of humanity.
Moreover, he had come prepared today.
He wanted to destroy Chen Yun’s lie and wipe out the reputation that Chen Yun had relied on his product to build in Jiangbei.
At the same time, he would publicize his products.
He would obtain more sponsorships and opportunities to work with others.
Compared to everyone’s praise for Logan, Chen Yun endured even more abuse.
Below him, the faces of the people from the Park Group were a little solemn.
They looked at the man in the black suit in the middle.
“Professor Nathan, it seems that Logan has indeed made good progress in free radical research.”
“Should we report this to the directors?”
The man listened to them and stroked his stubble.
He pondered for a moment.
“Alright, report it now.
If the director agrees, we’ll work with Logan.”
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at Logan and sneered.
“Are you saying that there’s no medicine that can rejuvenate one’s youth?
Are you saying that I’m sensationalizing this?”
“Ignorant fool, how dare you spout nonsense here!”
“You said that I had no evidence, right?
I’ll show you!”
As soon as he said this, everyone present did not dare to believe what they had heard.
Even the foreign experts and scholars widened their eyes and looked at Chen Yun on stage.
What did he just say?
Initially, they thought that Chen Yun had already been exposed by Logan.
But now, he actually wanted to prove it on the spot!
However, their shock only lasted for a moment before they sneered.
After all, Logan had been doing research in this field for decades and had yet to make a breakthrough.
Now, a Chinese kid actually dared to say that he had developed a divine medicine that could rejuvenate one’s youth.
Wouldn’t that make them laugh their heads off?
Even the people from the Park Group sneered at this moment.
Nathan shook his head.
“How interesting.
This can’t help but remind me of the feudal dynasties in China in the past.
They were called the Kingdom of Ten Thousand Nations and ruled the world.
In fact, they were just frogs at the bottom of a well.
They simply made an empty show of strength.
Under the enhancement of ships and advanced technology, the Kingdom of Ten Thousand Nations was like a paper tiger that could be broken at a touch.”
“Now, such a kid actually dares to say such words.
It seems that after so many years, they still haven’t taught the Chinese how to be humble.
Not only did they not restrain themselves at all, but even such a young man is talking nonsense on such an occasion.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the people beside him either flattered him or agreed.
They all nodded in agreement.
At this moment, Chen Yun had already walked in front of Logan and snorted.
“Your achievements are only superficial.
How dare you question me here?”
Oh?
When Logan heard Chen Yun’s words, he chuckled and said to Chen Yun in inaccurate Chinese, “I understand what you just said.
You said that you wanted to prove that your medicine can rejuvenate one’s youth, right?”
“Not bad.”
After saying these two words, Logan immediately laughed out loud, as if he had heard the most ridiculous joke in the world.
Then, he looked at Chen Yun and nodded.
Then, he took out a white rat that was so old that it could not move.
“This white rat has already lived for three years, which is equivalent to nearly 150 years in human age.
Since you have medicine that can rejuvenate the target, let me see if you can make this dying white rat rejuvenate.
If you don’t, hmph, I can guarantee that the future biotechnology conference will definitely not be held in China.
Your country will completely become a joke.
You don’t have to doubt my methods.”
Chen Yun ignored him.
He took the white rat and dripped the Heavenly Spirit Water into its mouth.
Seeing Chen Yun’s actions, the other experts and scholars exclaimed softly.
This kid was really good, but the cold mockery on their faces did not reduce at all.
However, slowly, the mockery on everyone’s faces condensed bit by bit, and the shock in their eyes became more and more intense.
They looked at the stage and saw the white rat that Logan had given Chen Yun, who was about to die of old age, actually stand up and crawl around the table.
The death intent from before was no longer there.
Instead, it was filled with vitality.
How was this possible?!
For a moment, even the scholars began to be shocked and in disbelief.
Beside Chen Yun, Logan also gasped, and his eyes began to tremble.
However, in the next moment, he pointed at Chen Yun.
“No!
This is adrenaline!
Only adrenaline can make it do such a thing!”
This sentence made many people react.
Adrenaline was a hormone.
For example, the so-called ‘last-minute lucidity’ was the effect of adrenaline.
When one was about to die, a large amount of adrenaline would be secreted, allowing one to instantly recover their consciousness and vitality.
However, when the effect of adrenaline disappeared, one’s life would come to an end.
It was the same for humans and white rats.
At that moment, many scholars began to argue.
Chen Yun sneered when he heard Logan’s words.
“Ignorant.”
Then, he waited at the side.
Although Logan was furious when he heard this, he waited quietly at the side.
After all, the effect of adrenaline only lasted for ten minutes.
After ten minutes, he would know if the mouse was really revived or if it was dying.
Everyone below also knew his intentions and waited quietly.
Gradually, more and more people exclaimed.
It had been more than ten minutes, but the white rat was still alive and kicking!
It did not look like its vitality had dissipated at all!
What did this mean?!
Naturally, it went without saying!
Even Logan trembled and looked at Chen Yun.
This Chinese!
He had really developed a divine medicine to rejuvenate one’s youth!
“How is this possible?
How can such a thing come from the hands of a Chinese?!” Logan shouted hysterically.
Then, he looked at Chen Yun, his eyes shining.
Then, he pounced forward, preparing to snatch the Heavenly Spirit Water from Chen Yun’s hand.
“Give me a taste.
I want to personally verify if this is divine water!”
However, his feet stopped the next moment.
Chen Yun grabbed Logan’s neck and snorted before throwing him out.
Logan rolled twice on the ground.
His original arrogance was gone, replaced by an indescribable sense of dejection.
The entire venue was already fanatical.
Everyone’s eyes lit up, as if they were misers who had seen a mountain of gold.
As for Logan, who had fallen to the ground, no one paid attention to him.
Their gazes were all on Chen Yun and the Heavenly Spirit Water in his hand.
For the remaining time of the biotechnology conference, no one was in the mood to participate.
After all, they, who were in the biological sciences, naturally knew the value of the Heavenly Spirit Water in Chen Yun’s hand.
It was a supreme treasure.
Compared to Chen Yun’s Heavenly Spirit Water, the research that they focused on seemed insignificant.
As a result, no one was interested at all.
Chen Yun only demonstrated the effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water but did not reveal any core content.
This also made a group of experts and scholars come to Chen Yun, wanting to obtain some information about the Heavenly Spirit Water from him.
At this moment, Chen Yun was surrounded by a group of world-class experts and scholars.
Beside him, those experts and scholars were like humble students.
They were extremely respectful to Chen Yun, and their faces were no longer as arrogant as before.
Other people from the international biotechnology groups also began to report to their own groups.
After all, such news was too shocking.
As the saying went, one could not miss the first opportunity.
Such a huge opportunity would create an unprecedented number of profits.
The high-ranking officials and nobles at the side also saw the effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water with their own eyes.
They immediately admired Chen Yun even more.
All of them looked at Chen Yun as if they were looking at a god.
The desire for Heavenly Spirit Water in their hearts swelled infinitely.
They knew that after today, not only would the supply of the Heavenly Spirit Water not be able to meet the demand in Jiangbei, but the entire world would go crazy for such a product!
However, Chen Yun sat there, as unmoving as a mountain, as if he did not see the people beside him.
“Let’s go.”
“Sir!
Please wait!”
The next moment, a voice suddenly sounded.
Everyone looked in the direction of the voice and their eyes widened.
It was them!
What did they want to do by speaking at this moment?!

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Five Billion? Take It and Send the Beggars Away
paragraphs: At this moment, a group of people in suits and leather shoes walked over. The group of scholars looked at the people in front of them and retreated to the side respectfully.
They might not be very powerful, but their background was abnormally powerful.
It was the Park Group!
It was one of the most powerful financial groups in Korea!

At this moment, the young man in the lead looked at Chen Yun and extended his hand. “Mr. Chen, the effect of the potion in your hand just now really stunned us. Can we have lunch together? On behalf of the Park Corporation, I want to talk to you about a collaboration.”
The young man and the others looked arrogant. Their bodies were straight, and their expressions were even more arrogant.
“The Park Group?”
Chen Yun glanced at him. “I like to get straight to the point. Tell me, how are we going to collaborate?”
“The Park Corporation will pay five billion yuan. We hope that you can share the formula, but don’t worry. We will definitely not publicize the formula.”
Five billion!
When the many people beside them heard this, their eyes were filled with surprise!
This was too terrifying!
As expected of a large financial group!
How generous!
At that moment, everyone looked at Chen Yun. Even Zhang Ming looked at Chen Yun, preparing to hear his thoughts.
However, in the next moment, Chen Yun looked at the young man in front of him and chuckled. “Do you think I lack the five billion yuan?”
“Take your five billion and send the beggars away.”
“Do I lack the five billion yuan?”
When the experts and scholars who had been laughing at Chen Yun heard this, they were stunned. This young man was actually so rich.

However, before they could recover from their shock, Chen Yun had already left. A high-ranking official from Shi’en City looked at the Park Group and sneered. “Director Chen is the richest man in Jiang City!”
“He holds Sacred Heaven Entertainment in his hands and occupies the East Mountain Villa. He also has huge businesses and a divine medicine like the Heavenly Spirit Water.”
“A conservative estimate is that Director Chen’s assets are above 20 billion yuan. The Park Corporation only offered five billion yuan. They really look down on Director Chen.”
This person’s words not only shocked the experts and scholars beside him, but also the people from the Park Corporation.
He was a tycoon who had assets worth 20 billion yuan!
He was actually so young!
How was this possible?!
However!
The reality was right in front of them. They had to believe it even if they didn’t want to!
At that moment, the young man in the lead looked behind him. “Hurry up and tell the board of directors about the situation.”
“Okay.”
The young man looked at Chen Yun, his eyes darkening bit by bit. In so many years, this was the first time someone dared to disrespect him like this.
On the other side, Chen Yun was surrounded by a group of high-ranking officials and nobles. He was even invited to eat lunch.

During the meal, Chen Yun did not touch a single drop of alcohol. The high-ranking officials and nobles also drank until their glasses were dry. They were not dissatisfied with Chen Yun’s actions at all.
No!
They didn’t dare to be dissatisfied either!
After the meal, Chen Yun bade farewell to everyone. The high-ranking officials and nobles could tell that Chen Yun did not want them to accompany him, so they did not join him.
Zhang Ming also left first.
After Chen Yun finished eating, he went to the first floor. As soon as he walked out of the hotel, he exclaimed softly.
He suddenly saw a figure that should not have appeared here, but he did.
He immediately walked over.
In front, three girls were chatting and laughing, eating ice cream in their hands.
“Beauty, can we take a walk together?”
These words made the three of them immediately turn around.
“Wow!”
The two girls at the side looked at the handsome man in front of them. For a moment, they thought that some popular young hunk had run out of the filming venue.
Every part of him was just right. It simply made people unable to close their legs.
They looked at Chen Yun, and stars immediately appeared in their eyes.
Only the girl in the middle looked at Chen Yun with a strange glint in her eyes. “Chen Yun!”
“Huh?” The other two looked at the girl in the middle. “Huaiyao, is this your friend?”
“What friend? This is my childhood friend.” Zhang Huaiyao walked towards Chen Yun. She did not expect to meet him in her hometown. Now, she could actually meet him in Jiangbei.
“Why are you here?”
“What are you saying? I’m here for a meeting. Moreover, Jiang City isn’t far from here, right? As for you, why did you come from Yanwei?” Chen Yun asked with a smile.
“We’re here for an internship.” Zhang Huaiyao smiled at Chen Yun. “I’m an intern at Shi’en University. I’m an intern art teacher.”
“Oh right, oh right. I forgot to introduce you. Xuechun, Weimeng, this is Chen Yun.”
“Chen Yun, these are my two best friends, Pan Xuechun and Liu Weimeng.”
Chen Yun nodded at them and was about to speak.
[Check-in Mission]
[Two hours later, at Shi’en University.]
[Reward unknown.]
Heh, what a coincidence. Chen Yun looked at Zhang Huaiyao. “I don’t have anything to do now. Shall I go to your school to take a look?”

“Sure, but once I bring you in, you’re not allowed to cause any trouble for me. You’d better cover your face. Otherwise, if those female students see you, won’t they drag you into a small black room?” Zhang Huaiyao did not hide her words. It was as if she drove directly toward Chen Yun, causing the wheels to crush Chen Yun’s face.

“Alright, let’s be serious. I’m still in my internship period and haven’t been promoted to a full-time employee. If you really cause any trouble and they find out that I was the one who brought you in, I won’t be able to pass my internship period.”
Chen Yun immediately winked at Zhang Huaiyao. “I’ll help you become a regular employee.”
“Help... help me become a regular employee?”

Zhang Huaiyao was immediately confused. She could not understand how Chen Yun, who was not a leader in the school, could help her become a regular employee. She immediately thought that Chen Yun was joking.
Chen Yun looked at her expression and immediately raised his eyebrows. It seemed that Mengjun had not told her what had happened.
Actually, it was not Fang Mengjun’s fault. She had wanted to tell Zhang Huaiyao a few times, but she did not know where to start.
No matter what, it was too unrealistic.
When they arrived at the school, the students had just finished eating. When many girls saw Chen Yun, their eyes lit up. They were young girls who had just fallen in love.
Those around them were male students who had not entered society. Thus, they had never seen anyone as handsome as Chen Yun, who was wearing a suit.
Many girls had attended the public elective class taught by Zhang Huaiyao and the others, and they even came forward.
“Teacher Zhang!” A girl teased, “Teacher Zhang, is this the new teacher from our school?”
Beside her, a girl chuckled and said, “No, this is Teacher Zhang’s boyfriend.”
“Oh!” The girls immediately started cheering, causing Zhang Huaiyao’s face to turn red.
“Teacher Zhang’s face is red. Let’s quickly go back and spread the news.”
“Hey, you guys!” Zhang Huaiyao looked helpless. Rumors were fiercer than tigers.
When Chen Yun saw this situation, he asked softly, “Teacher Zhang? You’re quite popular with students.”
“Aiya! Don’t laugh at me!” Zhang Huaiyao’s exquisite face immediately turned red. She looked at Chen Yun and wished she could bite him.
“Heh, intern teachers these days are really getting more and more sloppy. She simply brought her boyfriend to university.”
A strange voice sounded from behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Smash Someone!
paragraphs: Chen Yun turned around and saw a woman in a long black silk dress. She looked to be in her forties and had taken good care of herself. She still had her charm, but her disdainful gaze was annoying.
“Teacher Zhou, he’s not my boyfriend. He’s my childhood friend,” said Zhang Huaiyao.
Teacher Zhou immediately sneered and observed Chen Yun with disdain. Then, she looked at Zhang Huaiyao. “Look at yourself. You’re about to stick to him. Would you believe what you said just now?”
After saying that, she walked towards the building where the teaching office was. She turned around and glanced at Zhang Huaiyao and the others. She said sternly, “Hurry up, or you’ll be late!”
After Teacher Zhou’s arrogant figure disappeared from the building, Chen Yun looked at Zhang Huaiyao and said, “Who is this old woman? Why is she so arrogant?”

Zhang Huaiyao frowned and said gloomily, “Her name is Zhou Fang. She’s our internship teacher and specializes in managing us. I heard from the previous seniors that this teacher isn’t much. Now that I look at it, this teacher is simply too much. She lets interns do all the dirty work and insults us.”

As she spoke, Zhang Huaiyao and the two girls beside her sighed. After all, they had no choice. If they wanted to pass the internship, they had to have the signatures of her and the Director of Teaching to become regular employees.
Therefore, no matter how much they were instructed, they had to obediently accept it and did not dare to complain.
Moreover, they had heard from their seniors that she had a special relationship with the Deputy Dean. Even the Director of Teaching had to respect her.
Zhang Huaiyao pulled Chen Yun and whispered to him, pouring out her bitterness.
“No wonder she’s so arrogant. It turns out that a man is protecting her.” Chen Yun pursed his lips and felt even more disdain for Teacher Zhou, who had relied on her body to climb up the ranks.

The four of them entered the teaching office building. As soon as they went up, Teacher Zhou pointed at the clock on the wall and shouted at Zhang Huaiyao, “Zhang Huaiyao, Pan Xuechun, Liu Weimeng, you’re 13 seconds late. You’re still interns, yet you’re already so irresponsible. If you become regular employees in the future, what will happen?”
“Also, look at you guys. You’re free and undisciplined. Hehe, you even want to be teachers. Dream on!”
The other interns in the teaching office looked at Zhang Huaiyao sympathetically, but no one dared to stand up for her.
This was because the last intern who contradicted Teacher Zhou was suddenly transferred to the school’s sports equipment warehouse the next day. It was said that he had already left.
“I’m sorry, Teacher Zhou. I’ll definitely be on time next time.”
Zhang Huaiyao apologized submissively. Teacher Zhou snorted and turned to walk towards the office. “With your qualities, do you want to become a regular employee? Hmph!”
Hearing this, Zhang Huaiyao’s expression turned ugly.
“Don’t worry, I’ll definitely help you settle it.” Chen Yun winked at Zhang Huaiyao and pulled her towards the internship teacher’s office. “Let’s settle this old witch first.”
Seeing Chen Yun go straight to Teacher Zhou like this, Zhang Huaiyao was shocked. She quickly pulled him back and said, “What do you plan to do?”
Chen Yun sneered and said, “It’s very simple. I’ll reason with her.”
Reason with her...
If reasoning was useful, why was she still so worried?

The corners of Zhang Huaiyao’s mouth twitched. She immediately felt that she had made a huge mistake by bringing Chen Yun here. She originally had a chance at becoming a regular employee, but it would probably be completely ruined.
Chen Yun took out his phone and sent a message. Then, he went down. When he returned, he was already holding a black leather suitcase.
Zhang Huaiyao looked at Chen Yun and was about to persuade him when she saw that he had already walked into the internship teacher’s office.
“Ah! No!”

Zhang Huaiyao shouted weakly in her heart. She hurriedly rushed forward, but she couldn’t make it in time. The expression on her face immediately collapsed as she said bitterly, “It’s over, it’s over. How can you reason with Teacher Zhou? It will only make her hate me even more.”
Although the internship teacher did not like Zhang Huaiyao, the other interns got along well with her.
At this moment, seeing her troubled expression, they all walked over.
“Huaiyao, ignore Monster Zhou. She’s targeting you everywhere because she’s jealous that you’re younger and prettier than her.”

“Your teaching and painting skills are very strong. You’re completely qualified for work. If you can’t become a full-time employee, it’s definitely because Monster Zhou and the old bastard picked on you. When the time comes, we’ll report it together.”
“It’s not like everyone doesn’t know the relationship between the Deputy Dean and Demon Zhou. If we report it, not only will it be useless, but all of us will also be put in a difficult position.”
“Then, we’ll directly report it to the Dean. I don’t believe that the Dean can’t deal with them.”
“The Dean? Even if he finds out, can he help us? We’re just some interns. How can the Dean offend someone for us?”

As the interns discussed, they felt that Zhang Huaiyao’s promotion was a very difficult problem. All of them looked worried. They felt that it wouldn’t be long before Zhang Huaiyao packed up and left.
Zhang Huaiyao didn’t want everyone to worry, so she forced a smile and said, “Don’t worry, everyone. Maybe I’ll stay.”
Maybe? Yes, that was just a possibility.

No one wanted to mention this sad matter. An intern asked, “By the way, Huaiyao, who was the man who entered the internship teacher’s office just now? He went upstairs with you just now. Could he be your boyfriend?”
“He’s not my boyfriend. He’s my childhood friend. Um, how should I put it? We’ve been very close since we were young. We’re like family.”
Zhang Huaiyao shook her head and looked at the closed door of the internship teacher’s office. She wondered what was going on inside.
“Hello, Teacher Zhou. Do you still remember me?”
Chen Yun entered the office and sat opposite the desk. He smiled at Teacher Zhou.
Zhou Fang was stunned for a moment. She frowned at Chen Yun and said angrily, “Who asked you to sit down? Hurry up and get out. If you want to plead for Zhang Huaiyao, you came to the wrong place.”

“I heard that if Huaiyao wants to become a regular employee, she needs your signature, so I wanted to discuss the price with you.” Chen Yun shrugged and said with an indifferent expression, “But since you refuse, I...”
“Wait.”
Upon hearing the word “price”, Zhou Fang hurriedly interrupted Chen Yun, her eyes almost shining.
The expression on her face changed, and a smile appeared on her face. “Young man, why are you in such a hurry? I know you. It seems that you’re Zhang Huaiyao’s boyfriend.”

Seeing Chen Yun nod, Zhou Fang also looked enlightened. She looked at Chen Yun and said, “Little brother, since we’ve come to this point, I won’t make things difficult for you. Give me 300,000 yuan. I won’t make things difficult for Huaiyao.”
Three hundred thousand yuan. These words immediately made Chen Yun’s eyes turn cold. She had a good appetite! It was just an internship. Did she need so much?
Chen Yun sneered in his heart, but he put on a matter-of-fact expression. “A price of 300,000 yuan is not much.”
Then, he opened the suitcase in his hand.
The next moment, Zhou Fang’s eyes widened. She looked into the suitcase and could not believe what she was seeing!
Red banknotes!
There were stacks of red notes!
They were neat and tidy!
It was as if they were blooming with a dazzling light!
There was so much cash! Zhou Fang had never seen it before!
There was at least a million yuan in this big suitcase!
It was so terrifying!
She really could not tell that this kid was so rich!
At this moment, she was shocked. Then, she regretted it deeply!
If she had known that this kid was so rich, she might as well have asked for more!
Meanwhile, Chen Yun took out stacks of money from the box and stacked them on the table. Just the 300,000 yuan on the table was already shocking enough!

Zhou Fang beamed with joy. “Aiya, little brother, what are you doing? How can I accept this? However, don’t worry. Since I took your money, I, Zhou Fang, will naturally make your girlfriend a regular employee.”
At that moment, she reached for the 300,000 yuan on the table.
However, in the next moment.
The moment she touched the red notes, a flashbulb suddenly lit up.
Zhou Fang looked up and saw Chen Yun holding his phone and smiling evilly. She was instantly stunned.
“I already have evidence that you take bribes. There are recordings and photos. If I publish them on the Internet, you should know the consequences.”
You!

Zhou Fang’s body suddenly trembled. Then, she saw Chen Yun walk past her calmly. He picked up a stack of red notes and weighed them in his hand. Then, he sneered and threw the stack of red notes at Zhou Fang’s face.
Pa!
Swoosh...
The stack of red notes scattered.
It scattered all over the ground!
Zhou Fang was stunned and stood rooted to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: I Like to Reason With Money!
paragraphs: Chen Yun put the remaining 290,000 yuan into the suitcase and put his phone in his pocket. Then, he whistled, stood up, and walked out the door.
Looking at Chen Yun’s figure, Zhou Fang realized that she had been tricked. She was so angry that her entire body was trembling.

Although the fact that she took bribes had not become an established fact, with the photos and recordings, if they were published online and spread by the netizens, it would have a huge negative impact on her.
At that time, the school would definitely expel her. As an internship teacher, she would have nothing left.
Therefore, as she watched Chen Yun walk out of the office, Zhou Fang was helpless. Moreover, she had to sign Zhang Huaiyao’s document for Zhang Huaiyao to become a regular employee.
“This kid is actually so cunning!”
Zhou Fang gritted her teeth in hatred. The pen in her hand broke as she hurriedly walked towards the office of Zhu Shoucheng, the Director of Teaching.

Chen Yun had gotten through her, but there was still Zhu Shoucheng. Even if she was threatened by the other party, she was definitely unwilling to let Zhang Huaiyao become a regular employee. She had to remind Zhu Shoucheng to prevent Zhu Shoucheng from being tricked by this kid.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun left the internship teacher’s office. Zhang Huaiyao was waiting at the door. When she saw him, she walked forward and asked, “How is it?”

“Actually, Teacher Zhou is very easy to talk to. After I reasoned with her, she agreed to sign your promotion document. She also praised you for your superb painting skills and hard work. You’re a rare talent.”
“Stop coaxing me.” Zhang Huaiyao sighed. “That’s true. I don’t want to stay here anymore.”
Zhang Huaiyao lowered her head. She originally thought that it was time to showcase her skills in society, but she did not expect society to be the true beginning of hell.
Just for an internship, not only were they instructed by Zhou Fang to do dirty work, but they were also scolded from time to time and threatened by the Director of Teaching.
Many girls were threatened by the Director of Teaching to drink with him and did not return to the dormitory at night.

According to the senior, the Director of Teaching, Zhu Shoucheng, had already obtained many girls through this method. Zhang Huaiyao had naturally been threatened by him, but Zhang Huaiyao did not give in.
Just as Zhang Huaiyao was feeling disappointed, Zhou Fang rushed out of the office. Chen Yun blurted out, “Teacher Zhou, you said that you agreed to let Huaiyao become a regular employee, right?”

When she saw Zhang Huaiyao, Zhou Fang was furious. However, she glanced at Chen Yun beside her and quickly put on a smile. She said to Zhang Huaiyao, “Of course, you’re a talent in our school. Of course, I’ll agree to your promotion.”
With that, Zhou Fang quickly walked away.
Zhang Huaiyao was also instantly stunned.

After receiving Zhou Fang’s affirmative answer, Zhang Huaiyao was overjoyed. Right after that, she stood rooted to the ground and looked up at Chen Yun. There was a huge question mark in her heart. Zhou Fang was so sarcastic and unreasonable. How did Chen Yun convince Zhou Fang?
Chen Yun smiled at Zhang Huaiyao and asked, “Where’s Director Zhu? I’ll reason with him.”
With the experience of persuading Zhou Fang, Zhang Huaiyao was now filled with confidence in Chen Yun. She pointed at the office at the end of the stairs and said, “Director Zhu is in the office.”
“Okay, leave it to me.”
Chen Yun made an OK gesture and turned to walk towards the office.
At this moment, Zhou Fang walked out of the office and shouted to Zhang Huaiyao, “Zhang Huaiyao, Director Zhu wants to see you.”
Zhang Huaiyao was delighted. She wondered if Director Zhu had also agreed to sign the document for her. She pulled Chen Yun back and said, “Wait a moment. I’ll go see him first.”
“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded.
Zhang Huaiyao walked into Director Zhu’s office with joy.

Behind the desk sat a slightly fat and bald middle-aged man. His eyes under the thick lenses emitted a sneaky glint. When he saw Zhang Huaiyao enter, he narrowed his eyes and smiled. “Huaiyao, come and sit.”
Zhang Huaiyao felt her hair stand on end from Director Zhu’s gaze. She laughed dryly and sat opposite Director Zhu.

Director Zhu’s gaze swept across Zhang Huaiyao’s voluptuous chest. He swallowed and said earnestly, “Huaiyao, I know you’re eager to become a regular employee, but I still have to test your business ability. How about you accompany me to meet a few leaders tonight?”
Upon hearing this, Zhang Huaiyao’s expression changed drastically. She said in a low voice, “Director Zhu, my business ability has nothing to do with accompanying you to meet leaders tonight, right?”

“How is it unrelated? Think about it. In the future, when you want to be evaluated as an associate professor or a professor, don’t you have to listen to the leaders? If you don’t have the ability to do this, it will affect your development in the future. Moreover, if you’re insensible and offend the leaders in the future, we’ll also be blamed. Don’t you think it’s serious?”

Director Zhu pulled a long face and snorted. He then said, “Huaiyao, I know your situation. This job is very important to you. Think about it. If you can’t become a regular employee, where else can you find such a good job?”

As he spoke, Director Zhu stood up and walked around the desk. He walked towards Zhang Huaiyao and smiled maliciously. “Actually, it’s very simple for you to become a regular employee. As long as you accompany me tonight, I’ll teach you some business skills. Everything will be fine.”
Pa.
What responded to Director Zhu was a resounding slap that stunned him.
Zhang Huaiyao stood up and dodged. She pointed at Director Zhu and said angrily, “You beast, even if I lose this job, I won’t give in.”
“Zhang Huaiyao, how dare you hit me!”

Director Zhu touched his burning cheek and was furious. He scolded, “You stinky b*tch, you slut. I definitely won’t sign your promotion document. Also, don’t think that I don’t know that you brought a man here. I won’t fall for your trap. Get lost!”
Zhang Huaiyao was so angry that her entire body was trembling. She glared fiercely at Director Zhu before turning around and running out of the office.
Although she knew that this action of hers would cause her to lose her job and put her in a difficult situation, she would never accept a man’s insult. This was her principle.
“Huaiyao, why are you crying?”

Chen Yun was outside the door and could hear some voices inside. Then, he looked at Zhang Huaiyao, who had run out of the office, and could not help but frown. He looked at the director’s office, and a ruthless expression flashed across his eyes.
Zhang Huaiyao wiped the tears from her eyes and smiled at Chen Yun. “It’s nothing. Let’s go.”
“Did that Director Zhu bully you?”

Chen Yun’s voice was a little gloomy, scaring Zhang Huaiyao. She looked at Chen Yun and suddenly felt that she had let him down. It must have been difficult for him to convince Teacher Zhou, but she had still messed up the matter of becoming a regular employee.
“Chen Yun, let’s go. I can’t stay in this school anymore.”
Zhang Huaiyao shook her head and reached out to pull Chen Yun, but Chen Yun avoided her.
Chen Yun sneered. “Leave it to me. I’ll go in and talk to Director Zhu.”
With that, Chen Yun pushed open the door and walked into Director Zhu’s office.
“Who are you? What are you doing here?”
Director Zhu looked at Chen Yun, who had barged into the office, and slammed the table.
Chen Yun turned around and walked towards the other party. “I’m Huaiyao’s friend. I want to reason with you.”

“Hmph, Teacher Zhou has already told me what happened. If you want to trick me, no way!” Director Zhu glanced at Chen Yun from the corner of his eye, grabbed the phone on the table, and quickly dialed. “I’m Director Zhu. Send security up immediately. Someone is causing trouble here.”
After hanging up, Director Zhu sneered at Chen Yun. “Kid, don’t leave if you have the guts. You’re dead meat.”
“Who said I wanted to leave? I still have to reason with you.” Chen Yun’s eyes were filled with a ferocious glint. He opened the leather suitcase and revealed a stack of hundred-yuan bills.
Chen Yun took out a stack and threw it at Director Zhu.
There was a cracking sound.
Director Zhu’s shoulder bone broke with a bang. It was so painful that he let out a miserable wail. He did not expect Chen Yun to throw money at him with such strength.
The red notes scattered and fell to the ground.
“You... Didn’t you say that you wanted to be reasonable?” Director Zhu dodged back. He was no longer as arrogant as before, and his eyes were filled with fear.
“I’m not willing to reason with my mouth or my fists. As for me, I’m not short of money.”
“That’s why I prefer to use money to reason.”

After Chen Yun and Director Zhu “reasoned”, Director Zhu’s face had already become like a pig’s head. His entire face was swollen and he lay on the ground, unable to move. He begged vaguely, “Master! Master, please let me go...”
“Let you go? Weren’t you quite arrogant just now?”
Chen Yun took out another stack of red notes and weighed them in his hand. He said coldly, “Do you know that scum like you are not worthy of living in this world?”
“I was wrong. I won’t harass her anymore. I’ll definitely sign her promotion document,” said Director Zhu with a trembling voice.

Chen Yun threw the red notes in his hand at Director Zhu’s face. A few more teeth fell out. Then, Chen Yun took a piece of tissue and wiped the blood off his shoes before turning around and leaving the office.
Zhang Huaiyao’s heart was about to jump out of her chest from waiting outside the office.
When she saw Chen Yun come out, she quickly went forward and said, “Let’s go, Chen Yun. I know I’ll definitely be fired.”
Chen Yun smiled calmly and said to Zhang Huaiyao, “What nonsense are you talking about? Director Zhu has already agreed to let you become a regular employee.”
“He... he agreed?!”
Zhang Huaiyao’s eyes widened and her tongue was tied. She could not believe her ears.

Previously, when Chen Yun convinced Teacher Zhou, she could still accept it. However, she had slapped Director Zhu just now. He definitely hated her to the core. How could he agree to promote her to a regular employee? How did Chen Yun do it?
If he had really reasoned with Director Zhu, his eloquence was too awesome.
Zhang Huaiyao looked at the smiling Chen Yun and felt that she could not understand the man in front of her. Why was it so simple when it was in his hands?
At this moment, five security guards walked over. They ignored Zhang Huaiyao and Chen Yun and walked straight into Director Zhu’s office.
“Holy shit!”
The security guards had just entered when they heard their exclamations.
All the security guards looked at the scene in front of them with shining eyes. There were red notes all over the ground!
There was so much money!
It was an impact on security guards like them, who earned thousands of yuan a month!
It was self-evident!

With the experience of persuading Zhou Fang, Zhang Huaiyao was now filled with confidence in Chen Yun.
She pointed at the office at the end of the stairs and said, “Director Zhu is in the office.”
“Okay, leave it to me.”
Chen Yun made an OK gesture and turned to walk towards the office.
At this moment, Zhou Fang walked out of the office and shouted to Zhang Huaiyao, “Zhang Huaiyao, Director Zhu wants to see you.”
Zhang Huaiyao was delighted.
She wondered if Director Zhu had also agreed to sign the document for her.
She pulled Chen Yun back and said, “Wait a moment.
I’ll go see him first.”
“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded.
Zhang Huaiyao walked into Director Zhu’s office with joy.
Behind the desk sat a slightly fat and bald middle-aged man.
His eyes under the thick lenses emitted a sneaky glint.
When he saw Zhang Huaiyao enter, he narrowed his eyes and smiled.
“Huaiyao, come and sit.”
Zhang Huaiyao felt her hair stand on end from Director Zhu’s gaze.
She laughed dryly and sat opposite Director Zhu.
Director Zhu’s gaze swept across Zhang Huaiyao’s voluptuous chest.
He swallowed and said earnestly, “Huaiyao, I know you’re eager to become a regular employee, but I still have to test your business ability.
How about you accompany me to meet a few leaders tonight?”
Upon hearing this, Zhang Huaiyao’s expression changed drastically.
She said in a low voice, “Director Zhu, my business ability has nothing to do with accompanying you to meet leaders tonight, right?”
“How is it unrelated?
Think about it.
In the future, when you want to be evaluated as an associate professor or a professor, don’t you have to listen to the leaders?
If you don’t have the ability to do this, it will affect your development in the future.
Moreover, if you’re insensible and offend the leaders in the future, we’ll also be blamed.
Don’t you think it’s serious?”
Director Zhu pulled a long face and snorted.
He then said, “Huaiyao, I know your situation.
This job is very important to you.
Think about it.
If you can’t become a regular employee, where else can you find such a good job?”
As he spoke, Director Zhu stood up and walked around the desk.
He walked towards Zhang Huaiyao and smiled maliciously.
“Actually, it’s very simple for you to become a regular employee.
As long as you accompany me tonight, I’ll teach you some business skills.
Everything will be fine.”
Pa.
What responded to Director Zhu was a resounding slap that stunned him.
Zhang Huaiyao stood up and dodged.
She pointed at Director Zhu and said angrily, “You beast, even if I lose this job, I won’t give in.”
“Zhang Huaiyao, how dare you hit me!”
Director Zhu touched his burning cheek and was furious.
He scolded, “You stinky b*tch, you slut.
I definitely won’t sign your promotion document.
Also, don’t think that I don’t know that you brought a man here.
I won’t fall for your trap.
Get lost!”
Zhang Huaiyao was so angry that her entire body was trembling.
She glared fiercely at Director Zhu before turning around and running out of the office.
Although she knew that this action of hers would cause her to lose her job and put her in a difficult situation, she would never accept a man’s insult.
This was her principle.
“Huaiyao, why are you crying?”
Chen Yun was outside the door and could hear some voices inside.
Then, he looked at Zhang Huaiyao, who had run out of the office, and could not help but frown.
He looked at the director’s office, and a ruthless expression flashed across his eyes.
Zhang Huaiyao wiped the tears from her eyes and smiled at Chen Yun.
“It’s nothing.
Let’s go.”
“Did that Director Zhu bully you?”
Chen Yun’s voice was a little gloomy, scaring Zhang Huaiyao.
She looked at Chen Yun and suddenly felt that she had let him down.
It must have been difficult for him to convince Teacher Zhou, but she had still messed up the matter of becoming a regular employee.
“Chen Yun, let’s go.
I can’t stay in this school anymore.”
Zhang Huaiyao shook her head and reached out to pull Chen Yun, but Chen Yun avoided her.
Chen Yun sneered.
“Leave it to me.
I’ll go in and talk to Director Zhu.”
With that, Chen Yun pushed open the door and walked into Director Zhu’s office.
“Who are you?
What are you doing here?”
Director Zhu looked at Chen Yun, who had barged into the office, and slammed the table.
Chen Yun turned around and walked towards the other party.
“I’m Huaiyao’s friend.
I want to reason with you.”
“Hmph, Teacher Zhou has already told me what happened.
If you want to trick me, no way!” Director Zhu glanced at Chen Yun from the corner of his eye, grabbed the phone on the table, and quickly dialed.
“I’m Director Zhu.
Send security up immediately.
Someone is causing trouble here.”
After hanging up, Director Zhu sneered at Chen Yun.
“Kid, don’t leave if you have the guts.
You’re dead meat.”
“Who said I wanted to leave?
I still have to reason with you.” Chen Yun’s eyes were filled with a ferocious glint.
He opened the leather suitcase and revealed a stack of hundred-yuan bills.
Chen Yun took out a stack and threw it at Director Zhu.
There was a cracking sound.
Director Zhu’s shoulder bone broke with a bang.
It was so painful that he let out a miserable wail.
He did not expect Chen Yun to throw money at him with such strength.
The red notes scattered and fell to the ground.
“You...
Didn’t you say that you wanted to be reasonable?” Director Zhu dodged back.
He was no longer as arrogant as before, and his eyes were filled with fear.
“I’m not willing to reason with my mouth or my fists.
As for me, I’m not short of money.”
“That’s why I prefer to use money to reason.”
After Chen Yun and Director Zhu “reasoned”, Director Zhu’s face had already become like a pig’s head.
His entire face was swollen and he lay on the ground, unable to move.
He begged vaguely, “Master!
Master, please let me go...”
“Let you go?
Weren’t you quite arrogant just now?”
Chen Yun took out another stack of red notes and weighed them in his hand.
He said coldly, “Do you know that scum like you are not worthy of living in this world?”
“I was wrong.
I won’t harass her anymore.
I’ll definitely sign her promotion document,” said Director Zhu with a trembling voice.
Chen Yun threw the red notes in his hand at Director Zhu’s face.
A few more teeth fell out.
Then, Chen Yun took a piece of tissue and wiped the blood off his shoes before turning around and leaving the office.
Zhang Huaiyao’s heart was about to jump out of her chest from waiting outside the office.
When she saw Chen Yun come out, she quickly went forward and said, “Let’s go, Chen Yun.
I know I’ll definitely be fired.”
Chen Yun smiled calmly and said to Zhang Huaiyao, “What nonsense are you talking about?
Director Zhu has already agreed to let you become a regular employee.”
“He... he agreed?!”
Zhang Huaiyao’s eyes widened and her tongue was tied.
She could not believe her ears.
Previously, when Chen Yun convinced Teacher Zhou, she could still accept it.
However, she had slapped Director Zhu just now.
He definitely hated her to the core.
How could he agree to promote her to a regular employee?
How did Chen Yun do it?
If he had really reasoned with Director Zhu, his eloquence was too awesome.
Zhang Huaiyao looked at the smiling Chen Yun and felt that she could not understand the man in front of her.
Why was it so simple when it was in his hands?
At this moment, five security guards walked over.
They ignored Zhang Huaiyao and Chen Yun and walked straight into Director Zhu’s office.
“Holy shit!”
The security guards had just entered when they heard their exclamations.
All the security guards looked at the scene in front of them with shining eyes.
There were red notes all over the ground!
There was so much money!
It was an impact on security guards like them, who earned thousands of yuan a month!
It was self-evident!
